jobs.title: Implementation Engineer, Customer Support (APAC)
jobs.excerpt: Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere.
jobs.description:
Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California. Learn more at .

Bitwarden is committed to delivering the best possible experience for users when accessing and managing their sensitive information. The Customer Success team helps customers and all Bitwarden users meaningfully engage with Bitwarden products while proactively planning for user growth, service availability, and to ultimately achieve their desired outcome. Team members have excellent product knowledge, superb technical skills, stellar grammar, attention to detail, and the ability to explain complicated things simply. Success is measured in diligence, precision, transparency, and customer assessment.

Bitwarden is looking for a server and cloud enthusiast, with experience in both communicating about and deploying these technologies. You will become a Bitwarden product expert and handle business inquiries regarding our products, troubleshooting technical issues, completing systems integrations, and ensuring customer satisfaction.

This is an all-remote team and we’re looking for someone located in the APAC region.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Functioning as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Bitwarden and the entire product portfolio
  • Leading proof-of-concept trials with customers, new deployments, and/or integrations of Bitwarden containerized services
  • Advising customers on industry best practices for the full stack of Bitwarden
  • Working with enterprise customers to solve issues and/or look ahead to identify solutions to situations they may face in the future
  • Providing superb guidance and assistance for each business prospect or customer’s implementation of Bitwarden, integration with the rest of their technology stack, and general security
  • Collaborating with Sales, Engineering, and Product associates
  • Assist in planning, developing, and presenting live technical product demonstrations showcasing best practices scaled to the customer’s use-case
  • Document and share customer feedback from collaborative sessions to help the Bitwarden team exceed expectations

WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN

  • Excellent English and grammar
  • Excellent problem-solving skills (you might not know all the answers but you know how to find and communicate the solutions)
  • Project planning, including collaborative and individual time management
  • A passion for supporting your team members, growing together (technical ability and emotional intelligence), and sharing your knowledge with all
  • A strong sense of empathy and the ability to advocate for others
  • A passion for helping Bitwarden users
  • Experience from a previous technical position (e.g. Systems Engineer, Implementation Engineer, DevOps Engineer, IT Infrastructure Engineer, etc). Equivalent education or demonstrable skills may be accepted
  • Ability and desire to work remotely

Familiarity with several of the following areas/technologies is preferred:

  • Bitwarden
  • Linux, Windows, and macOS
  • Docker, Kubernetes, and Podman
  • NFS and CIFS
  • Bash and PowerShell
  • Active Directory, LDAP, Google Workspace, Azure Entra ID, Jumpcloud, Cloudflare and Okta
  • GCP, AWS, and Azure
  • Android and iOS
  • GitHub
  • NGINX
  • SQL
  • TCP/IP
  • DNS
  • HTTP
  • SMTP
  • SSO implementation and best practices (SAML and OpenID Connect)
  • Integrating SCIM solutions
  • TLS/SSL and PKI
  • RESTful APIs

WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Meeting with our Recruiting Manager
  • Interview with Manager of Implementation Engineering
  • Interview with Implementation Engineering team members
  • Interview with Chief Customer Officer & VP of Customer Success

A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US

  • Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.
  • Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software.
  • We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world.
  • Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with the support of your team, and join our #growth-club to continue personal and professional development.

jobs.title: Manager, Paid Search
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT QUINCEQuince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo.
jobs.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Manager, Paid Search (PLA)

We are seeking a Manager, Paid Search to join our growing team. This role will lead and scale high-performing Shopping (PLA) and Text Ad campaigns across Google and emerging search platforms, with a strong focus on feed optimization, testing, and ecommerce growth. In this role, you will drive performance, scalability, and innovation across paid search programs, helping accelerate customer acquisition and support the company’s continued growth.

Responsibilities

  • Play a crucial role in Quince’s growth story managing one of biggest channels which has grown 400% YoY and continued growth potential.
  • Support the end-to-end Paid Search strategy across Shopping (PLA) and Text Ads, driving performance, scalability, and innovation across Google and emerging engines such as Bing and Brave.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 5+ years of managing Paid Search programs with large budgets with a focus on product listing ads
  • Strong understanding of feed-based advertising and product-level optimization
  • Proven experience with title testing, image testing, and structured experimentation
  • Experience building and managing highly granular PLA account structures
  • Experience working with large product catalogs in ecommerce environment
  • Expertise in implementing measures to improve Quality scores, CTR’s and managing large portfolio of cross category keywords
  • Expertise in Google Adwords, Google Ads editor along with experience in Bing Ads
  • In-depth understanding of Paid Search campaign management and optimization best practices
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to leverage data to drive decision-making.
  • Be a proactive self-starter who enjoys a fast-paced, results-oriented work environment
  • Have strong program management and organizational skills, being able to manage multiple projects, deadline and priorities with ease
  • Test, Learn and Scale mindset
  • Strong proficiency in Google sheets/Excel
  • Experience with Google Ads scripts

Preferred:

  • Experience with visualization & analytical tools like Looker and SQL
  • Experience with tools like SA360, SKAI or Marin
  • Understanding of attribution models, measurement frameworks, and automation tools.
  • Experience with international search programs
  • Background in ecommerce or marketplace environments
  • Familiarity with feed management tools (e.g., GMC rules, supplemental feeds, third-party tools)
  • Understanding of merchandising, inventory, and margin-driven bidding strategies

Pay Range: $138,000 - $183,000

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

Pay Range
$138,000—$183,000 USD

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

jobs.excerpt: Sobre nosotros Innovación.  Sostenibilidad.  Productividad.
jobs.description:
Sobre nosotros

Innovación. Sostenibilidad. Productividad. Así es como estamos abriendo nuevos caminos en nuestra misión de promover de manera sostenible la noble labor de los agricultores y constructores de todo el mundo. Con una población mundial en crecimiento y una mayor demanda de recursos, nuestros productos son fundamentales para alimentar y dar cobijo al mundo.

Desde el desarrollo de productos que funcionan con energías alternativas hasta tecnología de precisión que mejora la productividad, ofrecemos soluciones que benefician a las personas, y esto es posible gracias a personas como usted. Si le entusiasma la oportunidad de desarrollar sus habilidades como parte de un equipo global y colaborativo, está en el lugar correcto.

Haga crecer su carrera. ¡Construya un futuro!

Forme parte de esta empresa a la vanguardia de la agricultura y la construcción, que innova con pasión para impulsar la eficiencia y el éxito de los clientes. Y sabemos que la innovación no puede ocurrir sin colaboración. Por eso, todo lo que hacemos en CNH Industrial consiste en alcanzar nuevas metas como un solo equipo, cumpliendo siempre por el bien de nuestros clientes.

Objetivo del puesto

  • El candidato seleccionado apoyará el desarrollo de vehículos todoterreno de próxima generación, contribuyendo a las decisiones de ingeniería desde las fases iniciales de desarrollo de concepto hasta la validación final del producto.
  • El ingeniero de rendimiento de vehículos y potencia fluida es responsable de definir, evaluar y optimizar el rendimiento a nivel de vehículo mediante análisis de ingeniería, simulaciones virtuales, modelado de sistemas y actividades de correlación experimental, trabajando en sistemas de tren motriz, transmisión, hidráulicos, electrificados y de vehículo.
  • Se solicitará al candidato que realice simulaciones de concepto en fase temprana, lo que permitirá realizar estudios de compensación de arquitectura y evaluaciones virtuales de tecnologías emergentes antes de que el hardware esté disponible, dentro de proyectos multidisciplinarios complejos coordinados en organizaciones de ingeniería globales.
  • El candidato seleccionado contribuirá a la evaluación de soluciones innovadoras, incluidos sistemas avanzados de potencia fluida, trenes motrices híbridos, electrificación de vehículos y tecnologías de combustibles alternativos, apoyando la transición hacia máquinas todoterreno más sostenibles y eficientes.

Responsabilidades clave

Ingeniería de rendimiento de vehículos

  • Analizar y optimizar la productividad del vehículo, la eficiencia del combustible, la utilización de energía y el rendimiento general de la máquina.
  • Apoyar el establecimiento de objetivos del vehículo y la definición de requisitos.
  • Realizar análisis de flujo de potencia y balance energético a nivel de vehículo.
  • Evaluar la eficiencia de la transmisión, la capacidad de tracción y el rendimiento operativo.
  • Realizar evaluaciones comparativas competitivas y evaluaciones de tecnología.

Ingeniería de potencia fluida

  • Desarrollar y validar arquitecturas, subsistemas y componentes hidráulicos.
  • Analizar la eficiencia hidráulica y las pérdidas de potencia a nivel de componente, subsistema y vehículo.
  • Optimizar el rendimiento del sistema considerando estrategias de control, consumo de energía y perfiles de uso del cliente.
  • Apoyar la definición de soluciones innovadoras de potencia fluida para futuras plataformas de vehículos.

Hibridación, electrificación y combustibles alternativos

  • Apoyar estudios de viabilidad y actividades de integración de sistemas para arquitecturas de vehículos híbridos y electrificados.
  • Evaluar estrategias de gestión de energía entre subsistemas convencionales y electrificados.
  • Evaluar los flujos de energía, la utilización de la batería y la eficiencia general del sistema.
  • Analizar el impacto de los combustibles alternativos (HVO, biodiésel, GNL, GNC, hidrógeno y futuras soluciones bajas en carbono) en el rendimiento y la eficiencia del vehículo.
  • Apoyar las hojas de ruta tecnológicas y las actividades de selección de conceptos para el desarrollo sostenible de vehículos.

Desarrollo de conceptos en fase temprana e ingeniería virtual

  • Realizar simulaciones de concepto en fase temprana para respaldar las decisiones de arquitectura antes de la disponibilidad de prototipos.
  • Realizar análisis de compensación entre conceptos y tecnologías en competencia.
  • Desarrollar metodologías de evaluación virtual para el rendimiento del vehículo, economía de combustible, productividad y eficiencia hidráulica.
  • Apoyar iniciativas de ingeniería "shift-left" a través de enfoques de desarrollo basados en modelos.
  • Generar recomendaciones basadas en datos para acelerar el desarrollo y reducir el riesgo del programa.

Simulación y modelado de sistemas

  • Desarrollar y mantener modelos de simulación de alta fidelidad y de orden reducido.
  • Ejecutar actividades de validación virtual a nivel de componente, subsistema y vehículo completo.
  • Correlacionar los resultados de la simulación con las mediciones experimentales.
  • Apoyar los procesos de ingeniería basados en modelos a lo largo del ciclo de desarrollo del producto.
  • Utilizar entornos de simulación como AMESim, MATLAB/Simulink y otras herramientas de análisis de ingeniería.

Liderazgo de proyectos y gestión de partes interesadas

  • Liderar flujos de trabajo técnicos dentro de proyectos multidisciplinarios complejos.
  • Coordinar actividades entre equipos de ingeniería globales y múltiples partes interesadas.
  • Impulsar la alineación técnica y los procesos de toma de decisiones.
  • Presentar resultados de simulación, recomendaciones técnicas y actualizaciones de proyectos a la dirección y al liderazgo de ingeniería.
  • Apoyar la planificación de proyectos, la identificación de riesgos y las actividades de mitigación.
  • Interactuar con proveedores, socios de investigación y organizaciones de ingeniería externas cuando sea necesario.

Experiencia requerida

HABILIDADES TÉCNICAS (HARD SKILLS)

  • Máster en ingeniería mecánica, automotriz, energética o aeroespacial, o equivalente.
  • Experiencia profesional en la industria todoterreno, agrícola, de construcción, automotriz o de vehículos comerciales - años de experiencia: 3-5
  • Conocimiento de los principios de rendimiento del vehículo, tren motriz, transmisión y gestión de energía.
  • Conocimiento de sistemas de potencia fluida: arquitecturas hidráulicas, subsistemas, componentes, eficiencia y pérdidas de potencia.
  • Conocimiento de arquitecturas de vehículos todoterreno híbridos y electrificados, gestión de energía del vehículo y tecnologías de combustibles alternativos (HVO, biodiésel, GNL, GNC, hidrógeno).
  • Conocimiento de entornos de simulación como AMESim, MATLAB/Simulink y otras herramientas de análisis de ingeniería.
  • Enfoque de ingeniería de sistemas; la exposición a la ingeniería de sistemas basada en modelos (MBSE) sería una ventaja.
  • Técnicas avanzadas de optimización y diseño de experimentos (DoE), análisis de datos y herramientas de visualización.
  • Ingeniería digital y metodologías de validación virtual; aplicaciones de inteligencia artificial para flujos de trabajo de ingeniería (preferido).

HABILIDADES INTERPERSONALES (SOFT SKILLS)

  • Sólida mentalidad de ingeniería de sistemas y excelentes habilidades analíticas.
  • Capacidad para traducir información técnica compleja en recomendaciones prácticas que impulsen las decisiones comerciales y de producto.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y presentación, con la capacidad de presentar resultados de simulación y recomendaciones técnicas a la dirección y al liderazgo de ingeniería.
  • Capacidad para coordinar actividades entre equipos de ingeniería globales y múltiples partes interesadas (ingeniería de producto, controles, validación, fabricación, gestión de programas, proveedores y socios técnicos).
  • Capacidad para trabajar tanto de forma autónoma como parte de un equipo multidisciplinario global.
  • Compromiso con los plazos, hitos y cronogramas establecidos.
  • Disponibilidad para viajes nacionales e internacionales.

Cualificaciones preferidas

  • Dispuesto y preparado para asumir la responsabilidad y la rendición de cuentas en sus propias acciones y decisiones.
  • Esforzarse por lograr la autonomía.
  • Comunicación abierta y transparente
  • Brindar un apoyo incondicional y superar las expectativas
  • Orientado a objetivos y soluciones (y no a obstáculos).

Transparencia salarial

El salario anual para este puesto es de 39.000,00 € - 52.000,00 € EUR más cualquier bonificación aplicable (los salarios reales variarán y se basarán en diversos factores, como las habilidades, la experiencia y la cualificación para el puesto).

Para los puestos abiertos en múltiples ubicaciones, el rango salarial indicado se refiere a la ubicación principal. Si se considera una ubicación diferente, el rango salarial aplicable se comunicará a los candidatos antes de la primera entrevista.

Lo que ofrecemos

Ofrecemos oportunidades profesionales dinámicas en un entorno internacional. Como empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades, estamos comprometidos a generar valor para todos nuestros empleados y fomentar una cultura de respeto.

En CNH, entendemos que las mejores soluciones provienen de las diversas experiencias y habilidades de nuestra gente. Aquí, usted tendrá la capacidad de desarrollar su carrera, seguir su pasión y ayudar a construir un futuro mejor. Para apoyar a nuestros empleados, ofrecemos beneficios integrales regionales, que incluyen:

  • Acuerdos de trabajo flexible
  • Beneficios de ahorro y jubilación
  • Reembolso de matrícula
  • Permiso parental
  • Asistencia para la adopción
  • Apoyo a la fertilidad y la planificación familiar
  • Programas de asistencia al empleado
  • Igualación de contribuciones benéficas y tiempo libre para voluntariado

jobs.title: Account Executive - Mid Market, West Coast
jobs.excerpt: About ThatchFor most people, health insurance is something that happens to them: a plan chosen by someone else, with little room to fit their life.
jobs.description:
About Thatch

For most people, health insurance is something that happens to them: a plan chosen by someone else, with little room to fit their life. Thatch is changing that. We help companies give every employee a real healthcare budget instead of a one-size-fits-all plan, so people can choose the coverage and care that works for them, and employers get predictable costs they can control.

It’s a simple idea, but making it real means solving hard problems across healthcare, payments, and technology, and we’re just getting started. We look for people who like solving complex problems, use good judgment, and are comfortable working through ambiguity. People here care deeply about our customers, take real responsibility for what gets built, and are driven by doing work that matters.

About the role

We’re looking for a consultative, strategic Account Executive to join our Mid-Market sales team at Thatch, owning a market within our West territory. Alongside our Broker partners, you will work with HR, finance, and executive stakeholders at companies with 100+ employees to solve complex healthcare challenges. This is an ideal role for someone who can run an exceptional sales process, influence high-level decisions, and help us build a category-defining business.

Where this role is based

This role covers the West territory. You’ll own the market where you live. We’re prioritizing candidates who are based in, and well networked in, the market they’d cover. We’re hiring reps who live in, and already have broker relationships in the following markets: Los Angeles, San Francisco Bay Area, Seattle, Portland, Denver, Phoenix.

Please apply to only one territory job post (East, Central, West): the one that includes your market.

What you'll do

  • Lead high-stakes consultative sales processes with companies navigating complex benefits needs across your assigned territory.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to executive-level buyers in your market, uncovering deep needs and aligning them to Thatch’s solutions.
  • Work cross functionally with product teams to refine positioning for this segment.
  • Analyze and share insights on the competitive landscape in your market, influencing go-to-market strategy.
  • Drive forecasting accuracy and pipeline health for the regional territory through disciplined sales operations.
  • Build relationships with existing and new broker partners across your market.
  • Travel within your assigned territory to build relationships and support broker partners.

Background we're looking for

  • 3+ years of experience in group benefits mid-market consulting, specifically tier 1 or tier 2 brokerage firm background, healthcare carrier field representation, payroll sales, or HR tech / SaaS sales is a requirement.
  • An established network of brokers and benefits professionals in your market, and a clear plan for where you’d prospect first.
  • Strong working knowledge of group medical plans: you can read SBCs, analyze a group’s current benefits, and support quoting. You also understand the basics of underwriting, including plan design, contribution strategies, and key cost and risk drivers.
  • Skilled at leading discovery, building business cases, and influencing multiple stakeholders across finance, HR, and executive teams.

Experience we’d be particularly excited about

  • You’ve built a book of business from scratch and enjoy outbound prospecting.
  • Inquisitive and thoughtful — you know how to ask the right questions and listen deeply
  • Passionate about creating a healthcare system that people will love.
  • Comfortable managing long and potentially very quick sales cycles and adapting to shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Someone who consistently embodies the Thatch brand and effectively represents our broker partners and clients.

What to expect

We interview rigorously based on integrity, talent, and drive; the trust we display in our teammates from day 1 is a reflection of the confidence we have in this process. We aim to evaluate the things you’ll be doing every day as best we can, and we move quickly. Here's what to expect:

  • 30 minute video meeting to talk through your background, your market, and your interest in Thatch
  • 30 minute video meeting with the hiring manager to dive deeper into your sales experience, your broker network, and how you’d build a book in your market
  • 30 minute video meeting to meet 2 members of our sales team to discuss your market knowledge, sales approach, and how you’d operate at Thatch
  • 30 minute working session with the hiring manager to go over a practical assessment focused on a real scenario you’d see in this role. We’ll share details ahead of time
  • 30 minute video meeting with the department head about the mid-market motion and your approach to building a territory
  • 30 minute video meeting with one of our founders to discuss your approach to culture and our operating principles

Please note: The posted compensation range reflects On-Target Earnings (OTE), not base salary.

Estimated Compensation Range
$200,000—$300,000 USD

jobs.title: Head of Product Operations
jobs.excerpt: YOUR MISSIONMake Nulogy's Product and Engineering organization run like a well-oiled machine, and make sure the rest of the company can see, trust, and act on what it builds.
jobs.description:
YOUR MISSION

Make Nulogy's Product and Engineering organization run like a well-oiled machine, and make sure the rest of the company can see, trust, and act on what it builds. As a member of the Product Leadership Team, you will own the operating system behind how we plan, deliver, measure, and launch product. You will connect the voice of our customers and go-to-market teams to the roadmap, give leadership clear visibility into delivery and outcomes, and ensure every release lands with customers and colleagues who know exactly what changed and why it matters.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Keep the trains running on time across Product and Engineering. Build and run an effective operating rhythm, including planning, roadmap reviews, and delivery check-ins, with one trusted view of every initiative's timeline, dependencies, and risks.
  • Raise delivery predictability. Support and coach Product Managers and Engineering Managers to plan realistically, spot delivery risk early, and act on it.
  • Close the loop between go-to-market and Product. Maintain a living log of product needs from new-logo and existing-customer opportunities, tied to pipeline and ARR, and track friction points across the customer lifecycle with Customer Success and Professional Services.
  • Put the right data behind product decisions. Centralize data from our product, delivery, customer, and revenue systems so PMs and leaders can answer key questions without hunting for numbers.
  • Build trust through KPIs, reporting, and transparency. Define core product and delivery KPIs with the Product Leadership Team, and own the dashboards and reporting that feed executive, board, and all-hands updates.
  • Align the organization around what we're building. Make sure Product and Engineering plans are understood across GTM, Customer Success, Services, Finance, and leadership, and that every release lands through release notes, customer communications, and internal enablement.
  • Be present with customers. Join customer visits, calls, and reviews, and bring what you hear back into planning.
  • Be a right hand to the CPO. Drive the day-to-day of the product organization, prepare executive communication briefs, and lead special projects as they come up.

EXPERIENCE & SKILL REQUIREMENTS
  • 8+ years in product operations, program or delivery management, product management, business operations, or a chief-of-staff-style role at a B2B SaaS company, including 3+ years working across Product and Engineering.
  • A track record of running an operating rhythm and tracking delivery across multiple product and engineering teams, including coaching teams to improve predictability.
  • Hands-on experience centralizing data from multiple systems into a single view
  • Experience building KPIs and reporting that executives relied on for decisions.
  • Strong executive communication: you've written leadership briefs, executive updates, or board materials.
  • Comfortable working directly with customers, including on-site visits.
  • Experience as a trusted partner to a senior leader, owning day-to-day operations and special projects.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and follow-through.
  • AI-first operating habits: you use AI tools daily in your own work.
  • Able to travel as needed for customer visits and team offsites approximately 1-2x a quarter
  • Experience in enterprise SaaS serving supply chain, manufacturing, or logistics.
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as Jira and Confluence, Pendo, Salesforce or HubSpot.
  • Experience running release communications or launch programs for customers and internal teams.
  • Experience measuring product adoption and usage.
  • A background as a Product Manager, Engineering Manager, Program Manager, or Chief of Staff to a product or engineering leader.
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Nulogy is a manufacturing technology company driven by a vision to make life better for the people who plan, produce, and deliver the products we use every day.
Nulogy’s Manufacturing Operating System helps manufacturers and packagers automate every stage of the production process—from inventory to quality—which reduces operating costs, increases efficiency, and boosts customer satisfaction. Hundreds of manufacturing sites around the world are powered by Nulogy, and our software also runs in the networks of world-leading brands such as Colgate-Palmolive, L’Oréal, and Procter & Gamble.

Nulogy has grown rapidly over the last decade, and we are proud to be recognized with a number of awards including: Canada’s Top Small & Medium Employers, Food Logistics Top 100 Software Provider, and Canada's Most Admired Corporate Culture. Nulogy has also received multiple awards for company culture, the most recent being one of Canada’s Top Small & Medium Employers for 2024, Great Place to Work 2025 & Greater Toronto’s Top Employers for 2025.

jobs.excerpt: About PolarGridPolarGrid is an early-stage Canadian company that runs managed AI inference.
jobs.description:
About PolarGrid

PolarGrid is an early-stage Canadian company that runs managed AI inference. A customer brings a model or a serving image. We run it on dedicated GPUs behind one endpoint, serve each request from the nearest site, and move traffic to the next nearest site when one fails.

Our goal is to make AI inference fast, reliable, and secure for customers running production workloads.

The Role

This role is responsible for scaling PolarGrid's inference network from a handful of sites to a geographically distributed fleet of GPU clusters. The GPU Infrastructure Engineer will own how new sites and nodes come online, from provisioning and burn-in through validation and a staged move into production. They will define when a site is ready for customer traffic, and make sure each new site joins the network without hurting latency or reliability.

A core responsibility is running the global routing layer that sends each request to the best place to serve it. The GPU Infrastructure Engineer will work with live signals such as network latency, capacity and health, and tune routing against real traffic to keep latency low and predictable.

The role also owns reliability across the network. The GPU Infrastructure Engineer will set and track availability targets, build the health checks and automation that detect and route around failing hardware and models, keep recovery fast, and test failure handling regularly.

The GPU Infrastructure Engineer will build the observability, release and network systems needed to run a distributed GPU fleet without operations work growing with every new site. This includes end-to-end tracing and latency alerting, safe staged rollouts, network configuration as code, and security and DDoS protection at the edge.

Requirements

  • Experience operating distributed systems across multiple sites or regions with high availability targets
  • Strong networking fundamentals: BGP, DNS, TCP/TLS and load balancing
  • Hands-on experience running bare-metal GPU fleets: provisioning, burn-in, firmware and node lifecycle
  • InfiniBand or RDMA networking experience
  • Experience running LLM inference engines such as vLLM, SGLang or TensorRT-LLM, including multi-node serving, cold starts and TTFT
  • Deep observability skills focused on p95/p99 latency and gray failures, not just uptime
  • Experience designing failover, graceful degradation and automated recovery
  • Strong automation and infrastructure-as-code mindset, including CI/CD for infrastructure
  • Ability to plan capacity on constrained, uneven hardware supply
  • Experience building internal tooling or control planes, ideally in Go or Rust

Nice to Have

- DDoS mitigation experience

- Running DNS infrastructure at scale

  • Hardware security: TPM, measured boot or confidential computing
  • Real-time streaming inference, including voice and audio
  • Operating remote datacenter sites with on-site technicians
  • Certificate automation across many domains

- Deterministic simulation testing

jobs.description:
Chief Program Officer (CPO) – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Chief Program Officer (CPO) is responsible for overseeing the organization's strategic programs, enterprise-wide initiatives, and complex, multi-project portfolios across its insurance and investment businesses.

The role ensures that major programs are strategically aligned, properly resourced, effectively governed, and successfully delivered within approved timelines and budgets. The CPO will establish program management standards, coordinate cross-functional teams, manage interdependent projects, and ensure that strategic initiatives deliver measurable business outcomes.

Working closely with the CEO, Board, and executive leadership team, the CPO will translate corporate priorities into coordinated programs that support business growth, operational excellence, digital transformation, regulatory compliance, and organizational development.

2. Key Responsibilities

Strategic Program Management

  • Develop and implement the organization's enterprise-wide program management strategy.
  • Identify, structure, prioritize, and oversee strategic programs aligned with corporate objectives.
  • Translate organizational strategies into coordinated programs with clear goals, milestones, deliverables, and expected outcomes.
  • Manage interdependencies between projects, business units, and strategic initiatives.
  • Monitor program performance and ensure alignment with organizational priorities.

Insurance & Investment Program Delivery

  • Lead strategic programs involving life insurance, general insurance, reinsurance, investment management, wealth management, and financial services.
  • Oversee programs related to insurance product development, underwriting modernization, claims transformation, policy administration, and distribution expansion.
  • Coordinate investment-related programs involving portfolio management systems, investment operations, client reporting, and service delivery, where applicable.
  • Manage initiatives involving regulatory changes, new business models, market expansion, and operational restructuring.
  • Ensure program deliverables address business requirements and relevant industry regulations.

Program Governance & Management Office

  • Establish and oversee program governance frameworks, methodologies, policies, and reporting standards.
  • Develop program charters, business cases, implementation plans, risk registers, and performance dashboards.
  • Implement structured review processes, approval mechanisms, escalation procedures, and executive reporting.
  • Ensure consistency in program management practices across subsidiaries and business units.
  • Work with the Project Management Office (PMO) to coordinate individual project delivery and maintain portfolio visibility.

Program Budget & Resource Management

  • Develop and oversee program budgets, resource plans, and financial forecasts.
  • Monitor program expenditure, financial performance, and budget variations.
  • Ensure effective allocation of people, technology, and financial resources across programs.
  • Evaluate program business cases, cost-benefit analysis, expected returns, and benefits realization.
  • Manage external consultants, contractors, technology vendors, and implementation partners.

Digital & Business Transformation Programs

  • Lead cross-functional programs involving digital transformation, automation, AI, cloud adoption, and enterprise system modernization.
  • Coordinate implementation of digital insurance platforms, customer portals, CRM systems, and investment service technologies.
  • Work with CIO, CTO, CDO, and business leaders to ensure technology programs deliver business value.
  • Oversee business process redesign, operational improvement, and organizational change initiatives.
  • Monitor adoption, implementation effectiveness, and long-term program outcomes.

Risk, Compliance & Quality Management

  • Identify, assess, and manage program-level operational, financial, regulatory, and technology risks.
  • Ensure programs comply with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.
  • Coordinate with risk, compliance, legal, and internal audit teams.
  • Establish mitigation strategies, contingency plans, and escalation mechanisms.
  • Monitor program quality and ensure deliverables meet approved standards.

Stakeholder & Executive Management

  • Collaborate with the CEO, Board, executive leadership, and business unit heads to define program priorities.
  • Coordinate communication and collaboration among project sponsors, program managers, and key stakeholders.
  • Manage relationships with regulators, external consultants, strategic partners, and implementation vendors, as appropriate.
  • Resolve conflicts involving program scope, resource allocation, timelines, and competing business priorities.
  • Present program progress, financial performance, key risks, and strategic recommendations to senior management.

Leadership & Program Management Excellence

  • Lead and develop program directors, program managers, project managers, and program delivery teams.
  • Build a high-performing program management function with clear accountability and performance standards.
  • Establish training, mentoring, and professional development initiatives.
  • Promote consistent program management methodologies and continuous improvement.
  • Introduce tools and reporting systems to improve program visibility, coordination, and delivery effectiveness.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Project Management, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • MBA or Master's degree in Program Management, Business Strategy, Finance, or a relevant discipline preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in program management, project portfolio management, enterprise transformation, or strategic initiative delivery.
  • At least 5 years in a senior leadership role overseeing large-scale, multi-project programs.
  • Experience in insurance, reinsurance, banking, investment management, asset management, wealth management, or financial services preferred.
  • Proven track record of successfully delivering complex, cross-functional programs with measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong knowledge of program governance, project management methodologies, budgeting, risk management, and resource planning.
  • Experience establishing or leading enterprise program management offices.
  • Familiarity with Agile, Waterfall, PRINCE2, PMI, and hybrid delivery methodologies.
  • Excellent leadership, strategic planning, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving capabilities.

Preferred Certifications:

  • Program Management Professional (PgMP).

- Project Management Professional (PMP).

  • Portfolio Management Professional (PfMP).

- PRINCE2 Practitioner.

- Agile or Scrum certifications.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Percentage of strategic programs delivered on time and within budget.
  • Program performance against approved strategic objectives.
  • Achievement of program milestones and deliverables.
  • Program budget variance and resource utilization.
  • Benefits realization and return on investment (ROI).
  • Effective management of project interdependencies.
  • Program risk mitigation and issue resolution effectiveness.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and executive reporting quality.
  • Compliance with program governance and reporting standards.
  • Successful delivery of digital, operational, and business transformation programs.
  • Reduction in program delays, cost overruns, and implementation risks.

Role Purpose

Develop foundational Apparel Engineering capability while supporting the technical development, sample review and production readiness of assigned apparel products. Working under the guidance of experienced Apparel Engineers and managers, the role applies established standards, builds practical knowledge across product categories and supports timely, accurate physical and digital development for compressed Go-To-Market calendars. Develop effective working relationships within VF pillars, with Brand and factory partners by communicating clearly, following through on commitments, asking questions and contributing positively to shared product outcomes.


Key Accountabilities

1. Product Development Support

  • Learn and apply established Apparel Engineering standards, tools and processes to assigned products and development activities.
  • Support Brand Development, Sourcing Development and vendors with routine technical follow-up across development and commercialization stages.
  • Assist with fit, pattern, construction, measurement, material and manufacturing reviews, documenting observations and proposed actions for review by an experienced Apparel Engineer.
  • Support construction, sizing, grading and block-related activities within clearly defined instructions and scope.
  • Raise unclear, complex, high-risk or material issues promptly rather than resolving them independently.

2. Physical & Digital Sample Support

  • Support the review of physical and digital samples across relevant development stages, including Proto, SMS, POC, PPS, Counter and Size Set.
  • Check assigned samples against the Tech Pack, measurements, approved product intent and established construction and workmanship standards.
  • Prepare clear draft comments, measurements, images and supporting information for review and approval by an experienced Apparel Engineer where required.
  • Update sample records, forms and systems accurately and on time, maintaining alignment between physical and digital findings.
  • Follow up with vendor technical teams on agreed actions and escalate late, repeated or unresolved issues.

3. Risk, Testing & Production Readiness Support

  • Support product risk classification and monitoring using established RBM guidance and direction from the Manager or Senior Apparel Engineer.
  • Prepare information for Tech Pack handover, Risk Analysis handoff, PRM, PP meetings, and participate as required.
  • Identify and record Tech Pack discrepancies; update minor discrepancies only where authorized and escalate all material or unclear items.
  • Coordinate assigned testing activities and track results, failures and agreed corrective actions under guidance.
  • Support production-readiness checks by confirming that assigned actions, sample comments and technical information are complete and current.

4. Learning, Cross-Category Growth & Development Trips

  • Build technical capability through intentional learning and planned exposure across product categories, manufacturing methods and development stages.
  • Participate in technical calibration, coaching, knowledge-sharing and training, and maintain an active Individual Development Plan.

5. Factory Exposure & Partner Support

jobs.description:
About Aidoc

Aidoc is the market leader in healthcare AI and has developed the world's largest clinical frontier model, supporting nearly 50 million patients each year.
Aidoc is deployed in more than 2,000 medical centers worldwide. Since our founding in 2016, Aidoc has raised over $500 million and achieved a record number of FDA-cleared solutions.

Medical diagnosis is hitting a breaking point, where the number of physicians hasn't kept up with the rapidly growing patient load. This leads to misdiagnosis and treatment delays that result in hundreds of thousands of deaths every year. Aidoc assists clinicians by precisely highlighting diseases directly on medical images, preventing misdiagnosis and ensuring that urgent patients receive the immediate attention they need.

About this role

The Director of Marketing Operations builds the systems, data, and processes, and reporting that help Aidoc turn marketing investment into measurable account engagement, pipeline progression, and revenue. This leader owns our marketing technology roadmap, campaign operations, lead lifecycle, and performance reporting, partnering closely with Marketing, Sales, and RevOps.

Aidoc sells into complex healthcare organizations with long, multi-stakeholder buying journeys. The right person will make our technology work as a connected system for enterprise demand generation and account-based marketing. Our ecosystem includes Salesforce, HubSpot, LeanData, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Cloudingo, iCapture, Revealed, Databricks, and Userled. We are evaluating a possible move from HubSpot to Marketo; this role will assess the tradeoffs and lead the migration if approved.

Responsibilities

  • Own marketing operations strategy. Set the roadmap, priorities, standards, and team structure to support Aidoc’s growth goals. Advise marketing leadership on investment, capacity, and measurement.
  • Lead the marketing technology stack. Govern HubSpot and its integrations with Salesforce, LeanData, iCapture, and the rest of the marketing tech stack. Manage vendors, contracts, and the martech budget.
  • Evaluate and execute platform change. Assess HubSpot and Marketo against Aidoc’s requirements, total cost, integrations, security, and scalability. If a move is approved, lead the HubSpot-to-Marketo migration, including data and field mapping, lifecycle and campaign design, integration testing, consent and deliverability checks, cutover, and adoption.
  • Run the lead and account lifecycle. Own capture, enrichment, scoring, routing, lifecycle stages, Sales handoffs, and service-level agreements. Align definitions and Salesforce campaign practices with Sales Ops and RevOps.
  • Enable enterprise and ABM programs. Build the data, segmentation, and campaign operations that support multi-stakeholder healthcare buying groups and coordinated plays across priority accounts.
  • Make performance visible. Improve data quality and reporting that connects campaign engagement to account progression, opportunity movement, pipeline, revenue, and efficiency. Explain attribution assumptions and limitations.
  • Scale execution. Create repeatable processes for campaign setup, QA, launch, and post-campaign learning. Identify practical opportunities to use automation and AI to improve speed and reliability.

What success looks like

Within the first year, Marketing, Sales, and RevOps share trusted funnel definitions and reporting; lead routing and campaign operations are reliable and repeatable; data quality and visibility into marketing’s contribution have improved; and the martech stack is fit for Aidoc’s needs. If a HubSpot-to-Marketo move is approved, it is delivered against agreed milestones with data integrity, campaign continuity, and user adoption protected.


Requirements

  • 8+ years in marketing operations, revenue operations, or a related field.
  • Experience owning marketing operations or a major martech program at a B2B technology company; enterprise or healthcare technology experience is a plus.
  • Deep hands-on experience with a marketing automation platform and Salesforce, including their data architecture, campaign practices, and integrations.
  • Experience planning or executing a marketing automation migration. HubSpot-to-Marketo migration experience is strongly preferred.
  • Strong background in lead and account lifecycle management, scoring, routing, funnel metrics, campaign operations, and attribution.
  • Experience leading marketing operations at a company that takes part in 80+ events per year.
  • Analytical rigor, sound data-governance practices, and experience building reporting that supports business decisions.
  • Experience managing technology vendors, contracts, and budgets; clear communication with both technical and executive audiences.
  • Working knowledge of privacy, consent, and email requirements, including GDPR, CCPA, and CAN-SPAM.

Working at Aidoc

We’re a dynamic, collaborative and fast growing team of more than 500 global employees, committed to improving the world of healthcare. We’re looking for mission-driven people excited to do transformative work.
We have offices in Barcelona, Tel Aviv and New York City, but Aidoc is a remote-first workplace.

What we offer:

  • A range of medical, dental and vision benefits
  • Stock options for all full-time employees
  • Flexible time off to enjoy the autonomy to take time off as needed to rest and recharge without vacation accrual limits, while coordinating with your manager and team to ensure business continuity and project goals are met.
  • A 401(k) plan with company match, life insurance, plus long- and short-term disability
  • The opportunity to directly improve medical care and impact patient outcomes

Aidoc is deeply committed to creating an inclusive workplace, and to the principle of equal opportunity for all individuals. We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

Group Head of Project Management Office (PMO) – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Group Head of PMO is responsible for leading and overseeing the Group's project management function across all subsidiaries, business units, and geographical markets within the Insurance & Investments sector.

The role establishes group-wide project governance, portfolio management standards, delivery frameworks, and performance monitoring systems to ensure that strategic projects and transformation initiatives are executed effectively. The position provides centralized oversight of project priorities, budgets, resources, risks, dependencies, and expected business outcomes.

Working closely with the Group CEO, executive leadership, subsidiary CEOs, and business heads, the Group Head of PMO ensures that all major projects support the organization's strategic growth, operational efficiency, digital transformation, and long-term business objectives.

2. Key Responsibilities

Group PMO Strategy & Governance

  • Develop and implement the Group's overall Project Management Office strategy, structure, and operating framework.
  • Establish standardized project management methodologies, governance policies, procedures, and reporting requirements across all subsidiaries.
  • Define project approval processes, stage-gate reviews, escalation procedures, and accountability frameworks.
  • Ensure project portfolios are aligned with the Group's strategic objectives and business priorities.
  • Establish consistent project management standards and controls across geographical markets and business units.

Strategic Project Portfolio Management

  • Oversee the consolidated project portfolio across insurance, investment, corporate, and operational business units.
  • Evaluate, prioritize, and monitor strategic projects based on business value, financial impact, risk exposure, and resource requirements.
  • Monitor project progress, milestones, dependencies, budgets, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Identify underperforming projects and recommend corrective actions or changes in resource allocation.
  • Provide executive leadership with a consolidated view of project portfolio performance.

Insurance & Investment Project Oversight

  • Oversee group-wide projects involving insurance product development, underwriting, claims management, policy administration, and distribution expansion.
  • Monitor investment-related projects involving portfolio reporting, investment operations, wealth management platforms, and client servicing, where applicable.
  • Coordinate strategic initiatives involving regulatory compliance, business process modernization, and operational efficiency.
  • Support the implementation of new financial products, business models, and market expansion initiatives.
  • Ensure projects meet relevant insurance, investment, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.

Digital Transformation & Technology Projects

  • Provide governance and oversight for group-wide technology modernization and digital transformation initiatives.
  • Coordinate implementation of enterprise systems, CRM platforms, automation solutions, AI applications, and digital financial services.
  • Work with CIO, CTO, CDO, and business leadership to ensure successful technology project delivery.
  • Monitor system integration, implementation risks, technology budgets, and business adoption.
  • Ensure digital initiatives deliver measurable improvements in customer experience and operational performance.

Financial & Resource Management

  • Oversee consolidated project budgets, financial forecasts, and expenditure tracking across the Group.
  • Monitor project cost performance and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
  • Coordinate resource allocation across subsidiaries, departments, and strategic initiatives.
  • Evaluate project business cases, cost-benefit analysis, ROI, and expected benefits.
  • Ensure effective utilization of internal teams, external consultants, contractors, and implementation partners.

Risk, Compliance & Quality Management

  • Establish group-level project risk management and escalation frameworks.
  • Monitor operational, financial, regulatory, technology, and implementation risks across project portfolios.
  • Coordinate with group risk, compliance, legal, and internal audit functions.
  • Ensure projects comply with internal policies, governance standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Establish contingency and mitigation plans for critical projects and strategic programs.

Performance Reporting & Benefits Realization

  • Develop group-wide project dashboards, performance reports, and executive presentations.
  • Monitor project delivery against approved scope, budgets, timelines, milestones, and quality standards.
  • Track financial benefits, operational improvements, and ROI from strategic initiatives.
  • Prepare regular portfolio performance reports for the Group CEO, Board, and executive committees.
  • Recommend strategic interventions to improve project execution and delivery performance.

Stakeholder & Subsidiary Management

  • Work closely with subsidiary CEOs, managing directors, business unit heads, project sponsors, and program directors.
  • Facilitate group-level project steering committees and portfolio review meetings.
  • Coordinate project planning and delivery across subsidiaries and corporate functions.
  • Manage relationships with external consultants, technology vendors, contractors, and implementation partners.
  • Ensure consistent communication, accountability, and reporting across all Group entities.

Leadership & PMO Capability Development

  • Lead and develop the Group PMO team, including PMO directors, project managers, project analysts, and project controls specialists.
  • Establish PMO structures, responsibilities, and reporting relationships across subsidiaries.
  • Develop project management training, mentoring, and capability-building initiatives.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, transparency, collaboration, and delivery excellence.
  • Drive continuous improvement in project management maturity across the organization.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Project Management, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • MBA or Master's degree in Project Management, Business Strategy, Finance, or a relevant discipline preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in project management, program management, portfolio management, or enterprise transformation.
  • At least 5 years in a senior PMO leadership position overseeing multiple business units, subsidiaries, or large project portfolios.
  • Experience in insurance, reinsurance, banking, investment management, asset management, wealth management, or diversified financial services.
  • Proven track record of establishing or leading enterprise-level or group-level PMO functions.
  • Strong knowledge of project portfolio governance, financial management, resource planning, risk management, and strategic execution.
  • Experience managing complex, multi-country or multi-entity projects and transformation programs.
  • Knowledge of PMI, PRINCE2, Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid project management methodologies.
  • Strong leadership, executive communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and analytical capabilities.

Preferred Certifications:

- Project Management Professional (PMP).

  • Program Management Professional (PgMP).
  • Portfolio Management Professional (PfMP).

- PRINCE2 Practitioner.

- Agile or Scrum certifications.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Percentage of group-wide projects delivered on time and within approved budgets.
  • Overall project portfolio performance against Group strategic objectives.
  • Project cost variance and schedule variance.
  • Group PMO governance and reporting compliance.
  • Successful delivery of strategic insurance and investment initiatives.
  • Project risk identification, mitigation, and escalation effectiveness.
  • Resource utilization and allocation efficiency across subsidiaries.
  • Benefits realization and ROI of major strategic projects.
  • Accuracy and timeliness of consolidated project reporting.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction across Group entities.
  • Improvement in project management maturity across subsidiaries.
  • Reduction in project delays, cost overruns, and implementation risks.

Hint Health is the leading digital health company dedicated to supporting the growth and success of the Direct Primary Care (DPC) movement. With a mission to power direct care and make it the new standard, the Hint Core platform supports thousands of clinics and networks across the nation, providing care for over a million members. Hint also produces Hint Summit, the leading DPC innovation conference and supports Hint Connect, a curated national network of independent DPC clinics. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco, CA. To learn more visit.

The Role

Hint Health is looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to join us on our mission to make great healthcare accessible and affordable. Reporting to our Director of Growth Marketing, you’ll play a key role in developing and executing creative marketing campaigns that reach new audiences, generate demand, and drive growth across the direct care space.

You’ll own campaigns from concept to execution, building targeted audiences, managing HubSpot workflows, creating marketing assets, and experimenting with new channels and messaging. You’ll also support product launches, events, and other go-to-market initiatives, working closely with teammates across Marketing, Sales, Product, and Customer Success.

We’re looking for someone who loves to get creative, try new things, and take ownership of their work. You’ll have the freedom to test new ideas (even ones we’ve never tried before!), lead your own projects, and make a real impact, all with the support of a collaborative team that’s excited to innovate alongside you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the execution of marketing campaigns, including campaign workflows, audience segmentation, messaging, and follow-up journeys.

  • Support digital marketing and marketing operations, including maintaining and using marketing platforms to deliver campaigns and assess performance.

  • Partner with content teammates on content planning and execution to get creative on the campaigns you are running.

  • Create marketing and sales-enablement assets for Hint’s solutions.

  • Develop campaigns and messaging for new target audiences in the direct care space; experiment with channels and approaches to improve reach and engagement.

  • Build event-specific campaigns and follow-up workflows; attend approximately 2–3 conferences per year to support the Sales team.

  • Support marketing projects for Hint Summit and Hint Connect.

  • Coordinate with external partners supporting social media and paid advertising.

  • Work cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Network Development, and Customer Success to support Hint’s go-to-market efforts.

About You

Have-to-have

Nice-to-have

Our team is inquisitive, kind, open, and smart. We share glimpses of our lives—introducing our kids and pets—and host virtual hangouts to stay connected. Our employee Slack channels include spaces for women, caregivers, and our Diversity & Inclusion Committee. We also have regular cadences for company all-hands updates and team learning sessions so all Hinters can stay connected to how their work is changing the landscape of healthcare.
Hint has taken the Parity Pledge and is committed to racial and gender parity. Furthermore, those historically underrepresented in tech—including people of color, immigrants, members of the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities and veterans—are encouraged to apply. We look for the best candidate for the job based on demonstrable skills, and do not screen for educational background, age, or markers of socioeconomic status.
Benefits

* Competitive compensation of base salary & stock options

United States

The Opportunity:

Product Marketing at Grafana Labs lives in the Product org, not the Marketing org, and we think differently about the job. As Grafana's offering shifts from dashboards to observability agents, our team closes the gap between what our products can do and how customers understand that value. We build clear, consistent positioning, run marketing campaigns that attract new customers, and create content that helps engineering teams see why Grafana Cloud is the right choice for them.

Rather than only executing launches and campaigns, we teach Grafana’s product managers and engineers how to think about growth and demand. We also codify product marketing knowledge into AI-forward tools and processes that anyone at Grafana can use. For example, we all contribute product information to a shared knowledge base, which we use to generate enablement materials and decks.

The Operations Manager keeps the Product Marketing system running and makes it better. You'll track how our work performs and report on it to the team every week, experiment with new AI workflows, and maintain the collateral and tools the team and the field depend on, so the sales team is fully supported in positioning our products. You'll work closely with the team's software engineers: you test ideas like sales deck generators or tools for competitive analysis, script prototypes, and define what good output looks like, and they turn the best ideas into production tools. You'll also coordinate with the field, Enablement, and Marketing so we understand each other's goals and make progress on shared initiatives.

For this role you don't need to be a product marketer but you should have experience working inside a Product or Marketing organization for a software company. Since we don’t have an operations manager yet, you’ll also help to shape your own role. You should arrive with a desire to find and solve imperfectly-defined problems.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Projects and Cross-Functional Initiatives: Drive cross-functional initiatives that align with product marketing strategies across GTM, Product, and Marketing teams. Own follow-ups, task tracking, and on-time completion.

Decide what good output looks like and codify that judgment in evaluations, working alongside the software engineers on our team as they refine and deploy tools. Hand the most promising prototypes to engineers to make production-ready. For example, you might test a deck generator with sellers, write evals for it, and communicate about it internally.
  • Collateral Management: Maintain the team's most important collateral, including core decks, positioning content, and enablement sessions. Keep it accurate and current, share it widely, and make sure sellers know where to find it and how to use it.
  • Knowledge Base Stewardship: Help keep our shared product knowledge base complete and current. Spot missing or stale information, chase down the owners, and improve the processes that keep it up to date.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • 2+ years in an operations, analytics, enablement, or technical support role within a Product or Marketing organization for a software company.

  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.

​​Parexel is hiring a Senior Clinical Data Manager in Mexico or Argentina.

The Senior Clinical Data Manager will be responsible for performing Data Management activities that support client’s commercial and development projects worldwide. He/she will participate as an active member of a multi-disciplinary team to plan, lead and execute the Data Management tasks required for phase 1-4 studies. The Senior Clinical Data Manager has a broad, fundamental knowledge of the data management process and is able to perform most required tasks with minimal guidance.Essential Functions

  • ​Be able to lead a large clinical study or a series of related studies with minimal guidance
  • ​Represents Data Management on the CTWG for assigned studies
  • ​Provide mentoring and training to lower level Data Management staff assigned to his/her studies
  • ​Manage and monitor the progress of data management activities with CROs or other vendors on assigned studies; build effective relationships with CRO / vendor counterparts
  • ​Review protocols for appropriate data capture including electronic Case Report Form (eCRF) design.
  • ​Be able to perform a thoroughly detailed review of eCRF data requirements.
  • ​Interact with CRAs, programmers, study managers and statisticians in designing eCRFs and creating the annotated eCRF and CRF completion guidelines.
  • ​Lead the development of data edit check specifications and data listings
  • ​Coordinate the design and testing of Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems according to company standards. Able to resolve EDC system issues with team members
  • ​Develop or lead the development of the Data Management Plan for a clinical study.
  • ​Able to review and provide feedback to the clinical team on other study documents e.g. Clinical Monitoring plans, Statistical analysis plans and vendor specifications
  • ​ May provide training on the EDC system and/or eCRF Completion Guidelines at Investigator Meetings and to internal and external study team members as needed
  • ​Perform reconciliation of header data from external data sources against the clinical database
  • ​Perform Serious Adverse Event reconciliation activities according to SOPs and guidelines
  • ​Lead database upgrades/migrations including performing User Acceptance Testing
  • ​Be able to maintain study workbooks and data management files
  • ​Perform database lock and freeze activities per company SOPs
  • ​Participate in regular team meetings and provide input when appropriate

​

​Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • ​Has good project management skills and a proven ability to multitask
  • ​Understands the scope and focus of Phase 1-4 clinical studies, and has a proven ability to perform most of the core Data Management tasks and interact with vendors.
  • ​Possesses a comprehensive understanding of regulatory guidelines and industry standards (e.g., ICH/FDA guidances, CDISC standards, GCDMP, 21 CFR 11, MedDRA, WHO Drug Dictionaries, etc.) and their application to Data Management practice.

  • ​Able to travel to off-site meetings or training seminars as needed.
  • ​Possesses solid computer system and technical skills with a strong ability to learn multiple computer applications. Prior experience with different Data Management systems and technologies, and Electronic Data Capture systems is desirable

​

​Required/Preferred Education and Licenses

  • ​BA/BS, preferably in the scientific/healthcare field.

We are seeking a Senior Clinical Data Manager to join our team in South Africa in a permanent, full-time capacity.


As a Senior Clinical Data Manager, you will play a critical role in supporting global commercial and development programs by leading clinical data management activities across Phase 1-4 studies. This position is central to ensuring the quality, integrity, and reliability of clinical trial data that support the development of innovative therapies for patients worldwide.


You will serve as a key data management leader within cross-functional study teams, driving the planning, execution, and oversight of data management deliverables throughout the clinical trial lifecycle. Responsibilities include leading study-level data management activities, collaborating with internal stakeholders and external vendors, supporting electronic data capture system development and validation, overseeing database lock activities, and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards.


You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment where your expertise will directly influence study outcomes, operational excellence, and the successful delivery of clinical research programs. With opportunities to work across global studies and collaborate with experienced clinical development professionals, this role offers a meaningful path for continued professional growth and leadership within clinical data management.

  • Lead large clinical studies or a series of related studies with minimal guidance
  • Represent Data Management on cross-functional clinical trial working groups for assigned studies
  • Oversee and monitor data management activities performed by CROs and external vendors while building effective working relationships
  • Review clinical protocols and provide leadership on data capture strategy, eCRF design, and data collection requirements
  • Collaborate with CRAs, programmers, study managers, statisticians, and other stakeholders to develop annotated eCRFs and completion guidelines

  • Conduct data reconciliations, including Serious Adverse Event reconciliation and external data source reconciliation activities

  • Strengths in clinical data management, project leadership, vendor oversight, and cross-functional collaboration
  • Experience working within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, clinical research, or other FDA-regulated environments
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining exceptional attention to detail and data quality
  • Strong communication skills and the confidence to collaborate effectively across internal teams and external partners
  • Comfort working with Electronic Data Capture systems, data management technologies, clinical databases, and study documentation processes
  • A commitment to delivering high-quality clinical data that supports informed decision-making and advances patient care

Required Qualifications


  • BA/BS degree, preferably in a scientific or healthcare-related field
  • At least seven years of experience in Data Management within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, or equivalent experience in an FDA-regulated environment, including study lead experience
  • Knowledge of ICH-GCP, FDA guidance, CDISC standards, GCDMP, 21 CFR Part 11, MedDRA, WHO Drug Dictionaries, and clinical trial processes
  • Experience with Electronic Data Capture systems and clinical data management technologies
  • Strong project management, organization, communication, problem-solving, and multitasking skills
  • Proven ability to support Phase 1-4 clinical studies and work effectively with vendors and cross-functional teams
  • Familiarity with database upgrades, migrations, user acceptance testing, and advanced data management processes
  • Strong English written and verbal communication skills

Preferred Qualifications


  • Scientific or healthcare-related educational background
  • Experience within Oncology or CNS therapeutic areas
  • Experience supporting Phase III pivotal clinical studies
  • Experience training internal and external study team members on EDC systems and data management procedures
