A quick note before you apply: This role is strictly UK-based and must be performed entirely within the United Kingdom; we do not employ remote staff overseas, nor do we offer relocation support. Candidates must have the legal right to work in the UK prior to commencing employment. While we hold a sponsor licence, visa sponsorship is only considered in exceptional circumstances and is not available as standard for this vacancy.

Role Overview

You'll lead Cambridge Spark's video and audio production — hands-on with the edit, and owning the oversight and quality of everything that goes out: thought leadership content, client and learner impact stories, event highlights, long-form interview content and the short, fast-turnaround cuts that drive our social channels every week. We'll work with agencies and freelance crews for filming, specialist production and our biggest projects. You'll do some of the filming yourself, and lead the edit on what follows, turning one shoot into a client story, a set of social cuts, a long-form interview edit and an event highlight — all built with best-in-class visual and motion storytelling.

You'll also manage the agencies and freelancers we use for bigger productions, own the production process end to end — brief, schedule, edit, sign-off — and work closely with editorial, marketing, sales and senior stakeholders to turn their ideas into finished content on time. And you'll set the studio up: the kit, the workflows and the templates that let the wider team record and edit simple content themselves with AI tools. It's a hands-on making role with room to shape a new function.

Key responsibilities:

  • Edit and finish our thought leadership films, client and learner case studies, and long-form interview content, including cuts for social
  • Capture and edit our flagship events, and turn them into content that brings the experience to people who weren't in the room
  • Cut long-form footage into many short, fast-turnaround pieces for LinkedIn, the website, newsletters and sales
  • Film smaller pieces yourself, from studio interviews to vox pops at events
  • Manage our production agencies and freelance crews end to end — briefing, scheduling, quality control and budgets on bigger shoots
  • Own the production process from brief to delivery, working closely with stakeholders across editorial, marketing and sales
  • Set up and look after the in-house kit and a well-organised footage library
  • Build templates and simple workflows so the team can make their own content with AI tools
  • Track how video and audio perform, and use it to shape the next round

Candidate Specification:

Essential

  • Five or more years editing video and audio professionally, in-house, at an agency or production company
  • A showreel that shows strong visual and motion storytelling across long-form and fast-turnaround social content
  • AI-native and fluent in professional video and audio editing tools — the specific suite matters less than speed and judgement (think Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, Audition or Descript) — and able to turn that fluency into templates and workflows the wider team can use themselves
  • Experience managing production agencies or freelance crews, and running a production process from brief through to delivery
  • Regular, hands-on use of AI video and audio tools, and good judgement about when they help
  • Agility and a great eye — able to move fast across several projects and deadlines, and spot the shot or cut that will actually land
  • Strong collaboration skills, comfortable briefing stakeholders across editorial, marketing and sales and pushing back when a brief isn't clear

Desirable

  • Camera and sound skills for small shoots
  • Motion graphics and captioning
  • Experience producing for a B2B audience, on LinkedIn or at live events
  • An interest in AI and how it's changing work

Company Benefits:

  • Pension with 4% matched contributions, opportunity to opt into salary sacrifice scheme
  • 25 days holiday + Flexi bank holidays + 1 day off on your birthday
  • A day for volunteering
  • Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Leave
  • Health & Wellbeing allowance of up to £30 per month
  • Annual Summer and Xmas events
  • Company socials including everything from Cambridge College formals, pub nights to team building events
  • CPD Allowance alongside quarterly reflections to ring fence time for development and growth
  • Private medical insurance and cash plan
  • Holiday buy back scheme (up to 10 days p/a)
  • Employee Assistance Programme with a dedicated company counsellor


Background to our Organisation

We are an education technology company that enables corporate and government organisations to achieve their business goals by educating their workforce with critical digital transformation skills to succeed in the AI era.

We deliver unique and innovative professional education that is accelerating the digital transformation of our clients, advancing the careers of their employees, helping people get into work and closing the digital skills gap. We are in a sector that is crucial to the economy and workforce, with a lot of opportunity for change and innovation. We are at the cutting edge of teaching applied data and digital skills, with our unique patented learning platform EDUKATE.AI offering our clients and learners a unique learning experience. EDUKATE.AI was developed with support from Innovate UK and provides all of our learners with 24/7 immediate feedback on their work, helping accelerate the learning process and providing a sandbox environment to experiment on real world datasets.

Since 2016, we have supported more than 15,000 learners across four continents with nearly 550,000 pieces of code submitted for feedback on EDUKATE.AI. We are trusted by some of the most recognisable brands in the world to educate their workforce, including Microsoft, the NHS, GSK, easyJet, the BBC and John Lewis. Our focus on applied learning to create business impact sets us apart - individual learners have reported applying their skills at work to generate recorded value of up to £40m.

Our Values

At the centre of the way we work together and inspire each other to achieve success are these core values:

Entrepreneurial

We take initiative and show entrepreneurial spirit which fuels innovation at Cambridge Spark. This includes identifying opportunities for improvement, taking ownership for implementing solutions effectively and driving improvement by using proof of concepts to demonstrate the feasibility and value of their work.

Team Spirit

Everyone is part of building an open and transparent culture, communicating effectively to raise issues, discuss improvements and share the evidence used to make decisions.

Customer-focused

Our customers are at the centre of everything we do, inspiring us to create great work. We strive to build friendly, professional and lasting relationships with them to better understand and anticipate their needs.

Gold Standard

We are experts in our field and are constantly developing our technology and offering. We set the benchmark in our industry: both in what we offer customers and in how we deliver it.

Moodle with us!

We're the world's most popular learning platform, and we’re on a mission to empower educators and learners worldwide with open, flexible, and innovative digital learning solutions. About the role..

Are you passionate about technology, already building things in your career as a developer? We’re looking for a motivated and curious Developer with 2 to 3 years of experience to join our Platform Solutions team. The team builds, improves and maintains Moodle LMS, the open-source platform all of Moodle’s products are built on. You’ll work on the core LMS alongside experienced developers, and your changes go through Moodle’s open contribution process.

We're building a team that works with AI, not around it. If you've been teaching yourself to build with tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or the OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, and you can show us what you've made, we want to hear from you. It matters far more to us what you've built than where (or whether) you studied.

This is a fully remote role and can be offered as a permanent role in India, Indonesia, Vietnam or the Philippines.

At Moodle, no two days will ever be the same, but will involve a mix of:

  • Collaborating with experienced developers on designing, developing, and implementing software solutions.
  • Using AI coding agents as part of your everyday workflow: scoping the task, writing a clear spec or prompt, then reviewing, testing and refining what comes back.
  • Writing clean, well-tested PHP and JavaScript, and being able to explain and defend every line of it, whether you or an agent wrote it first.
  • Building small automations and internal tools that make the wider team faster.
  • Participating in code reviews, learning best practices and improving code quality.
  • Contributing to the full software development lifecycle from concept to deployment and maintenance.
  • Learning new technologies and tools while solving real-world problems.
  • Contributing to projects that impact millions of users globally.

What we’re looking for..

  • Experience with or knowledge of PHP and JavaScript.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic AI development tools (for example Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or agents you've built yourself with an LLM API). Self-taught absolutely counts: side projects, hackathons, open-source contributions and things you built for fun are all evidence.
  • Working understanding of how to get good results from these tools: giving an agent the right context, breaking work into verifiable steps, and knowing when the output is wrong.
  • Judgement about where AI helps and where it doesn't, and a healthy scepticism about code you didn't reason through yourself.
  • Passion for problem-solving, keen attention to detail and an eagerness to keep learning.
  • An approachable, collaborative way of working in a global team.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills: increasingly, being a strong developer means being able to describe a problem precisely, to people and to machines.

Nice to have, not required: familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol), retrieval-augmented generation, prompt/context engineering, agent evaluation or testing, or having published a tool, plugin or agent of your own.

You don't need a certification or a formal AI qualification for this role. A GitHub repo, a demo video or a blog post explaining something you built will tell us more than any course certificate.

What life at Moodle is like..

Moodle has a globally diverse team with over 280 team members in more than 25 countries around the world. We’ve built a passionate team of hard-working, driven and diverse people from all over the world, united by a shared belief in the ability of our platform to make a positive difference in our world. We respect our colleagues and value an open and innovative workplace filled with integrity and of course a strong focus on education (yes, these are our company values!)

In addition, you can expect:

  • A genuinely flexible, remote role, working from anywhere in India, Indonesia, Vietnam or the Philippines.
  • We believe in motivating performance rather than micromanaging it, empowering you to do what you do best.
  • Gaining new skills by learning from highly skilled peers, along with your own learning and development allowance each year to support your growth.
  • Work with a global team on a worldwide platform and make a real difference.
  • As a certified B Corp, we are proud to be part of a global community of mission-driven companies dedicated to using business as a force for good.
  • Other excellent benefits, like an extra time-off to recharge yourself, give back to a charity or community group, and enjoy a day off for your birthday, ‘choose your own’ benefit options, flexible public holidays, and many more!

Learn more about your new workplace..

Moodle is the world’s most trusted online learning solution, with a growing ecosystem of products and services, including Moodle Workplace, Moodle App, MoodleCloud, and more. The engine of our ecosystem is Moodle LMS, the secure and customisable open-source learning management platform used by well over 300million learners worldwide.

Find out more about us on our website and careers page

Who We Are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the Team

The Solutions Architecture team partners with Stripe’s users to design and build transformative solutions that unlock growth, modernize business models, and shape the future of commerce. We work with executives, product leaders, and engineering teams at the world’s largest and most innovative companies, helping them translate ambitious strategies into scalable solutions on Stripe.

Strategic Accounts Solutions Architecture serves Stripe’s most complex and consequential users. The team combines deep technical expertise, commercial judgment, and customer empathy to solve problems that often have no established playbook. Its work not only helps individual users grow; it also surfaces emerging needs and opportunities that can inform Stripe’s product strategy and create value for users at global scale. These Solution Architects are deeply embedded in these users and are working along as their technical co-founders.

The Head of Strategic Accounts, Solutions Architecture will lead a team of senior architects who are trusted partners to strategic, key, and major accounts. This leader will set the vision for the team, develop exceptional technical talent, and work closely with account leadership to deepen and grow Stripe’s most important relationships. They will also build a strong partnership with Product and Engineering, turning insights from leading-edge customer engagements into the next wave of innovation across Stripe.

This is a highly technical, hands-on leadership role. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between executive conversations, account strategy, architecture reviews, product discussions, and direct support for the team’s most complex engagements. They will be AI-enabled in how they lead and operate, highly curious about new technologies and business models, and committed to helping their team and Stripe continuously raise the bar.

What You’ll Do

Responsibilities

  • Set the vision, strategy, and operating model for Strategic Accounts Solutions Architecture, aligning the team’s priorities with Stripe’s user, product, and business objectives.
  • Recruit, lead, coach, and retain a world-class team of senior Solutions Architects supporting Stripe’s strategic, key, and major accounts.
  • Partner with account leaders to develop and execute technical account strategies that deepen customer relationships, unlock new use cases, and drive durable growth.
  • Lead from the front in the team’s most complex and high-impact engagements, including architecture workshops, executive briefings, solution design, technical evaluations, and critical escalations.
  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor to senior executives, product leaders, and engineering leaders at the world’s largest and most innovative companies.
  • Build a close, durable partnership with Stripe Product and Engineering teams; synthesize patterns from strategic accounts, influence product priorities, and help translate customer needs into scalable capabilities for all Stripe users.
  • Create mechanisms for senior architects to share technical insights, reusable patterns, and field learnings across Stripe.
  • Establish a culture of technical excellence, curiosity, accountability, experimentation, and continuous learning.
  • Champion AI-enabled ways of working across the team, using AI to improve insight generation, solution development, team productivity, and the quality and speed of customer outcomes.
  • Develop talent through clear expectations, thoughtful coaching, meaningful feedback, and opportunities for architects to expand their technical, commercial, and leadership impact.
  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Technical Account Management, Partnerships, Marketing, Product, and Engineering to deliver cohesive outcomes for users.
  • Build processes and metrics that measure the team’s impact on customer outcomes, account growth, product influence, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Anticipate changes in technology, customer needs, competitive dynamics, and industry structure, and translate those signals into action for the team and Stripe.
  • Represent Stripe in executive forums, customer business reviews, industry events, and other strategic engagements.

Minimum Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience leading technical pre-sales, solutions architecture, sales engineering, or comparable customer-facing architecture teams aligned to strategic, key, or major accounts.
  • A track record of hiring, developing, and leading senior technical talent in a complex, high-growth environment.
  • Deep technical fluency and the ability to remain hands-on—quickly understanding architectures, APIs, data flows, integration patterns, security and reliability considerations, and emerging technologies.
  • Experience partnering directly with senior customer executives, product leaders, and engineering leaders on complex, business-critical initiatives.
  • Demonstrated success connecting technical strategy to account growth, customer outcomes, and long-term partnerships.
  • Strong experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmaps, shape requirements, and turn customer insights into scalable product innovation.
  • An AI-enabled approach to leadership and problem-solving, with practical experience using AI tools to increase the quality, speed, or scale of work.
  • Exceptional curiosity and learning agility, including a strong desire to explore new technologies, business models, and ways of working.
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to make complex technical and business topics clear to audiences at every level.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to lead through ambiguity, balance competing priorities, and make high-quality decisions in fast-moving environments.
  • A collaborative leadership style and a demonstrated ability to align stakeholders across Sales, Product, Engineering, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Willingness to travel as needed to engage with strategic customers and collaborate with internal teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with payments, financial infrastructure, fintech space

The Global Category Specialist (Hub 4) supports the execution of HubSpot’s global procurement operations by owning defined procurement workflows and applying sound judgment to routine and moderate-complexity work. This role partners closely with cross‑functional stakeholders to manage contract intake, vendor review, and purchase execution while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely delivery. The Global Category Specialist operates with growing autonomy, manages competing priorities, and builds the skills and judgment needed to take on increasingly complex procurement responsibilities over time.

Key Responsibilities

Contract Intake, Execution & Lifecycle Management

  • Owns contract intake and tracking for assigned categories, managing contracts from intake through red lining, execution, renewal, and publication.
  • Manages and maintains contract documentation, metadata, and audit readiness within Ironclad, Chamelio or the designated CLM tool.
  • Prepares contract change notices, monitors end dates, and supports renewal workflows to ensure continuity of services.
  • Executes purchase order processing and related procurement activities in alignment with established policies and procedures.
  • Ability to redline contracts to ensure alignment with company policy and negotiate redlines with vendors based on local policies and regional requirements.

Risk, Compliance & Vendor Review Support

  • Monitors vendor risk management queues in Omnea, ensuring assessments are completed accurately and within established service levels.
  • Collects, reviews, and organizes third‑party risk documentation in partnership with Legal, Security, Privacy, and Compliance teams.
  • Supports risk mitigation activities and vendor performance reviews, escalating issues when appropriate.
  • Ensures contracts and procurement activities adhere to internal policies and applicable regulations.

Stakeholder Partnership & Communication

  • Partners with internal stakeholders across IT, Legal, Security, Privacy, Finance, and other teams to coordinate contract reviews and procurement requests.
  • Serves as a primary point of contact for vendor‑related questions within assigned workflows, responding in a timely and professional manner.

Founded in 2017 in San Francisco, California, Anchorage Digital has offices in New York, New York; Porto, Portugal; Singapore; and Sioux Falls, South Dakota. Learn more at anchorage.com, on X @Anchorage, and on LinkedIn.

With the evolving landscape of digital threats and an increasing volume of sophisticated attacks by malicious actors, we have a security policy mandating all new hires complete an in-person onboarding process - no exceptions. Security is our foundation and we prioritize physical identity verification and secure IT setup. While our security and IT logistics require physical presence to protect our infrastructure from sophisticated global threats, this move is equally about our Village culture. We believe that a laptop can be shipped, but our culture cannot.

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Regulatory Licensing Attorney to join our dynamic Legal team. In this pivotal role, you will serve as the firm’s primary subject matter expert on CFTC and NFA firm-level licensing, guiding the business through the end-to-end registration lifecycle and the evolving regulatory landscape of the Commodity Exchange Act (CEA). Operating at the intersection of legal strategy and commercial reality in the fast-paced crypto space, you will provide critical legal counsel on OTC and cleared derivatives, margin lending, and privacy considerations for new business lines, balancing regulatory compliance with the firm's strategic objectives.
We have created the Factors of Growth & Impact to help Villagers better measure impact and articulate coaching, feedback, and the rich and rewarding learning that happens while exploring, developing, and mastering the capabilities and contributions within and outside of the Member of Legal, Trading & Licensing role:

Technical Skills:

  • Regulatory Advisory: Serve as the primary legal expert on the Commodity Exchange Act (CEA) and NFA Rules, advising the firm on the obligations associated with being a licensed firm.
  • Licensing & Registration Management: Lead the end-to-end strategy for obtaining and maintaining regulatory licenses, including managing the registration lifecycle and navigating complex exemption frameworks.
  • Margin Lending Arrangements: Draft, review, and negotiate complex margin lending agreements with sophisticated institutional counterparties.
  • Contract Drafting & Negotiation: Draft, review, and negotiate specialized regulatory agreements, including ISDA/CSA documentation, and disclosure documents required for regulatory compliance.

Complexity and Impact of Work:

  • Cross-Functional Integration: Partner with Trading, Operations, Risk, and Engineering teams to embed CFTC/NFA compliance requirements directly into trading workflows and platform architecture.
  • Regulatory Horizon Scanning: Proactively monitor and interpret shifts in CFTC mandates and NFA interpretive notices, advising the executive team on necessary pivots to business strategy.
  • Audit & Examination Leadership: Lead the legal response to regulatory inquiries and NFA examinations, managing the preparation, document production, and strategic communication with regulators.
  • High-Stakes Problem Solving: Act as a prolific individual contributor on complex projects, such as launching new derivative asset classes or navigating cross-border regulatory shifts.
  • Risk Mitigation: Drive the development of internal "Rules-to-Workflow" frameworks to prevent regulatory breaches, ensuring the firm’s "right to operate" remains uncompromised.

Organizational Knowledge:

  • Strong understanding of Anchorage Digital’s strategy to successfully lead regulatory licensing projects while taking into consideration the goals of the team you are supporting.
  • As progress is made on the licensing applications, making sure knowledge is shared across the appropriate teams .
  • Ability to prioritize work based on company’s goals and communicate the ‘why’ behind your work.

Communication and Influence:

  • Build close cross-functional relationships with product, engineering, operations, and other teams to develop new products, improve existing businesses, identify and resolve legal issues, structure complex agreements, and improve efficiency.
  • Strong communication skills (internally and externally)
  • Ability to be client-facing while working with cross-functional teams on multiple projects internally

You may be a fit for this role if you have:

  • J.D. degree with a focus on financial services, commodities, or corporate law.
  • 4+ years of experience practicing law, with at least 3+ years specifically focused on CFTC and NFA regulatory matters.
  • Deep knowledge and practical experience with the Commodity Exchange Act (CEA) and the Dodd-Frank Act (Title VII).
  • Technical proficiency in derivatives, including a solid understanding of OTC products, margin lending, and the legal life cycle of futures and swaps.
  • Excellent communication, drafting, and negotiation skills, with specific experience handling ISDA/CSA documentation or clearing agreements.
  • Demonstrated experience working closely with the business and cross-functional teams (Trading, Engineering, and Risk) to build new financial products, solve complex jurisdictional issues, and strategize for scale.
  • Enthusiasm for crypto and a foundational understanding of how digital assets intersect with CFTC/NFA jurisdiction and the evolving global regulatory landscape.
  • Demonstrated experience with close attention to detail and the ability to manage complex licensing applications and regulatory audits simultaneously.
  • The ability to execute with moderate supervision, balancing aggressive commercial growth targets with the necessity of rigorous legal and regulatory compliance.
  • Previous in-house legal experience at a fintech firm, hedge fund, major financial institution, or a specialist regulatory practice at a top-tier law firm.
  • Familiarity with market infrastructure, including electronic trading platforms, central clearing, and the operational complexities of margin and collateral management.

Although not a requirement, bonus points if:

  • You were emotionally moved by the soundtrack to Hamilton, which chronicles the founding of a new financial system. :)

The Anchorage Village, what we call our team, brings together the brightest minds from platform security, financial services, and distributed ledger technology to provide the building blocks that empower institutions to safely participate in the evolving digital asset ecosystem. As a Senior Manager, CTEM & Vulnerability Management, you will lead the enterprise Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) and Vulnerability Management function across enterprise IT, cloud, operational technology (OT), and product environments. •Lead the enterprise CTEM and Vulnerability Management program, including its strategy, roadmap, and operating model.

•Oversee vulnerability scanning and assessment across infrastructure, cloud, endpoint, application, identity, network, and OT environments.

•Manage the product security vulnerability lifecycle with Product Security, including intake, triage, risk assessment, remediation tracking, software bill of materials (SBOM) analysis, and coordinated vulnerability disclosure support.

•Prioritize vulnerabilities and exposures using CVSS, EPSS, CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV), threat intelligence, asset criticality, and business context.

•Lead attack surface management, exposure validation, and breach and attack simulation activities to confirm exploitability and control effectiveness.

•Evaluate emerging vulnerabilities, exploits, and threat intelligence affecting enterprise systems, marketed products, and embedded systems.

•Drive automation for vulnerability discovery, data enrichment, ticketing, remediation workflows, and reporting through SOAR platforms, APIs, Python, or PowerShell.

•Support cyber incident investigations with vulnerability context, exposure analysis, and remediation expertise.

Leadership & People Management Responsibilities:

•Partner with Infrastructure, Cloud, Application, Product Security, and Engineering teams to establish risk-based service-level agreements, drive remediation, and track plans of action and milestones.

•Establish governance standards, quality assurance procedures, and documentation for vulnerability and exposure management operations.

•Measure and report exposure reduction, remediation performance, validation results, and operational metrics to executive stakeholders.

•Lead vulnerability management, exposure management, or product security vulnerability teams.

Knowledge and Capabilities:

•Analyze complex vulnerability data and large volumes of exposure telemetry to identify risk and guide response.

•Translate technical findings, remediation status, and risk trends into clear written, verbal, and presentation-ready updates for technical and executive audiences.

What You Need:

Required Qualifications

•Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.

•Minimum 10 years of experience in cybersecurity.

•Minimum 3 years of experience leading vulnerability management, exposure management, or product security vulnerability teams.

•Experience managing product vulnerabilities, including triage, coordinated vulnerability disclosure, SBOM analysis, and remediation with product engineering teams.

•Experience with Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, Wiz, ServiceNow Vulnerability Response, or equivalent vulnerability and exposure management technologies.

•Experience implementing automation through SOAR platforms, APIs, Python, or PowerShell.

Preferred Qualifications

•Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.

•CISSP, CISM, GEVA, GPEN, GIAC, Tenable, Qualys, or equivalent professional certification.

We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

In this role, you will help train and refine Grok's voice and language capabilities in Uzbek. Your expertise will directly shape how Grok speaks and understands Uzbek, from pronunciation and natural phrasing to cultural nuance. You will see your work show up in a product used by people around the world.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Annotate, label, and provide feedback on multilingual audio clips, voice recordings, and speech samples using proprietary tools.
  • Translate and localize text (UI copy, prompts, responses, and other content) from English into Uzbek, with attention to accuracy, natural phrasing, and cultural fit.
  • Help produce clear, natural audio data that accurately captures linguistic and prosodic details such as intonation, rhythm, and accent.
  • Collaborate with technical staff to refine annotation guidelines and tools for handling accents, background noise, speech variation, and multilingual audio.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Proficiency in Uzbek at CEFR C1 level or higher.
  • English proficiency at CEFR B2 level or higher.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Native proficiency in Uzbek.
  • English proficiency at CEFR C1 level or higher.
  • Experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Advanced transcription or audio annotation, with strong attention to accents, prosody, disfluencies, and variable recording quality.
    • Translation or localization work (especially UI, product copy, or conversational text) between English and Uzbek.
    • Voice recording, voice acting, podcasting, or related audio production that demonstrates clear delivery and attention to sound quality.
    • Background in linguistics, phonetics, speech sciences, or hands-on work with speech/audio datasets and AI training data.

LOCATION AND OTHER EXPECTATIONS:

  • This is a remote role which may be performed from the following countries:
    • United States
    • United Kingdom
    • Canada
    • Australia
  • This role may be offered as a full-time or part-time position, depending on role / business needs and candidate availability. Full-time positions are preferred and require working standard business hours in your local time zone.

  • For US-based candidates, please note that we are unable to hire in Wyoming and Illinois at this time.
  • We are unable to provide visa sponsorship.
  • Travel to a SpaceXSI site may be required.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

US-based candidates: $35/hour - $45/hour depending on factors including relevant experience, skills, education, geographic location, and qualifications. International candidates: Information will be provided to you during the recruitment process.

Benefits vary based on employment type, location, and jurisdiction. Benefits for eligible US-based positions include health insurance, 401(k) plan, and paid sick leave. Specific details and role-specific information will be provided to you during the interview process.

jobs.title: Group Head of Project Management Office (PMO) – Insurance & Investments
jobs.excerpt: Group Head of Project Management Office (PMO) – Insurance & Investments 1.
jobs.description:
Group Head of Project Management Office (PMO) – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Group Head of PMO is responsible for leading and overseeing the Group's project management function across all subsidiaries, business units, and geographical markets within the Insurance & Investments sector.

The role establishes group-wide project governance, portfolio management standards, delivery frameworks, and performance monitoring systems to ensure that strategic projects and transformation initiatives are executed effectively. The position provides centralized oversight of project priorities, budgets, resources, risks, dependencies, and expected business outcomes.

Working closely with the Group CEO, executive leadership, subsidiary CEOs, and business heads, the Group Head of PMO ensures that all major projects support the organization's strategic growth, operational efficiency, digital transformation, and long-term business objectives.

2. Key Responsibilities

Group PMO Strategy & Governance

  • Develop and implement the Group's overall Project Management Office strategy, structure, and operating framework.
  • Establish standardized project management methodologies, governance policies, procedures, and reporting requirements across all subsidiaries.
  • Define project approval processes, stage-gate reviews, escalation procedures, and accountability frameworks.
  • Ensure project portfolios are aligned with the Group's strategic objectives and business priorities.
  • Establish consistent project management standards and controls across geographical markets and business units.

Strategic Project Portfolio Management

  • Oversee the consolidated project portfolio across insurance, investment, corporate, and operational business units.
  • Evaluate, prioritize, and monitor strategic projects based on business value, financial impact, risk exposure, and resource requirements.
  • Monitor project progress, milestones, dependencies, budgets, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Identify underperforming projects and recommend corrective actions or changes in resource allocation.
  • Provide executive leadership with a consolidated view of project portfolio performance.

Insurance & Investment Project Oversight

  • Oversee group-wide projects involving insurance product development, underwriting, claims management, policy administration, and distribution expansion.
  • Monitor investment-related projects involving portfolio reporting, investment operations, wealth management platforms, and client servicing, where applicable.
  • Coordinate strategic initiatives involving regulatory compliance, business process modernization, and operational efficiency.
  • Support the implementation of new financial products, business models, and market expansion initiatives.
  • Ensure projects meet relevant insurance, investment, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.

Digital Transformation & Technology Projects

  • Provide governance and oversight for group-wide technology modernization and digital transformation initiatives.
  • Coordinate implementation of enterprise systems, CRM platforms, automation solutions, AI applications, and digital financial services.
  • Work with CIO, CTO, CDO, and business leadership to ensure successful technology project delivery.
  • Monitor system integration, implementation risks, technology budgets, and business adoption.
  • Ensure digital initiatives deliver measurable improvements in customer experience and operational performance.

Financial & Resource Management

  • Oversee consolidated project budgets, financial forecasts, and expenditure tracking across the Group.
  • Monitor project cost performance and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
  • Coordinate resource allocation across subsidiaries, departments, and strategic initiatives.
  • Evaluate project business cases, cost-benefit analysis, ROI, and expected benefits.
  • Ensure effective utilization of internal teams, external consultants, contractors, and implementation partners.

Risk, Compliance & Quality Management

  • Establish group-level project risk management and escalation frameworks.
  • Monitor operational, financial, regulatory, technology, and implementation risks across project portfolios.
  • Coordinate with group risk, compliance, legal, and internal audit functions.
  • Ensure projects comply with internal policies, governance standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Establish contingency and mitigation plans for critical projects and strategic programs.

Performance Reporting & Benefits Realization

  • Develop group-wide project dashboards, performance reports, and executive presentations.
  • Monitor project delivery against approved scope, budgets, timelines, milestones, and quality standards.
  • Track financial benefits, operational improvements, and ROI from strategic initiatives.
  • Prepare regular portfolio performance reports for the Group CEO, Board, and executive committees.
  • Recommend strategic interventions to improve project execution and delivery performance.

Stakeholder & Subsidiary Management

  • Work closely with subsidiary CEOs, managing directors, business unit heads, project sponsors, and program directors.
  • Facilitate group-level project steering committees and portfolio review meetings.
  • Coordinate project planning and delivery across subsidiaries and corporate functions.
  • Manage relationships with external consultants, technology vendors, contractors, and implementation partners.
  • Ensure consistent communication, accountability, and reporting across all Group entities.

Leadership & PMO Capability Development

  • Lead and develop the Group PMO team, including PMO directors, project managers, project analysts, and project controls specialists.
  • Establish PMO structures, responsibilities, and reporting relationships across subsidiaries.
  • Develop project management training, mentoring, and capability-building initiatives.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, transparency, collaboration, and delivery excellence.
  • Drive continuous improvement in project management maturity across the organization.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Project Management, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • MBA or Master's degree in Project Management, Business Strategy, Finance, or a relevant discipline preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in project management, program management, portfolio management, or enterprise transformation.
  • At least 5 years in a senior PMO leadership position overseeing multiple business units, subsidiaries, or large project portfolios.
  • Experience in insurance, reinsurance, banking, investment management, asset management, wealth management, or diversified financial services.
  • Proven track record of establishing or leading enterprise-level or group-level PMO functions.
  • Strong knowledge of project portfolio governance, financial management, resource planning, risk management, and strategic execution.
  • Experience managing complex, multi-country or multi-entity projects and transformation programs.
  • Knowledge of PMI, PRINCE2, Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid project management methodologies.
  • Strong leadership, executive communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and analytical capabilities.

Preferred Certifications:

- Project Management Professional (PMP).

  • Program Management Professional (PgMP).
  • Portfolio Management Professional (PfMP).

- PRINCE2 Practitioner.

- Agile or Scrum certifications.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Percentage of group-wide projects delivered on time and within approved budgets.
  • Overall project portfolio performance against Group strategic objectives.
  • Project cost variance and schedule variance.
  • Group PMO governance and reporting compliance.
  • Successful delivery of strategic insurance and investment initiatives.
  • Project risk identification, mitigation, and escalation effectiveness.
  • Resource utilization and allocation efficiency across subsidiaries.
  • Benefits realization and ROI of major strategic projects.
  • Accuracy and timeliness of consolidated project reporting.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction across Group entities.
  • Improvement in project management maturity across subsidiaries.
  • Reduction in project delays, cost overruns, and implementation risks.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The People Operations and Insights team drives project management rigor for the People team and our stakeholders. We empower and enable innovative, connected People products and programs that advance our shared goals and support sustainable growth.

As a Project Manager on the team, you will be responsible for working across our People pillars to champion our delivery across all impacting project/program and portfolios. You will manage projects end-to-end or cross functionally, effectively navigating complex organizational dynamics. You will utilize structured project management methodologies to ensure successful delivery and adoption of high-priority initiatives with our internal team and our users.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities

  • Tackle hard, ambiguous questions with rigor and independence, owning projects from problem definition to final recommendation.
  • Develop and implement project plans, optimize workflows and ensure all stakeholders are informed and engaged throughout the process.
  • Monitor project progress, identify potential risks, and proactively implement mitigation strategies to ensure timely and successful project delivery.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including legal, finance, and engineering to identify areas for improvement in processes and controls.
  • Establish and maintain effective project governance, ensuring that all project activities, decisions, and key milestones comply with standards and best practices.
  • Prepare materials to present to senior leadership, internal and external stakeholders, and users.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, experimentation, and continuous improvement within the People team.

Description

About Us

At Utila, you’ll help build the modern, enterprise-grade platform that powers digital asset operations for more than 300 global institutions. Our technology secures $20B+ in monthly transaction volume and has protected over $100B to date, and we’re growing fast, backed by $50M in funding and a rapidly expanding customer base.

We work on mission-critical systems that demand innovation, precision, and deep technical expertise. If you’re excited by complex challenges, want to work with exceptionally strong teammates, and are looking to make a real impact on the future of financial technology, you’ll feel right at home here.

Join us, and help build something big.

How we work
From an idea, problem, or opportunity to the final product. We have the autonomy to make decisions, challenge what can be better, and the responsibility to make it happen. We look past specific tasks or product requirements to understand their impact on our customers, our product, and the company, while finding ways to improve it.

This fast-paced, high-standard culture isn’t for everyone. And that’s okay.

Responsibilities

The role

You’ll lead two areas on our Sales Engineering team: Utila’s technical partnerships and our bids (RFPs, RFIs, DDQs, and security questionnaires). We’re looking for real technical depth: someone who isn’t satisfied until they understand how a system works end to end, and who can turn that understanding into a clear picture for engineers, executives and procurement teams alike.

Both areas rely on the same core skills: deep Utila product knowledge, mapping our fit to client systems, and translating that into an actionable story. Bids reveal where deals stall and which partners can close the gap, while partnerships provide the leverage to win bids.

This is a pre-sales role. You’ll work closely with sales, BD, product, engineering, security, and marketing, and you’ll face partners and prospects directly. You won’t run discovery, demos, POCs or sales cycles.

What you’ll lead

Technical partnerships:

  • Lead the technical scope of each partnership: validate the joint solution, scope the integration, and work through the technical details with the partner’s team.
  • Be the technical counterpart to partners’ engineering and product teams, while BD leads the commercial terms.
  • Spot new partnerships that would help win deals, including ones outside the current pipeline, and make the case to SE for why they matter.
  • Write and maintain each partnership’s documentation, architecture diagrams, and collateral.
  • Enable sales, marketing, and SE on each partnership: what it does, who it’s for, and how to position it.

Bid management:

  • Run each RFX end to end, from intake to submission.
  • Bring in the right people across product, engineering, security, legal, and commercial, so each part is answered well and on time.
  • Shape the bid strategy for each RFX: how Utila is positioned, which partners to co-bid with, and how the joint solution fits together. Build the case and drive it to a decision with SE and commercial leadership.
  • Answer the technical content as a product expert across Utila’s custody architecture, policy engine, supported chains, APIs, and compliance posture, pulling in SE and product for edge cases and new areas.
  • Support the SE leading the deal in later bid stages, such as clarification calls, finalist presentations, and security reviews.
  • Run our RFP answer library and the in-house AI tooling that drafts responses and keeps the library current, so each bid makes the next one faster.

Requirements

What you bring

  • 3+ years in a technical role that faced customers or partners, such as sales or solutions engineering, solutions architecture or partner engineering. Technical bid management experience is a plus when paired with the engineering depth below.
  • Real engineering depth from building or running systems yourself, for example in software engineering, solutions architecture, security or infrastructure. You can read code, call APIs directly and reason about how distributed systems, key management and security controls fit together.
  • You’re comfortable going deep with a partner’s engineering team or a bank’s security architects, and you’d rather test something yourself than take a doc’s word for it.
  • Curiosity about how things work. You go deep until you understand something, then explain the bigger picture to technical and business audiences alike.
  • Clear, precise writing. You can turn a complex architecture into an answer a bank’s security team or a partner’s CTO will trust.
  • Strong organization under deadlines. You’ve run several deliverables in parallel and kept many stakeholders on track.
  • Confidence with external audiences, including senior technical, security, and compliance reviewers.

Nice to have

  • Experience with digital assets, stablecoins, payments, or custody.
  • Familiarity with MPC, wallet infrastructure or blockchain protocols such as EVM chains and Solana.
  • Experience with RFP tools such as Loopio, and with institutional security questionnaires and frameworks such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001.
  • Experience selling to or partnering with banks, payment firms or other regulated financial institutions.

jobs.description:
Chief Program Officer (CPO) – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Chief Program Officer (CPO) is responsible for overseeing the organization's strategic programs, enterprise-wide initiatives, and complex, multi-project portfolios across its insurance and investment businesses.

The role ensures that major programs are strategically aligned, properly resourced, effectively governed, and successfully delivered within approved timelines and budgets. The CPO will establish program management standards, coordinate cross-functional teams, manage interdependent projects, and ensure that strategic initiatives deliver measurable business outcomes.

Working closely with the CEO, Board, and executive leadership team, the CPO will translate corporate priorities into coordinated programs that support business growth, operational excellence, digital transformation, regulatory compliance, and organizational development.

2. Key Responsibilities

Strategic Program Management

  • Develop and implement the organization's enterprise-wide program management strategy.
  • Identify, structure, prioritize, and oversee strategic programs aligned with corporate objectives.
  • Translate organizational strategies into coordinated programs with clear goals, milestones, deliverables, and expected outcomes.
  • Manage interdependencies between projects, business units, and strategic initiatives.
  • Monitor program performance and ensure alignment with organizational priorities.

Insurance & Investment Program Delivery

  • Lead strategic programs involving life insurance, general insurance, reinsurance, investment management, wealth management, and financial services.
  • Oversee programs related to insurance product development, underwriting modernization, claims transformation, policy administration, and distribution expansion.
  • Coordinate investment-related programs involving portfolio management systems, investment operations, client reporting, and service delivery, where applicable.
  • Manage initiatives involving regulatory changes, new business models, market expansion, and operational restructuring.
  • Ensure program deliverables address business requirements and relevant industry regulations.

Program Governance & Management Office

  • Establish and oversee program governance frameworks, methodologies, policies, and reporting standards.
  • Develop program charters, business cases, implementation plans, risk registers, and performance dashboards.
  • Implement structured review processes, approval mechanisms, escalation procedures, and executive reporting.
  • Ensure consistency in program management practices across subsidiaries and business units.
  • Work with the Project Management Office (PMO) to coordinate individual project delivery and maintain portfolio visibility.

Program Budget & Resource Management

  • Develop and oversee program budgets, resource plans, and financial forecasts.
  • Monitor program expenditure, financial performance, and budget variations.
  • Ensure effective allocation of people, technology, and financial resources across programs.
  • Evaluate program business cases, cost-benefit analysis, expected returns, and benefits realization.
  • Manage external consultants, contractors, technology vendors, and implementation partners.

Digital & Business Transformation Programs

  • Lead cross-functional programs involving digital transformation, automation, AI, cloud adoption, and enterprise system modernization.
  • Coordinate implementation of digital insurance platforms, customer portals, CRM systems, and investment service technologies.
  • Work with CIO, CTO, CDO, and business leaders to ensure technology programs deliver business value.
  • Oversee business process redesign, operational improvement, and organizational change initiatives.
  • Monitor adoption, implementation effectiveness, and long-term program outcomes.

Risk, Compliance & Quality Management

  • Identify, assess, and manage program-level operational, financial, regulatory, and technology risks.
  • Ensure programs comply with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.
  • Coordinate with risk, compliance, legal, and internal audit teams.
  • Establish mitigation strategies, contingency plans, and escalation mechanisms.
  • Monitor program quality and ensure deliverables meet approved standards.

Stakeholder & Executive Management

  • Collaborate with the CEO, Board, executive leadership, and business unit heads to define program priorities.
  • Coordinate communication and collaboration among project sponsors, program managers, and key stakeholders.
  • Manage relationships with regulators, external consultants, strategic partners, and implementation vendors, as appropriate.
  • Resolve conflicts involving program scope, resource allocation, timelines, and competing business priorities.
  • Present program progress, financial performance, key risks, and strategic recommendations to senior management.

Leadership & Program Management Excellence

  • Lead and develop program directors, program managers, project managers, and program delivery teams.
  • Build a high-performing program management function with clear accountability and performance standards.
  • Establish training, mentoring, and professional development initiatives.
  • Promote consistent program management methodologies and continuous improvement.
  • Introduce tools and reporting systems to improve program visibility, coordination, and delivery effectiveness.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Project Management, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • MBA or Master's degree in Program Management, Business Strategy, Finance, or a relevant discipline preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in program management, project portfolio management, enterprise transformation, or strategic initiative delivery.
  • At least 5 years in a senior leadership role overseeing large-scale, multi-project programs.
  • Experience in insurance, reinsurance, banking, investment management, asset management, wealth management, or financial services preferred.
  • Proven track record of successfully delivering complex, cross-functional programs with measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong knowledge of program governance, project management methodologies, budgeting, risk management, and resource planning.
  • Experience establishing or leading enterprise program management offices.
  • Familiarity with Agile, Waterfall, PRINCE2, PMI, and hybrid delivery methodologies.
  • Excellent leadership, strategic planning, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving capabilities.

Preferred Certifications:

  • Program Management Professional (PgMP).

- Project Management Professional (PMP).

  • Portfolio Management Professional (PfMP).

- PRINCE2 Practitioner.

- Agile or Scrum certifications.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Percentage of strategic programs delivered on time and within budget.
  • Program performance against approved strategic objectives.
  • Achievement of program milestones and deliverables.
  • Program budget variance and resource utilization.
  • Benefits realization and return on investment (ROI).
  • Effective management of project interdependencies.
  • Program risk mitigation and issue resolution effectiveness.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and executive reporting quality.
  • Compliance with program governance and reporting standards.
  • Successful delivery of digital, operational, and business transformation programs.
  • Reduction in program delays, cost overruns, and implementation risks.

This is a new role on our Learning, Training, and Content Operations team. It's remote, with approximately 30% domestic and international travel to our BPO partner sites.

In this role, you can expect to

  • Own training execution across our lines of business, ensuring BPO trainers are facilitating our programs and content as expected, that agents are receiving the support they need during new hire training, that agents are completing training on time, and provide feedback to the Learning team about opportunities.
  • Guide a group of BPO master trainer contractors to drive training excellence with BPO training teams.

Their success depends on more than a well-designed user flow: the right coverage, pricing, eligibility, partner economics, distribution, claims experience, and operational processes all need to work together. Evolve is looking for a product leader who can shape this portfolio as a durable business while making protection simple and valuable for customers.

As Principal Product Manager, you’ll own the strategy and roadmap for Protection Programs end to end. You’ll identify where protection can create value for customers and Evolve, build and optimize program economics with Commercial and partner teams, and lead cross-functional delivery with Design, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders.

What you’ll do

  • Define and own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Protection Programs, connecting customer value, risk reduction, and sustainable business performance.
  • Build a deep understanding of homeowners, guests, internal teams, and insurance or protection partners; identify where protection addresses meaningful needs across the reservation lifecycle.
  • Develop a portfolio strategy across offerings such as damage protection, travel insurance, and chargeback insurance, including where to invest, expand, refine, or retire programs.
  • Own the commercial model for programs in partnership with Commercial, Finance, and external partners. Evaluate pricing, conversion, coverage, partner economics, claims costs, and operational expense to improve sustainable contribution.
  • Identify and validate growth opportunities, including customer segments, distribution moments, packaging, pricing, and partner capabilities; translate them into clear business cases and measurable product bets.
  • Improve the end-to-end experience, from understanding and selecting protection through purchase, servicing, cancellation, and claim, while making coverage terms, eligibility, and customer expectations clear.
  • Partner with Commercial and go-to-market teams on positioning, packaging, channel strategy, and enablement so programs are compelling, accurately represented, and easy to sell or adopt.
  • Work with Operations, Claims, Support, Legal, Compliance, and partners to make program rules and service processes reliable, scalable, and aligned with applicable requirements.
  • Use customer research and data to monitor performance across awareness, attach or adoption, conversion, retention, loss and claims trends, customer satisfaction, and unit economics; adjust the roadmap as evidence changes.
  • Lead cross-functional work through discovery, business case, definition, delivery, launch, and iteration, aligning teams around outcomes, dependencies, and decisions.
  • Make clear choices across customer experience, commercial return, risk exposure, and operational complexity; communicate tradeoffs to senior stakeholders.
  • Represent the voice of customers and the health of the Protection Programs portfolio in product decisions and help the organization build a shared understanding of both.

What makes you a great fit

  • Minimum 10 years of product management experience, including 0-to-1 product buildouts and ownership of strategy and delivery for complex products or product areas.
  • Strong commercial judgment and experience owning or materially shaping a product’s business model. You can evaluate revenue, margin or contribution, pricing, adoption, partner economics, and cost-to-serve alongside customer outcomes.
  • A track record of turning ambiguous opportunities into focused strategies, business cases, roadmaps, and measurable results.
  • Experience building products that involve financial risk, insurance, payments, lending, warranties, fraud or disputes, or other regulated or partner-dependent services; direct insurance experience is a plus.
  • Ability to connect product decisions to go-to-market execution, including customer segmentation, positioning, packaging, distribution, and sales or channel enablement.
  • Strong customer discovery skills and the ability to balance customer needs with business viability, risk controls, partner requirements, and operational realities.
  • Experience working closely with external partners and internal teams such as Commercial, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Operations, Support, Design, and Engineering.
  • Comfort using product and financial data to set success measures, assess program performance, understand unit economics, and make evidence-based investment decisions.
  • The judgment to balance near-term performance with long-term customer trust, clear coverage expectations, and scalable program operations.
  • Comfort working closely with Engineering on technical tradeoffs, system constraints, integrations, and sequencing.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to align senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams around decisions and outcomes.
  • An AI builder mindset with a pragmatic approach to using AI tools, LLMs, and agents. You can rapidly prototype solutions, validate hypotheses, and address core customer needs, partnering closely with Engineering to transition proven concepts into scalable production features.
  • Experience in insurance, fintech, travel, e-commerce, property technology, vacation rentals, or other consumer or B2B2C businesses is a plus.

Compensation

For this role, our salary range is $170K to $205K, depending on relevant experience. The role is also eligible for a variable annual bonus based on company and individual performance.

Location

All Evolve team members must live in one of our approved locations by their first day. We can hire from anywhere in the U.S. except D.C. and Hawaii. Some positions may also have restrictions based on compensation in the following states: California, Maryland, New York, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, and Washington. If you live in Colorado, you can work remotely anywhere in the state, at our downtown Denver office, or a hybrid of both! If you're planning to move soon, please let us know, and we'll be happy to review your application again.

California Applicant Privacy Policy | Evolve

How we reward Evolvers

We’re intentional about offering benefits that empower every Evolver to thrive both professionally and personally because they’re more than perks—they’re investments in our customer-obsessed, high-performing team.

We believe in treating others as they want to be treated, providing benefits that deliver real value, and challenging the status quo to meet the diverse needs of our team. Whether it’s helping you take care of your health, plan for the future, or celebrate life’s milestones, our offerings are designed to support you every step of the way.

  • Financial Wellness: Industry-competitive pay, equity in the company, and a 401(k) with a 4% immediate vesting match.
  • Family Support: 16-18 weeks of paid parental leave for birthing parents and 10 weeks for non-birthing parents, plus infertility coverage.
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, with 100% employer-paid dental and vision for individual coverage, a low-cost medical option, 10 free mental health visits, and pet insurance.
  • Time to Recharge: Generous PTO, RTO (for full-time exempt employees), sick leave, holidays, and a personal holiday to celebrate what matters most to you.
  • Travel Perks: Annual Evolve travel credit after one year and discounts on stays at all Evolve properties.
  • Growth Opportunities: World-class onboarding programs, learning, and development resources to help you grow your impact.
  • Connection: Employee Resource Groups celebrating our diverse communities at Evolve.

How we work together

With our core values as our guide, every Evolver helps shape the company we want to work for and the people we want to be. We’ve cultivated a culture of collaboration, care, and responsibility that we can all be proud of, and we’re excited to see what you’ll bring as your authentic self.

Still curious about who we are and what we do? Read more about our business and our culture at .

EEO

As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified candidates will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), gender identity or gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, military service or veteran status, physical or mental disability, or any other legally protected characteristic. We're seeking a Senior Business Architect (Canada) for ACCC: someone who can go deep on brokerage operations across accounts, trading, clearing, settlement, custody, and asset servicing, and can turn that operating knowledge into clear requirements and turn that into clear requirements Product and Engineering can build.

You are the bridge between how the Canadian brokerage actually works and the product roadmap. You lead structured discovery with counterparts and work out how partner firms, account opening, clearing, custody, and day-to-day operations fit together, then write that down as epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and open decisions.

Success is measured by: requirements and designs teams can build without guessing; a clear split between what the system does and what people still do at launch; solution options that Product and Engineering can sequence; and a backlog tied to ACCC milestones and capabilities.

What You'll Walk Into

You won't be starting from zero. You'll be owning live problems:

  • Operations scope: defining what ACCC must support across accounts, trading, clearing, settlement, custody, books and records, and asset servicing.

  • Platform gap analysis: comparing today's Alpaca platform with Canadian brokerage operations requirements to decide what we reuse, change, or build.
  • Launch scope: separating what must work on day one from what follows, including registered accounts (TFSA, RRSP, RESP), more products, and more partner services.
  • Open decisions: logging each one with an owner so it gets closed or consciously deferred.

What you’ll own

Requirements across ACCC’s brokerage operations, and what comes next:

  • Map brokerage operations end to end across these areas: broker onboarding, account carrying, trade clearing/settlement, custody of cash/securities, books & records, financing (if in scope), corporate actions, transfers, exceptions, and reporting
  • Help define target operating models and capability designs: what the platform must do, what stays manual (for now), what is control vs. feature, what is Canada-specific vs. reusable globally
  • Turn regulatory and operational obligations into product requirements: what the platform must do, what stays manual (for now), what is control vs. feature, what is Canada-specific vs. reusable globally
  • Write epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and edge cases that Product and Engineering can build against.
  • Produce the artifacts teams actually use: process maps, capability matrices, requirement specs, data/field definitions, state machines, exception catalogs, RACI for build vs. run, and decision logs
  • Work with Product Managers and Engineering to sequence MVP → launch → scale: must-haves for go-live vs. post-launch backlog across these operating areas (e.g. additional account types, asset classes, IB services, automation)
  • Interface across Product, Engineering, Ops, and Compliance: translate business need into buildable scope; escalate open decisions with clear owners and options
  • Run structured discovery: workshops, SME interviews, gap analysis vs. current Alpaca platform, peer operating models where useful
  • Keep requirements automation- and AI-aware: flag where STP, rules, and AI-assisted exception handling should be designed in—not bolted on later
  • Flag where straight-through processing, rules, and AI-assisted exception handling should be designed from the start.
  • Maintain a living requirements backlog tied to ACCC milestones, risks, and open decisions

Who you are (Must-Haves)

  • Excited about what Alpaca is building and about standing up Canadian brokerage operations.
  • Comfortable operating as a senior IC reporting to the President — driving clarity across Product, Engineering, Ops, and Compliance without needing a formal team.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, finance, or equivalent.
  • 8+ years as a business architect, business analyst, consultant or in product operations within brokerage, clearing, custody, or capital markets.
  • Comfortable translating brokerage operating processes and regulatory requirements into product language (you don’t need to be a lawyer or CCO)
  • Strong structured analysis: flows, entities, states, exceptions, controls, and what breaks if a step is missing.
  • Clear writing: specs, diagrams, and decisions others can execute against.
  • Collaborative with Ops SMEs, PMs, Engineering, and Compliance; curious enough to dig; disciplined enough to close loops
  • Bias to precision over vague “requirements fluff”; you know when something is a product change vs. an ops procedure vs. a policy decision
  • Judgment to tell a product change from an operating procedure or a policy decision.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across operations, product, engineering, and compliance.

Who you might be (Nice-to-Haves)

  • Experience on a carrying, self-clearing, or custody build.
  • Canadian dealer, carrying broker, or introducing broker experience.
  • Prior business architecture or enterprise/solution architecture exposure in capital markets
  • Familiarity with CDS or Canadian settlement workflows.

Arctiq is a global, intelligence-driven technology services company delivering professional and managed services across Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure, Networking & Connected Experiences, Cybersecurity, Data & AI, Autonomous Operations & Intelligence, and Enterprise Service Management. We help organizations operate, secure, and modernize complex environments by unifying infrastructure, networking, data, security, automation, and observability under a single, integrated operating model. Our work focuses on helping customers reduce operational friction, improve resilience, and make better, faster decisions as their environments evolve. Arctiq builds on decades of industry expertise and a customer-centric ethos to deliver exceptional value to clients across diverse industries.

This is a fully remote 6 month contract-to-permanent opportunity with one of Arctiq's clients. Candidates must be able to work permanent for any US employer and located in one of these states: AZ; CA; CO; CT; DC; FL; IL; IN; MA; MD; ME; NH; NJ; NY; PA; TN; TX; UT; VA; VT.

We are hiring a Senior Systems Engineer to take the lead on engineering, administering, and continually refining our client's enterprise Systems and Compute environment. Your focus will be keeping the infrastructure reliable, secure, and efficient, and spotting ways to modernize, automate, and upgrade the overall technology environment.

Day to day, you'll collaborate with the Manager of Systems and other technology groups to make sure infrastructure solutions fit business requirements, enterprise architecture, and operational standards. We need someone who pairs hands-on technical depth with sharp problem-solving and real experience running complex enterprise environments.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and manage the foundational systems: Exchange, physical and virtual servers, Active Directory and Group Policy, Certificate Services, authentication platforms, and the compute, networking, storage, and remote access/mobility services that go with them.
  • Provide administration and support for cloud-based platforms and services, including Microsoft Azure and Office 365.
  • Oversee and administer Citrix VDI, load balancers, and SSL certificate management.
  • Track, maintain, and fine-tune system performance so the environment stays reliable, scalable, and secure.
  • Handle routine, scheduled, and long-term maintenance as well as user-facing service work, keeping operational standards consistently high.
  • Act as the expert-level escalation contact for difficult technical problems.
  • Write and keep current detailed technical documentation covering processes, procedures, troubleshooting guides, training materials, and change management records.
  • Share in the on-call rotation, covering after-hours support as required.
  • Be ready for occasional overtime, off-hours work, or travel when projects and operations call for it. Make sure integrations are secure, efficient, and in line with enterprise architecture and governance standards.

  • Keep records of data flows, API endpoints, schemas, and integration logic.

  • Back efforts to ensure data quality, integrity, and reconciliation between systems.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of designing, building, securing, and managing virtualized environments on the VMware stack (ESXi, vCenter).
  • Hands-on experience building and securing Hyperconverged Infrastructure (Nutanix, Dell VxRail, HPE).
