jobs.title: Associate Ocular Sales Representative - North (USA - Remote, US)
jobs.excerpt: Bausch + Lomb (NYSE/TSX: BLCO) is a leading global eye health company dedicated to protecting and enhancing the gift of sight for millions of people around the world—from the moment of birth through every phase of life.
jobs.description:
Bausch + Lomb (NYSE/TSX: BLCO) is a leading global eye health company dedicated to protecting and enhancing the gift of sight for millions of people around the world—from the moment of birth through every phase of life. Our mission is simple, yet powerful: helping you see better, to live better.

Our comprehensive portfolio of over 400 products is fully integrated and built to serve our customers across the full spectrum of their eye health needs throughout their lives. Our iconic brand is built on the deep trust and loyalty of our customers established over our 170-year history. We have a significant global research, development, manufacturing and commercial footprint of approximately 13,000 employees and a presence in approximately 100 countries, extending our reach to billions of potential customers across the globe. We have long been associated with many of the most significant advances in eye health, and we believe we are well positioned to continue leading the advancement of eye health in the future.

Overview

Bausch + Lomb is seeking a high-performing Associate Ocular Sales Representative to participate in an 18-24 month sales development program designed to prepare high-potential talent for future field sales opportunities within the organization. In this role, you will partner closely with field sales leadership, Eye Care Sales Specialists, and cross-functional teams to execute territory business plans, engage Eye Care Practitioners and Health Care Providers, and promote the appropriate use of approved Bausch + Lomb products and services.

As a flexible field support resource, you will gain exposure to a variety of customers, markets, and business challenges while providing support across priority and strategically important territories. The role may involve up to 50% travel and support customers across multiple geographies and time zones based on business needs. Candidates must be willing and able to relocate within 18 months of hire to pursue future field sales opportunities and career growth within Bausch + Lomb.

Responsibilities

  • Execute territory business plans, call plans, and customer engagement strategies to meet or exceed sales goals, key performance metrics, and business continuity needs within assigned geographies delivering sales calls and approved resources.
  • Provide in person and virtual field coverage for open, priority, or targeted territories by engaging the right customers with the right message and appropriate frequency through video, phone, digital, and other approved channels.
  • Build and maintain collaborative relationships with customers, field sales leadership, customer service, marketing, and multiple stakeholders.
  • Use approved marketing, sales, and promotional resources to support customer education, product awareness, clinical discussions, demonstrate strong competitive knowledge to support credible customer conversations and identify opportunities for growth.
  • Leverage CRM, virtual engagement platforms, Microsoft Office, and other digital tools to document customer interactions, track account progress, analyze territory opportunities, and maintain accurate records.
  • Complete all administrative responsibilities, reporting, compliance requirements, and business documentation accurately and participate in all training programs and meetings.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred with focus in business, communications, marketing, operations, and medical but will accept applicants with at least 2+ years of successful B2B or healthcare experience demonstrating transferable skills sets needed for success in role in lieu of degree.
  • Phone/Virtual selling capability to open new access and service existing customers, including proficiency with video, phone, CRM, Microsoft Office, and digital engagement technologies used to support remote customer interactions.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and collaboration skills with the ability to educate customers and work effectively across internal teams.
  • Self-motivated, accountable, ethical, and able to work independently from a professional home office environment with reliable high-speed internet.
  • Ability to support targeted accounts across assigned time zones and travel as needed for key customer meetings, field coverage, sales meetings, programs, or trade shows.
  • Valid driver’s license and driving record which meets Bausch + Lomb company standards.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

For U.S. locations that require disclosure of compensation, the starting pay for this role is between $90,000.00 - $115,000.00. The estimated salary range reflects an anticipated range for this position. The actual base salary offered may depend on a variety of factors.

U.S. based employees may be eligible for short-term and/or long-term incentives. They may also be eligible to participate in medical, dental, vision insurance, disability and life insurance, a 401(k) plan and company match, a tuition reimbursement program (select degrees), company holidays, and well-being benefits, among others. U.S. based employees are also eligible to receive sick time, floating holidays and paid vacation.

Job Applicants should be aware of job offer scams perpetrated through the use of the Internet and social media platforms.

To learn more please read Bausch + Lomb's Job Offer Fraud Statement

Our US Benefit Programs Employee Benefits: Bausch + Lomb

jobs.title: Business Partner Analyst
jobs.excerpt: Who we areAbout StripeStripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses.
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Strategy & Analytics (S&A) maximizes and accelerates Operations' ability to make Stripe work for our users. We aspire to be the COOs for Stripe Ops, working cross-functionally with global teams to help run the day-to-day business and articulate and achieve the longer term, high effort, high value strategic priorities. We take a data-driven approach that combines strategy and analytics to help Ops leaders solve their most complex and most important issues while also driving the business planning and operational cadence end-to-end, from strategy to goal-setting to execution.

What you’ll do

In this role, you’ll be the go-to expert for your business area. You’ll be hands-on and responsible for delivering critical insights, ensuring data driven decision making is at the core of what we do. You’ll also partner with leadership to drive business strategy, planning, goal-setting and performance tracking. You may also scope and lead mission critical projects and execute on strategic initiatives.

Responsibilities

  • Metrics & Insights: Wrangle large, highly complex datasets using SQL into actionable insights and become the data expert for your business area. Develop metrics and large-scale dashboards to track the health of our user-facing and internal teams. Perform analyses (using SQL & other analytical tools/languages), identify trends, conduct research, build models, all to deliver objective, critical insights that can inform leadership of opportunities, risks, and strategic priorities.
  • Communicate with executives: Create narratives and documents that tell the story of your business area to influence senior Operations leadership and Stripe executive team decision making
  • Stakeholder management: Influence and drive cross-functional change by partnering with stakeholders across a wide internal network of globally distributed teams, including Ops, Finance, Data Science, Product/Engineering, and more
  • Drive operational excellence: Design, optimize and drive operational reviews and rhythm of the business. Guide the planning and goal-setting process for your business area, as well as progress checks throughout the year. Bring and consistently apply a ROI lens to all operational decisions, so we can make better-informed trade-offs
  • Support planning: support with forecasting/planning processes for Financial Crimes, including near/medium/long-term planning, to enable leadership to make strategic decisions

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of prior experience in analytical and strategic roles in management consulting, Operations, Support, Risk or Financial Services
  • Outstanding analytical ability, expert in SQL and understanding of data relationships
  • Outstanding communication, presentation skills & stakeholder management skills
  • Experience working in or with Operations, Support, Risk, Trust & Safety, Financial Crimes, or Financial Services
  • Expertise working cross-functionally and with globally distributed teams to drive business and operational goals using data
  • Ability to connect the big picture to minute details, toggling between them to set and operationalize strategy

Preferred qualifications

    • Experience working in fast-paced environments (e.g. high-growth internet or software company, management consulting)
    • Structured problem solving skills, combined with strong business acumen.
    • Experience with Tableau

Full time, United Kingdom

We are very excited to be on the lookout for an experienced Entertainment Consultant to join our Media & Entertainment division. We are the Media & Entertainment division of BCD Travel, one of the world’s largest and most admired travel management companies. Leading artists, sporting teams, labels, media, and production companies have trusted us with their travel for over 40 years. We handle anything from managing travel for TV & Film productions, making sure that the artists and their entourage arrive on the red carpet on time, to transporting a football team internationally to a cup final at a moment’s notice!

At BCD Travel, we work with highly motivated and passionate people. We value open communication, collaboration, and a flexible work-life balance. We offer unique, often global, experiences that empower you to develop and grow within the organization. Sustainability and helping others is also high on our list. We make a difference through charitable activities in our communities across the globe.

BCD Travel helps companies travel smart and achieve more. We drive program adoption, cost savings and talent retention through digital experiences that simplify business travel. Our 15,000+ dedicated team members service clients in 170+ countries as we shape a sustainable future for business travel. BCD’s leading meetings and events management and global consultancy services complete our comprehensive suite of solutions for all aspects of corporate travel. In 2024, BCD achieved US$22.9 billion in sales. For more information, visit www.bcdtravel.com.

Get to know us by reading our blog and checking out our social media:

  • A compensation package that feels fair to you, including mental, physical, and financial wellbeing tools
  • Travel industry professional perks and discounts

jobs.title: VP, Financial Planning & Analysis
jobs.excerpt: About ClearGovClearGov is building the modern financial operating layer for the public sector.
jobs.description:
About ClearGov

ClearGov is building the modern financial operating layer for the public sector.

We help US local governments and school districts plan, budget, report, and communicate their finances with clarity and confidence. From long-term planning to financial reporting, compliance, and transparency, our platform connects the work finance teams are already doing and makes it easier to deliver for their communities.

Today, more than 2,000 public sector organizations use ClearGov, and we continue to expand our platform and reach as we grow.

Our Core Values

  • Be Clear & Credible
    • We are authentic in our interactions, communicating with clarity, speaking with honesty, and following through with consistency. We turn transparency into our greatest competitive advantage.
  • Be Human
    • We are human partners to our colleagues and customers and lead with consideration and kindness - making space for others to do the same. We turn empathy into a shared strength.
  • Be Better Together
    • We are committed to building an inclusive community where everyone thrives. We share successes, support each other through challenges, and show up for our teammates the way we show up for our customers. We turn togetherness into our greatest advantage and collaboration into our greatest multiplier.
  • Be Honourable/Honorable
    • We are responsible to our colleagues and customers. We bring our full selves to every conversation, every project, every decision, and every relationship. We act with intention, deliver on our commitments, and lead with integrity - even when no one is watching. We turn honour into the foundation that powers everything we do.
  • Be Connected
    • We are culture builders where people are seen, welcomed, and celebrated. We show up in every interaction - the laughs, the wins, the hard days. We turn connection into opportunities for people to feel they belong.


What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You take ownership and follow through
  • You communicate clearly and effectively
  • You're comfortable solving problems and figuring things out
  • You learn quickly and adapt as things change
  • You care about the team, not just your own work
  • You bring a sense of humor and perspective to what you do

About the Opportunity

We are seeking a hands-on Vice President, Financial Planning & Analysis to own enterprise-wide planning, forecasting, and performance analytics for a growth-stage SaaS business. This is not a purely oversight role, the VP, FP&A will be in the models directly, building and stress-testing scenarios, and translating the numbers into decisions. Reporting to the CFO, this person will be a key partner to executive leadership and business unit owners, and will play a central role in the company's next chapter of growth.

We're looking for someone who wants to build, not just review, someone as comfortable inside the mechanics of a model as they are presenting its output to the CFO and board.

Key Responsibilities:

  • 10+ years of progressive finance experience, including FP&A leadership, with a track record of being genuinely hands-on in the model — not several layers removed from it.
  • Direct experience in a SaaS or recurring-revenue business, fluent in ARR, NRR, churn, cohort, and unit economics analysis.
  • Strong financial modeling and scenario-planning skills — able to build complex models from scratch and pressure-test assumptions in real time.
  • Exposure to an exit, sale process, recapitalization, refinancing, or similar transaction, with a working understanding of what "diligence-ready" actually looks like.
  • Executive presence — able to move fluidly between deep model work and clear, confident presentation to the CFO and board.
  • Strong judgment about what's urgent, what's important, and what can wait — able to prioritize across competing asks from the CFO, business leaders, and the sponsor.

Nice-to-haves:

  • M&A diligence or post-acquisition integration experience.
  • CPA, CFA, or MBA.
  • Prior experience building or scaling an FP&A function from a less mature state.

Compensation:

  • In the spirit of transparency, we are excited to share the base salary for this position is $200,000 - $240,000 USD and $185,000 - $225,000 CAD and exclusive of fringe benefits or potential bonuses. If you are hired at ClearGov, your final base salary compensation will be determined by factors such as skills, interview performance, education and/or experience. In addition to those factors, we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider internal equity of our current team members as a part of any final offer. Please keep in mind that the range mentioned above is the full base salary for the role. Hiring beyond the base range would not be typical in order to allow for future & continued salary growth. We also offer a generous compensation and benefits package (more information on benefits listed below).

Why Join ClearGov

  • Remote and flexible work environment
  • Meaningful work that impacts communities across the United States
  • Collaborative, high-performing team
  • Competitive compensation and benefits
  • Opportunities to grow as we scale

Benefits

  • Medical, dental & vision insurance
  • FSA, HSA, and/or Dependent Care FSA (US)
  • Life + AD&D insurance, plus short-term and long-term disability insurance (US)
  • Life + disability insurance (Canada)
  • 401(k) (US) / RRSP (Canada) with 3.5% match
  • 10 company holidays
  • 3 wellness days
  • Paid vacation time off
  • Sick and safe time off
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid bereavement leave
  • Paid jury duty + civic service leave
  • Employee assistance program
  • 2 summer days + annual end-of-year "Dimming of the Lights"
  • Employee referral bonus program

How to Apply
Ready to join us? Apply online today!


Equal Opportunity Employer
ClearGov is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, or any other protected characteristic. Hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

jobs.description:
About ClearGov

ClearGov is building the modern financial operating layer for the public sector.

We help US local governments and school districts plan, budget, report, and communicate their finances with clarity and confidence. From long-term planning to financial reporting, compliance, and transparency, our platform connects the work finance teams are already doing and makes it easier to deliver for their communities.

Today, more than 2,000 public sector organizations use ClearGov, and we continue to expand our platform and reach as we grow.

Our Core Values

  • Be Clear & Credible
    • We are authentic in our interactions, communicating with clarity, speaking with honesty, and following through with consistency. We turn transparency into our greatest competitive advantage.
  • Be Human
    • We are human partners to our colleagues and customers and lead with consideration and kindness - making space for others to do the same. We turn empathy into a shared strength.
  • Be Better Together
    • We are committed to building an inclusive community where everyone thrives. We share successes, support each other through challenges, and show up for our teammates the way we show up for our customers. We turn togetherness into our greatest advantage and collaboration into our greatest multiplier.
  • Be Honourable/Honorable
    • We are responsible to our colleagues and customers. We bring our full selves to every conversation, every project, every decision, and every relationship. We act with intention, deliver on our commitments, and lead with integrity - even when no one is watching. We turn honour into the foundation that powers everything we do.
  • Be Connected
    • We are culture builders where people are seen, welcomed, and celebrated. We show up in every interaction - the laughs, the wins, the hard days. We turn connection into opportunities for people to feel they belong.


What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You take ownership and follow through
  • You communicate clearly and effectively
  • You're comfortable solving problems and figuring things out
  • You learn quickly and adapt as things change
  • You care about the team, not just your own work
  • You bring a sense of humor and perspective to what you do

About the Opportunity

We're hiring a Senior Manager, PMO to build, professionalize, and scale our project management function from the ground up. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can operate at both the strategic and tactical level, designing repeatable processes and templates one day, sitting in a client escalation call the next, and coaching a growing team of project managers throughout.

You will be a foundational leader as we scale 3x over the next 3-4 years, directly shaping how we deliver, implement, and retain government clients at scale. This is a player-coach role.

Key Responsibilities:

Team Leadership & Talent Development

  • Build, hire, and lead a high-performing team of Project Managers / Implementation Managers, scaling the team and processes in line with company growth (from $50M to $150M ARR)
  • Establish career pathing, performance management, coaching frameworks, and onboarding programs for PMO staff
  • Foster a culture of accountability, client-centricity, and continuous improvement
  • Act as a player-coach — hands-on in delivery while developing direct reports into future leaders

PMO Build-Out & Process Ownership

  • Stand up the formal PMO function: governance model, methodology, and delivery playbooks appropriate for public sector implementations
  • Design and implement standardized templates for project charters, implementation plans, status reporting, RAID logs, and change orders
  • Define and continuously improve intake-to-close delivery workflows, ensuring consistency and scalability across a growing project portfolio
  • Establish KPIs and dashboards to track project health, resource utilization, on-time/on-budget delivery, and client satisfaction

Client-Facing Delivery & Escalation Management

  • Serve as a senior escalation point for at-risk or high-visibility government client implementations
  • Partner directly with client stakeholders (agency leadership, CFOs, procurement) to manage expectations, timelines, and scope
  • Lead executive-level status reviews and steering committee meetings for strategic accounts
  • Systems, Tools & Reporting
  • Influence and optimize the PMO's tool stack
  • Ensure clean data flow and reporting between CSM, Support, Sales, and Delivery systems
  • Own KPIs including backlog, at-risk reporting, projected go-live dates, and budgets vs. actuals

Cross-Functional & Strategic Contribution

  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering to ensure smooth handoffs and alignment on client commitments
  • Provide input into resourcing models and hiring plans as the company scales toward $150M ARR — looking for opportunities for continuous efficiencies
  • Contribute to broader operational scalability initiatives, including pricing/packaging of services, SOW standardization, and delivery capacity planning

Critical Skills/Experience:

Experience

  • 7+ years in project/program management, with 3+ years in a PMO leadership or team management capacity
  • Experience in SaaS, ideally with GovTech, public sector, or highly regulated environments
  • Demonstrated success building or scaling a PMO function from an early or informal stage into a structured, repeatable practice
  • Track record of managing and growing a team of PMs/Implementation Managers (hiring, coaching, performance management)
  • Direct experience with Salesforce, Rocketlane, ChurnZero (or comparable implementation/PS tools), and Gong (or comparable call intelligence platforms)
  • Experience managing client escalations at the executive level, ideally with government or public sector clients
  • Strong understanding of both Agile and traditional/Waterfall methodologies, with the judgment to apply the right approach by client and project type

Skills & Attributes

  • Builder mentality — comfortable creating structure and process where none exists
  • Excellent executive presence; confident leading conversations with government stakeholders and internal leadership
  • Strong financial/operational acumen (utilization, margin, resourcing, forecasting)
  • Calm under pressure; skilled at de-escalating tense client situations
  • Data-driven, with the ability to translate metrics into action
  • Passion for public sector, mission-driven work
  • Excels at the player-coach role

Preferred Qualifications

  • PMP, PgMP, or equivalent certification
  • Experience with public sector procurement cycles, RFPs, and government contracting nuances
  • Prior experience in a company scaling through hypergrowth (PE-backed company)

Compensation:

  • In the spirit of transparency, we are excited to share the base salary for this position is $115,000 - $135,000 USD and exclusive of fringe benefits or potential bonuses. If you are hired at ClearGov, your final base salary compensation will be determined by factors such as skills, interview performance, education and/or experience. In addition to those factors, we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider internal equity of our current team members as a part of any final offer. Please keep in mind that the range mentioned above is the full base salary for the role. Hiring beyond the base range would not be typical in order to allow for future & continued salary growth. We also offer a generous compensation and benefits package (more information on benefits listed below).

Why Join ClearGov

  • Employee referral bonus program

How to Apply
Ready to join us? Apply online today!

We’re positive. You’ll love it.

Are you passionate about oral health, building meaningful professional relationships, and driving sales for world-class dental solutions? Colgate-Palmolive is seeking a proactive and relationship-driven Virtual Oral Care Consultant to join our dedicated, remote UK team.

In this role, you will act as a key partner to dental professionals across your designated territory. Working remotely via video calls and telesales, you will detail, sell, and merchandise Colgate's specialist professional product line. You will play a pivotal role in driving brand endorsement, educating dental teams, and boosting sales across the UK.

What You Will Do

  • Build Strong Relationships: Connect with dentists, hygienists, and dental nurses via scheduled video calls and phone interactions to build rapport and trust.

  • Drive Product Endorsement & Sales: Sell specialist professional products while promoting consumer brand recommendations and endorsement across your territory.

  • Educate & Inform: Deliver technical, scientific, and product insights during one-on-one virtual meetings, educational group presentations, and trade exhibitions.

  • Data & CRM Management: Maintain meticulous customer records in our C4C system—capturing meeting notes, market feedback, and competitor intelligence.

  • Collaborate & Grow: Work closely with your Senior Dental Area Manager through tailored coaching and individual development plans, while sharing continuous market feedback with our Professional Marketing and Sales teams.

  • Relationship & Consultative Sales: Proven ability in consultative and solution-focused selling with strong relationship-building capabilities.

  • Customer-Centric Approach: Dedicated to understanding customer needs and crafting tailored sales recommendations.

  • Analytical & Strategic Thinking: Skilled at evaluating market activity, managing territory performance, and making sound business decisions.

  • Healthcare Experience (Preferred): Prior experience working with or partnering alongside healthcare professionals is an advantage, though not essential.

  • Strong planning, prioritization, and negotiation skills.

jobs.title: Client Support Specialist
jobs.excerpt: About ClearGovClearGov is building the modern financial operating layer for the public sector.
jobs.description:
About ClearGov

ClearGov is building the modern financial operating layer for the public sector.

We help US local governments and school districts plan, budget, report, and communicate their finances with clarity and confidence. From long-term planning to financial reporting, compliance, and transparency, our platform connects the work finance teams are already doing and makes it easier to deliver for their communities.

Today, more than 2,000 public sector organizations use ClearGov, and we continue to expand our platform and reach as we grow.

Our Core Values

  • Be Clear & Credible
    • We are authentic in our interactions, communicating with clarity, speaking with honesty, and following through with consistency. We turn transparency into our greatest competitive advantage.
  • Be Human
    • We are human partners to our colleagues and customers and lead with consideration and kindness - making space for others to do the same. We turn empathy into a shared strength.
  • Be Better Together
    • We are committed to building an inclusive community where everyone thrives. We share successes, support each other through challenges, and show up for our teammates the way we show up for our customers. We turn togetherness into our greatest advantage and collaboration into our greatest multiplier.
  • Be Honourable/Honorable
    • We are responsible to our colleagues and customers. We bring our full selves to every conversation, every project, every decision, and every relationship. We act with intention, deliver on our commitments, and lead with integrity - even when no one is watching. We turn honour into the foundation that powers everything we do.
  • Be Connected
    • We are culture builders where people are seen, welcomed, and celebrated. We show up in every interaction - the laughs, the wins, the hard days. We turn connection into opportunities for people to feel they belong.


What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You take ownership and follow through
  • You communicate clearly and effectively
  • You're comfortable solving problems and figuring things out
  • You learn quickly and adapt as things change
  • You care about the team, not just your own work
  • You bring a sense of humor and perspective to what you do

About the Opportunity

We're looking for a Client Support Specialist (CSS) with a passion for learning, a kind heart, a positive attitude, and a great sense of humor. The CSS answers questions and resolves or escalates client issues with accuracy, empathy, and efficiency, becoming an expert on ClearGov's products and how clients use them. When not responding to inbound requests, the CSS helps create and maintain Support Center content (articles, tutorials, checklists). Primary expectations are availability between 8:00 AM-5:00 PM ET.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Master ClearGov's Software: Learn, in detail, how client financial data flows through our products; stay current as new features and products launch.
  • Provide First-Line Support: Investigate, diagnose, and resolve technical/non-technical client issues across phone, email, chat, and remote (Zoom) sessions.
  • Be a Proactive Problem Solver: Resolve customer issues quickly, efficiently, and correctly, anticipating challenges before they escalate.
  • Manage Complaints & Feedback: Address concerns professionally, follow up to confirm resolution, and share client feedback to improve the product.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with Product, Data, TCSS, and Client Success Managers to ensure client satisfaction and continuous improvement.
  • Coordinate Escalations: Work directly with the LTWO team to prioritize and resolve bug fixes.
  • Communicate with Precision: Tailor clear, concise communication to internal and external stakeholders; manage your workload to meet deadlines.
  • Drive Client Success: Advocate for client needs, build trusted relationships, and champion their journey toward their goals.
  • Support Content Creation: Help build and maintain Support Center articles, tutorials, and checklists based on ongoing support trends.

Critical Skills/Experience:

  • Proven customer service experience across multiple support channels.
  • Excellent oral and written communication; able to explain technical concepts clearly.
  • Technical aptitude with a quick ability to master ClearGov's product suite.
  • Strong, proactive troubleshooting skills; knows when to escalate to Tier 2 support.
  • Skilled at multitasking and prioritizing in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience with Zendesk a plus; experience with Jira a plus.
  • Experience with local governments or school districts is a definite plus.

Compensation:

  • In the spirit of transparency, we are excited to share the base salary for this position is $60,000 - $70,000 USD and exclusive of fringe benefits or potential bonuses. If you are hired at ClearGov, your final base salary compensation will be determined by factors such as skills, interview performance, education and/or experience. In addition to those factors, we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider internal equity of our current team members as a part of any final offer. Please keep in mind that the range mentioned above is the full base salary for the role. Hiring beyond the base range would not be typical in order to allow for future & continued salary growth. We also offer a generous compensation and benefits package (more information on benefits listed below).

Why Join ClearGov

  • Remote and flexible work environment
  • Meaningful work that impacts communities across the United States
  • Collaborative, high-performing team
  • Competitive compensation and benefits
  • Opportunities to grow as we scale

Benefits

  • Medical, dental & vision insurance
  • FSA, HSA, and/or Dependent Care FSA (US)
  • Life + AD&D insurance, plus short-term and long-term disability insurance (US)
  • Life + disability insurance (Canada)
  • 401(k) (US) / RRSP (Canada) with 3.5% match
  • 10 company holidays
  • 3 wellness days
  • Paid vacation time off
  • Sick and safe time off
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid bereavement leave
  • Paid jury duty + civic service leave
  • Employee assistance program
  • 2 summer days + annual end-of-year "Dimming of the Lights"
  • Employee referral bonus program

How to Apply
Ready to join us? Apply online today!


Equal Opportunity Employer
ClearGov is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, or any other protected characteristic. Hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

ClearGov is building the modern financial operating layer for the public sector.

We help US local governments and school districts plan, budget, report, and communicate their finances with clarity and confidence. From long-term planning to financial reporting, compliance, and transparency, our platform connects the work finance teams are already doing and makes it easier to deliver for their communities.

Today, more than 2,000 public sector organizations use ClearGov, and we continue to expand our platform and reach as we grow.

  • Be Human
    • We are human partners to our colleagues and customers and lead with consideration and kindness - making space for others to do the same. We turn empathy into a shared strength.

    • We are committed to building an inclusive community where everyone thrives. We share successes, support each other through challenges, and show up for our teammates the way we show up for our customers. We turn togetherness into our greatest advantage and collaboration into our greatest multiplier.

We act with intention, deliver on our commitments, and lead with integrity - even when no one is watching. We turn honour into the foundation that powers everything we do.
  • Be Connected
    • We are culture builders where people are seen, welcomed, and celebrated. We show up in every interaction - the laughs, the wins, the hard days. We turn connection into opportunities for people to feel they belong.


What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You take ownership and follow through
  • You communicate clearly and effectively
  • You're comfortable solving problems and figuring things out
  • You learn quickly and adapt as things change
  • You care about the team, not just your own work
  • You bring a sense of humor and perspective to what you do

About the Opportunity

ClearGov has built a strong product marketing foundation, with an established team supporting product launches, messaging, and sales enablement across a growing portfolio. As the company enters its next phase of growth, ClearGov is hiring a Director of Product & Solution Marketingto elevate the function from strong product-level execution to platform-and- solution-level strategy.

Reporting to the VP of Marketing, this leader will define how ClearGov positions, packages, and brings to market a suite of 13 products across cities, counties, school districts, and special districts, each with distinct needs and buying dynamics. The Director of Product & Solution Marketing will help the company make sharper decisions about where to invest, how the products fit together, and how ClearGov expands within its customer base.

This is a highly visible leadership role with meaningful autonomy and direct access to the executive team and board. The Director of Product & Solution Marketing will serve as a strategic partner to the VP of Marketing, CPO and CRO, translating customer and market insight into portfolio choices and measurable commercial impact.

This leader will manage an established team of four, creating a five-person product & solution marketing organization, with the opportunity to grow the team as the function expands.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead pricing and packaging strategy: Set the strategic direction for bundling, discounting, and launch pricing in partnership with Product, Finance, Revenue, and external research partners.
  • Set portfolio and commercialization strategy: Define how ClearGov’s products fit together, where bundling and cross-sell opportunities exist, and how positioning and go-to-market motions should vary across customer segments.
  • Shape executive decision-making: Represent product marketing with the executive team and board, connecting market, customer, and competitive insight to growth priorities and business performance.
  • Lead and develop the product marketing organization: Build on the team’s subject matter expertise and strengths in messaging, launches, and enablement while expanding its capabilities in portfolio strategy, market intelligence, pricing, and commercial planning.
  • Build a scalable launch and integration model: Partner with Product, Marketing, and Sales on new product / bundle launches and create repeatable approaches for positioning, packaging, and commercializing acquired products.
  • Strengthen expansion motions: Partner with Revenue and Marketing leaders to improve cross-sell, upsell, and account-based growth programs across ClearGov’s customer base.
  • Establish a market and customer intelligence discipline: Build competitive intelligence, win-loss analysis, and industry engagement that inform product, sales, and portfolio decisions.
  • Own the market narrative and field adoption: Craft bold, outcome-based messaging that clearly differentiates ClearGov from spreadsheets and competing vendors, including sharp depositioning that sales can use in live deals. Ensure sales actually uses what the team builds by measuring content adoption, retiring assets that go unused, and tying messaging to win rates.
  • Create clear measures of impact: Define how product marketing performance is evaluated and connect the team’s work to adoption, expansion, win rates, and revenue outcomes.

Critical Skills/Experience:

  • Significant product marketing leadership experience in B2B SaaS, including recent experience at the Director or Senior Director level, or operating at a comparable scope.
  • Experience owning go-to-market or commercialization strategy across a multi-product / platform portfolio, multiple customer segments, or distinct buyer personas.
  • Pricing and packaging experience, including bundling, discounting, or launch pricing.
  • A track record of translating customer, market, and competitive insight into positioning, portfolio, investment, or growth decisions.
  • People leadership experience, including building, developing, and elevating a product marketing team.
  • Strong partnership with Product, Sales, and Marketing leaders in a mid-market or enterprise sales environment.
  • Executive presence and sound judgment, with the ability to operate autonomously, align senior stakeholders, and communicate strategy clearly to executives and board members.
  • Comfort operating in a growing, evolving business where portfolio priorities and organizational needs continue to change.
  • Experience with mid-market or lower-enterprise B2B SaaS products in the $30K–$60K ARR range and sales cycles of approximately three to four months.

Preferred Skills/Experience:

  • Experience with programmatic growth motions such as account-based marketing, cross-sell, or upsell at scale.
  • Experience with enterprise SaaS products of $75k-$250M+
  • Background in GovTech, FinTech, finance, accounting, compliance, or another technical or regulated vertical.
  • Experience supporting growth through M&A, portfolio expansion, or product-line integration.
  • Experience building win-loss, competitive intelligence, or industry analyst programs.

Compensation:

  • In the spirit of transparency, we are excited to share the base salary for this position is $165,000 - $200,000 USD or $155,000 - 190,000 CAD, and exclusive of fringe benefits or potential bonuses. If you are hired at ClearGov, your final base salary compensation will be determined by factors such as skills, interview performance, education and/or experience. In addition to those factors, we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider internal equity of our current team members as a part of any final offer. Please keep in mind that the range mentioned above is the full base salary for the role. Hiring beyond the base range would not be typical in order to allow for future & continued salary growth. We also offer a generous compensation and benefits package (more information on benefits listed below).

Why Join ClearGov

  • Remote and flexible work environment

jobs.description:
About Imagine Worldwide

All children have immense potential, but hundreds of millions don’t have access to the learning they need. Imagine Worldwide believes that every child should be empowered with the basic right to literacy and numeracy. We provide an innovative education technology solution and implementation model to the global literacy/numeracy learning crisis using the onebillion application and various toolkits and systems to support implementation. Our model is massively scalable, evidence-based, and can deliver foundational learning to millions of the most marginalized children.

Imagine Worldwide partners with governments, organizations, and communities to provide child-directed, tablet-based learning that is accessible, effective, and affordable. We are incorporated in California (United States) as a nonprofit organization, but operate in Sub-Saharan Africa through locally-registered entities in Malawi, Sierra Leone, and Tanzania. Learn more on our website.

Role Overview

The Data Quality Analyst focuses on data quality across Imagine’s data ecosystem. The role proactively monitors data from devices, programme systems and field sources, builds and improves the checks that catch problems early, and investigates issues raised across the organisation. Where an issue requires deeper analysis, reporting changes or engineering work, the role provides its findings and works with the relevant team member to resolve it.

Imagine’s data covers learning activity from tablets in more than 1,500 schools, along with programme, operational and field data. Devices sync intermittently and sources don’t always agree, so checking data against what is happening in schools and in the field is central to the work.

The role reports to the Director of Analytics and works closely with the Data Scientist, who provides methodological support. It suits an analyst who enjoys tracing a problem back to its source and wants to keep developing in a small team. As they build context on Imagine’s data, the role takes on more ownership of the team’s data quality reporting and standards.

Key Responsibilities

The Data Analyst’s responsibilities fall into four pillars: data quality monitoring and improvement, data issue investigation, communicating findings, and analytical practice.

Data Quality Monitoring and Improvement

The role takes a proactive approach to data quality, identifying risks and gaps before they affect reporting or decision-making.

  • Monitor the completeness, consistency and plausibility of data across Imagine’s sources, and identify issues independently.
  • Design and implement data quality checks, and recommend where further checks or controls are needed across pipelines and source systems.
  • Develop tooling and automated monitoring that make data quality issues visible, working with the Analytics Engineer on implementation within the platform.
  • Reconcile figures across related sources and investigate discrepancies.
  • Contribute to the team’s data quality reporting, rules and standards.

Data Issue Investigation

The role is the Analytics Team’s first point of investigation when data issues are identified, whether through monitoring or raised by colleagues.

  • Investigate data issues and trace them to their root cause across source systems, pipelines and data models.
  • Work with the Analytics Engineer, MEAL and country teams to resolve issues at source and confirm their resolution.
  • Handle assigned data quality and data export requests from the Analytics Team’s request process.
  • Document findings and hand over issues that require deeper analysis, reporting changes or engineering work to the relevant team member.
  • Support the team’s data quality incident process by providing the evidence needed for decisions.

Communicating Findings

  • Write concise summaries of data issues and investigations, covering the cause, the impact and the recommended action.
  • Report on the state of data quality to the Analytics Team and, where appropriate, to the teams that own the source data.
  • Use clear charts and tables to show the scope and impact of issues.
  • State data limitations plainly, so that figures are not over-interpreted when shared further.

Analytical Practice

Analysis is only useful to a small team if others can check it, reuse it and build on it.

  • Keep checks and analyses reproducible, using version-controlled code and notebooks that someone else could rerun and arrive at the same result.
  • Follow the Analytics Team’s standards for code, documentation and data use, and contribute to improving them as the team grows.
  • Use the team’s shared data models and agreed metric definitions as the starting point for analysis, and flag where they fall short rather than working around them quietly.
  • Ask for review of methods and conclusions from the Data Scientist and Director of Analytics, and give constructive review on colleagues’ work in return.
  • Build a working knowledge of Imagine’s data, programmes and operating contexts, so that analyses reflect how the programme actually runs on the ground.
  • Handle sensitive data responsibly, in line with Imagine’s data governance and privacy policies.

Requirements

The qualifications below are grouped by importance. Core requirements are needed to do the role from the start. Strongly preferred skills shorten the time it takes to become effective with Imagine’s data. Advantageous experience adds value but is not expected.

Education

  • A bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, Computer Science or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.

Experience

  • At least 3 years in a data analyst or closely related quantitative role.
  • Experience monitoring, validating or reconciling data, and tracing issues back to their source.
  • Experience working with imperfect real-world data, such as missing records, inconsistent sources or late-arriving data, and explaining how those issues affect a result.
  • Experience building automated checks or reports that others rely on.
  • Experience communicating findings in writing to non-technical readers.
  • Experience working with remote teams across multiple countries and time zones.
  • Experience in the non-profit, international development or social sector is an advantage but not a requirement.

Technical Skills: Core

  • Strong SQL, including joins, aggregations and window functions across large tables.
  • Proficiency in at least one key programming language (such as Python) for automation, data analysis, and reproducible research.
  • Data profiling and validation techniques, including completeness, consistency and plausibility checks.
  • Applied statistics for identifying anomalies, including distributions, outliers and trends.
  • Clear data visualisation.

Technical Skills: Strongly Preferred

  • Querying analytical or columnar databases such as ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake or Redshift.
  • Data quality testing frameworks such as dbt tests, Great Expectations or Soda.
  • Reproducible workflows using notebooks and Git.

Technical Skills: Advantageous

  • An understanding of data pipelines and how a dbt-modelled data warehouse is structured.
  • Education, programme monitoring or field survey data.
  • Field data collection tools such as CommCare, ODK or KoboToolbox.
  • BI tools such as Apache Superset, Metabase or Power BI.
  • Spreadsheet tools for sharing data with stakeholders.

Compensation & Benefits

Salary is competitive and commensurate with experience.

Location

The Data Analyst must be based in Africa. The role will frequently collaborate and coordinate with operations teams across Africa, the US, and the UK.

This is a full-time remote position; the role can be based anywhere in Africa with reliable internet access and alignment with core working hours across time zones. This is a full-time remote position; the role can be based anywhere in Africa with reliable internet access and alignment with core working hours across time zones. The role may involve occasional international travel for in-person team meetings, field support or training, as needed. Candidates should be comfortable working independently in a virtual environment and coordinating with colleagues across global teams.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer, Finance and Modeling
jobs.excerpt: At In Tandem, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions.
jobs.description:
At In Tandem, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions. Through our four brands—OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall, and Custody Navigator—we help families stay organized, communicate well, and foster healthy childhoods.
We believe technology should strengthen relationships and make daily coordination less complicated. Everything we create is designed to lighten the mental load, reduce conflict, and support families through big and small moments.
If you want your work to make a real difference in the daily lives of parents and kids, In Tandem is the place where your impact will truly matter.

As an Analytics Engineer (Finance & Modeling), you'll own the metrics, reporting and reconciliation our financial decisions rest on, turning subscription and transaction data across OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall and Custody Navigator into numbers the business can defend. As that foundation becomes automatic, the work shifts toward forecasting and modeling.

You won't start from scratch. Our dbt project is live on Databricks with a star-schema finance mart in production and documented in Unity Catalog. What's missing is the layer on top, and that layer is yours. We also run an internal AI agent that answers business questions in Slack off the semantic layer, so every metric you define and test becomes a question Finance can ask directly rather than queue.

What you'll accomplish:

  • Governed metrics. Add the definitions the finance mart doesn't have yet (ARR, renewal rate, churn, CAC), versioned in dbt and documented in Unity Catalog, with the tests that make each one defensible, and wired into the agent so Finance can ask them directly.
  • Reporting Finance can run without you. Move the recurring finance pack into marimo, retire the Tableau views behind it, and turn a monthly hand-build into something that runs on a schedule.
  • Numbers that reconcile. Reconcile transactions across the app stores, payment processors, subscription systems and the ledger, with automated checks that alert rather than surface at close. Route discrepancies upstream with the evidence attached and turn each one into a test. You build the checks and escalate. Accounting owns the treatment.
  • Forecasting for Finance. Cohort subscriber and revenue projection, and aggregate renewal and retention forecasting, feeding the CFO's forecast and board reporting. LTV by acquisition source, feeding paid spend allocation with Growth. Pricing and promo impact, modeled before we ship rather than measured after. Individual churn propensity and uplift follow once there's a retention motion ready to act on the scores.
  • Models ship as scored tables in dbt and Unity Catalog, with tests, lineage and a definition the agent can answer from. Not as notebooks.

Who you are:

  • Statistically rigorous. You know why a cohort curve is the wrong shape, what a model is leaking, and when a result is noise.
  • Fluent in finance, and unwilling to let a number you can't explain go out the door. When two systems disagree, you find out why and tell the people upstream.
  • An engineer who owns the number end to end, from a CFO's question through the model, the test, the report and the conversation that follows. A spreadsheet nobody can reproduce reads to you as a liability.
  • AI-proficient in practice, not in theory. Claude Code, coding agents and agent SDKs are part of our daily loop, and we expect you to already work this way. A lot of what used to be a week of modeling work is now an afternoon, and we're hiring for people who have internalized that.
  • Willing to wear several hats. This is a small team supporting four brands. Some weeks you're deep in a retention model, some weeks you're chasing an app store discrepancy or unblocking someone else's dashboard. The scope above is the center of the role, not a fence around it.
  • Motivated by work that matters. Families rely on these products during real moments in their lives.

What you bring:

  • 3+ years in analytics engineering, data science, BI engineering or advanced analytics.
  • Statistical modeling shipped into a business process: forecasting, survival or cohort analysis, or propensity.
  • Measuring the lift from a price change or a growth experiment. You don't need to have designed the test, but you need to be able to read the result honestly and say what it's worth.
  • Subscription metrics you've built and defended to a finance stakeholder: ARR/MRR, renewal, churn, LTV/CAC, or cohort revenue.
  • Strong SQL and real dimensional modeling. You've designed marts, not just queried them.
  • Python and Git as daily habits.
Nice to have, not a dealbreaker:
  • dbt, Databricks and Unity Catalog, or a comparable lakehouse.
  • Reconciling transactional data to a financial system of record.
  • Code-first notebook reporting (marimo, Hex, Streamlit, Quarto).

jobs.title: IT Service Technician I
jobs.excerpt: At VC3, we don’t just solve IT problems — we own them.
jobs.description:
At VC3, we don’t just solve IT problems — we own them. We serve hundreds of municipalities and organizations across the United States and Canada, bringing IT to the people who need it most. We believe in earning trust, having a growth mindset, and delivering excellence every single time.

We're a team of doers, builders, and tech whisperers who live by 4 core values:
Go Beyond | Own It | Be Curious| Serve as One
We pride ourselves on making IT personal, making IT easy, and getting IT right. And it all starts with our talented team that is committed to raising the bar.
The Impact you will have:
In this role, you will be responsible for providing technical support to VC3 clients, with a strong focus on resolving client requests to their satisfaction. You will also assist your Service Technician teammates with their incident ticket workload when needed.

What you will be doing:

  • Provide end user support to VC3 clients via inbound phone, email and webchat, following ITIL founded triage model to determine the appropriate course of action
  • Troubleshoot technical issues including hardware (monitors, keyboards, printers), applications, VPN/remote access, network drives, DNS, and workstation performance issues
  • Support user account management in Active Directory, Exchange, and O365, including account set ups/terminations, password resets, email updates and permission changes
  • Perform standard service tasks such as IMAC (installs, moves, adds and changes) requests, software installs, system updates
  • Manage mobile and telephone support, including email set up on mobile, adjust phone systems, call forwarding and updating extensions
  • Investigate spam/phishing emails, secure compromised email accounts, and complete malware scan and removal
  • Escalate out of scope issues to the appropriate elevated team
  • Ensure proper documentation by updating tickets, changing logs, internal guides, and knowledge base articles
  • Participate in the on-call rotation (1 week every 3-4 months)
  • Additional duties as required

The tools you bring:

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in a technical support or customer service position OR recent technical education experience in a post-secondary environment
  • Demonstrable understanding of Windows OS (7–11), Office Suite/365, Windows Server (2016–2025), Active Directory, DHCP, DNS, and Terminal Services, MS Entra environment
  • Go Beyond– you take that extra step to create moments that are unexpected but appreciated.
  • Own It - You have the courage to do what's right, the resolve to take responsibility, and the grit to cross the finish line.
  • Be Curious - You challenge the status quo and aim for continuous improvement and constant learning.
  • Serve as One - You believe that together, we are greater than the sum of our individuals, and that teamwork is essential to success.

What’s in it for you:

  • Flexibility– We’re remote-first, but not remote-only. Some roles include an onsite component, depending on team needs. We aim to give you the flexibility to do your best work, plus company-paid time off to help you thrive in work and in life.
  • Well-being & Support - Caring for our team goes beyond the workday. We offer a range of benefits to support your overall well-being, from mental health and leave support through our Employee and Family Assistance Program, to financial wellness through company-matched 401(k)/RRSP plans. Whether it’s today’s needs or tomorrow’s goals, we’ve got you covered.
  • Grow with Us – Whether you’re just getting started or ready to take the next step, we are committed to investing in your growth. We offer structured development through our Leadership Academy, monthly learning sessions, mentorship programs, learning reimbursements, internal career fairs, job shadowing, and personalized career-pathing to support internal mobility.
  • People-First Culture – We live our values, support each other, and create a space where everyone belongs. We have a common goal of doing work that matters, with autonomy, recognition, and a mission to serve those who serve.
  • Transparent Leadership – From open communication to clear company goals, our leaders are involved, and our managers are here to support your growth every step of the way.
Applicant selected will be subject to a criminal and department of motor vehicles background checks and must meet Criminal Justice Information Systems (CJIS) requirements post-employment
Thank you for your interest in VC3. We appreciate all applications; however, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.
Learn more about VC3 by visiting our website and follow us on LinkedIn to stay informed!

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst who can turn that data into clear, trustworthy answers — and document it well enough that others can reuse the work. You will sit close to the platform and its consumers, analyzing data to drive decisions while writing the queries, definitions, and guides that make the platform easier for everyone to use.

This role blends deep analytical work with strong technical writing. You will not only produce analysis, you will document data sources, metrics, and how-to guidance so that self-service actually works. We move fast and use AI as a normal part of the job, so we want someone who reaches for those tools to raise the quality and speed of their work.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do

  • Deliver analysis that drives decisions — scope questions with stakeholders, pull and model data from the platform, and turn it into clear findings and recommendations.
  • Be the go-to expert on the platform's data — develop deep knowledge of the data model, the data it holds, and the platform's capabilities, and answer questions from consumers about what data exists, what it means, and how to use it.
  • Own metrics and definitions — define, validate, and maintain the key metrics teams rely on, and keep them consistent across the platform.
  • Write technical documentation — document data sources, schemas, metric definitions, and query patterns so consumers can find and trust the data without a meeting.
  • Enable self-service — build reusable queries, dashboards, and how-to guides that let other teams answer their own questions.
  • Safeguard data quality — profile new and existing sources, flag anomalies, and partner with data engineering to resolve issues at the source.
  • Be a bridge to the platform — translate consumer needs into feedback for the platform team, and help onboard teams onto new data as it lands.
  • Work AI-forward — use AI tools as a default part of how you analyze, draft SQL, summarize findings, and produce documentation — and share what works with the team.

Qualifications

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a similar role delivering analysis that shaped real decisions.
  • Strong SQL — you can independently query, join, and model data in a cloud warehouse; comfort with a scripting language such as Python is a plus.
  • Data platform fluency — hands-on understanding of modern cloud data architectures, data pipelines, and schemas; able to trace data from source to consumption, identify data issues, and partner effectively on technical solutions.
  • Technical writing skills — you write clear, well-organized documentation — data dictionaries, metric definitions, runbooks, and how-to guides — that non-experts can follow.
  • Rigor and clarity — you validate your numbers, explain your assumptions, and communicate findings simply to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • AI-forward mindset — you actively use AI tools to do your best work and raise your leverage, and you stay current as the tooling evolves.
  • US-based — authorized to work in the United States; this role is open to US-based candidates.

Nice to Have

  • Real estate / proptech experience — familiarity with property, leasing, or real estate data is desired but not required.
  • Experience standing up or maintaining a data catalog, data dictionary, or metrics layer.
  • Experience supporting internal consumers of a shared data platform.
  • Familiarity with dbt, version control, or documentation-as-code workflows.

How We'll Measure Success

  • Analysis that stakeholders act on, delivered accurately and on time.

  • A well-documented, trusted set of metrics and data sources that others reuse.

  • Growth in self-service — teams answering their own questions from your guides and queries.

  • Faster, higher-quality output through effective use of AI tools.

About Docket

Docket is the AI Marketing Agent platform helping B2B marketing teams move past the broken MQL model. Our agents engage buyers in real conversations, qualify intent using our proprietary Sales Knowledge Lake™, and surface Agent Qualified Leads (AQLs), a far better signal than form fills and lead scores.

We're building the category of agentic marketing. We need an Outcomes Architect to make sure every customer gets measurable pipeline, value and ROI from it.

Why this role exists

AI agents don't need adoption. Nobody has to be trained to log in, so the traditional CSM job of driving usage doesn't apply here.

What our customers need is a strategic partner. Someone who understands their business, their role and the problems they're trying to solve. Someone who helps them decide which outcomes matter, measures them, changes the approach when the numbers fall short, and knows where to double down when they work.

That's an Outcomes Architect. The role is closer to strategy consulting than account management, with real technical depth underneath. You'll own customers from pilot kickoff through renewal and expansion, and you'll be measured on the results they get.

What you'll own

  • Your customers, end to end. Typically 4–5 active pilots and 10–15 annual customers. You lead the pilot and stay with the account after it converts, so customers have one owner throughout.

  • The outcome, not the relationship. You define success with the customer, set the baseline, measure it, and own the results: pipeline, value and ROI.

  • Retention and growth. Renewals, expansion into new agents and use cases, and customer stories we can share.

What you'll do

  • Set the bar at kickoff. Agree on success criteria and a baseline with every customer, and deliver the business outcomes they bought Docket for, from pilot through renewal and expansion.

  • Design and tune the agents. Prompts, qualification logic, routing rules and agent behavior.

  • Connect the stack. Integrate agents with HubSpot, Salesforce, Clay, Gong, webhooks and APIs, and trace where leads get lost.

  • Find the signal. Analyze conversation and visitor data to see what's converting, what's leaking and what the market is asking about.

  • Drive the decision. Turn analysis into clear recommendations for CMOs and demand gen leaders, and walk them through what to change.

  • Grow the account. Spot the next agent or use case each customer needs, and build the business case for it.

  • Shape the product. Bring customer feedback to Product with evidence, not anecdotes.

  • Run on AI yourself. Build the workflows, prompts and automations that let you manage a full portfolio without drowning in it.

Who you are

  • You've been the customer. 4+ years in B2B marketing, demand gen, growth or marketing ops. You've owned pipeline, MQL or conversion targets, and you know what a CMO is measured on. A traditional CSM background isn't what we're looking for.

  • You own numbers. You can name a metric you were accountable for, where it started, where you took it, and what you changed.

  • You're AI-native, not just AI-comfortable. You've rebuilt a real process with AI, not just used it to write faster, and you can show us what you built.

  • You've built with conversational AI. Hands-on prompt engineering or conversational AI work, not just reading about it.

  • You're technical without an engineering title. You've built Zaps, Clay tables, HubSpot workflows or prompt chains because it was faster than filing a ticket.

  • You've worked at an AI-native or early-stage SaaS company. You know how to move fast when the playbook is still being written.

  • You've worked with US customers. You're comfortable running calls and building relationships with US-based marketing and revenue leaders.

  • You tell executives the truth. You can tell a CMO their agent isn't converting, back it with data, and come with a plan.

  • You thrive when the goal isn't fully defined. You can work out what success looks like with a customer after kickoff, then go deliver it.

Nice to have

  • Experience selling or implementing marketing automation or martech

    How we interview

    Come ready to show something real you built with AI: a prompt, an agent, a workflow or an automation. Walk us through the problem it solves, how you built it, what broke along the way, and how you know it works. No-code builds are welcome. An engineering background isn't required.

We've already begun moving our stack from on-premises servers to AWS, and need a DevOps engineer to help us take that effort to the next level. If you'd like to work at the intersection of cool cloud tech and making a better world, this is the job for you.

ActionKit is built by We Also Walk Dogs. Named after a Robert Heinlein story about a company that specialized in solving impossible problems, We Also Walk Dogs has spent over a decade serving online progressive organizations and charities. We're a small, friendly, and clever company. And we all work remotely.

Is this the job for you?

  • Do you keep production systems running? According to our external monitoring, we've kept 99.98% uptime this past year, and gone three months without downtime, while very actively working on the product. We need someone with the expertise and discipline to help us keep that going.
  • Do you think in the cloud? After starting with a fully on-premises deployment, today we're serving millions of end-users from AWS. But we know that intelligently deploying new tools and cloud capabilities can help us do things we could never do with just a rack of servers, and we need a DevOps engineer who can take us there.
  • Can you can wear a lot of hats? We're a small company and not much for bureaucratic divisions. The boss codes; the project manager gives sales demos; most everyone, including you, does a shift of at least a few hours each week answering our clients' support tickets.

If this sounds like you, please apply!

Must haves:

  • You need to care about maintaining a high-quality deployment. We've kept our uptime record with solid automation and monitoring, jumping on oddities before they become problems, and digging into root causes when things go wrong. We need you to be able to continue that tradition.
  • You need vision as well as execution. We need you to not only keep things running smoothly, but also help lead us where we need to go next. You need expertise in modern tools and AWS capabilities, and a strategic sense of how we can use them for efficiency, manageability, performance, and reliability.
  • You need to be in touch with others' needs. We're a small, tight-knit crew where everyone pitches in. Empathy with clients and end-users is also core to our business. Everyone on the team works directly with clients.

  • Four weeks paid time off. We encourage you to take vacation; we are not the sort of workplace that pressures anyone into 60-hour weeks.

About the role

Docket builds AI agents that become part of a B2B company's demand gen engine. Our Website Agent turns anonymous traffic into qualified conversations, Agent Qualified Leads (AQLs) and booked meetings, and we expand into ABM, inbound automation, paid ads acceleration, technical docs and product-led growth.

We're hiring a Customer Growth Strategist to join our Customer Success team. You've run demand gen yourself. Now you'll sit beside our customers' marketing leaders and help them get the most pipeline out of Docket: where it fits in their stack, which accounts and audiences to go after, which campaigns and content to build, and which agent to add next.

This is a strategic advisor role, not a campaign execution role. You'll work alongside our Customer Success Managers, who own each customer relationship day to day. You'll sit in Customer Success, not Marketing: you won't run Docket's own campaigns; you'll help our customers run theirs.

What you'll do

  • Plan with customers: run demand gen discovery with marketing leaders, map their stack and funnel, and show where Docket drives the most pipeline

  • Turn agent data into strategy: use what buyers ask, which accounts engage and where traffic leaks to shape positioning, content, campaigns and ABM lists

  • Lead the next agent: build the plan for each customer's next agent type (ABM, inbound, paid ads, technical docs, PLG) and get it live

  • Prove ROI: tie agent results to pipeline, cost per lead and return on ad spend in quarterly Value Reviews

  • Drive expansion: spot growth opportunities and build the business case with the VP of Customer Success

  • Feed proof to Marketing: surface the strongest results for case studies and testimonials

  • Make the team better: create playbooks and templates the Customer Success team uses across every account

  • Run on AI yourself: use AI tools and Docket's own agent data to build strategy, reports and playbooks fast

What success looks like in year one

  • Every customer in the expansion stage has a next-agent plan, and most have a second agent live

  • Every quarterly Value Review shows pipeline and ROI where we have CRM and ad data

  • The accounts you support produce a set share of Docket's expansion pipeline, against a target agreed in your first 30 days

  • Customer marketing leaders see you as a peer, and ask for you by name

  • The team runs your playbooks without you in the room

Who you are

  • 6+ years in B2B SaaS demand generation, including time as a demand gen manager or director

  • Hands-on with ABM, paid media, content and SEO/AEO, and marketing attribution

  • You've owned a pipeline number and can explain what moved it

  • Fluent in HubSpot or Salesforce, and comfortable pulling and reading your own data

  • Credible in front of a CMO: you lead with insight and numbers, not features

  • Curious about AI and how it changes the funnel

  • Clear writer and presenter; turns data into a story and a decision

Nice to have

  • Experience with conversational marketing, intent data or ABM platforms (6sense, Demandbase, Clay)

  • Agency or consulting experience advising several companies at once

  • Experience selling to or working in a startup

About The Role:

WebEngage’s Data Engineering team is the backbone of our analytics, personalisation, and machine-learning capabilities. As a Data Engineer, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of data — from ingesting raw event streams and third-party feeds to building well-modelled, highly reliable datasets that power dashboards, predictive models, and customer journey orchestration. This is a high-impact, hands-on role where you will work at the intersection of product, analytics, and backend engineering. You will be expected to think beyond just moving data — designing for data quality, pipeline observability, cost efficiency, and long-term maintainability from day one.

Responsibilities:

Pipeline Development & Reliability

  • Design, build, and maintain production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from APIs, databases, event streams (Kafka/Pub-Sub), and flat files into the central data warehouse.
  • Implement idempotent, incremental load patterns with built-in retry logic, dead-letter queues, and SLA-based alerting to ensure zero-data-loss pipelines.
  • Own pipeline observability — set up data freshness checks, row-count validations, schema drift detection, and anomaly alerts using tools like Great Expectations or dbt tests.

Data Modelling & Warehouse Design

  • Translate business requirements into clean dimensional models (star/snowflake schemas) and maintain a well-documented data catalogue.
  • Design slowly changing dimensions (SCD Type 1/2), bridge tables, and fact tables optimised for analytical query patterns.
  • Enforce partitioning, clustering, and materialised view strategies to keep warehouse costs under control while maintaining sub-second query performance.

Code Quality & Engineering Best Practices

  • Write clean, modular, well-tested Python and SQL code. Follow DRY principles, use version control (Git), and participate in peer code reviews.
  • Build reusable transformation frameworks using dbt or equivalent tooling, with proper documentation and testing at every layer (staging → intermediate → mart).
  • Containerise data services with Docker and automate deployments via CI/CD pipelines (GitHub
Actions / GitLab CI).

BI, Visualization & Analytics

  • Build interactive dashboards and analytical tools using Streamlit, enabling stakeholders to explore metrics, run ad-hoc analyses, and make data-driven decisions without engineering dependency.
  • Design and maintain BI layers — semantic models, KPI definitions, and pre-aggregated mart tables that serve as the single source of truth for reporting across teams.
  • Translate raw data into compelling visual narratives using libraries like Plotly, Matplotlib, or Altair; present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Partner with product managers, analysts, and data scientists to understand data needs and proactively identify gaps in current data coverage.
  • Document data lineage, transformation logic, SLAs, and known limitations in a shared knowledge base to enable self-service analytics.
  • Contribute to internal engineering guilds, knowledge-sharing sessions, and post-incident reviews for pipeline failures.

Requirements:

  • Strong SQL skills with expertise in complex queries, performance optimization, and cost-efficient design on cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Redshift).
  • Strong Python scripting for data ingestion, transformation, and validation, with hands-on experience in Pandas, SQLAlchemy, APIs, and automation.
  • ETL/ELT- End-to-end ownership of data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, and loading, with understanding of incremental loads, and backfills.
  • Data Modelling- Ability to design dimensional and transactional data models (star/snowflake, SCDs) and translate business needs into optimized table structures.

Good to Have:

  • Airflow, dbt, Docker, CI/CD
