Job Title: Development Ops Engineer
Job Location: Remote (Toronto, ON)

Job Type: T4 Contract

Experience: 5+ Years

Rate: CAD 45 - 50 per hour

Role Summary: NearSource is seeking a Development Ops Engineer with strong software engineering and DevOps experience to maintain, secure, and support cloud-based and desktop software applications. The role focuses on cloud infrastructure management, CI/CD pipeline maintenance, technical documentation, software troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of deployment and maintenance processes.

About the Project: The role supports software products that enable customers to visualize 3D models in virtual reality (VR) and augmented reality (AR). These products include cloud and web components for model uploading, processing, browsing, and synchronization, along with multiplayer capabilities and Unity clients for VR experiences across multiple devices.

The selected candidate will collaborate with Infrastructure, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to maintain reliable software operations, improve system documentation, and strengthen DevOps practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain cloud-based and desktop software products in collaboration with Infrastructure and Engineering teams, ensuring security, stability, and compliance with applicable Autodesk Platform policies.
  • Support the Customer Success team by troubleshooting customer-reported issues and implementing software fixes, patches, and maintenance updates.
  • Analyze the end-to-end architecture of supported products and reverse-engineer existing systems to create comprehensive technical documentation.
  • Manage cloud infrastructure and maintain CI/CD pipelines in alignment with established DevOps best practices.
  • Execute regular software patching, security updates, and performance tuning to maintain application reliability.
  • Support the maintenance and continuous improvement of deployment processes and software delivery workflows.
  • Document system architecture, operational processes, and maintenance procedures to improve knowledge sharing across engineering teams.
  • Take ownership of ongoing software support, infrastructure maintenance, and operational reliability for the supported products.

Must-Have Skills

  • 5+ years of experience in software development.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a similar field.
  • Experience working with full-stack models, services, and cloud deployment.
  • Proficiency in either Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or Amazon Web Services (AWS).
  • Experience understanding and working with full-stack software using Go, JavaScript, and React.
  • Proficiency in databases, specifically NoSQL databases such as DynamoDB and MongoDB.
  • Experience with either Jenkins or Buildkite for CI/CD.
  • Experience with DevOps tools, including Docker, Terraform, and Linux.
  • Proficiency in Git and knowledge of GitHub.
  • Strong understanding of software engineering principles and the ability to maintain desktop and cloud-based software applications.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work independently with a self-starter mindset.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Master's degree in Computer Science or a similar technical field.
  • Proficiency in both Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Amazon Web Services (AWS).
  • Experience with C# for desktop application development.
  • Proficiency in gRPC and Protocol Buffers (Protobuf).
  • Basic experience with the Unity game engine.
  • Experience with TestFlight.
  • Knowledge of software installers.
  • Knowledge of Jenkins, Buildkite, and Bitbucket Pipelines.
  • Knowledge of Electron.

Top 3 Must-Haves

  • Infrastructure and DevOps expertise: Demonstrated experience with AWS and/or GCP, including cloud infrastructure management and DevOps best practices.
  • Software engineering and application maintenance: Familiarity with understanding, supporting, and maintaining desktop and cloud-based software applications.
  • Ownership and independent execution: Evidence of a self-starter mindset and ownership of software support, maintenance, and DevOps responsibilities across multiple products.

Apply now, or share your resume with salary expectations at . Thank you for considering a career with us! Once you submit your application, our Talent Acquisition team will review your resume thoroughly. If there's a strong match, we'll reach out to discuss your experience, role details, benefits, compensation, and next steps. While we strive for transparency, we may not be able to respond to every applicant due to high volume, but we genuinely appreciate your time and interest

Enterprise Account Provisioning Specialist — Federal Health IT

Location: Remote — United States

Enable Secure Access. Support Mission-Critical Healthcare Operations.

Rackner is seeking an Enterprise Account Provisioning Specialist to manage high-volume user account and access requests across complex federal healthcare technology environments. In this role, you'll help authorized personnel obtain appropriate system access while maintaining accurate records, established security controls, and required approval processes.

You'll work across enterprise applications, identity and access management (IAM) operations, and service management workflows to support dependable account provisioning. This hands-on opportunity combines technical accuracy, cross-functional coordination, and continuous process improvement to strengthen the reliability of essential healthcare technology services.

What You'll Do

  • Fulfill high-volume standard and complex account provisioning requests, managing assigned activities from initial intake through authorized account creation, modification, and completion.
  • Verify identity information and access prerequisites, apply established role assignments, and coordinate account changes across enterprise applications in accordance with approved procedures.
  • Coordinate clinical, privileged, and sensitive access requests with designated reviewers and approvers, preparing supporting documentation and ensuring required approvals are obtained before provisioning.
  • Validate completed access changes, communicate request outcomes, and maintain accurate records and closure documentation to support accountability and service continuity.
  • Maintain established cross-application role mappings, access records, and recurring account maintenance activities to support consistent permissions and approved operational requirements.
  • Track provisioning cycle times, document delays and outstanding dependencies, and summarize request activity to support operational reporting, timely resolution, and service performance improvements.
  • Identify repeatable provisioning activities and opportunities to streamline workflows, supporting authorized automation initiatives while maintaining approved manual procedures and access controls.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 2 years of professional experience in high-volume account provisioning or identity and access management (IAM) operations.
  • Professional experience using ServiceNow to fulfill and manage account or access requests.
  • Eligibility for a Tier 3 investigation in accordance with applicable federal personnel-vetting requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Managing specialized healthcare application role definitions, position-based access requirements, and user permissions across enterprise systems.
  • Familiarity with healthcare technology access provisioning in operational, field-support, or regulated environments.
  • Supporting the rollout of approved account provisioning automation, workflow enhancements, or related process improvements.

Why Rackner

At Rackner, you'll contribute to technology and services that support important federal missions.

Our teams bring together expertise across cloud, DevSecOps, AI/ML, software engineering, and mission operations. We value collaboration, professional development, and practical solutions to complex challenges.

You'll have the opportunity to apply your IAM expertise, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and improve the consistency and reliability of essential technology services.

Benefits & Perks

Rackner offers a competitive benefits package designed to support employees' professional development, health, and well-being, including:

  • Company-supported professional development and certification opportunities.
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company matching.
  • Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance options.
  • Paid time off and paid holidays.
  • Home-office equipment and remote-work support.
  • Fitness and wellness reimbursement opportunities.
  • Weekly pay and company team events.

Benefits are subject to applicable plan terms and eligibility requirements.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Rackner is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to any status protected by applicable law.

jobs.description:
Chief Transformation Officer (CTO) – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Chief Transformation Officer (CTO) is responsible for leading enterprise-wide transformation initiatives to improve organizational performance, operational efficiency, business agility, and long-term competitiveness across the insurance and investment businesses.

The role involves developing and executing the organization's transformation strategy, modernizing business models, optimizing operating structures, driving digital adoption, and leading strategic change programs. The CTO will work closely with the CEO, Board, and executive leadership team to translate corporate strategy into measurable transformation outcomes.

The ideal candidate will combine strategic leadership, financial and operational expertise, technology awareness, and strong change management capabilities, with a proven track record of delivering complex transformation initiatives in insurance, investment management, banking, or financial services.

2. Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Transformation Strategy

  • Develop and execute the organization's enterprise-wide transformation strategy and roadmap.
  • Identify opportunities to improve business performance, operational effectiveness, profitability, and organizational agility.
  • Align transformation priorities with corporate strategy, market conditions, and long-term business objectives.
  • Evaluate existing business models, organizational structures, and operating processes to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Establish transformation objectives, milestones, governance frameworks, and measurable success criteria.

Business Model & Operating Model Transformation

  • Lead initiatives to modernize business models, operating structures, and service delivery frameworks.
  • Drive organizational restructuring, process redesign, and business integration initiatives.
  • Improve operational efficiency across insurance underwriting, claims, policy administration, distribution, and customer service.
  • Support transformation of investment operations, portfolio reporting, client servicing, and wealth management processes, where applicable.
  • Develop scalable operating models to support business expansion, diversification, and organizational growth.

Digital & Technology Transformation

  • Lead technology-enabled business transformation initiatives in collaboration with the CIO, CTO, and CDO.
  • Drive adoption of automation, AI, advanced analytics, cloud solutions, and digital platforms.
  • Modernize legacy systems, enterprise applications, and operational infrastructure.
  • Oversee transformation programs involving InsurTech, FinTech, digital insurance, and investment platforms.
  • Ensure technology investments deliver measurable improvements in productivity, customer experience, and business performance.

Financial & Operational Performance Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve profitability, reduce operating costs, and optimize resource utilization.
  • Lead cost transformation, process efficiency, and productivity improvement programs.
  • Establish performance management frameworks and operational KPIs.
  • Evaluate transformation business cases, financial benefits, investment requirements, and expected returns.
  • Monitor cost savings, revenue improvements, and overall financial impact of transformation initiatives.

Organizational Change Management

  • Develop and implement change management strategies to support enterprise transformation.
  • Build organizational readiness and secure leadership and employee engagement.
  • Lead communication, training, and stakeholder engagement initiatives during transformation programs.
  • Address resistance to change and promote a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Support leadership development and workforce transformation initiatives.

Customer & Business Experience Transformation

  • Drive initiatives to improve customer journeys and service delivery across insurance and investment businesses.
  • Collaborate with the Chief Experience Officer and commercial leadership to improve customer satisfaction, retention, and engagement.
  • Simplify customer onboarding, claims processing, policy renewals, investment transactions, and client servicing.
  • Promote customer-centric operating models and consistent service standards.
  • Use customer insights and analytics to identify transformation priorities.

Risk, Governance & Regulatory Transformation

  • Ensure transformation initiatives align with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.
  • Work with risk, compliance, legal, and internal audit teams to strengthen organizational controls.
  • Lead initiatives to improve regulatory reporting, risk management processes, and governance frameworks.
  • Assess transformation-related operational, financial, technology, and regulatory risks.
  • Establish appropriate controls and accountability throughout transformation programs.

Strategic Projects, M&A & Business Integration

  • Oversee major strategic transformation programs, including mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures, and post-merger integration.
  • Lead integration of business processes, systems, teams, and organizational structures following acquisitions.
  • Support new market entry, geographic expansion, and business diversification initiatives.
  • Coordinate cross-functional transformation projects involving multiple subsidiaries and business units.
  • Track project outcomes and ensure delivery of expected strategic and financial benefits.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Work closely with the CEO, Board, executive team, and business unit heads to establish transformation priorities.
  • Lead transformation offices, program directors, project managers, and cross-functional teams.
  • Establish transformation governance, reporting structures, and performance accountability.
  • Manage relationships with external consultants, technology partners, and implementation specialists.
  • Present transformation progress, business impact, risks, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership and the Board.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • MBA or Master's degree in Business Strategy, Organizational Development, Finance, or Transformation Management preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in corporate strategy, business transformation, management consulting, operational excellence, or enterprise change management.
  • At least 5 years in a senior executive or leadership role overseeing large-scale transformation initiatives.
  • Significant experience in insurance, banking, investment management, asset management, wealth management, or financial services.
  • Proven track record of leading complex enterprise transformation programs with measurable financial and operational outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of insurance operations, investment services, financial products, and regulated business environments.
  • Experience in operating model redesign, organizational restructuring, digital transformation, and process optimization.
  • Strong financial acumen, strategic planning, and business performance management capabilities.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder engagement, and change management skills.

Preferred Certifications:

  • Prosci Change Management Certification.
  • Certified Business Transformation Professional (CBTP).
  • PMP or Program Management Professional (PgMP).

- Lean Six Sigma Black Belt.

- Agile or Scrum certifications.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Achievement of enterprise transformation milestones.
  • Cost savings and operational efficiency improvements.
  • Revenue growth and profitability improvements resulting from transformation.
  • Reduction in process turnaround times and operational bottlenecks.
  • Successful implementation of new operating models and business processes.

- Digital adoption and automation rates.

  • Customer satisfaction and service delivery improvements.
  • Employee engagement and organizational change adoption.
  • Successful integration of acquired businesses and strategic partnerships.
  • Realization of expected transformation benefits and ROI.
  • Regulatory compliance and risk management effectiveness.
  • Delivery of transformation initiatives within approved budgets and timelines.

* This role will be remote, and can be based out of Arizona, California, Colorado, Idaho, Montana, New Mexico, Nevada, Oregon, Utah, Texas, Washington, and Wyoming for external candidates. *

NeighborWorks as a Company and an Employer

For nearly 50 years, Neighborhood Reinvestment Corporation, a congressionally chartered national nonprofit known as NeighborWorks® America, has strived to make every community safer and more prosperous. Our network of excellence includes nearly 250 nonprofits in every state, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, and on Native lands. NeighborWorks offers grant funding, peer exchange, technical assistance, evaluation tools, and access to best-in-class training as the nation’s leading trainer of housing and community development professionals. NeighborWorks network organizations build homes and apartments, expanding the supply of affordable housing in every community; provide financial counseling and coaching that increases self-sufficiency; encourage resident leadership; and collaborate with local stakeholders in the areas of health, economic development, employment, and education.

Caring for communities starts with caring for our internal community, our staff. Picture yourself in a collaborative and diverse hybrid environment surrounded by colleagues who challenge, encourage and inspire you. This opportunity offers an impressive total rewards package that includes a 401(k) match of up to 12%, 11 paid holidays, generous leave (including 40 hours of paid volunteer time) and industry-leading benefits. Start your career with NeighborWorks America and take advantage of our Staff Training and Education Program (STEP), designed to support continued learning and professional development. Our benefits are designed to support staff holistically, enabling them to give their best in both work and life.

We are a mission-based organization committed to building a high-performing work culture, guided by the following core values:

  • We hold ourselves and each other accountable.
  • We act with integrity.
  • We lead with curiosity.
  • We pursue excellence with courage.
  • We respect, honor and celebrate each other.
  • We collaborate with purpose.

Work at a Glance: Relationship Management and Capacity Building.

Position Summary and Essential Responsibilities:

The NWA (Senior) Relationship Manager (RM) role is pivotal within the organization, focusing on serving a portfolio of network organizations (NWOs) and ensuring a deep understanding of their operations and needs. This position works closely with a team of relationship managers, other staff, and regional leadership in support of the region’s entire portfolio of NWOs. The following responsibilities and qualifications are associated with this position:

  • Portfolio Management: (Sr.) RMs oversees a portfolio of network organizations. This involves developing a comprehensive understanding of each organization's mission, goals, challenges, needs, establish and maintain relationships with executive leadership, board members, partners, and stakeholders of network organizations through in-person and virtual engagements.
  • Expertise in NW Services and Products: (Sr.) RMs are experts in the services and products offered by NeighborWorks America. This knowledge helps them guide network organizations in utilizing these resources effectively, including brokering connections to the tools, resources, and subject matter experts available across NeighborWorks America and network organization peers.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making: Utilize data compiled by NW, along with market and industry analysis, to make informed decisions on how best to support the organizations in their portfolio.
  • Customer-Centric Approach: (Sr.) RMs are resourceful and innovative in their efforts to support network organizations, ensuring a customer-centric approach in their interactions and solutions.
  • Strategic Thinking: Critical thinkers who strategically plan and implement capacity-building strategies to strengthen the performance of organizations in their portfolio.
  • Organizational Development Expertise: (Sr.) RMs have deep expertise in understanding various non-profit business models and implementing strategies to enhance organizational performance and sustainability.
  • Performance Assessment: (Sr.) RMs assist network organizations in preparing for performance assessments and work on developing action plans based on assessment results.
  • Board Management: Work directly with non-profit boards of directors, assess their performance, facilitate board training, and engage in strategic planning activities.
  • Funding Evaluation: (Sr.) RMs review and evaluate funding requests from network members, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and objectives.
  • Strategic Visioning: Collaborate with NWOs in strategic thinking and visioning beyond compliance remediation, helping organizations plan for long-term success and impact.

This remote position reports to the regional Senior Director, and the candidate must be physically located in one of the following states: Arizona, California, Colorado, Idaho, Montana, New Mexico, Nevada, Oregon, Utah, Texas, Washington, Wyoming and NeighborWorks America corporate and field locations.

Required Minimum Qualifications:
(a) Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Public Administration, Nonprofit Management, Community Development, Urban Planning, Finance, Organizational Development, or a related field. Applicable experience may be considered in place of education.

(b) Experience: 5-7 years of related professional or personal experience in community development, affordable housing or the non-profit management field for Relationship Manager, and 8+ years of experience for a Sr. Relationship Manager designation.

(c) Licenses, Certifications: N/A

(d) Competencies, Knowledge, and Skills & Abilities:

  • Nonprofit Management and Board Governance Experience: Candidates should have professional or personal experience in nonprofit/organizational management and board governance, including understanding fiduciary responsibilities, strategic roles of boards and executive leadership.
  • Specialized Expertise: Demonstrated experience in areas such as real estate development, asset management, homeownership, lending/Community Development Financial Institutions (CDFIs), financial management, resource development, organizational management, or board governance is highly valued.
  • Outcome-Based Performance Measurement: Advanced experience in developing outcome-based performance measurements is necessary to assess the effectiveness and impact of programs and initiatives.
  • Financial Analysis: Experience in evaluating and analyzing financial statements is required to assess the financial health and sustainability of organizations within the portfolio.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent written, auditory, and oral communication skills are essential for effectively communicating program results, facilitating meetings with NW staff and network directors, and engaging with program staff and directors.
  • Technical Assistance: Experience in delivering technical assistance in asset management, affordable housing, or real estate development is beneficial.
  • Cultural Competence: Ability to interact effectively with people of diverse cultures and socio-economic backgrounds.
  • Technical Proficiency: Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Access) is required for documentation, reporting, and data analysis.
  • Project Management: Demonstrated project management skills and multitasking abilities are necessary for handling multiple projects with diverse deliverables.
  • Initiative-taking and Collaborative: Must be initiative-taking, able to work independently as well as collaboratively with colleagues and network members and possess a strong customer-service orientation.

(e) Technology:

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Access) is required for documentation, reporting, and data analysis.

(f) NeighborWorks America Staff are expected to demonstrate excellence in the following:

  • Sensitivity to racial, gender, sexual orientation, and cultural differences.
  • Effective, respectful, and timely communications with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Listening effectively, seeks and accepts feedback well.
  • Effective teamwork.
  • Analytic, thoughtful, and strategic thinking.
  • Considering the mission, objectives, and goals of NeighborWorks and demonstrating an understanding of the impact of her/his/their decisions and behavior on the organization.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated expertise in affordable housing real estate development across single-family, multifamily, community land trust, and manufactured housing models
  • Strong experience in comprehensive community development, lending, capital strategies, and broader economic development
  • Working knowledge of affordable housing trends in the Western Region footprint

Working Conditions:
(a) Travel: Work is performed both in field and office settings, requiring extensive travel and frequent overnight absences from an employee's place of residence. Approximately 50% travel.

(b) Others:

  • Work is performed as part of a team of relationship managers and other staff with considerable independence under the general direction of the regional management.
  • Work is reviewed through individual conferences and customer feedback.
  • For external applicants, this position requires residency and travel within the following states- California, Arizona, Colorado, Idaho, Montana, New Mexico, Nevada, Oregon, Texas, Utah, Washington, and Wyoming. *You must reside within one of these states OR have plans to relocate to be considered. *

(c) Remote work environment with extensive travel

Salary Range:

Senior Relationship Manager (8+ years of experience) - $78,665- $110,700

Client Partner – Financial Services
Vertical Relevance | Business Development | 2026

Job Summary

The Client Partner (CP) is a strategic, quota-carrying role focused on growing Vertical Relevance’s business in financial services. You will find and close professional services engagements, build trusted relationships with business and technology leaders, and position Vertical Relevance as the partner of choice for AWS cloud and AI transformation. Our model is domain-led, agentic by design, and platform-backed: financial services advisory, agentic AI delivery, and AWS cloud and AI platform engineering.
This role requires a proven track record of selling professional services into financial services firms, including cloud services built on AWS. Vertical Relevance is an AWS Premier Tier Partner, and the CP sells across all seven of our AWS practice competencies, from platform foundations, security, and resiliency through application modernization, data, and AI. GenAI and agentic AI, delivered with AWS and our Anthropic partnership, are a growing part of the portfolio, and the CP should be able to hold a credible conversation about them.

Our Seven AWS Competencies

The Client Partner is expected to understand each competency well enough to find the opportunity, frame the business case, and bring in the competency lead to shape the solution.
  • Enterprise Program Governance / PMO: Program and engagement management, IT transformation, mergers and acquisitions, and integration offices for large cloud programs
  • DevOps: DevOps platforms that deliver infrastructure and deployment pipelines through automation, including account, network, pipeline, and container foundations
  • Security & Compliance: SecOps platforms that deliver security and compliance policies as code, including identity and control foundations, policy as code, and our Control Broker asset
  • SRE & Resiliency: Monitoring, observability, and automated resiliency testing, including game days, chaos experiments, and performance testing for critical workloads
  • App Modernization: Re-designing, re-factoring, and re-platforming applications to run AWS-native, including monolith-to-microservices and migration programs
  • Data & Analytics: DataOps platforms for data ingestion, governance, and analytics, including lakehouse, data mesh, data marketplace, and catalog work
  • AI: Designing, building, and tuning AI, GenAI, and agentic AI solutions on AWS (Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker) and with Anthropic Claude
Each competency is backed by 35+ AWS reusable solution accelerators (playbooks, blueprints, modules, and libraries) that shorten timelines and reduce risk. The CP uses these assets to differentiate Vertical Relevance in every pursuit.

Key Responsibilities

Business Development
  • Identify and close new professional services opportunities across banks, asset and wealth managers, insurers, and payments firms
  • Build pipeline across all seven AWS competencies, and connect opportunities across them (for example, a migration that leads to security, resiliency, and data work)
  • Use personal networks, AWS account teams, and internal relationships to generate qualified pipeline
  • Run the pursuit from first meeting through executive briefings, assessments, proofs of value, and SOW
Direct Sales, AWS Partnership & Co-Sell (in priority order)
  • 1. Lead direct sales: Own and lead direct sales with financial services clients: originate opportunities, run the pursuit, build the relationship with the economic buyer, and close the SOW. Direct selling is the core of this role and the primary measure of success.
  • 2. Work the AWS partnership: Work closely with AWS account managers, partner development managers, and AWS field teams. Build joint account plans, use AWS funding and buying programs such as MAP, proof-of-concept funding, and AWS Marketplace, and position Vertical Relevance’s AWS Premier Tier status and competencies (Financial Services, Security, DevOps, Resilience, and GenAI).
  • 3. Co-sell with partners: Run co-sell motions with partners, including AWS ProServe engagements and staffing requests through the AWS partner delivery process, and joint pursuits with Anthropic and other technology partners.
GenAI & Agentic AI
  • Identify where GenAI and agentic AI create value for clients, such as operations, reconciliation, vulnerability management, software engineering productivity, and client service
  • Position our GenAI Center of Excellence, agentic reconciliation, and AI-driven vulnerability management (Mythos/Glasswing) offerings, delivered with AWS and Anthropic
  • Address the questions financial services buyers ask about AI: model risk, data privacy, security, controls, and regulatory expectations
Client Relationship Management
  • Build and maintain relationships with decision-makers at target accounts, including CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, Chief Data and AI Officers, and business line heads
  • Position Vertical Relevance as a strategic partner for business and technology consulting
  • Manage client relationships through the full sales cycle and into delivery
Collaboration & Strategy
  • Work with delivery teams to build competitive proposals, estimates, and SOWs
  • Build joint go-to-market plans with our technology partners, including AWS, Anthropic (Claude), and ServiceNow
  • Bring in competency leads and solution architects at the right moment to shape solutions, demos, and proposals
  • Drive account planning to expand within existing clients and win new logos
Sales Execution

jobs.description:
About Us

Red Cell Partners is an incubation firm building and investing in rapidly scalable technology-led companies that are bringing revolutionary advancements to market in three distinct practice areas: healthcare, cyber, and national security. United by a shared sense of duty and deep belief in the power of innovation, Red Cell is developing powerful tools and solutions to address our Nation’s most pressing problems.

ABOUT DEFCON AI

RESILIENCE IN THE FACE OF DISRUPTION. DEFCON AI is an insights company that leverages artificial intelligence, mathematical optimization, data analytics, and software engineering for resilient optimization of complex systems.
In today’s dynamically changing world, DEFCON AI’s technology aligns outcomes with operational goals, better decision making, and empowers customers to anticipate assess, and mitigate the impacts of disruptions.

About the Role

As QA Engineer you will own quality for an AI-enabled decision-support system: the test plan, the automated coverage, and the evidence that what was delivered is what was specified. Product defines the acceptance criteria. You build the executable version of it, and you hold engineering, platform, and everyone else delivering the work accountable to it.

This role sits on the product side of the organization, not the engineering side. You will report through the Product Lead and take direction from product, while working with engineering and platform every day. A tester embedded in engineering tends to verify what was built, because the implementation is what they see. This role verifies what was specified. A test suite written from the code will pass while still missing what the customer asked for.

That reporting line does not lower the engineering bar. You will write code and build real automation rather than managing test cases, and you will need enough fluency in the application code to test it well. As the first dedicated quality engineering hire you are establishing the approach rather than inheriting one, so we want someone with a clear point of view on how testing should work. We build with current tooling and expect the same, including AI assistance in our own engineering practice.

This is a fully remote role with occasional travel (up to 25%) to DEFCON AI HQ, customer sites, and vendor facilities as required.

Key Responsibilities

Test Strategy and Acceptance Criteria

  • Own the system test plan covering functional, integration, performance, and load testing, and maintain it as a formal deliverable
  • Translate the acceptance criteria set by product into executable tests
  • Review acceptance criteria with product before development begins, and identify requirements that are ambiguous or not verifiable as written
  • Hold engineering, platform, and partner teams accountable to the acceptance criteria, and define what evidence must exist before a change is considered complete
  • Work alongside the engineering team day to day, close enough to test their work well and independent enough to report what the testing shows
  • Plan and coordinate user acceptance testing with the customer, and track findings through to resolution

Test Automation and Coverage

  • Build and maintain automated test suites, and integrate them into the CI/CD pipeline as release gates
  • Establish and hold an automated coverage standard, and report against it
  • Build performance and load testing that validates the system under its expected user load
  • Maintain regression coverage across releases

Measurement and Evidence

  • Build and maintain labeled evaluation sets, working with subject-matter experts whose time is limited
  • Design and run sampled audits confirming that automated decisions were correct
  • Measure and report what the system misses alongside what it gets right
  • Measure how often users override the system, and report the trend
  • Document how each committed measure is computed, on what data, and what evidence accompanies a release
  • Produce this evidence independently of the people building the models

Release Governance

  • Maintain the version inventory across builds, models, configurations, and thresholds
  • Produce test reports, evaluation records, and rollback criteria for each release
  • Work with platform engineering to confirm that test environments match production closely enough for results to be meaningful
  • Hold the gate: no release ships without the evidence its acceptance requires

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years in software quality engineering, test automation, or software engineering with substantial dedicated test ownership
  • A clear point of view on how testing should be done, and the judgment to know which practices are worth holding to. You will be setting the standard here rather than following one
  • Strong coding ability in a language and framework used for test automation, for example Python with pytest, or JavaScript or TypeScript with Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium. Python is what most of this stack is written in. You should also be able to read and reason about the application code under test
  • Routine use of AI-assisted development, with informed judgment about where it adds value and where its output requires verification. We expect AI tooling to be part of how test coverage gets built here, not an occasional experiment
  • Demonstrated experience building automated test suites and integrating them into CI/CD as release gates
  • Experience owning a test plan through review and acceptance
  • Demonstrated habit of testing against the requirement rather than the implementation, including working directly with product owners or end users to establish what correct actually means
  • Experience with performance and load testing, including establishing what a result does and does not demonstrate
  • Working statistical literacy, including sampling design and the confidence a measurement can support
  • Experience measuring what a system misses, not only what it gets right
  • Willingness to report a result the team did not want, and to keep the measurement independent of the people whose work it evaluates
  • Ability to gate work owned by people who do not report to you, and to earn enough credibility with engineers that the gate holds
  • Clear, audit-ready written documentation, since much of the output of this role is evidence that others read
  • Willingness to hold a release, and explain the reason, to people who want it shipped
  • US Citizenship Required
  • Active US Secret clearance. The work is performed in a controlled government cloud environment and requires a favorable investigation and CAC eligibility from the start
  • Elevated security requirements apply to portions of this work and are discussed during the interview process
  • Willingness to travel up to 25% to customer sites, DEFCON AI HQ, and vendor facilities as required

Preferred Qualifications

  • Clearance: active Top Secret
  • Environment: government DevSecOps, RMF, or ATO environments, and experience producing test evidence for a formal accreditation or audit
  • Automation: contract and API testing, test data management, and building test infrastructure others can extend
  • AI-assisted testing: using language models to generate and maintain test coverage, and the practices that keep generated tests meaningful rather than merely passing
  • Performance: JMeter, k6, Locust, or comparable
  • Evaluation: validating machine learning or model output, including groundedness and citation checking, and analyzing where users disagreed with a system recommendation
  • Domain: systems where an incorrect result carries real cost, and where testing had to satisfy an outside reviewer rather than only an internal one
  • Governance: model cards, NIST AI RMF, or comparable responsible AI practice
  • Accessibility: Section 508 and WCAG verification

What Success Looks Like

  • A test plan the customer accepts, and that holds up as the system grows
  • Acceptance criteria that are verifiable before development starts
  • Automated coverage meeting its standard and running as a release gate
  • Sampled audits designed to catch an incorrect automated decision
  • Performance evidence that reflects realistic load
  • A release trail complete enough to reconstruct why any version shipped

What We Offer:

  • A fully remote, results-based environment
  • Competitive salary, bonus, and equity package
  • 100% employer paid, comprehensive health insurance including medical, dental, and vision for you and your family
  • Unlimited PTO, with your manager’s approval
  • Flexible work environment where you manage your work day
  • 14 weeks of fully-paid parental leave

Salary Range: $135,000-$170,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience, skills, and other factors.

Our Red Cell Partners Benefits (may differ for each incubation):

For full-time roles

  • Career track opportunity with potential for rapid advancement with strong performance as the firm grows
  • 100% employer paid, comprehensive health care including medical, dental, and vision for you and your family.
  • Paid maternity and paternity for 14 weeks at employees' normal pay.

From experiment tracking and model optimization to high-performance training clusters, agent building, and inference at scale, we’re combining forces to serve the full AI lifecycle — all in one seamless platform.

Weights & Biases has long been trusted by over 1,500 organizations — including AstraZeneca, Canva, Cohere, OpenAI, Meta, Snowflake, Square, Toyota, and Wayve — to build better models, AI agents and applications. Now, as part of CoreWeave, that impact is amplified across a broader ecosystem of AI innovators, researchers, and enterprises.

As we unite under one vision, we’re looking for bold thinkers and agile builders who are excited to shape the future of AI alongside us. If you’re passionate about solving complex problems at the intersection of software, hardware, and AI, there’s never been a more exciting time to join our team.

What You’ll Do

As a Senior Data Platform Engineer, you will apply advanced knowledge of software engineering, data architecture, distributed systems, and database technologies to design and operate our enterprise data platform. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Design and implement scalable data systems and pipelines — 30%: Architect, develop, test, and maintain distributed batch and streaming pipelines that ingest, transform, validate, and deliver structured and semi-structured data across production systems.

Diagnose and resolve performance, scalability, availability, and cost-efficiency issues within multi-petabyte data environments.

  • Operate and support the platform — 5%: Monitor production systems, troubleshoot incidents, document operational procedures, and participate in an on-call rotation after completing the required onboarding and training.

This position requires independent technical judgment to evaluate architectural alternatives, identify system constraints, and select appropriate data structures, algorithms, database designs, and distributed-processing patterns.

Chief Transformation Officer (CTO) – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Chief Transformation Officer (CTO) is responsible for leading enterprise-wide transformation initiatives to improve organizational performance, operational efficiency, business agility, and long-term competitiveness across the insurance and investment businesses.

The role involves developing and executing the organization's transformation strategy, modernizing business models, optimizing operating structures, driving digital adoption, and leading strategic change programs. The CTO will work closely with the CEO, Board, and executive leadership team to translate corporate strategy into measurable transformation outcomes.

The ideal candidate will combine strategic leadership, financial and operational expertise, technology awareness, and strong change management capabilities, with a proven track record of delivering complex transformation initiatives in insurance, investment management, banking, or financial services.

2. Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Transformation Strategy

  • Develop and execute the organization's enterprise-wide transformation strategy and roadmap.
  • Identify opportunities to improve business performance, operational effectiveness, profitability, and organizational agility.
  • Align transformation priorities with corporate strategy, market conditions, and long-term business objectives.
  • Evaluate existing business models, organizational structures, and operating processes to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Establish transformation objectives, milestones, governance frameworks, and measurable success criteria.

Business Model & Operating Model Transformation

  • Lead initiatives to modernize business models, operating structures, and service delivery frameworks.
  • Drive organizational restructuring, process redesign, and business integration initiatives.
  • Improve operational efficiency across insurance underwriting, claims, policy administration, distribution, and customer service.
  • Support transformation of investment operations, portfolio reporting, client servicing, and wealth management processes, where applicable.
  • Develop scalable operating models to support business expansion, diversification, and organizational growth.

Digital & Technology Transformation

  • Lead technology-enabled business transformation initiatives in collaboration with the CIO, CTO, and CDO.
  • Drive adoption of automation, AI, advanced analytics, cloud solutions, and digital platforms.
  • Modernize legacy systems, enterprise applications, and operational infrastructure.
  • Oversee transformation programs involving InsurTech, FinTech, digital insurance, and investment platforms.
  • Ensure technology investments deliver measurable improvements in productivity, customer experience, and business performance.

Financial & Operational Performance Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve profitability, reduce operating costs, and optimize resource utilization.
  • Lead cost transformation, process efficiency, and productivity improvement programs.
  • Establish performance management frameworks and operational KPIs.
  • Evaluate transformation business cases, financial benefits, investment requirements, and expected returns.
  • Monitor cost savings, revenue improvements, and overall financial impact of transformation initiatives.

Organizational Change Management

  • Develop and implement change management strategies to support enterprise transformation.
  • Build organizational readiness and secure leadership and employee engagement.
  • Lead communication, training, and stakeholder engagement initiatives during transformation programs.
  • Address resistance to change and promote a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Support leadership development and workforce transformation initiatives.

Customer & Business Experience Transformation

  • Drive initiatives to improve customer journeys and service delivery across insurance and investment businesses.
  • Collaborate with the Chief Experience Officer and commercial leadership to improve customer satisfaction, retention, and engagement.
  • Simplify customer onboarding, claims processing, policy renewals, investment transactions, and client servicing.
  • Promote customer-centric operating models and consistent service standards.
  • Use customer insights and analytics to identify transformation priorities.

Risk, Governance & Regulatory Transformation

  • Ensure transformation initiatives align with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.
  • Work with risk, compliance, legal, and internal audit teams to strengthen organizational controls.
  • Lead initiatives to improve regulatory reporting, risk management processes, and governance frameworks.
  • Assess transformation-related operational, financial, technology, and regulatory risks.
  • Establish appropriate controls and accountability throughout transformation programs.

Strategic Projects, M&A & Business Integration

  • Oversee major strategic transformation programs, including mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures, and post-merger integration.
  • Lead integration of business processes, systems, teams, and organizational structures following acquisitions.
  • Support new market entry, geographic expansion, and business diversification initiatives.
  • Coordinate cross-functional transformation projects involving multiple subsidiaries and business units.
  • Track project outcomes and ensure delivery of expected strategic and financial benefits.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Work closely with the CEO, Board, executive team, and business unit heads to establish transformation priorities.
  • Lead transformation offices, program directors, project managers, and cross-functional teams.
  • Establish transformation governance, reporting structures, and performance accountability.
  • Manage relationships with external consultants, technology partners, and implementation specialists.
  • Present transformation progress, business impact, risks, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership and the Board.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • MBA or Master's degree in Business Strategy, Organizational Development, Finance, or Transformation Management preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in corporate strategy, business transformation, management consulting, operational excellence, or enterprise change management.
  • At least 5 years in a senior executive or leadership role overseeing large-scale transformation initiatives.
  • Significant experience in insurance, banking, investment management, asset management, wealth management, or financial services.
  • Proven track record of leading complex enterprise transformation programs with measurable financial and operational outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of insurance operations, investment services, financial products, and regulated business environments.
  • Experience in operating model redesign, organizational restructuring, digital transformation, and process optimization.
  • Strong financial acumen, strategic planning, and business performance management capabilities.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder engagement, and change management skills.

Preferred Certifications:

  • Prosci Change Management Certification.
  • Certified Business Transformation Professional (CBTP).
  • PMP or Program Management Professional (PgMP).

- Lean Six Sigma Black Belt.

- Agile or Scrum certifications.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Achievement of enterprise transformation milestones.
  • Cost savings and operational efficiency improvements.
  • Revenue growth and profitability improvements resulting from transformation.
  • Reduction in process turnaround times and operational bottlenecks.
  • Successful implementation of new operating models and business processes.

- Digital adoption and automation rates.

  • Customer satisfaction and service delivery improvements.
  • Employee engagement and organizational change adoption.
  • Successful integration of acquired businesses and strategic partnerships.
  • Realization of expected transformation benefits and ROI.
  • Regulatory compliance and risk management effectiveness.
  • Delivery of transformation initiatives within approved budgets and timelines.

jobs.description:
Machinify is a leading healthcare intelligence company with expertise across the payment continuum, delivering unmatched value, transparency, and efficiency to health plan clients across the country. Deployed by over 85 health plans, including many of the top 20, and representing more than 270 million lives, Machinify brings together a fully configurable and content-rich, AI-powered platform along with best-in-class expertise. We’re constantly reimagining what’s possible in our industry, creating disruptively simple, powerfully clear ways to maximize financial outcomes and drive down healthcare costs.

Machinify brings together several payment integrity and recovery businesses for health plans. Each one produces numbers that executives, operations leaders, and clients act on. Your job is to make sure there is one warehouse, one conformed model, and one definition of every number.

The foundation is already in production: a Databricks lakehouse with 600+ dbt models, 1,800+ automated tests, Power BI semantic models, and LLM self-service on governed metrics. Your first priority isoperational measurement: building the trusted metrics our Operations leaders run their business on. Next, you'll extend the warehouse to new business domains with a repeatable, template-driven approach.

This is a hands-on Engineering Manager role on a flat team. You'll manage engineers and analysts directly and spend about half your time building: designing the dimensional model, writing and reviewing code, and setting the engineering standards. You'll partner closely with a Product counterpart who owns priorities and stakeholder intake, so you can focus on architecture, delivery, and the team.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the data model. Design and evolve the conformed dimensional model and the standards the team builds against. Review every new model for grain and conformance.
  • Build and run the pipelines. Design ETL/ELT from source systems through bronze → silver → gold on Databricks, with incremental loads, data contracts, and Airflow orchestration.
  • Own the semantic layer. Build governed metrics in Unity Catalog metric views and Power BI semantic models, so every dashboard, report, and LLM query uses the same definitions.
  • Deliver reliable operational metrics. Turn KPI definitions from Product and Operations into certified models and metrics, reconciled to source and delivered through dashboards and self-service.
  • Assure the numbers. Own reconciliation, data tests, freshness and anomaly monitoring, SLOs, and CI/CD for data.
  • Modernize orchestration. Lead the move of dbt orchestration from dbt Cloud to Airflow without gaps in data freshness.
  • Partner with Product. Work with your Product counterpart and business stakeholders to shape requirements. You own the technical plan: architecture, sequencing, estimates, and trade-offs.
  • Lead the team. Manage, coach, and hire analytics engineers and BI analysts. Run sprint execution and set the bar for code review, testing, documentation, and AI-assisted development.

What You Bring

  • 10+ years in data warehousing, data engineering, or analytics engineering, including 3+ years as a hands-on engineering manager.
  • Expert in dimensional modeling: grain, fact types, conformed dimensions, slowly changing dimensions, bridge tables, and the bus matrix. Has built an enterprise warehouse across multiple source systems and owned it in production
  • Expert SQL and dbt: complex SQL and performance tuning; dbt models, tests, macros, packages, and CI
  • Databricks in production: Spark SQL, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and medallion architecture. Deep Snowflake or BigQuery experience will be considered
  • Semantic layer: has built governed metrics (Databricks metric views, dbt Semantic Layer/MetricFlow, Cube, or Power BI semantic models) and the BI on top. Power BI/DAX preferred
  • ETL/ELT and orchestration: has designed and run production pipelines with incremental loads, snapshots or CDC, and Airflow (or a similar orchestrator). Python for pipeline work
  • Data quality: testing, reconciliation, observability, and CI/CD for data
  • Cross-functional partner: works well with a Product counterpart and business stakeholders. Turns requirements into technical designs and explains trade-offs in plain language

Nice to have

  • Healthcare claims or payment integrity data
  • Building operational KPIs with business operators
  • LLM-based self-service analytics (e.g., Databricks Genie)
  • Experience leading teams across time zones

What We Offer

  • Work from anywhere in the US! Machinify is digital-first.
  • Full Medical/Dental/Vision for employees & their families
  • Flexible and trusting environment where you’ll feel empowered to do your best work
  • Unlimited FTO
  • Competitive salary, equity, 401(k) including employer match

Base Salary: $220,000-$260,000

The salary for this position is based on an array of factors unique to each candidate: Such as years and depth of experience, set skills, certifications, etc. We are hiring for different levels, and our Recruiting team will let you know if you qualify for a different role/range. Salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes meaningful equity, excellent healthcare, flexible time off, and other benefits and perks.

NVIDIA owned the way in accelerated computing to address problems beyond the reach of standard computers. Its creation of the GPU in 1999 ignited the expansion of PC gaming and transformed modern computer graphics. Now, NVIDIA drives AI forward as a full-stack computing firm.   • Ability to assess standard functionality and custom extensions, identify downstream data impacts, and recommend sustainable alternatives.
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to translate between finance and operations stakeholders, functional consultants, technical teams, delivery partners, and executives.
  • Experience working within a large ERP transformation using Agile, hybrid, or stage-gated delivery methods.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft certification in Dynamics 365 Finance, Supply Chain Management, Power BI, Fabric, Azure Data, or solution architecture.

Chief Project Officer (CPO) – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Chief Project Officer (CPO) is responsible for leading the organization's strategic project portfolio, enterprise-wide program management, and major transformation initiatives across its insurance and investment businesses.

The role ensures that strategic projects are properly planned, prioritized, funded, executed, and delivered in alignment with organizational goals. The CPO will oversee complex projects involving insurance operations, investment services, digital transformation, regulatory compliance, business expansion, mergers and acquisitions, and operational improvement.

Working closely with the CEO, Board, and senior management team, the CPO will establish effective project governance, optimize resources, manage delivery risks, and ensure measurable business outcomes from the organization's project investments.

2. Key Responsibilities

Strategic Project & Portfolio Management

  • Develop and execute the organization's enterprise-wide project management and portfolio strategy.
  • Identify, assess, prioritize, and oversee strategic projects across insurance and investment business units.
  • Ensure project portfolios align with corporate strategy, growth objectives, and operational priorities.
  • Evaluate project feasibility, business cases, resource requirements, expected returns, and implementation risks.
  • Monitor portfolio performance and ensure projects deliver their intended strategic and financial benefits.

Insurance & Investment Project Delivery

  • Lead strategic initiatives involving life insurance, general insurance, reinsurance, investment management, wealth management, and financial services.
  • Oversee projects involving new insurance product launches, policy administration systems, claims management, underwriting processes, and distribution expansion.
  • Manage investment-related initiatives involving portfolio management systems, investment operations, client reporting, and service delivery, where applicable.
  • Coordinate projects involving regulatory changes, business process modernization, and operational restructuring.
  • Support the implementation of new business models, financial products, and market expansion initiatives.

Project Governance & PMO Leadership

  • Establish and oversee the Project Management Office (PMO), including project standards, methodologies, policies, and governance frameworks.
  • Implement project approval processes, stage-gate reviews, reporting structures, and escalation procedures.
  • Ensure consistent project management practices across business units and subsidiaries.
  • Monitor project scope, timelines, budgets, deliverables, and quality standards.
  • Present portfolio performance reports, major risks, and project recommendations to executive leadership and the Board.

Digital Transformation & Technology Projects

  • Lead strategic technology implementation and digital transformation projects across the organization.
  • Oversee projects involving insurance technology (InsurTech), financial technology (FinTech), automation, AI, cloud platforms, CRM, and enterprise systems.
  • Coordinate implementation of digital insurance platforms, customer portals, mobile applications, and investment service platforms.
  • Work with CIO, CTO, and CDO teams to ensure technology projects meet business requirements.
  • Monitor technology implementation costs, timelines, system integration, and business adoption.

Financial & Resource Management

  • Develop and manage project portfolio budgets and investment plans.
  • Monitor expenditure, cost variations, financial performance, and project profitability.
  • Optimize resource allocation across projects, departments, and business units.
  • Evaluate project return on investment (ROI), cost-benefit analysis, and benefits realization.
  • Manage external consultants, contractors, technology vendors, and implementation partners.

Risk, Compliance & Quality Management

  • Identify and manage project-related operational, financial, regulatory, and technology risks.
  • Ensure projects comply with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.
  • Coordinate with risk management, legal, compliance, and internal audit teams.
  • Establish risk mitigation, contingency, and business continuity plans for critical projects.
  • Ensure project deliverables meet quality standards and organizational requirements.

Business Transformation & Strategic Initiatives

  • Lead cross-functional transformation programs aimed at improving operational efficiency and business performance.
  • Support organizational restructuring, mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures, and post-merger integration projects.
  • Coordinate strategic initiatives involving geographic expansion, new market entry, and business diversification.
  • Drive process improvement, automation, and cost optimization initiatives.
  • Track business benefits and ensure successful adoption of project outcomes.

Stakeholder & Executive Management

  • Collaborate with the CEO, Board, executive leadership, and business unit heads to establish project priorities.
  • Maintain effective communication with internal stakeholders, regulators, investors, consultants, and external partners, as appropriate.
  • Resolve project conflicts involving scope, budgets, timelines, and resource allocation.
  • Provide executive-level updates on project performance, delivery challenges, and strategic recommendations.
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders to ensure successful project execution.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead project directors, program managers, project managers, and PMO professionals.
  • Develop high-performing project delivery teams across multiple business units.
  • Establish accountability, performance standards, and professional development programs.
  • Promote a culture of project ownership, collaboration, innovation, and delivery excellence.
  • Introduce project management tools, dashboards, and performance measurement systems.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Project Management, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • MBA or Master's degree in Project Management, Finance, Business Strategy, or a relevant discipline preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in project management, program management, portfolio management, or enterprise transformation.
  • At least 5 years in a senior executive or leadership position overseeing complex project portfolios and strategic programs.
  • Experience in insurance, reinsurance, banking, investment management, asset management, wealth management, or financial services preferred.
  • Proven track record of delivering large-scale, multi-departmental projects within approved budgets and timelines.
  • Strong understanding of insurance operations, investment services, financial products, and regulated business environments.
  • Experience establishing and managing enterprise PMOs and project governance frameworks.
  • Knowledge of Agile, Waterfall, PRINCE2, PMI, and other project delivery methodologies.
  • Strong financial planning, budgeting, risk management, and resource allocation capabilities.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Certifications:

- Project Management Professional (PMP).

  • Program Management Professional (PgMP).
  • Portfolio Management Professional (PfMP).

- PRINCE2 Practitioner.

- Agile or Scrum certifications.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Percentage of strategic projects delivered on time and within budget.
  • Overall project portfolio performance and strategic alignment.
  • Project cost variance and schedule variance.
  • Achievement of project milestones and approved deliverables.
  • Return on investment (ROI) and realization of expected business benefits.
  • Successful delivery of insurance and investment transformation initiatives.
  • Project risk mitigation and issue resolution effectiveness.
  • PMO governance and reporting compliance.
  • Resource utilization and project team productivity.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and project quality ratings.
  • Reduction in project delays, cost overruns, and implementation risks.
  • Successful execution of digital transformation and business expansion projects.

Agentic AI Coach

About Break Through Tech

Break Through Tech transforms how tech talent is discovered, developed, and connected to opportunity in the age of AI. Working across higher education and industry, Break Through Tech delivers programs nationwide and integrates technical training, work-based learning, mentorship, and career readiness with deep employer partnerships to create more effective and scalable routes into early tech careers. Break Through Tech is actively shaping the field of early tech talent development by identifying what works, translating those insights into replicable models, and helping define more consistent approaches to how talent is prepared, assessed, and hired across institutions and employers.

At a moment when AI is reshaping every aspect of work and society, Break Through Tech’s mission is urgent: to ensure that the people who build what comes next — and who are in the room where the most consequential technology decisions of our time get made — look like the world they will shape. Learn more about our work at.

Position Summary

We are seeking several subject matter experts to partner with Break Through Tech program staff to deliver our Agentic AI programs for up to 500 undergraduate fellows. Agentic AI is offered at two levels, Beginner and Advanced. Coaches will be matched to a level based on their experience with Agentic AI and staffing needs.

For a long time, chatbots were the biggest thing in AI. Now companies are building them into something more powerful: agents that work together to plan, use tools, hand off work, and take action. That shift is creating fast-growing demand for engineers who can design, evaluate, and deploy these systems.

The new 16-week Agentic AI program builds on fellows' foundation in machine learning and Python. Many have completed our rigorous 9-week Machine Learning Foundations course and a 3-month industry-sponsored AI project. Fellows learn to build agents, extend them with tools and knowledge, measure how well they perform, and ship systems that hold up in production.

With expert guidance and support from their Coaches, fellows will work in teams to build agents from ideation onward. They will build agentic systems in LangGraph, stress-test them with systematic evaluations, trace every decision in LangSmith, and use what they learn to make their systems faster, cheaper, and more reliable. They will then deploy to the cloud and present at a final showcase.

Across 4 units, fellows move from agent fundamentals through architecture, evaluation, and deployment, learning the practices professional AI engineers use. Asynchronous coursework will be completed before monthly virtual Workshops and Maker Days, where teams build and troubleshoot together.

Coaches for this Specialization will each support 8–10 project teams (about 40 fellows). Coaches will be expected to facilitate live virtual events end-to-end, provide technical mentorship and code review, hold regular team check-ins, and grade and give feedback on project deliverables.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

The essential duties of this role are grouped into these categories, with the approximate percentage of time spent on each category indicated below.

  • Event Facilitation (30%)
    • Facilitate 4 Workshops (1.5 hours each, one per month) from start to finish for your assigned fellows, leading code demos and guided project working sessions.
    • Facilitate 4 Maker Days (3 hours each, one per month) from start to finish, leading build-sprint structure, checking milestone progress, and troubleshooting technical issues live.
    • Prepare for each Workshop and Maker Day you are facilitating.
    • Maintain attendance records for Workshops, Maker Days, and team check-ins.
  • Technical Support (25%)
    • Provide technical mentorship on agent design, RAG and tool integration, evaluation and observability (LangSmith), and cloud deployment and containerization. Advanced Agentic AI Coaches will also provide mentorship on multi-agent architecture and coordination patterns.
    • Review code and conduct debugging sessions to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
    • Find and recommend additional resources to support your teams' projects as needed.
    • Attend and actively engage in twice-monthly Community of Practice meetings with other Coaches and program staff, to share ideas and troubleshoot together.
  • Team Check-Ins & Progress Monitoring (25%)
    • Hold a recurring check-in at least once a month with each of your 8–10 assigned teams to monitor progress and provide feedback.
    • Monitor team progress and intervene to address technical blockers or team dynamics issues.
    • Partner with Break Through Tech program staff to manage unresolved issues affecting project success.
    • Conduct outreach to at-risk fellows, which may include 1:1s and post-meeting follow-ups.
  • Assessment & Feedback (20%)
    • Grade unit and event deliverables for all of your assigned teams using provided rubrics.
    • Track deliverable submissions and follow up with teams that have not submitted.
    • Provide constructive technical feedback on project milestones and presentations.
    • Observe final presentations and provide meaningful feedback.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Solid knowledge of agent architecture, including tool calling, RAG, and memory. Advanced Agentic AI Coaches will also need solid knowledge of multi-agent coordination patterns, including supervisor/orchestrator workflows, agent handoffs, and agents-as-tools.
  • Comfortable reading, writing, and debugging Python code.
  • Ability to troubleshoot code and debug complex systems.
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills (including evaluating and giving feedback on technical work).
  • Comfort facilitating a live session for a group of about 40 fellows.
  • Ability to thrive in a virtual work environment.
  • Commitment to developing inclusive and equitable working relationships with fellows from a variety of backgrounds, volunteers, other Coaches, and program staff.

Education and/or Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Associate’s degree in computer science, data science, or a related field. An advanced degree is a plus.
  • Strong background in AI/ML with hands-on experience in agent development.
  • Experience personally building an agent with tools and/or RAG, and evaluating its performance. Advanced Agentic AI Coaches will also need experience building a multi-agent system or a single-agent system with advanced tool routing, and running systematic evaluations on agent performance.
  • Hands-on experience with LangChain and LangGraph. Advanced Agentic AI Coaches will also need hands-on experience with LangGraph subgraphs, parallel execution, and multi-agent coordination patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with RAG systems, API integrations, and deploying applications to cloud platforms.
  • Experience with evaluation and observability/tracing tools, particularly LangSmith.
  • Experience with deployment and containerization (Docker, cloud platforms).
  • Prior teaching, tutoring, or mentoring experience, including coaching or leading a team through an ambiguous, open-ended technical project.
  • Experience giving feedback on presentations or public speaking coaching.
  • Prior Break Through Tech and/or Machine Learning Foundations experience is a plus.

Important Notes

  • This is a part-time, remote, temporary position beginning on Monday, January 4th, 2027 and ending on Monday, May 20th, 2027.
  • Estimated time commitment: 15-20 hours/week. Actual weekly hours will vary depending on program activities.
  • This role is not eligible for benefits.
  • This role is open to any eligible candidate across the US.
  • Visa sponsorship (including H-1B) is not available. Candidates authorized to work through F-1 CPT or OPT are welcome to apply.
  • Pay rate: $35 per hour.
  • Coaches will be required to participate in about 10 hours of pre-program training in early January 2027.
  • Coaches will be required to be available to facilitate 8 events (four 90-minute Workshops and four 4-hour Maker Days, including Final Presentations) on to-be-determined dates, from January-May, 2027.

  • Arc-Flash Hazard Analysis

  • Equipment Specification: Develop detailed specifications for major electrical equipment, including current-limiting fuses, power transformers, switchgear, and protective relays.

  • Codes & Standards: Deep understanding of the National Electrical Code (NEC/NFPA 70), National Electrical Safety Code (NESC/IEEE C2), and industry-standard protective relaying philosophies.

Professional Attributes

  • Proven ability to manage engineering deliverables for multiple fast-tracked projects simultaneously.

  • Detail-oriented with an uncompromising focus on accuracy, safety, and quality in industrial construction documentation.

  • Manage change by rolling out policy, process, and system updates with clear stakeholder communication and adoption tracking
  • Elevate customer satisfaction across internal stakeholders and suppliers by owning the service experience, measuring CSAT/NPS, and acting on feedback
  • Deliver quarterly business reviews with senior and executive stakeholders, presenting performance, risks, and the improvement roadmap

  • Lean Six Sigma or similar process-improvement credentials, with automation and AI experience

About SideBy Care

SideBy Care is the first AI-supported virtual care service for GI practices and clients with Crohn's, colitis, and Disorders of Gut-Brain Interaction (DGBI).

Because the gut and brain constantly communicate through nerves, hormones, and chemicals, stress directly triggers GI symptoms (cramping, bloating, diarrhea), while gut issues simultaneously impact mood. We break this cycle by providing insurance-covered gut-brain therapy alongside diet and lifestyle support. Backed by scalable technology and behavioral science, more than 92% of our clients report quality of life and symptom improvement during the program.

Founded by individuals with lived experience, our purpose-built, personalized, and empathetic program delivers life-changing outcomes. We are seeking a highly motivated, self-directed Registered Dietitian (RD) to join our multidisciplinary team and play a leading role in helping individuals heal from the inside out.

  • Clinical Counseling: Provide medical nutrition therapy for GI conditions; counsel clients on nutrition and sustainable lifestyle changes to support the gut-brain axis and overall health.
  • Care Planning: Create lifestyle-focused care plans that promote a healthy relationship with food, exercise, and self.
  • Documentation & Coordination: Appropriately document clinical encounters and communicate as needed with the care team and clients outside of sessions.

  • Credentials: Active RD/RDN credential from the Commission of Dietetic Registration (CDR).
  • Licensure: RD license in the state of Massachusetts.
  • NPI: Must have your own National Provider Identifier.
  • Experience: 2–3 years of nutrition counseling experience (ideally in an outpatient and/or telehealth setting).
  • Education: Master’s Degree (preferred).
  • Credentials Support: CAQH & PECOS Logins (preferred).
  • Philosophy & Fit: Alignment with a holistic approach to care; excitement to learn new skills to deliver the SideBy Care model.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with individuals with GI disorders.
