The Director of PMO ensures projects are delivered within approved timelines, budgets, quality standards, and organizational objectives while maintaining effective risk management, resource allocation, and stakeholder engagement.

The successful candidate will drive project management excellence, strengthen governance frameworks, improve delivery performance, and ensure that project outcomes contribute to business growth, operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and customer experience.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. PMO Strategy, Leadership & Governance

  • Establish, develop, and lead the organization's Project Management Office.
  • Define PMO strategy, policies, methodologies, standards, and governance frameworks.
  • Implement standardized project management processes, tools, templates, and reporting structures.
  • Establish project approval processes, stage gates, escalation procedures, and accountability frameworks.
  • Promote project management best practices across departments and business units.
  • Ensure alignment between project execution and corporate strategy.

B. Project Portfolio Management

  • Oversee the organization's project portfolio, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities.
  • Evaluate project proposals, business cases, feasibility studies, and investment requirements.
  • Prioritize projects based on business value, financial impact, risk, and resource availability.
  • Monitor project dependencies, interdepartmental coordination, and portfolio-level risks.
  • Provide recommendations to senior management regarding project prioritization and resource allocation.
  • Track portfolio performance and ensure delivery of expected business benefits.

C. Project Planning & Execution

  • Oversee the planning, scheduling, budgeting, and execution of strategic projects.
  • Ensure project managers develop comprehensive project plans, milestones, deliverables, and resource requirements.
  • Monitor project progress and identify delays, delivery challenges, and performance gaps.
  • Drive corrective actions and escalation processes to maintain project delivery commitments.
  • Ensure projects are completed within approved scope, budget, timelines, and quality standards.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure smooth project implementation.

D. Insurance & Investment Project Oversight

  • Oversee projects related to insurance operations, underwriting, claims management, policy administration, and distribution.
  • Coordinate initiatives involving investment operations, financial products, portfolio reporting, and client services, where applicable.
  • Support the implementation of regulatory, compliance, risk management, and internal control initiatives.
  • Monitor projects involving new product development, market expansion, operational improvements, and business integration.
  • Ensure project deliverables reflect the operational and regulatory requirements of the insurance and financial services industry.

E. Digital Transformation & Technology Projects

  • Oversee technology-enabled transformation projects, including core insurance systems, CRM, ERP, digital platforms, and automation initiatives.
  • Coordinate with IT, technology, operations, and business teams to ensure successful implementation.
  • Monitor technology project budgets, vendor performance, implementation timelines, and delivery quality.
  • Support digitalization, process automation, data management, and operational efficiency initiatives.
  • Ensure technology projects deliver measurable business outcomes.

F. Financial & Resource Management

  • Develop and monitor project budgets, financial forecasts, and expenditure reports.
  • Ensure effective allocation and utilization of project resources.
  • Monitor project costs, financial variances, and budget performance.
  • Evaluate project financial risks and recommend cost-control measures.
  • Coordinate with Finance and Procurement teams on project funding, contracts, and vendor payments.
  • Assess project return on investment (ROI) and benefits realization.

G. Risk Management, Compliance & Quality Assurance

  • Establish project risk management frameworks and escalation mechanisms.
  • Identify, assess, and monitor project risks, issues, dependencies, and delivery constraints.
  • Ensure projects comply with applicable regulatory requirements, internal policies, and governance standards.
  • Monitor project quality and ensure deliverables meet agreed specifications.
  • Maintain project documentation, audit trails, and management records.
  • Coordinate with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Internal Audit teams.

H. Performance Monitoring & Executive Reporting

  • Develop project dashboards, management reports, and portfolio performance metrics.
  • Present project status, risks, budget performance, and delivery updates to executive leadership.
  • Provide timely visibility into project delays, resource constraints, and critical dependencies.
  • Monitor project KPIs and ensure accountability among project managers.
  • Lead project review meetings and portfolio governance sessions.
  • Recommend improvements to project delivery processes and organizational performance.

I. Stakeholder & Team Management

  • Lead and develop project managers, PMO analysts, and project support professionals.
  • Build strong working relationships with senior executives, department heads, project sponsors, and external vendors.
  • Facilitate communication and coordination across business units and functional teams.
  • Develop project management capabilities through training, coaching, and performance management.
  • Promote a culture of ownership, collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

Educational Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Finance, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Master's degree in Business Administration (MBA), Project Management, Finance, or a relevant discipline is preferred.

Professional Experience

  • Minimum 10–15 years of progressive professional experience in project management, program management, or portfolio management.
  • At least 5 years in a senior PMO leadership or Director-level position.
  • Proven experience establishing, managing, or transforming a Project Management Office.
  • Experience overseeing complex, enterprise-wide projects and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Background in insurance, banking, financial services, investment management, or related industries is highly desirable.
  • Experience managing large project portfolios, budgets, resources, and multiple project teams.
  • Exposure to digital transformation, technology implementation, business process improvement, and organizational change initiatives.

Preferred Certifications

- Project Management Professional (PMP).

- PRINCE2 Practitioner.

- Managing Successful Programmes (MSP).

  • Portfolio Management Professional (PfMP).

- Agile or Scrum certifications.

- Lean Six Sigma certification.

Core Competencies

  • Strategic project and portfolio management.
  • PMO governance and operational leadership.
  • Financial planning and budget management.

- Risk assessment and problem-solving.

  • Executive communication and stakeholder management.
  • Change management and business transformation.
  • Leadership, team development, and decision-making.
  • Project management systems and reporting tools.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Percentage of projects delivered on time and within approved budgets.
  • Overall project portfolio performance and delivery success rate.

- Project cost and schedule variance.

  • Achievement of project milestones and strategic objectives.

- Project benefits realization and ROI.

  • Effectiveness of project governance and reporting.
  • Project risk identification, mitigation, and resolution.
  • Resource utilization and allocation efficiency.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and project sponsor feedback.
  • PMO process maturity and continuous improvement.
  • Compliance with project management standards and regulatory requirements.

jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Hyatt seeks seeks an enthusiastic Senior Manager to join our Global Payments Team. In this role, you will be collaborating closely with the broader Digital, Finance, Security, and Property Technology teams, where you’ll be instrumental in continuing to make Hyatt a leading hospitality company. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines canopen the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care for Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family.Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious100 Best Companies to Work For®list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

·Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally

·Flexible work schedule

·Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center

·A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption

·Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

Key Responsibilities:

Payment Product Management & Strategy

  • Support and execute the global payment product roadmap across digital and in-property channels.
  • Contribute to the management of multiple payment capabilities including gateways, tokenization, alternative payment methods, fraud tools, and integrations with PMS, POS, and digital platforms.
  • Partner with Digital, Finance, Security, and Property Technology teams to align payment initiatives with business priorities and guest experience goals.

·Identify opportunities to design and implement AI-powered workflows and agent-based solutions to improve internal efficiencies, enhance data analysis, and enable smarter, more scalable ways of working across payment operations and delivery teams.

Global Vendor Certification & Solution Enablement

  • Coordinate certification and onboarding of global payment vendors across PMS (Opera Cloud), POS, and digital platforms.
  • Support development and execution of standardized certification frameworks, validation processes, and rollout plans.
  • Work with internal engineering and infrastructure teams to ensure solutions meet scalability, security, and compliance requirements.

Alternative Payment Methods & Digital Payments

  • Support implementation of alternative payment methods (e.g., digital wallets, regional payment methods, BNPL, real-time payments).
  • Assist with integration of payment solutions across web, mobile, and property environments.
  • Monitor industry trends and recommend opportunities to improve payment capabilities.
  • Collaborate closely with regional teams to support market-specific payment needs, while staying informed of emerging legal and regulatory requirements.

Agile Delivery & Execution

  • Participate in agile delivery processes across multiple workstreams.
  • Support backlog prioritization, sprint planning, and agile ceremonies (stand-ups, retrospectives).
  • Utilize JIRA to track progress, manage dependencies, and ensure visibility into delivery.

Vendor & Commercial Support

  • Support management of global payment vendors including gateways, acquirers, and fraud providers.
  • Assist in vendor evaluations, onboarding, and performance tracking.
  • Contribute to commercial discussions, cost analysis, and optimization initiatives.

Team Leadership & Accountability

  • Lead and mentor a team of FTEs and contractors supporting payment initiatives.
  • Provide clear direction, performance expectations, and regular feedback.
  • Promote accountability, ownership, and delivery excellence within the team.

Fraud, Risk & Compliance

  • Support fraud prevention initiatives and monitoring across digital and property environments.
  • Partner with Risk and Security teams to ensure compliance with PCI and global regulatory standards.
  • Assist in identifying and mitigating payment-related risks.

KPI Tracking & Reporting

  • Support tracking and analysis of payment KPIs including authorization rates, chargebacks, fraud, uptime, and transaction costs.
  • Contribute to development of dashboards and reporting for leadership visibility.

Project & Portfolio Support

  • Support delivery of key initiatives such as Opera Cloud migrations, payment integrations, vendor certifications, and platform enhancements.
  • Assist in coordinating cross-functional teams to ensure timely and successful delivery.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 6+ years of experience in payments or payment product management.
  • 4+ years of people management experience, including managing FTEs and/or contractors.
  • Experience working with payment systems, payment service providers, or digital commerce platforms.
  • Exposure to global vendor ecosystems and coordination of integrations or certification activities.
  • Experience working in agile environments and familiarity with tools such as JIRA, Smartsheet, Confluence or similar platforms.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to work across technical and business teams.
  • Experience contributing to system implementations, integrations, or technology deployments.

Preferred:

  • Experience in hospitality, travel, or other global consumer-facing industries.
  • Familiarity with Opera PMS, Opera Cloud (OPI), or POS systems.
  • Exposure to alternative payment methods and emerging payment technologies.
  • Knowledge of payment security concepts including PCI compliance and fraud tools.

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

We welcome you:

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

The salary range for this position is $135,000 - $160,000

The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work. Pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate.

We value our relationships with recruitment partners and require that agencies contact us first before submitting any candidates. Hyatt will not be responsible for any fees and obligations associated with unsolicited submissions unless a formal agreement is in place.

Job Description Summary

Are you ready to see your future take flight? At GE Aerospace, we are advancing aviation technologies for today and tomorrow. Your work will contribute to the production and support of advanced jet engines, components, and integrated systems that power commercial and military aircraft. As part of our CFM56 spares team, you’ll help keep one of the world’s most widely used engines flying safely and reliably. You’ll be part of a team that embraces your drive, your curiosity, and your unique ideas and perspectives. Most importantly, you’ll share in our pride and purpose that affects the lives of millions around the world.
The Sr Fulfillment Leader – CFM56 Spares will coordinate and expedite the flow of CFM56 spare parts and hardware in line with production schedules and global customer demand. The role monitors and validates material and production plans, manages material processes and systems for data integrity, and leads recovery and improvement actions for shortages and delivery risks. Working cross-functionally, the Sr Fulfillment Leader identifies gaps between plan and demand, prioritizes recovery efforts, optimizes inventory, and protects on-time delivery and SQDC outcomes for CFM56 customers, while role modeling GE Aerospace Behaviors in how they lead and communicate.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Engage with supply chain and manufacturing programs to drive critical part delivery and allocation calls
  • Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to review and validate short‑term execution and longer‑term capacity plans, ensuring they can meet business needs in future quarters and surfacing risks or gaps early.

  • Manage incoming hardware at the fulfillment horizon to align to program needs.
  • Reviews waterfalls and open orders to manage shortages while building strong relationships with sources
  • Communicates program needs clearly and concisely to drive results at internal and external source locations

  • Ability to effectively manage competing priorities and resolve challenges simultaneously
  • Lean/Continuous Improvement experience/mindset

  • Humble: respectful, receptive, agile, eager to learn

Job Summary:

Join Our Team as an M&A Origination and Corporate Development Professional

Job Description:

Volaris Group is seeking a high-performing Corporate Development Professional to originate acquisition opportunities and build long-term relationships with software company founders across Australia and New Zealand, with additional focus across the broader Asia-Pacific region. This is a flexible, work from home/remote opportunity that requires a proactive, externally focused individual who combines commercial curiosity, disciplined execution, sound judgment, and persistence. You will identify attractive vertical market software businesses, earn the trust of owners and executives, and help develop opportunities from initial research and outreach through qualification and handoff to the broader M&A team.


This role will support the growth of our Asia-Pacific software portfolio in a flexible, remote working environment. This remote role is open to candidates based in Australia or New Zealand. You will represent Volaris as a trusted permanent acquirer and engage owners and founders at different stages of their journey, often well before they are considering a transaction. Success requires the patience and credibility to build relationships over time, understand each founder’s objectives, and position Volaris as a compelling long-term home for their business.


As part of Volaris Group, an operating group of Constellation Software Inc., you will:


  • Build meaningful, long-term relationships with business founders, C-Suite executives, and investors.
  • Collaborate with a professional team to acquire mid-market software businesses
  • Be challenged with dynamic, high-impact acquisition projects in the software industry.

This full-time role offers flexible work arrangements and reports directly to the Manager, Corporate Development.


Core Responsibilities:


  • Research software markets in Australia, New Zealand, and the broader Asia-Pacific region and identify high-quality acquisition targets that align with Volaris’ strategic and investment criteria, using sound judgment to prioritize the most relevant opportunities.
  • Build and nurture multi-year relationships with software company founders, owners, and senior executives. Prepare thoroughly, ask thoughtful questions, understand each stakeholder’s objectives, and communicate Volaris’ permanent ownership model with credibility and integrity.
  • Create and execute targeted origination strategies across calls, email, LinkedIn, industry networks, conferences, and referrals. Personalize outreach, test and refine messaging, follow up with discipline, and convert priority targets into meaningful founder and executive dialogues.
  • Own early-stage opportunity development by conducting initial qualification, maintaining accurate and timely records, identifying key risks and next steps, and partnering with the Manager, Corporate Development to transition well-developed opportunities into the later stages of the M&A process.
  • Deliver against individual and team objectives for targeted activity, meaningful dialogues, qualified opportunities, pipeline progression, and relationship development. Use data to assess performance, adjust your approach, maintain strong pipeline hygiene, and contribute actively to shared team priorities.
  • Geographic focus: Australia and New Zealand, with broader Asia-Pacific exposure

Success in this role means combining intellectual curiosity with consistent execution. You will become credible with founders, develop informed points of view on software markets, create high-quality opportunities through disciplined outreach, and manage a portfolio of relationships with excellent judgment, preparation, and follow-through.

Skills, Experience & Qualifications:


  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to earn credibility with founders and senior executives, lead thoughtful discovery conversations, listen carefully, and tailor messages to different stakeholders and cultural contexts.
  • Demonstrated ability to work with a high degree of autonomy in a remote environment: set priorities, manage time effectively, exercise judgment, maintain attention to detail, and follow through reliably on commitments and agreed outcomes.
  • A strong record of building senior B2B relationships and creating opportunities through proactive outreach. Relevant experience may come from M&A origination, business development, executive search, consulting, enterprise sales, investment banking, or another environment requiring credibility with founders and executives.
  • Strong analytical and commercial judgment, with the ability to synthesize incomplete information, assess market and company attractiveness, identify key questions and risks, and form a clear, evidence-based point of view.
  • Self-motivated, resilient, and receptive to coaching, with the discipline to sustain high-quality effort through long sales cycles, learn from unsuccessful outreach, and continuously improve your approach.
  • Experience in strategic outbound business development using multiple channels preferred but not essential (calls, email, LinkedIn).
  • Candidates must be based in Australia or New Zealand.
  • Professional fluency in English is required. Fluency in another language relevant to target markets in the Asia-Pacific region is a strong asset.

What We Offer:


  • Competitive base salary plus performance incentives.
  • A remote, flexible working environment with meaningful autonomy, clear objectives, regular coaching, and collaboration with colleagues across Volaris’ global M&A network.
  • Global networking opportunities.
  • Career growth opportunities within a global technology organization.

About Volaris Group

Volaris Group, an operating group of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), acquires, strengthens, and grows vertical market software companies. We provide businesses with a permanent home, preserve their entrepreneurial culture, and support long-term growth through a global network of experienced software operators. Our approach is built on decentralized decision-making, disciplined investment, and enduring partnerships with the leaders of the companies we acquire.

The CPO will oversee complex projects involving insurance operations, investment services, digital transformation, regulatory compliance, business expansion, mergers and acquisitions, and operational improvement.

Project Governance & PMO Leadership

  • Monitor project scope, timelines, budgets, deliverables, and quality standards.

Digital Transformation & Technology Projects

  • Lead strategic technology implementation and digital transformation projects across the organization.

  • Provide executive-level updates on project performance, delivery challenges, and strategic recommendations.
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders to ensure successful project execution.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead project directors, program managers, project managers, and PMO professionals.
  • Develop high-performing project delivery teams across multiple business units.
  • Establish accountability, performance standards, and professional development programs.
  • Promote a culture of project ownership, collaboration, innovation, and delivery excellence.
  • Introduce project management tools, dashboards, and performance measurement systems.

3. Required Qualifications

jobs.description:
Software Engineer, Distributed Systems (Core) – Remote (US/Canada)

$180k -$320k

We are looking for a distributed systems engineer to work on the systems that power the syncing engine our customers and other engineering teams rely on. This presents an exciting challenge where you can apply your expertise in distributed systems, performance optimization, and troubleshooting to push the boundaries of what is possible and meaningfully improve our ability to move massive amounts of customer data. This role also offers a unique opportunity to work on a multi-cloud, multi-region infrastructure that supports a global customer base. You will own and deliver projects from start to finish; work directly with customers to solve their hardest scaling problems; and have significant influence over what we work on as a team and company.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience as a software engineer with a very high level of general aptitude and experience working in distributed systems
  • Strong backend engineers (not full stack), please send them to our senior full stack role instead.
  • An engineer passionate about solving hard technical problems that generate real value for customers.
  • You've created event collection or data streaming services that power company-critical systems ( work with message queues,​ Kafka,​ SQL databases,​ Kubernetes,​ Docker)
  • You've owned systems that have undergone orders of magnitude of growth and helped them scale accordingly
  • Experience and comfort with distributed systems and high-scale systems, or the ability and desire to build this experience quickly. You have built syncing engines that process and move terabytes of data per day in a scalable way
  • Created event collection or data streaming services that power company critical systems
  • Owned systems that have undergone orders of magnitude growth and helped them scale accordingly
  • You have relevant skills and are a fast learner who is excited to take on the challenges we face

Some of the problems we'll be working on include:

  • Sync Speed: Customers want to sync a lot of data to important destinations like Facebook and Snapchat, which requires us to analyze every part of our syncing process and find where we can optimize to sync data more quickly
  • Streaming Syncing: We currently sync data from sources in batch only, but envision a world where we also do syncs in real-time and support streaming sources like webhooks and queues
  • Scalability and Reliability: As part of our rapid growth, we're always evaluating current and future bottlenecks in scaling and reliability, and architecting for the next order of magnitude of growth
  • Personalization API: Our Personalization API product provides a low-latency caching layer on top of data warehouses that enables customers to use their data warehouse for real-time personalization use cases with <30ms p90 response times with QPS in the millions

Education

  • Graduated from a top 30 CS program such as:​ University of Waterloo,​ Harvard,​ Columbia,​ Princeton,​ Stanford,​ UC Berkeley,​ MIT,​ CMU,​ Caltech,​ Cornell,​ Duke,​ Dartmouth,​ Brown,​ IITs

jobs.excerpt: Position Summary:The Roof Measurement Specialist is responsible for accurately capturing and documenting detailed roof measurements and features using specialized software.
jobs.description:
Position Summary:

The Roof Measurement Specialist is responsible for accurately capturing and documenting detailed roof measurements and features using specialized software. This role requires a high level of precision, technical aptitude, and a solid understanding of roofing structures and terminology. The Specialist will input customer and property details, select and manage roof imagery, precisely draw roof outlines, label key roof elements, assign accurate pitches, and utilize software tools to refine and organize measurement data. Upon completion, the Specialist will generate final roof reports in the required format and provide them to clients or stakeholders. This position demands excellent attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects efficiently to meet deadlines.

Job Details:

  • Work from Home
  • Monday to Friday | 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM Manila Time (Shifts are subject to change/Shifting)
  • *Following PH Holidays

Responsibilities:

  • Input address and customer details into the Roofer platform to initiate roof measurements.
  • Select and manage roof imagery that would be used.
  • Precisely draw roof outlines using tools like the 90-degree snapping feature to ensure accurate edge alignment.
  • Label various roof features including eaves, valleys, hips, ridges, and rakes, applying your knowledge of roofing structures for accurate categorization.
  • Assign the correct pitch to each roof facet, adjusting for slope and integrating additional architectural features like dormers.
  • Utilize the platform's layering and editing tools to organize and refine measurement details, making use of functionalities such as undo, redo, and delete to correct errors.
  • Save ongoing projects and return to them as needed, ensuring no details are lost between sessions.
  • Upon completion of measurements and labeling, proceed to generate the final roof report, selecting appropriate output formats and sending the report to clients or stakeholders.
  • Ensure the delivery of 100% quality and 100% turnaround time from day one.
  • Thoroughly review all notes from clients and the support team to ensure no details are overlooked in task execution.
  • Prioritize weekly training refresher courses to evaluate new hires' abilities and identify areas for improvement, facilitating quicker adaptation to their responsibilities and enhancing overall productivity.

Qualifications:

  • Hands-on experience in roof measurement is preferred.
  • High attention to detail and precision, with a keen eye for aesthetics and technical accuracy.
  • Strong understanding of roofing terminology and structural elements, or willingness to learn quickly on the job.
  • Competence in handling digital tools and software for data entry and image manipulation.
  • Strong organizational skills to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Good problem-solving skills to navigate software issues or measurement challenges.

jobs.description:
Description

OpenDor Media is searching for a Jr. Data Analyst to cover a 6-month maternity leave, with the option to stay on long term, and keep the numbers our teams and funders rely on accurate, current and easy to use. You will answer data requests, build Looker Studio dashboards for fundraising, Unpacked for Educators, ConnectED and Amplified, and make sure the data in our BigQuery warehouse matches its sources. Every number you get right ends up in a real decision, a funder report, or a program that reaches more people.

OpenDor Media is a leading global non-profit media company for the 21st century. We educate, entertain, and engage our audiences by bringing to life big ideas and authentic stories, and by celebrating all things Jewish.

What you'll own

  • Reporting and analysis. Answer data requests from fundraising, department heads and leadership, prepare the analysis behind organization-wide and grant reporting, and turn recurring asks into standing reports.
  • Dashboards. Build and improve the Looker Studio dashboards teams use to track their own performance, including cross-divisional KPI views, and help colleagues find answers on their own.
  • Data quality. Validate BigQuery tables and metrics against their source platforms, diagnose reporting bugs, and build corrected versions in the analytics layer for the warehouse team to apply.

Requirements

  • You have 3-5 years in data analytics, business intelligence or a related role.
  • You have a bachelor's degree in data analytics, statistics, mathematics, computer science, economics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • You're comfortable writing SQL in BigQuery or a similar cloud warehouse, including validating data across sources and schema design.
  • You work confidently in Looker Studio or similar BI tools, advanced Excel, and a CRM, ideally Salesforce.
  • You already use AI tools like Claude in your day-to-day analytical work.
  • You're analytical, organized, and good at seeing a project through from request to delivery.
  • You can explain what the numbers mean to technical and non-technical people alike.
  • You're curious and self-motivated.
  • You're available full time for a 6-month maternity cover, with the option to continue long term, working remotely with no travel required.

Bonus points for

  • Social media analytics
  • ETL, Python or scripting experience
  • Experience reporting against grant or funder commitments

None of these are required.

What You Have:

What we're looking for

  • A stickler for accuracy. You check numbers against the source, and you notice when something doesn't add up.
  • Someone who closes the loop. When the same request comes in twice, your instinct is to turn it into a standing report so nobody has to ask a third time.
  • A good detective. When a report looks off, you dig in until you find out why.
  • Quick to get up to speed. You're comfortable picking up existing dashboards and processes and running with them from the first weeks.

Who We Are:

Chief Project Officer (CPO) – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Chief Project Officer (CPO) is responsible for leading the organization's strategic project portfolio, enterprise-wide program management, and major transformation initiatives across its insurance and investment businesses.

The role ensures that strategic projects are properly planned, prioritized, funded, executed, and delivered in alignment with organizational goals. The CPO will oversee complex projects involving insurance operations, investment services, digital transformation, regulatory compliance, business expansion, mergers and acquisitions, and operational improvement.

Working closely with the CEO, Board, and senior management team, the CPO will establish effective project governance, optimize resources, manage delivery risks, and ensure measurable business outcomes from the organization's project investments.

2. Key Responsibilities

Strategic Project & Portfolio Management

  • Develop and execute the organization's enterprise-wide project management and portfolio strategy.
  • Identify, assess, prioritize, and oversee strategic projects across insurance and investment business units.
  • Ensure project portfolios align with corporate strategy, growth objectives, and operational priorities.
  • Evaluate project feasibility, business cases, resource requirements, expected returns, and implementation risks.
  • Monitor portfolio performance and ensure projects deliver their intended strategic and financial benefits.

Insurance & Investment Project Delivery

  • Lead strategic initiatives involving life insurance, general insurance, reinsurance, investment management, wealth management, and financial services.
  • Oversee projects involving new insurance product launches, policy administration systems, claims management, underwriting processes, and distribution expansion.
  • Manage investment-related initiatives involving portfolio management systems, investment operations, client reporting, and service delivery, where applicable.
  • Coordinate projects involving regulatory changes, business process modernization, and operational restructuring.
  • Support the implementation of new business models, financial products, and market expansion initiatives.

Project Governance & PMO Leadership

  • Establish and oversee the Project Management Office (PMO), including project standards, methodologies, policies, and governance frameworks.
  • Implement project approval processes, stage-gate reviews, reporting structures, and escalation procedures.
  • Ensure consistent project management practices across business units and subsidiaries.
  • Monitor project scope, timelines, budgets, deliverables, and quality standards.
  • Present portfolio performance reports, major risks, and project recommendations to executive leadership and the Board.

Digital Transformation & Technology Projects

  • Lead strategic technology implementation and digital transformation projects across the organization.
  • Oversee projects involving insurance technology (InsurTech), financial technology (FinTech), automation, AI, cloud platforms, CRM, and enterprise systems.
  • Coordinate implementation of digital insurance platforms, customer portals, mobile applications, and investment service platforms.
  • Work with CIO, CTO, and CDO teams to ensure technology projects meet business requirements.
  • Monitor technology implementation costs, timelines, system integration, and business adoption.

Financial & Resource Management

  • Develop and manage project portfolio budgets and investment plans.
  • Monitor expenditure, cost variations, financial performance, and project profitability.
  • Optimize resource allocation across projects, departments, and business units.
  • Evaluate project return on investment (ROI), cost-benefit analysis, and benefits realization.
  • Manage external consultants, contractors, technology vendors, and implementation partners.

Risk, Compliance & Quality Management

  • Identify and manage project-related operational, financial, regulatory, and technology risks.
  • Ensure projects comply with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.
  • Coordinate with risk management, legal, compliance, and internal audit teams.
  • Establish risk mitigation, contingency, and business continuity plans for critical projects.
  • Ensure project deliverables meet quality standards and organizational requirements.

Business Transformation & Strategic Initiatives

  • Lead cross-functional transformation programs aimed at improving operational efficiency and business performance.
  • Support organizational restructuring, mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures, and post-merger integration projects.
  • Coordinate strategic initiatives involving geographic expansion, new market entry, and business diversification.
  • Drive process improvement, automation, and cost optimization initiatives.
  • Track business benefits and ensure successful adoption of project outcomes.

Stakeholder & Executive Management

  • Collaborate with the CEO, Board, executive leadership, and business unit heads to establish project priorities.
  • Maintain effective communication with internal stakeholders, regulators, investors, consultants, and external partners, as appropriate.
  • Resolve project conflicts involving scope, budgets, timelines, and resource allocation.
  • Provide executive-level updates on project performance, delivery challenges, and strategic recommendations.
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders to ensure successful project execution.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead project directors, program managers, project managers, and PMO professionals.
  • Develop high-performing project delivery teams across multiple business units.
  • Establish accountability, performance standards, and professional development programs.
  • Promote a culture of project ownership, collaboration, innovation, and delivery excellence.
  • Introduce project management tools, dashboards, and performance measurement systems.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Project Management, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • MBA or Master's degree in Project Management, Finance, Business Strategy, or a relevant discipline preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in project management, program management, portfolio management, or enterprise transformation.
  • At least 5 years in a senior executive or leadership position overseeing complex project portfolios and strategic programs.
  • Experience in insurance, reinsurance, banking, investment management, asset management, wealth management, or financial services preferred.
  • Proven track record of delivering large-scale, multi-departmental projects within approved budgets and timelines.
  • Strong understanding of insurance operations, investment services, financial products, and regulated business environments.
  • Experience establishing and managing enterprise PMOs and project governance frameworks.
  • Knowledge of Agile, Waterfall, PRINCE2, PMI, and other project delivery methodologies.
  • Strong financial planning, budgeting, risk management, and resource allocation capabilities.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Certifications:

- Project Management Professional (PMP).

  • Program Management Professional (PgMP).
  • Portfolio Management Professional (PfMP).

- PRINCE2 Practitioner.

- Agile or Scrum certifications.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Percentage of strategic projects delivered on time and within budget.
  • Overall project portfolio performance and strategic alignment.
  • Project cost variance and schedule variance.
  • Achievement of project milestones and approved deliverables.
  • Return on investment (ROI) and realization of expected business benefits.
  • Successful delivery of insurance and investment transformation initiatives.
  • Project risk mitigation and issue resolution effectiveness.
  • PMO governance and reporting compliance.
  • Resource utilization and project team productivity.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and project quality ratings.
  • Reduction in project delays, cost overruns, and implementation risks.
  • Successful execution of digital transformation and business expansion projects.

The Digital Stronghold - Remote Full-time

Help five distinctive brands in a growing portfolio get found in search, and in what AI says.

We’re looking for a Director of Search and Discovery to make sure every brand in our portfolio is visible, accurately represented and recommended wherever customers are looking.

About The Digital Stronghold

The Digital Stronghold is home to a growing portfolio of consumer apparel and accessories brands, including Boston Scally, Taylor Stitch, The Tie Bar, Pedal Mafia and Glade Optics. Each brand has its own identity, customer and culture, from heritage menswear to unapologetic performance cycling to responsibly built outdoor apparel. We give them shared capabilities in people, finance, technology and operations, so they can grow further and faster than they could on their own, without losing what makes them different.

Reporting to the SVP of Consumer Marketing, you’ll own organic search and AI-driven discovery across the portfolio. This is a senior individual contributor role with a lot of influence. AI FIRST SEO & AI SEARCH GROWTH SPECIALIST (SHOPIFY)
Shenzhen, China | Full time | Remote within Shenzhen

Savvy Smart Deals | Ecommerce Growth

THE ROLE

We sell consumer products internationally. We want a hands-on growth specialist who can make our Shopify stores and product pages easier to find, understand and recommend across Google Search, Google AI Overviews and AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Perplexity.

Your job is to increase qualified discovery and profitable organic sales. You must be able to diagnose technical problems, make or coordinate production fixes, create content that helps customers make decisions, and measure what changed. This is not a general copywriting, SEO reporting or prompt-writing role.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

1. Shopify technical SEO. Diagnose and fix crawl and index coverage, canonicals, redirects, duplicate pages, collection and product architecture, internal links, sitemaps and robots rules. Work with Shopify themes, Liquid, HTML and validated JSON-LD where appropriate. Improve mobile speed and Core Web Vitals without breaking the customer journey.

2. Search and AI discovery. Build accurate, useful product facts, commercial comparisons, buying guides and FAQs. Improve product and brand consistency across on-site content, feeds and credible third-party sources. Monitor commercial queries across traditional search and relevant AI answer products, recording actual brand mentions, citations, competitors and dates. No claims of guaranteed AI placement.

3. AI-powered execution. Use AI daily to research, analyze pages, draft and refine content, inspect structured data and accelerate quality assurance. Check all factual claims, source attribution, language, policy compliance and page behavior before publishing. Build repeatable workflows that increase output without lowering quality.

4. Revenue and conversion. Work with growth, creative, engineering and CRO teams so organic landing pages turn qualified visits into orders. Prioritize high-value product and collection pages. Track nonbrand search traffic, organic conversion rate, attributable orders and contribution where reliable, rather than relying on traffic or rankings alone.

5. Shipping and accountability. Own a ranked backlog of fixes and experiments, clearly identify dependencies, document what went live and report outcomes. Use Search Console, GA4, Shopify analytics, Bing Webmaster Tools and a specialist SEO crawler/platform. Distinguish directly measurable results from directional AI visibility indicators.

YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

  • First 30 days: Establish analytics and technical baselines; audit priority stores, product pages and search competitors; submit a practical ranked implementation plan.
  • By day 60: Deploy and verify priority indexing, structured-data, speed, linking and content improvements; establish recurring AI visibility sampling and an operational dashboard.
  • By day 90: Show completed fixes and measured movement in search visibility, qualified visits and commercial outcomes, with a repeatable AI-assisted production and review system. Results are evaluated against the baseline and realistic search lag, not arbitrary guaranteed rankings.

REQUIREMENTS

• Three or more years delivering hands-on ecommerce SEO improvements, including meaningful Shopify implementation.
• Practical Shopify theme/Liquid, HTML, technical indexing, JSON-LD and site-performance knowledge.
• Evidence of work on live ecommerce pages and measurable search improvement, using redacted data where appropriate.
• Daily practical AI-assisted work with rigorous human verification and a defensible method for tracking AI search visibility.
• Experience with Google Search Console, GA4, Shopify analytics and tools such as Screaming Frog, Ahrefs or Semrush.
• Strong written English, sound commercial judgment and the ability to work independently with international colleagues.
• Based in Shenzhen, available for at least four hours of daily overlap with the Vietnam team (UTC+7), with lawful and company-approved access to required work platforms.

ADVANTAGES

US consumer ecommerce, multistore Shopify operations, direct response marketing, CRO or A/B testing, Google Merchant Center and product feeds, automation using scripts or APIs, and professional Mandarin communication.

WHY THIS ROLE

You will work on live international consumer brands, implement improvements rather than merely recommend them, and have meaningful ownership of search growth and AI-era product discovery. Compensation will be based on experience and demonstrated results.

HOW TO APPLY

Provide your CV;

Two live Shopify ecommerce pages or stores you personally improved and what you changed;

Redacted before-and-after Search Console, analytics or attributable sales evidence;

One dated AI search visibility example showing the query, source or screenshot and your exact contribution (or an honest description of inconclusive results);

A short outline of your AI-assisted research, QA and publishing workflow;

Expected gross monthly salary in CNY;

Earliest start date.

Do not submit private customer information, confidential client credentials or unredacted commercial records.

Shortlisted applicants complete a paid practical assessment using a publicly accessible ecommerce page. We assess technical accuracy, implementation priorities, AI search reasoning, concise English and commercial impact.

Group Head of Project Management Office (PMO) – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Group Head of PMO is responsible for leading and overseeing the Group's project management function across all subsidiaries, business units, and geographical markets within the Insurance & Investments sector.

The role establishes group-wide project governance, portfolio management standards, delivery frameworks, and performance monitoring systems to ensure that strategic projects and transformation initiatives are executed effectively. The position provides centralized oversight of project priorities, budgets, resources, risks, dependencies, and expected business outcomes.

Working closely with the Group CEO, executive leadership, subsidiary CEOs, and business heads, the Group Head of PMO ensures that all major projects support the organization's strategic growth, operational efficiency, digital transformation, and long-term business objectives.

2. Key Responsibilities

Group PMO Strategy & Governance

  • Develop and implement the Group's overall Project Management Office strategy, structure, and operating framework.
  • Establish standardized project management methodologies, governance policies, procedures, and reporting requirements across all subsidiaries.
  • Define project approval processes, stage-gate reviews, escalation procedures, and accountability frameworks.
  • Ensure project portfolios are aligned with the Group's strategic objectives and business priorities.
  • Establish consistent project management standards and controls across geographical markets and business units.

Strategic Project Portfolio Management

  • Oversee the consolidated project portfolio across insurance, investment, corporate, and operational business units.
  • Evaluate, prioritize, and monitor strategic projects based on business value, financial impact, risk exposure, and resource requirements.
  • Monitor project progress, milestones, dependencies, budgets, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Identify underperforming projects and recommend corrective actions or changes in resource allocation.
  • Provide executive leadership with a consolidated view of project portfolio performance.

Insurance & Investment Project Oversight

  • Oversee group-wide projects involving insurance product development, underwriting, claims management, policy administration, and distribution expansion.
  • Monitor investment-related projects involving portfolio reporting, investment operations, wealth management platforms, and client servicing, where applicable.
  • Coordinate strategic initiatives involving regulatory compliance, business process modernization, and operational efficiency.
  • Support the implementation of new financial products, business models, and market expansion initiatives.
  • Ensure projects meet relevant insurance, investment, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.

Digital Transformation & Technology Projects

  • Provide governance and oversight for group-wide technology modernization and digital transformation initiatives.
  • Coordinate implementation of enterprise systems, CRM platforms, automation solutions, AI applications, and digital financial services.
  • Work with CIO, CTO, CDO, and business leadership to ensure successful technology project delivery.
  • Monitor system integration, implementation risks, technology budgets, and business adoption.
  • Ensure digital initiatives deliver measurable improvements in customer experience and operational performance.

Financial & Resource Management

  • Oversee consolidated project budgets, financial forecasts, and expenditure tracking across the Group.
  • Monitor project cost performance and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
  • Coordinate resource allocation across subsidiaries, departments, and strategic initiatives.
  • Evaluate project business cases, cost-benefit analysis, ROI, and expected benefits.
  • Ensure effective utilization of internal teams, external consultants, contractors, and implementation partners.

Risk, Compliance & Quality Management

  • Establish group-level project risk management and escalation frameworks.
  • Monitor operational, financial, regulatory, technology, and implementation risks across project portfolios.
  • Coordinate with group risk, compliance, legal, and internal audit functions.
  • Ensure projects comply with internal policies, governance standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Establish contingency and mitigation plans for critical projects and strategic programs.

Performance Reporting & Benefits Realization

  • Develop group-wide project dashboards, performance reports, and executive presentations.
  • Monitor project delivery against approved scope, budgets, timelines, milestones, and quality standards.
  • Track financial benefits, operational improvements, and ROI from strategic initiatives.
  • Prepare regular portfolio performance reports for the Group CEO, Board, and executive committees.
  • Recommend strategic interventions to improve project execution and delivery performance.

Stakeholder & Subsidiary Management

  • Work closely with subsidiary CEOs, managing directors, business unit heads, project sponsors, and program directors.
  • Facilitate group-level project steering committees and portfolio review meetings.
  • Coordinate project planning and delivery across subsidiaries and corporate functions.
  • Manage relationships with external consultants, technology vendors, contractors, and implementation partners.
  • Ensure consistent communication, accountability, and reporting across all Group entities.

Leadership & PMO Capability Development

  • Lead and develop the Group PMO team, including PMO directors, project managers, project analysts, and project controls specialists.
  • Establish PMO structures, responsibilities, and reporting relationships across subsidiaries.
  • Develop project management training, mentoring, and capability-building initiatives.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, transparency, collaboration, and delivery excellence.
  • Drive continuous improvement in project management maturity across the organization.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Project Management, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • MBA or Master's degree in Project Management, Business Strategy, Finance, or a relevant discipline preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in project management, program management, portfolio management, or enterprise transformation.
  • At least 5 years in a senior PMO leadership position overseeing multiple business units, subsidiaries, or large project portfolios.
  • Experience in insurance, reinsurance, banking, investment management, asset management, wealth management, or diversified financial services.
  • Proven track record of establishing or leading enterprise-level or group-level PMO functions.
  • Strong knowledge of project portfolio governance, financial management, resource planning, risk management, and strategic execution.
  • Experience managing complex, multi-country or multi-entity projects and transformation programs.
  • Knowledge of PMI, PRINCE2, Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid project management methodologies.
  • Strong leadership, executive communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and analytical capabilities.

Preferred Certifications:

- Project Management Professional (PMP).

  • Program Management Professional (PgMP).
  • Portfolio Management Professional (PfMP).

- PRINCE2 Practitioner.

- Agile or Scrum certifications.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Percentage of group-wide projects delivered on time and within approved budgets.
  • Overall project portfolio performance against Group strategic objectives.
  • Project cost variance and schedule variance.
  • Group PMO governance and reporting compliance.
  • Successful delivery of strategic insurance and investment initiatives.
  • Project risk identification, mitigation, and escalation effectiveness.
  • Resource utilization and allocation efficiency across subsidiaries.
  • Benefits realization and ROI of major strategic projects.
  • Accuracy and timeliness of consolidated project reporting.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction across Group entities.
  • Improvement in project management maturity across subsidiaries.
  • Reduction in project delays, cost overruns, and implementation risks.

About Nscale

Nscale is the vertically integrated AI cloud engineered for AI. We own and operate the full stack — energy, data centres, GPU superclusters, orchestration, and AI services — delivering high-performance infrastructure to AI-native companies, enterprises, and governments across Europe and the US. We are deploying GPU capacity at hyperscale, operating some of the densest, most advanced AI infrastructure in the world.

At Nscale, our Deployment team plays a critical role in bringing new AI data center capacity online safely, on schedule, and to spec. We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.

About the Role

We're looking for a Project Manager to deliver low-voltage scopes across Nscale's AI data center deployments. You'll own the day-to-day delivery of assigned projects from kickoff through turnover, managing schedule, budget, vendors, quality, and stakeholder updates. You'll work closely with Senior Project Managers, Low Voltage Deployment Engineers, Construction, Network Infrastructure, and Commissioning to deliver on time, on budget, and to spec.

This is a hands-on delivery role. You'll spend your time running projects, coordinating contractors, resolving issues in the field, and keeping your team and partner groups clearly informed, with support and escalation paths through senior project leadership.

This is a remote role based in the United States, with approximately 30–40% travel for site kickoffs, critical milestones, and field oversight.

Experience required: 4+ years of project management experience, including 2+ years supporting or delivering data center, mission-critical, telecom, or low-voltage construction projects.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Manage the lifecycle of assigned low-voltage projects, including scope confirmation, baseline schedule, budget tracking, execution, and closeout.
  • Build and maintain project schedules, tracking milestones, critical path, dependencies, and look-ahead plans.
  • Track project budgets and forecasts, including cost tracking, change order processing, and invoice validation, escalating variances to senior project leadership.
  • Maintain risk and issue registers, help drive mitigation plans, and raise concerns early when schedule, cost, or quality is at risk.
  • Run one or more concurrent projects with clear ownership and accountability, growing toward a broader multi-site portfolio.
  • Coordinate low-voltage contractors and integrators through scope review, onboarding, mobilization, and daily execution, and support bid leveling as needed.
  • Hold vendors accountable to scope, schedule, safety, workmanship, and documentation requirements, and share field observations on vendor performance and material lead times with Procurement and Supply Chain.
  • Support or lead site kickoffs, walkdowns, and regular coordination meetings with field teams and contractors.
  • Oversee delivery of structured cabling (copper and fiber), high-density fiber and MPO trunking, labeling, and related low-voltage systems, and coordinate with the General Contractor on cable pathways (tray and ladder rack).
  • Manage RFIs, submittals, QA/QC inspections, test and certification results, punch lists, and as-built documentation.
  • Prepare complete, accurate closeout packages for a clean turnover to Commissioning and Operations.
  • Promote a strong safety culture and ensure contractors comply with site safety requirements.
  • Coordinate handoffs and dependencies with Construction, Network Infrastructure, AI Infrastructure Deployment, Engineering, Commissioning, Supply Chain, and Procurement.
  • Run project meetings that turn discussions into clear decisions, owners, and due dates.
  • Work with Low Voltage Deployment Engineers to align plans with design intent and field realities.
  • Provide clear, accurate weekly reporting on project status, milestones, cost, risks, and decisions using the team's standard tools and KPIs, keeping Jira and team trackers current and reliable.
  • Capture lessons learned and suggest improvements to templates, processes, and tooling as the organization scales.

About You

  • Experience. 4+ years of project management experience, including 2+ years supporting or delivering data center, mission-critical, telecom, or low-voltage construction projects.
  • Delivery ownership. Hands-on experience managing project schedules, budgets, change orders, and subcontractor performance. You take accountability for your projects and see them through to closeout.
  • Low-voltage knowledge. Working knowledge of structured cabling and fiber systems, including installation, testing, and certification practices.
  • Technical fluency. Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, and scopes of work.
  • Tools. Experience with scheduling and project tools such as Smartsheet, MS Project, or Primavera P6, plus Jira or similar tracking tools.
  • Field-ready problem solving. You're comfortable on site and work through problems quickly with contractors and field teams.
  • Organization and judgment. You keep plans, budgets, and documentation accurate as conditions change, and you know when to make a call and when to escalate.
  • Communication. You give concise, honest updates to field teams, engineers, vendors, and leadership, and you raise risks before they become surprises.
  • Collaboration. You build trust with engineers, construction leads, vendors, and partner teams.
  • Growth mindset. You're eager to learn from senior project leaders and take on larger, more complex scopes over time.

Nice to Have

  • Experience on hyperscale, cloud, HPC, or AI infrastructure deployments.
  • BICSI certification (e.g., Installer, Technician, or RCDD) and familiarity with TIA-568 and TIA-942 standards.
  • Experience working on projects across multiple sites or regions.

Why This Role Matters

Every GPU cluster Nscale brings online depends on the low-voltage infrastructure underneath it. In this role, you'll directly contribute to how quickly and reliably we deliver AI capacity to our customers, while building the experience and relationships to grow with our deployment program across sites and regions.

What We Can Offer You

At Nscale, you'll find a collaborative, supportive, and innovative environment where your contributions spark real impact. We're building something extraordinary, and we want you at the core.

  • Highly competitive package, including base salary and equity, with reviews every 12 months.
  • Join one of the fastest-growing tech startups: your chance to push boundaries, collaborate with brilliant minds, and make your mark on cutting-edge AI.
  • Expect a dynamic progression plan tailored to your ambitions, including a clear path toward Senior Project Manager. Grow by trying new things, leading, challenging the status quo, and owning your impact, always with our full support.
  • Human-first flexibility. We treat you as humans first. Our flexible workplace trusts Nscalers to deliver, giving you the autonomy to shape your day around life's moments.
  • Join our thriving remote-first team. Geography is no barrier to impact or connection. We build seamless virtual collaboration, empowering you wherever you work.

Equal Opportunities Statement

At Nscale, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enrich our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

jobs.description:
Why is Health Advocate a great place to work? For starters, Health Advocate employees enjoy helping people every single day. Employees are given the training they need to do their jobs well, and they work with supervisors and staff who are supportive and friendly. Employees have room to grow, and many of Health Advocate's supervisors are promoted from within the company. Join our award winning team!

2025:

As part of Teleperformance in the US, we were also named #95 in the 2024 ‘Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For®’ in the USA by Great Places to Work (GPTW®)

Your Mission: What Success Looks Like


Your primary accountability and Personal Health Advocate, Registered Nurse is to deliver high-quality, member-centered clinical advocacy while meeting service, quality, and case management standards.


Success in this role includes consistently achieving:


🔹 Member Advocacy & Clinical Guidance

  • Receive inbound member calls related to a wide range of healthcare issues (e.g., infertility, chronic disease, medications, diagnoses)
  • Assess needs and determine the best course of action while adhering to established policies, procedures, and performance indicators (KPIs)
  • Take ownership of member cases by going beyond the initial request and encouraging continued engagement

🔹 Education, Trust & Relationship-Building

  • Educate members on their medical conditions, diagnostic testing, test results, and available treatment options
  • Explain complex medical and benefit-related information clearly and compassionately
  • Build trusted relationships that empower members to actively participate in their healthcare decisions

🔹 Care Coordination & System Navigation

  • Provide members with options for healthcare providers and services based on clinical needs, geographic location, and benefit coverage
  • Research providers through credentialing, education verification, and affiliations with recognized medical centers
  • Facilitate communication between members, treating physicians, and insurance carriers
  • Assist with scheduling and re-scheduling appointments, transferring medical records, resolving access issues, and clarifying benefit provisions
  • Intercede on behalf of members to obtain earlier appointments or remove barriers to care
  • Support members with prescriptions, pre-service fee negotiations, and authorization-related challenges

🔹 Case Management, Documentation & Follow-Up

  • Maintain accurate, timely documentation using approved case management systems and procedures
  • Place outbound follow-up calls when issues cannot be resolved during the initial interaction
  • Respond to delegate box, answer service, and after-hours calls as required
  • Escalate cases appropriately and on a timely basis to supervisors or internal clinical resources

🔹 Professional Growth & Team Contribution

  • Stay current on patient care procedures, diagnoses, authorizations, denials, and evolving healthcare practices
  • Mentor and support new team members as needed
  • Collaborate with colleagues to maintain service excellence and balanced workflows

Who You Are: The Leader We’re Looking For

You are an experienced nurse who brings clinical judgment, composure, and accountability to every interaction.

You naturally demonstrate:

  • Ownership and follow-through
    You take responsibility for member outcomes and see cases through with care and precision.
  • Empathy grounded in professionalism
    You listen deeply and respond with compassion while maintaining clarity, confidence, and appropriate boundaries.
  • Strong critical thinking
    You quickly synthesize clinical information, prioritize what matters, and determine effective next steps.
  • Clear and confident communication
    You explain complex medical and insurance concepts in a way members can understand and trust.
  • A commitment to quality and results
    You are motivated by accuracy, meaningful resolution, and delivering an exceptional member experience.
  • Curiosity and continuous learning
    You stay current on healthcare trends, systems, and procedures to provide thoughtful, informed guidance.

Who Will Thrive in This Role

You will thrive in this role if you are comfortable balancing compassionate member conversations with a fast-paced, high-volume phone environment. This is a strong fit for someone who can stay organized, document thoroughly and in real time, follow cases through to resolution, and maintain a calm, professional presence while managing multiple member needs throughout the day.


Minimum Qualifications

Education

  • BSN or RN degree from an accredited college or university (required)

Licensure

  • Active and unrestricted State or Multi-State Registered Nurse license (required)

Experience

  • Minimum 3–5 years of clinical and/or medical management experience

Behavioral and/or mental health experience is strongly preferred, especially experience supporting members through sensitive, complex, or emotionally charged healthcare situations.


Core Skills

  • Strong understanding of medical terminology and healthcare systems
  • Excellent verbal communication skills and professional phone presence
  • Ability to explain complex healthcare topics to diverse populations
  • Highly effective listening, problem-solving, and issue-resolution skills
  • Strong organizational and administrative abilities
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word and Excel
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, remote team environment

Team Interface & Customer Service

  • Establish and maintain professional relationships with internal and external customers
  • Collaborate with team members to meet departmental goals
  • Deliver customer service that consistently exceeds expectations
  • Treat all individuals with dignity, respect, and professionalism
  • Escalate workflow or communication issues to leadership as appropriate


Mental and Physical Requirements

This position is fully remote and requires a dedicated, HIPAA-compliant workspace with reliable internet access.

The nature of the work is sedentary, involving prolonged sitting and continuous computer and phone use. Essential functions include repetitive motion, typing, concentration, reading, and ongoing verbal and written communication throughout the workday.


Related Duties as Assigned

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be a comprehensive list of all activities, duties, or responsibilities.

Job incumbents may be asked to perform other duties as required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions outlined above.

Please contact your local Employee Relations representative to request a review of accommodations.


Why Health Advocate?

Because here, nursing expertise drives impact.

You’ll join an organization that values structure, autonomy, accountability, and compassion — where your clinical judgment directly improves the lives of the members you serve.


Company Overview

Health Advocate is the nation’s leading provider of health advocacy, navigation, well-being and integrated benefits programs. For 20 years, Health Advocate has provided expert support to help our members navigate the complexities of healthcare and achieve the best possible health and well-being. Our solutions leverage a unique combination of best-in-class, personalized support with powerful predictive data analytics and a proprietary technology platform to address nearly every clinical, administrative, wellness or behavioral health need. Whether facing common issues or an unprecedented challenge like COVID-19, our team of highly trained, compassionate experts work together to go above and beyond expectations, making healthcare easier for our members and ensuring they get the care they need.

Passion: We love what we do. Our energy inspires, engages, and motivates others.

Whether you knew us in the 80’s as Physician Detailing Inc., or in the 00’s as part of Publicis Health , the companies that came together in 2019 to form Amplity have delivered contract medical, commercial + communications excellence for 40+ years.

Our people-driven, tech-enabled DNA fuels everything we do. Our professionals understand the pharmaceutical industry from the inside out. With a deep grasp on product lifecycles, marketing hurdles, operational nuances + the complex needs of providers and patients, we help our clients launch products + operate smoothly with precision — across all business shapes, sizes + specialties.

We are on a mission to improve patient outcomes through executional excellence — enabling our partners in pharma to thrive in turn. At Amplity, we are allies in excellence. And we do it quicker, better, nicer than anyone else.
