Chief Project Officer (CPO) – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Chief Project Officer (CPO) is responsible for leading the organization's strategic project portfolio, enterprise-wide program management, and major transformation initiatives across its insurance and investment businesses.

The role ensures that strategic projects are properly planned, prioritized, funded, executed, and delivered in alignment with organizational goals. The CPO will oversee complex projects involving insurance operations, investment services, digital transformation, regulatory compliance, business expansion, mergers and acquisitions, and operational improvement.

Working closely with the CEO, Board, and senior management team, the CPO will establish effective project governance, optimize resources, manage delivery risks, and ensure measurable business outcomes from the organization's project investments.

2. Key Responsibilities

Strategic Project & Portfolio Management

  • Develop and execute the organization's enterprise-wide project management and portfolio strategy.
  • Identify, assess, prioritize, and oversee strategic projects across insurance and investment business units.
  • Ensure project portfolios align with corporate strategy, growth objectives, and operational priorities.
  • Evaluate project feasibility, business cases, resource requirements, expected returns, and implementation risks.
  • Monitor portfolio performance and ensure projects deliver their intended strategic and financial benefits.

Insurance & Investment Project Delivery

  • Lead strategic initiatives involving life insurance, general insurance, reinsurance, investment management, wealth management, and financial services.
  • Oversee projects involving new insurance product launches, policy administration systems, claims management, underwriting processes, and distribution expansion.
  • Manage investment-related initiatives involving portfolio management systems, investment operations, client reporting, and service delivery, where applicable.
  • Coordinate projects involving regulatory changes, business process modernization, and operational restructuring.
  • Support the implementation of new business models, financial products, and market expansion initiatives.

Project Governance & PMO Leadership

  • Establish and oversee the Project Management Office (PMO), including project standards, methodologies, policies, and governance frameworks.
  • Implement project approval processes, stage-gate reviews, reporting structures, and escalation procedures.
  • Ensure consistent project management practices across business units and subsidiaries.
  • Monitor project scope, timelines, budgets, deliverables, and quality standards.
  • Present portfolio performance reports, major risks, and project recommendations to executive leadership and the Board.

Digital Transformation & Technology Projects

  • Lead strategic technology implementation and digital transformation projects across the organization.
  • Oversee projects involving insurance technology (InsurTech), financial technology (FinTech), automation, AI, cloud platforms, CRM, and enterprise systems.
  • Coordinate implementation of digital insurance platforms, customer portals, mobile applications, and investment service platforms.
  • Work with CIO, CTO, and CDO teams to ensure technology projects meet business requirements.
  • Monitor technology implementation costs, timelines, system integration, and business adoption.

Financial & Resource Management

  • Develop and manage project portfolio budgets and investment plans.
  • Monitor expenditure, cost variations, financial performance, and project profitability.
  • Optimize resource allocation across projects, departments, and business units.
  • Evaluate project return on investment (ROI), cost-benefit analysis, and benefits realization.
  • Manage external consultants, contractors, technology vendors, and implementation partners.

Risk, Compliance & Quality Management

  • Identify and manage project-related operational, financial, regulatory, and technology risks.
  • Ensure projects comply with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.
  • Coordinate with risk management, legal, compliance, and internal audit teams.
  • Establish risk mitigation, contingency, and business continuity plans for critical projects.
  • Ensure project deliverables meet quality standards and organizational requirements.

Business Transformation & Strategic Initiatives

  • Lead cross-functional transformation programs aimed at improving operational efficiency and business performance.
  • Support organizational restructuring, mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures, and post-merger integration projects.
  • Coordinate strategic initiatives involving geographic expansion, new market entry, and business diversification.
  • Drive process improvement, automation, and cost optimization initiatives.
  • Track business benefits and ensure successful adoption of project outcomes.

Stakeholder & Executive Management

  • Collaborate with the CEO, Board, executive leadership, and business unit heads to establish project priorities.
  • Maintain effective communication with internal stakeholders, regulators, investors, consultants, and external partners, as appropriate.
  • Resolve project conflicts involving scope, budgets, timelines, and resource allocation.
  • Provide executive-level updates on project performance, delivery challenges, and strategic recommendations.
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders to ensure successful project execution.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead project directors, program managers, project managers, and PMO professionals.
  • Develop high-performing project delivery teams across multiple business units.
  • Establish accountability, performance standards, and professional development programs.
  • Promote a culture of project ownership, collaboration, innovation, and delivery excellence.
  • Introduce project management tools, dashboards, and performance measurement systems.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Project Management, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • MBA or Master's degree in Project Management, Finance, Business Strategy, or a relevant discipline preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in project management, program management, portfolio management, or enterprise transformation.
  • At least 5 years in a senior executive or leadership position overseeing complex project portfolios and strategic programs.
  • Experience in insurance, reinsurance, banking, investment management, asset management, wealth management, or financial services preferred.
  • Proven track record of delivering large-scale, multi-departmental projects within approved budgets and timelines.
  • Strong understanding of insurance operations, investment services, financial products, and regulated business environments.
  • Experience establishing and managing enterprise PMOs and project governance frameworks.
  • Knowledge of Agile, Waterfall, PRINCE2, PMI, and other project delivery methodologies.
  • Strong financial planning, budgeting, risk management, and resource allocation capabilities.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Certifications:

- Project Management Professional (PMP).

  • Program Management Professional (PgMP).
  • Portfolio Management Professional (PfMP).

- PRINCE2 Practitioner.

- Agile or Scrum certifications.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Percentage of strategic projects delivered on time and within budget.
  • Overall project portfolio performance and strategic alignment.
  • Project cost variance and schedule variance.
  • Achievement of project milestones and approved deliverables.
  • Return on investment (ROI) and realization of expected business benefits.

  • Project risk mitigation and issue resolution effectiveness.
  • PMO governance and reporting compliance.
  • Resource utilization and project team productivity.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and project quality ratings.
  • Reduction in project delays, cost overruns, and implementation risks.
  • Successful execution of digital transformation and business expansion projects.

jobs.description:
Chief Project Officer (CPO) – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Chief Project Officer (CPO) is responsible for leading the organization's strategic project portfolio, enterprise-wide program management, and major transformation initiatives across its insurance and investment businesses.

The role ensures that strategic projects are properly planned, prioritized, funded, executed, and delivered in alignment with organizational goals. The CPO will oversee complex projects involving insurance operations, investment services, digital transformation, regulatory compliance, business expansion, mergers and acquisitions, and operational improvement.

Working closely with the CEO, Board, and senior management team, the CPO will establish effective project governance, optimize resources, manage delivery risks, and ensure measurable business outcomes from the organization's project investments.

2. Key Responsibilities

Strategic Project & Portfolio Management

  • Develop and execute the organization's enterprise-wide project management and portfolio strategy.
  • Identify, assess, prioritize, and oversee strategic projects across insurance and investment business units.
  • Ensure project portfolios align with corporate strategy, growth objectives, and operational priorities.
  • Evaluate project feasibility, business cases, resource requirements, expected returns, and implementation risks.
  • Monitor portfolio performance and ensure projects deliver their intended strategic and financial benefits.

Insurance & Investment Project Delivery

  • Lead strategic initiatives involving life insurance, general insurance, reinsurance, investment management, wealth management, and financial services.
  • Oversee projects involving new insurance product launches, policy administration systems, claims management, underwriting processes, and distribution expansion.
  • Manage investment-related initiatives involving portfolio management systems, investment operations, client reporting, and service delivery, where applicable.
  • Coordinate projects involving regulatory changes, business process modernization, and operational restructuring.
  • Support the implementation of new business models, financial products, and market expansion initiatives.

Project Governance & PMO Leadership

  • Establish and oversee the Project Management Office (PMO), including project standards, methodologies, policies, and governance frameworks.
  • Implement project approval processes, stage-gate reviews, reporting structures, and escalation procedures.
  • Ensure consistent project management practices across business units and subsidiaries.
  • Monitor project scope, timelines, budgets, deliverables, and quality standards.
  • Present portfolio performance reports, major risks, and project recommendations to executive leadership and the Board.

Digital Transformation & Technology Projects

  • Lead strategic technology implementation and digital transformation projects across the organization.
  • Oversee projects involving insurance technology (InsurTech), financial technology (FinTech), automation, AI, cloud platforms, CRM, and enterprise systems.
  • Coordinate implementation of digital insurance platforms, customer portals, mobile applications, and investment service platforms.
  • Work with CIO, CTO, and CDO teams to ensure technology projects meet business requirements.
  • Monitor technology implementation costs, timelines, system integration, and business adoption.

Financial & Resource Management

  • Develop and manage project portfolio budgets and investment plans.
  • Monitor expenditure, cost variations, financial performance, and project profitability.
  • Optimize resource allocation across projects, departments, and business units.
  • Evaluate project return on investment (ROI), cost-benefit analysis, and benefits realization.
  • Manage external consultants, contractors, technology vendors, and implementation partners.

Risk, Compliance & Quality Management

  • Identify and manage project-related operational, financial, regulatory, and technology risks.
  • Ensure projects comply with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.
  • Coordinate with risk management, legal, compliance, and internal audit teams.
  • Establish risk mitigation, contingency, and business continuity plans for critical projects.
  • Ensure project deliverables meet quality standards and organizational requirements.

Business Transformation & Strategic Initiatives

  • Lead cross-functional transformation programs aimed at improving operational efficiency and business performance.
  • Support organizational restructuring, mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures, and post-merger integration projects.
  • Coordinate strategic initiatives involving geographic expansion, new market entry, and business diversification.
  • Drive process improvement, automation, and cost optimization initiatives.
  • Track business benefits and ensure successful adoption of project outcomes.

Stakeholder & Executive Management

  • Collaborate with the CEO, Board, executive leadership, and business unit heads to establish project priorities.
  • Maintain effective communication with internal stakeholders, regulators, investors, consultants, and external partners, as appropriate.
  • Resolve project conflicts involving scope, budgets, timelines, and resource allocation.
  • Provide executive-level updates on project performance, delivery challenges, and strategic recommendations.
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders to ensure successful project execution.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead project directors, program managers, project managers, and PMO professionals.
  • Develop high-performing project delivery teams across multiple business units.
  • Establish accountability, performance standards, and professional development programs.
  • Promote a culture of project ownership, collaboration, innovation, and delivery excellence.
  • Introduce project management tools, dashboards, and performance measurement systems.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Project Management, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • MBA or Master's degree in Project Management, Finance, Business Strategy, or a relevant discipline preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in project management, program management, portfolio management, or enterprise transformation.
  • At least 5 years in a senior executive or leadership position overseeing complex project portfolios and strategic programs.
  • Experience in insurance, reinsurance, banking, investment management, asset management, wealth management, or financial services preferred.
  • Proven track record of delivering large-scale, multi-departmental projects within approved budgets and timelines.
  • Strong understanding of insurance operations, investment services, financial products, and regulated business environments.
  • Experience establishing and managing enterprise PMOs and project governance frameworks.
  • Knowledge of Agile, Waterfall, PRINCE2, PMI, and other project delivery methodologies.
  • Strong financial planning, budgeting, risk management, and resource allocation capabilities.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Certifications:

- Project Management Professional (PMP).

  • Program Management Professional (PgMP).
  • Portfolio Management Professional (PfMP).

- PRINCE2 Practitioner.

- Agile or Scrum certifications.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Percentage of strategic projects delivered on time and within budget.
  • Overall project portfolio performance and strategic alignment.
  • Project cost variance and schedule variance.
  • Achievement of project milestones and approved deliverables.
  • Return on investment (ROI) and realization of expected business benefits.
  • Successful delivery of insurance and investment transformation initiatives.
  • Project risk mitigation and issue resolution effectiveness.
  • PMO governance and reporting compliance.
  • Resource utilization and project team productivity.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and project quality ratings.
  • Reduction in project delays, cost overruns, and implementation risks.
  • Successful execution of digital transformation and business expansion projects.

Job Description: Director of PMO – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Director of Project Management Office (PMO) is responsible for establishing, leading, and managing the organization's Project Management Office to ensure effective governance, planning, execution, monitoring, and delivery of strategic and operational projects.

The role oversees the project portfolio across insurance, investment, corporate operations, technology, digital transformation, and business development functions. The Director of PMO ensures projects are delivered within approved timelines, budgets, quality standards, and organizational objectives while maintaining effective risk management, resource allocation, and stakeholder engagement.

The successful candidate will drive project management excellence, strengthen governance frameworks, improve delivery performance, and ensure that project outcomes contribute to business growth, operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and customer experience.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. PMO Strategy, Leadership & Governance

  • Establish, develop, and lead the organization's Project Management Office.
  • Define PMO strategy, policies, methodologies, standards, and governance frameworks.
  • Implement standardized project management processes, tools, templates, and reporting structures.
  • Establish project approval processes, stage gates, escalation procedures, and accountability frameworks.
  • Promote project management best practices across departments and business units.
  • Ensure alignment between project execution and corporate strategy.

B. Project Portfolio Management

  • Oversee the organization's project portfolio, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities.
  • Evaluate project proposals, business cases, feasibility studies, and investment requirements.
  • Prioritize projects based on business value, financial impact, risk, and resource availability.
  • Monitor project dependencies, interdepartmental coordination, and portfolio-level risks.
  • Provide recommendations to senior management regarding project prioritization and resource allocation.
  • Track portfolio performance and ensure delivery of expected business benefits.

C. Project Planning & Execution

  • Oversee the planning, scheduling, budgeting, and execution of strategic projects.
  • Ensure project managers develop comprehensive project plans, milestones, deliverables, and resource requirements.
  • Monitor project progress and identify delays, delivery challenges, and performance gaps.
  • Drive corrective actions and escalation processes to maintain project delivery commitments.
  • Ensure projects are completed within approved scope, budget, timelines, and quality standards.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure smooth project implementation.

D. Insurance & Investment Project Oversight

  • Oversee projects related to insurance operations, underwriting, claims management, policy administration, and distribution.
  • Coordinate initiatives involving investment operations, financial products, portfolio reporting, and client services, where applicable.
  • Support the implementation of regulatory, compliance, risk management, and internal control initiatives.
  • Monitor projects involving new product development, market expansion, operational improvements, and business integration.
  • Ensure project deliverables reflect the operational and regulatory requirements of the insurance and financial services industry.

E. Digital Transformation & Technology Projects

  • Oversee technology-enabled transformation projects, including core insurance systems, CRM, ERP, digital platforms, and automation initiatives.
  • Coordinate with IT, technology, operations, and business teams to ensure successful implementation.
  • Monitor technology project budgets, vendor performance, implementation timelines, and delivery quality.
  • Support digitalization, process automation, data management, and operational efficiency initiatives.
  • Ensure technology projects deliver measurable business outcomes.

F. Financial & Resource Management

  • Develop and monitor project budgets, financial forecasts, and expenditure reports.
  • Ensure effective allocation and utilization of project resources.
  • Monitor project costs, financial variances, and budget performance.
  • Evaluate project financial risks and recommend cost-control measures.
  • Coordinate with Finance and Procurement teams on project funding, contracts, and vendor payments.
  • Assess project return on investment (ROI) and benefits realization.

G. Risk Management, Compliance & Quality Assurance

  • Establish project risk management frameworks and escalation mechanisms.
  • Identify, assess, and monitor project risks, issues, dependencies, and delivery constraints.
  • Ensure projects comply with applicable regulatory requirements, internal policies, and governance standards.
  • Monitor project quality and ensure deliverables meet agreed specifications.
  • Maintain project documentation, audit trails, and management records.
  • Coordinate with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Internal Audit teams.

H. Performance Monitoring & Executive Reporting

  • Develop project dashboards, management reports, and portfolio performance metrics.
  • Present project status, risks, budget performance, and delivery updates to executive leadership.
  • Provide timely visibility into project delays, resource constraints, and critical dependencies.
  • Monitor project KPIs and ensure accountability among project managers.
  • Lead project review meetings and portfolio governance sessions.
  • Recommend improvements to project delivery processes and organizational performance.

I. Stakeholder & Team Management

  • Lead and develop project managers, PMO analysts, and project support professionals.
  • Build strong working relationships with senior executives, department heads, project sponsors, and external vendors.
  • Facilitate communication and coordination across business units and functional teams.
  • Develop project management capabilities through training, coaching, and performance management.
  • Promote a culture of ownership, collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

Educational Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Finance, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Master's degree in Business Administration (MBA), Project Management, Finance, or a relevant discipline is preferred.

Professional Experience

  • Minimum 10–15 years of progressive professional experience in project management, program management, or portfolio management.
  • At least 5 years in a senior PMO leadership or Director-level position.
  • Proven experience establishing, managing, or transforming a Project Management Office.
  • Experience overseeing complex, enterprise-wide projects and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Background in insurance, banking, financial services, investment management, or related industries is highly desirable.
  • Experience managing large project portfolios, budgets, resources, and multiple project teams.
  • Exposure to digital transformation, technology implementation, business process improvement, and organizational change initiatives.

Preferred Certifications

- Project Management Professional (PMP).

- PRINCE2 Practitioner.

- Managing Successful Programmes (MSP).

  • Portfolio Management Professional (PfMP).

- Agile or Scrum certifications.

- Lean Six Sigma certification.

Core Competencies

  • Strategic project and portfolio management.
  • PMO governance and operational leadership.
  • Financial planning and budget management.

- Risk assessment and problem-solving.

  • Executive communication and stakeholder management.
  • Change management and business transformation.
  • Leadership, team development, and decision-making.
  • Project management systems and reporting tools.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Percentage of projects delivered on time and within approved budgets.
  • Overall project portfolio performance and delivery success rate.

- Project cost and schedule variance.

  • Achievement of project milestones and strategic objectives.

- Project benefits realization and ROI.

  • Effectiveness of project governance and reporting.
  • Project risk identification, mitigation, and resolution.
  • Resource utilization and allocation efficiency.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and project sponsor feedback.
  • PMO process maturity and continuous improvement.
  • Compliance with project management standards and regulatory requirements.

Mechanical Commissioning Engineer: Perform and manage commissioning procedures for mechanical systems, including moderately complex systems and data centers and other mission critical facilities. Manage and lead commissioning projects, as well as other commissioning engineers would be a plus. Be self-motivated and proactive on projects with limited supervision. Position is very mentally demanding and requires candidate to be self- aware.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Perform all aspects of commissioning for building mechanical systems, including HVAC, hydronic, steam, plumbing, heat rejection, energy recovery, building automation systems (BAS), central plant equipment, and other related mechanical infrastructure systems.

  • Review mechanical and controls submittals for compliance with design intent and commissioning requirements.
  • Develop commissioning plans, specifications, forms, checklists, and project documentation.
  • Interpret and apply contract documents, including drawings, specifications, sequences of operation, and control narratives.
  • Develop pre-functional, functional performance, and integrated systems testing procedures and scripts.
  • Execute commissioning tests and verify system performance in accordance with project requirements.
  • Identify, track, coordinate, and report commissioning issues through resolution.
  • Prepare and assemble commissioning reports, system readiness documentation, and final project deliverables.
  • Conduct site observations and inspections to verify proper installation, startup, and operation of mechanical systems.
  • Work safely and effectively in active construction environments while maintaining compliance with company and site safety requirements.
  • Collaborate with owners, design consultants, contractors, vendors, and operations personnel throughout all phases of the commissioning process.
  • Serve as the commissioning lead on small to moderately sized projects, with responsibility for planning, coordination, communication, and execution.
  • Monitor project schedules and commissioning milestones to help ensure timely project delivery.
  • Provide regular project updates and maintain clear communication with clients and project stakeholders.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships through responsive service and technical excellence.
  • Assist with project management activities, including scope management, resource planning, budgeting, scheduling, and proposal support.
  • Support business development efforts by identifying opportunities for additional commissioning and related professional services.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Graduate Bachelor Engineer (BSME or BSAE).

-OR-

  • Graduate of applicable Commissioning Technical Training and two years minimum same or similar work experience.
  • At least (5) commissioning projects including Design, Construction, and Acceptance phase processes.

-OR-

  • High school education or equivalent and five years minimum same or similar work experience.
  • At least (8) commissioning projects including Design, Construction, and Acceptance phase processes.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of industry commissioning standards and best practices, including ASHRAE Guideline 0, ASHRAE Standard 202, and related commissioning processes; commissioning certification (BCxP, CxA, CxM, ACG CCP, or equivalent) is preferred.
  • Familiarity with LEED®, sustainable design principles, and green building certification processes; LEED Accredited Professional (LEED AP) credential is preferred.
  • Strong technical knowledge of building mechanical systems and their operation, including HVAC, chilled water, heating water, hydronic, steam, plumbing, glycol, heat rejection, air distribution, central plant, energy recovery, and building automation systems (BAS), with the ability to apply commissioning principles throughout all phases of project delivery.
  • Experience with the operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and optimization of mechanical equipment and building systems.
  • Ability to independently plan, organize, schedule, and execute commissioning activities for medium- to large-scale projects and programs.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver projects on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with client expectations and quality standards.

About Us

Quartermaster is building the most comprehensive real-time picture of activity on the world's oceans. We do it by placing next-generation sensing equipment aboard commercial ships and turning the global fleet itself into a living network that illuminates the maritime domain in ways legacy AIS never could. Better maritime domain awareness means safer mariners, more secure sea lanes, and an ocean that can no longer go dark. Every vessel we bring onto the network extends that picture a little further.

The network only exists if ships join it. This role owns that mission end-to-end: enlisting the right vessels across priority ship types and regions. You will find target fleets, win over owners, close agreements, and shepherd the relationships that keep them contributing to the network long term.

This role sits at the foundation of how we scale. Rather than stepping into a rigid playbook, you will actively participate in designing and refining our acquisition workflow from day one. You’ll work with the team to evolve our early outreach into an efficient, repeatable engine that brings hundreds and thousands of vessels onto the network.

What You'll Build:

  • Engineer vessel recruitment from initial discovery to qualification, contract close, and long-term retention into a repeatable, data-driven operational funnel.

  • Synchronize supply acquisition with Quartermaster’s broader growth targets and regional maritime coverage demands so deployment teams are never bottlenecked by vessel availability.

  • Determine headcount needs by ship type, geography, and stage of acquisition; hire, mentor, and level up acquisition specialists and field leads as the company expands.

  • Cultivate deep subject matter expertise across key maritime segments (e.g., container, bulk, tankers, specialized craft) within the team to eliminate coverage blind spots.

  • Lead from the front by closing high-priority partner fleets yourself, while developing standard operating procedures and training your team to hit sustained targets.

Responsibilities:

  • Target & Close High-Value Fleets: Work from prioritized lists of critical vessel types, initiate direct outreach to shipowners, operators, and technical managers, and close commercial partnerships.

  • Own Partner Relationships: Serve as a trusted advisor to maritime executives, technical managers, and port agents globally to ensure high alignment and fast contract turnaround.

  • Maintain Buffer Capacity: Keep a healthy surplus of qualified, signed vessels in reserve across key maritime hubs so installation teams can deploy without idle time.

  • Operationalize the Funnel: Instrument acquisition metrics, tracking pipeline health, stage velocity, conversion rates, and acquisition costs.

Outcomes You'll Own

  • Fleet Coverage Velocity: Deliver qualified vessels to the network on schedule to meet regional and global coverage mandates.

  • Supply Unit Economics: Manage incentives, connectivity arrangements, and field support costs to preserve network margin.

  • Network Quality: Prioritize mission-critical, high-impact vessel classes over low-utility volume.

  • Operational Repeatability: Establish a documented, hardened acquisition playbook that new team members can run out of the box.

Qualifications

  • 4–7+ years of relevant experience: Demonstrated track record in supply acquisition, operations management, marketplace expansion, or business development—with direct ownership of supply-side rollouts, partner recruitment, or field-based acquisition.

  • Proven 0-to-1 builder: Hands-on experience entering new markets, regions, or segments with no established playbook, standing up supply networks from scratch, and leaving behind repeatable processes that others can execute.

  • Funnel architecture & discipline: Skilled at transforming unstructured, relationship-driven deal-making into a structured, trackable acquisition engine powered by clear milestones, pipeline hygiene, and operational rigor.

  • Team leadership & coaching: Direct experience recruiting, onboarding, and managing frontline acquisition specialists, field teams, or sales reps—holding teams accountable to ambitious performance targets.

  • Metrics-driven & unit economics minded: Rigorous focus on quantitative outcomes; comfortable analyzing funnel conversion, acquisition velocity, cohort retention, and operational cost per partner.

  • Hands-on deal-making: Eager to lead from the front, comfortable handling end-to-end commercial negotiations, contract closing, and long-term account stewardship directly with partners.

Nice to Have

  • Experience scaling supply within a two-sided marketplace or distributed hardware network.

  • Direct familiarity with maritime supply chains, commercial shipping operations, or port-side services.

  • Experience working across international time zones and with cross-cultural commercial partners.

Location & Travel

  • Location: New York City

  • Travel: 25% international and domestic travel to meet with shipowners, fleet managers, and port stakeholders, as well as to stand up acquisition efforts in newly targeted hubs.

Position: Peer Manager

Salary Range: $69,100 - 92,600

Department: H2H Connect Contact Center
Reports to: Assistant Program Director, NYC 988 Services

Vibrant Emotional Health’s groundbreaking solutions have delivered high quality services and support, when, where and how people need it for over 50 years. Through our state-of-the-art technology-enabled services, community wellness programs, and advocacy and education work, we are building a society in which emotional wellness can be a reality for everyone.


Vibrant Emotional Health's Contact Center (Here2Help Connect) is our cutting-edge, multi-channel contact center providing immediate access to care and life-saving support through text, calls, and webchat—24/7/365. H2H Connect operates various hotlines, including New York City's NYC 988 (& Peer Support Warmline), New York State's HOPEline, the Capital Region 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline, among others. H2H Connect continues to grow as new managed care arrangements and new technologies make it possible to reach more people in distress through more channels. The contact center currently provides crisis intervention, peer support and information and referrals to over 40,000 people every month, and we expect this number to continue to grow.


Position Overview:


The Peer Manager provides leadership and operational oversight to Peer Supervisors, ensuring high-quality services that uphold peer support values, professional standards, and organizational expectations. The role promotes a recovery-oriented, person-directed, trauma-informed, and culturally responsive approach that honors lived experience, mutuality, and self-determination. The Peer Manager is accountable for effective team leadership, staff development and well-being, and service performance while maintaining the integrity of nonclinical peer support.

Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Provides ongoing administrative, operational and technical supervision to Peer Supervisors, reviewing application of peer skills, providing coaching where necessary, identifying areas of improvement and making recommendations for remediation.
  • Responsible for managing, assisting and supporting Peer Supervisors and staff during shift.
  • Manages supervisor documentation and communication around Peer Support Specialist performance as well as shift details.
  • Ensures compliance of Peer Supervisor’s biweekly individual supervisions with Peer Support Specialists.
  • Collaborates with Training, Workforce Management (WFM)/Operations, Crisis Services and Quality Improvement departments to ensure superior peer support services.
  • Ensures Peer Supervisors complete interaction monitoring for quality improvement and training purposes.
  • Answers helpline calls as necessary to maintain service levels during call volume surges, staffing shortages, and/or when otherwise needed to maintain service levels.
  • Monitors and tracks peer certification progress of Peer Support Specialists to ensure compliance with funder requirements.
  • Ensures program aligns with Peer Support Core Values and National Peer Support Practice Guidelines for Peer Specialists and Peer Supervisors.
  • Creation of Peer Support training materials and the live, virtual delivery of training sessions.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Active listening skills to establish working alliance with help seekers and Peer Support Specialists.
  • Efficiency with information gathering, problem-solving, and conflict-resolution.
  • Superior communication skills to convey information clearly and concisely.
  • Ability to maintain professional demeanor when handling crises and abusive contacts.
  • Superior supervisory skills, as evidenced by effective time management and multitasking.
  • Ability to work efficiently in a team and independently.

Required Qualifications:

  • Must be a Certified Peer Support Specialist, Certified Recovery Peer Advocate (CRPA) or Certified Recovery Peer Advocate-Family (CRPA-Family) through NYS Office of Mental Health (OMH) and/or NYS Office of Addiction Services and Supports (OASAS).
  • 3+ years of experience as a Peer Specialist/Advocate, and preferably with demonstrated experience coaching, supervising, or leading peer staff, or equivalent leadership experience.
  • Fluency in the English language, both verbal and written.
  • Fluency in Spanish, or another language is a plus.
  • Knowledge of mental health systems in the New York metropolitan area.
  • Crisis intervention and/or mental health information and referral services experience a plus.
  • Copy of peer certification required by date of hire.

Physical Requirements:

  • Stationary Position: Must be able to remain in a stationary position (sitting or standing) for prolonged periods (typically 75% to 100% of the workday).
  • Equipment Interaction: Constantly operates a computer, keyboard, mouse, and other office productivity machinery.
  • Communication: Frequently communicates with internal/external stakeholders and team members via video conferencing, phone, and chat applications; must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.
  • Visual Acuity: Required to visually review digital documents or data on a computer monitor for extended durations.

A complete overview of compensation and benefits will be provided by the Talent Acquisition team during the hiring process.

jobs.excerpt: About us:Jerry. ai is a Series C, YC-backed tech startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding.
jobs.description:
About us:

Jerry.ai is a Series C, YC-backed tech startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding. Founded in 2017, product launched in 2019, and achieved profitability in 2024.

Why we exist:

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

We are building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with your car in 2019, now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat).

Why We’re Hiring

Our Data Science & Analytics team has been a force multiplier and accelerant to our business that has helped us reach these pivotal milestones in spite of headwinds and within a highly competitive market. They are a team of former McKinsey, BCG and Bain consultants who drive data & insights, and inform decision-making across every corner of our business. They are analytical powerhouses and first principles problem solvers who push forward our most important initiatives across product, growth, tech, and operations.

Every business unit has a Data Science team member embedded within it — someone who doesn't just run analyses and build dashboards, but shapes what questions we should ask, what data to pull, what conclusions to draw, what decisions to make, and then drives our teams towards our next goal: go from 5M to 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years.

As our business continues to expand, there is growing demand for more Data Science team members. We are hiring 2-3 people to drive impact in these areas:

  • Growth Marketing

  • Product Development

  • Strategic Partnerships

On leveling: You may see job ads for this role at different job levels. Our priority is finding the right people, we can be flexible with job title/leveling.

Why You Will (Or Won't) Like Working Here

  • No slides: If you've worked in consulting, you know what it feels like to be up at 3am reformatting a deck. That doesn't exist here. The only work that gets done at Jerry is work that will materially change the trajectory of our business — an important product, a new growth channel, a key metric, a critical partner relationship, etc.

  • No corporate fluff: The Data Science & Analytics team is 14 insatiable learners who care deeply about solving difficult problems and making a tangible impact. Every person owns a critical domain. There is no bloat, unnecessary meetings, or waiting for approvals.

  • Hands-on: This is not a pure strategy role, you will also own execution. Your day-to-day will be surfacing analytical insights, driving decisions, and seeing them through end-to-end.

What You'll Own

You'll sit on our central Data Science & Analytics team but you’ll be embedded in one of Jerry's core business areas — growth, product, AI and automation, strategic partnerships — and own the analytical function for that business unit end-to-end.

  • Define the right problems: Before any analysis, understand what business question it's answering and what decision it will inform. Push back if the question is flawed.

  • Data and insights: Define metrics, build reports, run analyses, design experiments, and surface data insights that move your team's key metrics.

  • Drive outcomes: Bring recommendations to your counterparts in product, growth, finance or operations, tell them what's happening and why, and what next steps should be.

Who You Are

  • First principles thinker: You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses before touching data. You're analytically strong (comfortable with SQL or Python) but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?"

  • Direct communicator: You can walk a skeptical stakeholder through a complex finding and get buy-in quickly. You write clearly, speak precisely, and don't bury the lede.

  • Owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane.

What You'll Bring

  • 1+ years of experience at a consulting firm, investment bank, or high-growth technology company.

  • Strong analytical skills; ability to pull, structure, and interpret data independently.

  • Track record of owning ambiguous problems and delivering impact.

  • Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence decisions at the leadership level.

Our Tools

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. Department Overview

The Systems Engineering Group designs and implements innovative communications solutions that make a difference in the day to day operations of our Federal customers. As the Solution Architecture and Technical Consulting Lead, the Systems Engineering Group has end-to-end design, technology consultancy, and implementation responsibility for all pre-sale and post-sale engagements nationwide. The Systems Engineering Group delivers customer-driven, world-class, leading-edge, end-to-end solutions that rise to the challenges of first responder, government, carrier, utility, transportation, and enterprise customers.


Job Description

Note: Candidate must reside be able to travel nationwide to support Federal Customers. This is a remote position requiring travel (25-50%) to customer sites located around the country.

As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will drive the design and implementation of solutions for Motorola’s ASTRO 25 and adjacent technologies for DOD and Federal Government agencies. We are looking for engineers energized by delivering solutions that truly make a difference.


In this role, you will collaborate closely with a multi-disciplinary field team (including Project Managers, Systems Engineers, System Technologists, Construction Managers, and Customer Service Managers) to lead all technical aspects of assigned projects through final system acceptance.

Duties will include, but are not limited to:

  • Design and implementation of the radio network accounting for infrastructure, subscribers, power systems design, equipment shelter and tower layouts, backhaul network design including microwave, leased line, and customer provided Ethernet networks
  • High level of customer and consultant interaction involving customer design reviews, customer witnessed staging and acceptance testing events, coverage acceptance testing, live system upgrades, and troubleshooting efforts.
  • System buildout, configuration and acceptance testing in both lab staging and field environments
  • Radio coverage testing, frequency analysis and interference mitigation
  • Supplying input and participating in radio system licensing (NTIA)
  • Preparation of system fleetmap, encryption schema, and radio programming templates
  • Produce as-built system documentation
  • Develop plans and participate in live system cutovers and upgrades

Desired Skills/Knowledge:

  • Radio Frequency Engineering principles
  • Land / Mobile Radio Engineering principles
  • Wireless & Wireline communications systems
  • RFDS principles to include antenna and cable selection, transmit combiners, receive multi-couplers, and lightning protection systems.
  • P25 Land Mobile Radio terminology and two-way subscriber radio provisioning methods.
  • Experience with Motorola ASTRO 25 architecture is a plus.
  • Construction of remote communication sites to include: site selection, grounding, compound development, tower and shelter requirements.
  • Fortinet and Juniper firewalls, Nokia 7705 series routers, Juniper SRX/MX (Junos) series routers, HP/Aruba and Juniper switches
  • Remote access using SSH, SCP, SFTP, RDP
  • Knowledge with point-to-point Microwave systems, Microwave RF & Network design
  • Software applications integration, Application Protocol Interfaces (API) concepts, computer operating systems, and the OSI model.
  • Networking protocols and devices including OSPF, ISIS, BGP, MPLS, SIP, RTP, SNMP, NAT, routers, switches, and stateful packet firewalls.

Desired Abilities:

  • Create design documents and drawings to provide information to project teams about system construction and configuration (Familiarity with Microsoft, Google, etc. office productivity/drawing software tool packages)
  • Exhibit excellent troubleshooting, critical thinking, and analytical skills with the ability to seek out other internal company expertise when needed.

  • Learn to use company-supplied software systems and tools to model and test radio coverage
  • Learn to use company-supplied software systems and tools to assist engineers and technicians with setup and troubleshooting of RF components and systems.
  • Learn to configure, and troubleshoot applications and operating systems on IP network devices, servers, or on virtualization platforms.
  • Learn to debug new software installations, review log files, and work with development engineers to resolve issues.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's (BS) Degree in Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent + 2 years of relevant experience. OR 6+ Years of Experience in Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent.

Desired Certifications:

  • GROL (General Radiotelephone Operator License), Amateur Radio Operator License, or equivalent experience.
  • CompTIA Network+, Juniper JNCIA-Junos, Nokia NRS1, CCNA or similar.

jobs.description:
About the role

As a Programme Manager at Infinite Lambda, you'll hold accountability for the successful delivery of multi-workstream programmes for our most important clients. You will own the entire programme lifecycle — from commercial handover through to closure — coordinating multiple projects, teams, and delivery streams into a single coherent outcome. You will be a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, including C-level executives, and the person our clients and our own leadership turn to when a programme hits a serious issue and needs a steady, credible hand to resolve it.

You are a critical partner in our client relationships, working closely with Account Managers to protect and grow long-term accounts, and with Executive Sponsors to keep governance sharp and escalations resolved quickly. Beyond delivery, you're expected to translate ambiguous, high-level business strategy into structured requirements and a deliverable roadmap — bringing the same rigour to business analysis as you do to programme governance.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end delivery of multi-workstream programmes spanning multiple projects, vendors, and delivery teams, using Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid approaches tailored to each client and phase.

  • Hold ultimate accountability for programme scope and benefits realisation across the full programme lifecycle.

  • Act as the escalation point for serious programme issues: recover programmes that are off-track, re-baseline commercials and timelines where needed, and manage the client conversations that come with it.

  • Design and enforce programme-level governance models, RAID processes, and reporting standards, ensuring predictable, high-quality execution is visible at every level from delivery team to executive sponsor.

  • Facilitate steering committees, delivering clear, credible updates and recommendations to C-level stakeholders on both the client and Infinite Lambda side.

  • Build and hold relationships with senior client stakeholders and executive sponsors, acting as a trusted voice in high-stakes conversations, difficult trade-offs, and commercial negotiations.

  • Lead business analysis at a programme level: gather and structure high-level business requirements and strategic objectives, and translate them into a coherent programme roadmap, benefits case, and workstream breakdown.

  • Identify and manage cross-workstream dependencies, escalating and closing them out before they threaten delivery.

  • Constructively challenge technical and commercial assumptions across workstreams, guiding recovery plans and trade-off decisions between engineering quality, cost, and delivery speed at a programme level.

  • Own commercial governance for the programme, including Change Control, Change Orders, and milestone sign-off, working closely with Account Managers and Executive Sponsors to protect margin and client trust.

  • Represent Infinite Lambda credibly in the most demanding client conversations — the ones where relationships, not just delivery plans, are on the line.

Requirements

Experience:

  • 7+ years of experience leading complex, multi-workstream programmes, with a strong focus on data warehouse migration and/or AI.

  • Consulting background, ideally within data or technology consultancies.

  • Track record of taking accountability for troubled or at-risk programmes and successfully recovering them — commercially and operationally.

  • Demonstrated business analysis experience at a strategic level — translating executive-level business objectives into structured requirements, benefits cases, and roadmaps.

  • Extensive experience with agile methodologies at programme scale, including managing dependencies and governance across multiple concurrent workstreams.

  • Strong conceptual understanding of software engineering and data delivery principles, sufficient to challenge, guide, and support technical leadership across several workstreams at once.

  • Significant experience in business change as well as IT delivery, at an enterprise or large-account level.

  • Gravitas, credibility, and maturity to engage, influence, and hold difficult conversations with C-level stakeholders on both client and internal sides.

  • Commercial experience: negotiating Change Orders, managing fixed-cost and T&M commercial models, and protecting margin under pressure.

  • Travel requirements for this role are mandated by the need of the client and depending on the client some travel is required.

Skills:

  • Proficiency in a variety of programme and project management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, Trello).

  • Strong business analysis toolkit at programme scale: requirements gathering, benefits mapping, process mapping, and senior stakeholder workshops.

  • Exceptional problem-solving, conflict resolution, and change management skills, particularly under pressure or in adversarial situations.

  • Ability to structure a complex, ambiguous programme into a clear workstream breakdown, dependency map, and governance model.

  • Experience managing multiple concurrent programmes or a large single programme with several parallel workstreams.

  • Familiarity with a range of delivery methodologies and the judgement to select and adapt the right one per workstream.

Mindset:

  • Comfortable holding ultimate accountability, including for issues you didn't personally cause.

  • Calm and decisive under pressure — the person the room looks to when a programme is at risk.

  • Demonstrated ability to orchestrate the big picture across multiple workstreams while still tracking the details that matter.

  • A collaborative and positive approach to people, balanced with the willingness to have difficult conversations early.

  • Willingness to take new directions and adapt to changing priorities at short notice.

Nice to have Skills

  • Working knowledge of SQL and data warehousing concepts.

  • Familiarity with data visualisation tools (e.g. Omni, Sigma, Tableau, PowerBI).

  • Formal programme management certification (e.g. MSP, PMI-PgMP) or equivalent hands-on experience.

  • Proven experience leading data warehousing and analytics programmes, preferably migrations, at enterprise scale.

Soft skills

  • Servant leadership mindset with the ability to manage, motivate, inspire and support Project Managers and delivery teams.

  • Outstanding communication skills, calibrated for C-level and executive audiences.

  • A considerate, curious, positive, naturally collaborative and supportive approach to people, without shying away from hard conversations.

  • Proactivity regarding risk, issues and planning, especially the risks that haven't surfaced yet.

  • Ability to present complex technical and commercial concepts clearly to non-technical, senior audiences.

  • Natural problem-solving attitude, strong facilitation skills, and sound judgement under ambiguity.

  • Proficiency in English.

Interview Process

  1. Introductory call with TABP: 45 minutes

  2. Take-home technical assignment + Technical interview with Head of Program Management: 60 minutes

  3. Cultural chat with CSO, General Manager and Account Manager: 45 minutes

Why join Infinite Lambda

  • We support your growth with dedicated learning time, access to top-notch resources and a knowledge-sharing culture;

  • You work autonomously here in a wholesome environment and get as much paid holiday as you need;

  • The projects are diverse and give you plenty of opportunity to experiment with new tech;

  • The benefits are plenty, with private health insurance, work-from-home budget, a company MacBook and more on the list.

Clarity Pediatrics is reimagining pediatric chronic care, starting with ADHD. Nearly 10% of people in the US are diagnosed with ADHD, and for parents, it can feel impossible to find the right care. Our new clinical model is tech-enabled, backed by the best science, and has the potential to deliver exceptional health outcomes to transform a child’s trajectory. In the future, our pediatric care platform will expand rapidly to other common chronic conditions like asthma, allergies, and obesity.

Our co-founders and leadership team have deep commitment to clinical excellence and domain expertise in healthcare. Our CEO, Christina LaMontagne, has led two startups and earned her MBA at Harvard Business School. Our Chief Medical Officer, Alesandro Larrazabal, MD, trained at UCSF and Stanford. Until recently, he was a Medical Director building specialty care services at Kaiser Permanente. Earlier, he worked at IDEO.

What makes this role unique:

Opportunity to join a multi-disciplinary clinical team dedicated to providing integrated care to patients and families. We aim to give our providers the tools they need to provide excellent care including collaboration with peers, guidance from ADHD experts and researchers, and opportunities to pursue ongoing professional development.

Contribute to the development of a better pediatric healthcare system for patients and providers. Our team is dedicated to setting clinicians up for success, and you’ll be encouraged to help us make improvements to our care models, workflows, and clinical tools in order to make your work easier and more enjoyable.

Focus on your strengths. We appreciate how different clinical backgrounds help us learn from each other and take better care of patients. We encourage our clinicians to develop special areas of interest and expertise to become leaders within the team. We provide ongoing training opportunities to gain new skills as well as stipends for additional learning and development.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide comprehensive clinical services for children and teens with ADHD and their families, with a focus on diagnostic and medication management.

  • Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team that includes MD’s, nurse practitioners, psychologists and other clinicians to provide excellent care.

  • Complete administrative work and clinical documentation in a timely and accurate manner.

  • Contribute to implementation, evaluation and program development iteration to ensure optimal delivery of care.

  • This is a clinical position, but there may be opportunities to expand and grow into program development, and other leadership activities, depending on employee interest and company needs.

Qualifications:

  • Licensed to practice medicine in California

  • Prescribing treatment plans including administering and managing ADHD stimulant medication

  • Board certified in Pediatrics

  • At least 5 years of patient care experience

  • Spanish-speaking

  • Experience working with families from different cultural backgrounds and willingness to receive ongoing training and support in advancing your skills in delivering culturally responsive treatment

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising.

The way consumers discover, evaluate, and choose brands is being rewritten in real time. LLM-powered search, AI agents, and generative experiences are replacing the decade-old playbook of keywords and blue links. Darkroom is building a new AI Marketing division to own this space, and we need an SEO Specialist who can operate at the intersection of traditional organic search and the emerging world of AI-mediated discovery.

As an SEO Specialist within the AI Marketing division, you will manage all aspects of SEO and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) strategy and execution for a portfolio of high-growth consumer brands. This is not a traditional SEO role. You will be responsible for ensuring that Darkroom clients are discoverable, recommended, and cited by both traditional search engines and LLM-powered platforms like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and Gemini.

You will report to the Associate Director of AI Marketing and work closely with content, creative, paid media, and data teams to deliver integrated organic growth strategies. This is a fast-paced, high-accountability environment for someone who is curious about AI, obsessed with search, and ready to help define a category that is still being written.

What You’ll Do

SEO Strategy & Execution

  • Develop and implement comprehensive SEO strategies aligned with client business objectives across e-commerce, DTC, and consumer brands.

  • Conduct keyword research, site audits, and competitor analyses to identify growth opportunities in both traditional and AI-powered search environments.

  • Continuously analyze and report on SEO performance metrics, providing actionable insights and clear recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders.

  • Monitor rankings, organic traffic, and AI citation frequency, adjusting tactics based on performance data.

AI Search & Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)

  • Optimize client content and digital properties for visibility within LLM-powered search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Claude).

  • Develop and execute strategies to increase how often and how favorably client brands are referenced in AI-generated answers and recommendations.

  • Monitor the rapidly shifting landscape of how LLMs source, rank, and cite information, and translate changes into actionable client strategies.

  • Build and maintain frameworks for tracking “AI share of voice” across generative search platforms.

On-Page & Technical SEO

  • Optimize website content, meta tags, structured data, and internal linking structures to improve visibility in both traditional and AI search.

  • Perform technical audits to identify crawl issues, indexation bottlenecks, site performance concerns, and schema markup opportunities.

  • Architect technical SEO, knowledge graphs, and entity-based optimization to maximize machine readability and AI citation potential.

  • Collaborate with development teams to recommend and implement SEO-friendly site structures and code enhancements.

Content Strategy & Off-Page

  • Collaborate with content teams to build strategies that serve dual purposes: ranking in traditional search AND being surfaced by AI systems as authoritative, trustworthy sources.

  • Build and maintain effective link-building campaigns to enhance domain authority and AI discoverability.

  • Identify high-value external partnership opportunities, guest posting placements, and relevant industry directories.

  • Monitor and manage backlink profiles to maintain a strong online reputation.

  • Create and manage content briefs, oversee article creation, and perform QA to ensure premium quality outputs across all content deliverables.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Partner with cross-functional teams (Content, Creative, Paid Media, Marketplaces, Retention) to deliver integrated marketing campaigns.

  • Present complex SEO and GEO insights to clients and stakeholders in clear, accessible language.

  • Support the Associate Director in developing proprietary methodologies, playbooks, and reporting frameworks for AI marketing services.

  • Foster a culture of continuous learning and experimentation, sharing AI search best practices across the broader Darkroom organization.

What You’ll Need

Experience

  • 2–4 years of experience managing SEO strategies for e-commerce, consumer, or digital-first brands.

  • Proven track record in driving organic traffic growth, keyword ranking improvements, and ROI-focused SEO campaigns.

  • Familiarity with SEO and analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, or Moz.

  • Agency experience is a strong plus.

Skills

  • Deep understanding of on-page SEO, link-building, technical SEO, and structured data best practices.

  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate data into actionable insights and client-ready reports.

  • Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, or JavaScript is a plus.

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills, with the ability to present complex ideas clearly.

  • Adaptability to stay ahead of ever-changing search engine algorithms and emerging AI search platforms.

Nice to Have

  • Background in local SEO, multi-location brands, or programmatic SEO.

  • Knowledge of PR and digital authority-building strategies that support LLM trust signals.

  • Experience in e-commerce SEO or product discovery optimization.

What Sets You Apart

  • You’re already experimenting with GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), LLM-SEO, or AI search strategies — even if those terms barely existed a year ago.

  • You understand how ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews decide what to cite, and why that matters for brands.

  • You’re obsessed with AI and LLMs — not just “interested.” You’ve played with the APIs, tested prompts, and you have opinions about structured vs. unstructured content for machine readability.

  • You think about search as a broader ecosystem that includes AI assistants, voice search, agentic browsing, and recommendation engines — not just Google page one.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

Syneos Health® is a leading fully integrated biopharmaceutical solutions organization built to accelerate customer success. We translate unique clinical, medical affairs and commercial insights into outcomes to address modern market realities.

We are agile and driven to accelerate the delivery of therapies, because we are passionate to change lives.

Discover what our 29,000 employees, across 110 countries already know:

WORK HERE MATTERS EVERYWHERE

Why Syneos Health

  • We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
  • We are committed to our Total Self culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Our Total Self culture is what unites us globally, and we are dedicated to taking care of our people.
  • We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because when we bring together diversity of thoughts, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives – we’re able to create a place where everyone feels like they belong.

Job Responsibilities

  • Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management activities and close-out visits (performed on-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practice (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.
  • Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
  • Per the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP): Assesses site processes. Conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records. Verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete. Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines. Utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical study data review and capture. Verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements.
  • May perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
  • Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations.
  • Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.
  • For assigned activities, understands project scope, budgets, and timelines; manages site-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets.
  • May act as primary liaison with study site personnel, or in collaboration with Central Monitoring Associate. Ensures all assigned sites and project-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements
  • Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
  • Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.
  • Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes; completes assigned training as required. For Real World Late Phase, the CRA II will use the business card title of Site Management Associate II. Additional responsibilities include:Site support throughout the study lifecycle from site identification through close-out. Knowledge of local requirements for real world late phase study designs.Chart abstraction activities and data collection
    Collaboration with Sponsor affiliates, medical science liaisons and local country staff. The SMA II may be requested to train junior staff. Identify and communicate out of scope activities to Lead CRA/Project Manager. Proactively suggest potential sites based on local knowledge of treatment patterns, patient advocacy and Health Care Provider (HCP) associations.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace new technologies
  • Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to manage required travel of up to 75% on a regular basis
  • US ONLY: As part of your employment with Syneos Health, you may be deployed to Sites that require certain medical and other personal information to gain facility access. Pursuant to our Employee Privacy Notice, Syneos Health can provide the Sites with the information necessary for you to gain such access. Further, a Site may ask you for additional information beyond that which Syneos Health has in its possession. You are required to comply with any such Site requests as a condition of your employment with Syneos Health. Please note that failure to provide requested information may result in a Site barring you from entry, which could put your ongoing employment at risk.

We are always excited to connect with great talent. This posting is intended for a [possible] upcoming opportunity rather than a live role. By expressing your interest, you'll be added to our talent pipeline and considered should this role become available.


At  Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality-of-life balance. The benefits for this position may include a company car or car allowance, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, Eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and individual performance, and flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos complies with all applicable federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.


Salary Range:

The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Descripción general de la empresa:

BeOne, Ltd. (NASDAQ: ONC; HKEX: 06160) es una empresa de biotecnología global, en fase comercial y basada en la investigación, centrada en terapias contra el cáncer inmuno-oncológicas y con objetivos moleculares específicos. Con un equipo de más de 10.000 empleados en China, Estados Unidos (Cambridge, MA; Ridgefield Park, Nueva Jersey; Emeryville, CA y San Mateo, CA), Suiza, Australia, Brasil y México, BeOne está avanzando en un proyecto que consiste en nuevas moléculas pequeñas orales y anticuerpos monoclonales para el tratamiento del cáncer. BeOne está trabajando para crear soluciones combinadas destinadas a tener un impacto significativo y duradero en los pacientes con cáncer.

Bajo la dirección del Business Unit Manager, esta persona será responsable de maximizar los productos de BeOne en el territorio asignado. Responsable de impulsar e implementar la estrategia comercial considerando las particularidades de cada actor con el objetivo de mejorar el recorrido del paciente y ampliar el acceso, contribuyendo a un sistema de salud sostenible al desbloquear barreras de acceso.

• Desarrollar planes de negocios e implementar actividades relacionadas, como eventos para clientes, campañas de ventas y marketing, así como presentaciones de ventas necesarias para lograr los objetivos acordados.

• Mantener y mejorar el conocimiento del producto, la estrategia del producto, el posicionamiento y los mensajes clave.
