jobs.excerpt: Group Head of Project Management Office (PMO) – Insurance & Investments 1.
jobs.description:
Group Head of Project Management Office (PMO) – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Group Head of PMO is responsible for leading and overseeing the Group's project management function across all subsidiaries, business units, and geographical markets within the Insurance & Investments sector.

The role establishes group-wide project governance, portfolio management standards, delivery frameworks, and performance monitoring systems to ensure that strategic projects and transformation initiatives are executed effectively. The position provides centralized oversight of project priorities, budgets, resources, risks, dependencies, and expected business outcomes.

Working closely with the Group CEO, executive leadership, subsidiary CEOs, and business heads, the Group Head of PMO ensures that all major projects support the organization's strategic growth, operational efficiency, digital transformation, and long-term business objectives.

2. Key Responsibilities

Group PMO Strategy & Governance

  • Develop and implement the Group's overall Project Management Office strategy, structure, and operating framework.
  • Establish standardized project management methodologies, governance policies, procedures, and reporting requirements across all subsidiaries.
  • Define project approval processes, stage-gate reviews, escalation procedures, and accountability frameworks.
  • Ensure project portfolios are aligned with the Group's strategic objectives and business priorities.
  • Establish consistent project management standards and controls across geographical markets and business units.

Strategic Project Portfolio Management

  • Oversee the consolidated project portfolio across insurance, investment, corporate, and operational business units.
  • Evaluate, prioritize, and monitor strategic projects based on business value, financial impact, risk exposure, and resource requirements.
  • Monitor project progress, milestones, dependencies, budgets, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Identify underperforming projects and recommend corrective actions or changes in resource allocation.
  • Provide executive leadership with a consolidated view of project portfolio performance.

Insurance & Investment Project Oversight

  • Oversee group-wide projects involving insurance product development, underwriting, claims management, policy administration, and distribution expansion.
  • Monitor investment-related projects involving portfolio reporting, investment operations, wealth management platforms, and client servicing, where applicable.
  • Coordinate strategic initiatives involving regulatory compliance, business process modernization, and operational efficiency.
  • Support the implementation of new financial products, business models, and market expansion initiatives.
  • Ensure projects meet relevant insurance, investment, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.

Digital Transformation & Technology Projects

  • Provide governance and oversight for group-wide technology modernization and digital transformation initiatives.
  • Coordinate implementation of enterprise systems, CRM platforms, automation solutions, AI applications, and digital financial services.
  • Work with CIO, CTO, CDO, and business leadership to ensure successful technology project delivery.
  • Monitor system integration, implementation risks, technology budgets, and business adoption.
  • Ensure digital initiatives deliver measurable improvements in customer experience and operational performance.

Financial & Resource Management

  • Oversee consolidated project budgets, financial forecasts, and expenditure tracking across the Group.
  • Monitor project cost performance and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
  • Coordinate resource allocation across subsidiaries, departments, and strategic initiatives.
  • Evaluate project business cases, cost-benefit analysis, ROI, and expected benefits.
  • Ensure effective utilization of internal teams, external consultants, contractors, and implementation partners.

Risk, Compliance & Quality Management

  • Establish group-level project risk management and escalation frameworks.
  • Monitor operational, financial, regulatory, technology, and implementation risks across project portfolios.
  • Coordinate with group risk, compliance, legal, and internal audit functions.
  • Ensure projects comply with internal policies, governance standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Establish contingency and mitigation plans for critical projects and strategic programs.

Performance Reporting & Benefits Realization

  • Develop group-wide project dashboards, performance reports, and executive presentations.
  • Monitor project delivery against approved scope, budgets, timelines, milestones, and quality standards.
  • Track financial benefits, operational improvements, and ROI from strategic initiatives.
  • Prepare regular portfolio performance reports for the Group CEO, Board, and executive committees.
  • Recommend strategic interventions to improve project execution and delivery performance.

Stakeholder & Subsidiary Management

  • Work closely with subsidiary CEOs, managing directors, business unit heads, project sponsors, and program directors.
  • Facilitate group-level project steering committees and portfolio review meetings.
  • Coordinate project planning and delivery across subsidiaries and corporate functions.
  • Manage relationships with external consultants, technology vendors, contractors, and implementation partners.
  • Ensure consistent communication, accountability, and reporting across all Group entities.

Leadership & PMO Capability Development

  • Lead and develop the Group PMO team, including PMO directors, project managers, project analysts, and project controls specialists.
  • Establish PMO structures, responsibilities, and reporting relationships across subsidiaries.
  • Develop project management training, mentoring, and capability-building initiatives.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, transparency, collaboration, and delivery excellence.
  • Drive continuous improvement in project management maturity across the organization.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Project Management, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • MBA or Master's degree in Project Management, Business Strategy, Finance, or a relevant discipline preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in project management, program management, portfolio management, or enterprise transformation.
  • At least 5 years in a senior PMO leadership position overseeing multiple business units, subsidiaries, or large project portfolios.
  • Experience in insurance, reinsurance, banking, investment management, asset management, wealth management, or diversified financial services.
  • Proven track record of establishing or leading enterprise-level or group-level PMO functions.
  • Strong knowledge of project portfolio governance, financial management, resource planning, risk management, and strategic execution.
  • Experience managing complex, multi-country or multi-entity projects and transformation programs.
  • Knowledge of PMI, PRINCE2, Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid project management methodologies.
  • Strong leadership, executive communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and analytical capabilities.

Preferred Certifications:

- Project Management Professional (PMP).

  • Program Management Professional (PgMP).
  • Portfolio Management Professional (PfMP).

- PRINCE2 Practitioner.

- Agile or Scrum certifications.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Percentage of group-wide projects delivered on time and within approved budgets.
  • Overall project portfolio performance against Group strategic objectives.
  • Project cost variance and schedule variance.
  • Group PMO governance and reporting compliance.
  • Successful delivery of strategic insurance and investment initiatives.
  • Project risk identification, mitigation, and escalation effectiveness.
  • Resource utilization and allocation efficiency across subsidiaries.
  • Benefits realization and ROI of major strategic projects.
  • Accuracy and timeliness of consolidated project reporting.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction across Group entities.
  • Improvement in project management maturity across subsidiaries.
  • Reduction in project delays, cost overruns, and implementation risks.

jobs.description:
About Ascent

Ascent Global Logistics, headquartered in Belleville, Michigan, is a leading global provider of expedited, time-critical logistics solutions and other direct transportation services. The company connects customers to its extensive carrier network, internal ground fleet and airline via its proprietary, digital PEAK freight marketplace, which provides robust carrier capacity and transparent pricing, backed by 24/7/365 logistics experts. Ascent’s offerings include air charter and ground expedited solutions as well as truckload, less-than-truckload, global forwarding, brokerage, and managed transportation services. The experienced Ascent team solves customers’ most challenging logistics needs by providing industry-leading service and top-tier satisfaction.

Our Guiding Principles


At the core of Ascent's culture is a strong commitment to excellence, driven by the passion and dedication of every team member. We're equally dedicated to going above and beyond for our customers, ensuring this commitment extends beyond our team and brings exceptional value to those we serve. We aim for perfect execution in everything we do and ‘play hard’ by creating an environment where tasks are performed with a can-do attitude from start to finish. We ‘play smart’ by delivering on our commitments in an honest, fair and ethical manner. We treat every person with whom we interface with the utmost dignity and respect. We understand that our teammates are our most valuable assets, so we ‘play together’ by making every effort to provide a professional and enjoyable experience, enabling careers to flourish and personal growth to be achieved.

ROLE SUMMARY

The Operational Key Account Manager (OKAM) is the performance owner of a portfolio of Ascent’s most important key account customers. The role is accountable for end-to-end service performance — SLAs, KPIs, continuous improvement, and cost-to-serve — across the assigned accounts. The OKAM runs the day-to-day operational cadence, owns issue resolution, and ensures Ascent delivers consistent, measurable execution on the commercial commitments made by the Growth KAM. Working closely with Operations, Control Tower, IT, and Finance, the OKAM turns performance data into customer-facing insight and continuous improvement — a hands-on, execution-focused role for a disciplined operational leader.

KEY ACTIVITIES

The six most important activities of the role:

  • Own Day-to-Day Service Performance — Accountable for SLA/KPI delivery (OTIF, TTFB, claims, win/capture) across the assigned account portfolio; run the weekly and monthly operational cadence with the customer.
  • Drive Continuous Improvement & Savings — Lead the CI roadmap for each account — identify systemic issues, deliver measurable cost-to-serve and OTIF improvements, and convert performance trends into documented savings.
  • Lead Root-Cause Analysis & CAPA — Own issue resolution, root-cause investigation, and corrective/preventive action for escalations; close the loop with Operations and the customer on sustainable fixes.
  • Maintain SOPs & Operational Governance — Design, maintain, and govern the account SOPs; ensure cross-regional consistency and smooth onboarding of new lanes, modes, or scopes awarded by the Growth KAM.
  • Deliver Performance Visibility via Power BI — Own the customer’s KPI dashboards and scorecards; turn Power BI data into structured performance narratives for internal reviews and customer QBRs.
  • Coordinate Cross-Functional Execution — Act as the central bridge between the customer’s operational teams, Ascent Operations, Control Tower, IT, and Finance; ensure one coordinated service delivery for the customer.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING

The successful candidate brings the following qualifications, experience, and education:

Work Experience

  • 6+ years of progressive operational experience in logistics, supply chain, or freight forwarding — with a proven track record of managing complex, multi-modal customer accounts.
  • Demonstrated success owning SLA/KPI performance (OTIF, claims, cost-to-serve) across global, multi-region customer footprints.
  • Hands-on experience leading continuous improvement initiatives that delivered measurable savings and service-level uplift.
  • Proven ability to run root-cause analysis (5 Whys, fishbone, CAPA) and drive systemic corrective actions with Operations.
  • Experience authoring and governing SOPs, account playbooks, and onboarding documentation for complex customer flows.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Strong operational mindset — disciplined, detail-oriented, and relentless about execution against the SLA.
  • Analytical and data-driven — expert-level Power BI and Excel for KPI reporting, trend analysis, and customer scorecards.
  • Excellent communication skills — confident presenting service performance to senior customer stakeholders in QBRs and issue reviews.
  • Proven cross-functional collaboration with Operations, Control Tower, IT, and Finance without direct authority.
  • Knowledge of CargoWise or equivalent TMS, PEAK Marketplace integrations, and shipment-level data flows a strong plus.
  • Bilingual (English / Spanish) a plus, given cross-border US-MX account scope.

Educational Background

  • Bachelor’s degree required — preferably in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
  • Advanced degree (MBA, MS in Supply Chain / Operations) a plus.
  • Relevant professional certifications strongly preferred — APICS / CSCP, Lean Six Sigma (Green or Black Belt), PMP, or equivalent.

Ascent’s Competitive Benefits


  • 401(k) and employer matching
  • Life Insurance
  • Health, Dental, Vision Insurance
  • Short- & Long-Term Disability
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Employee Wellness Program
  • Paid Holidays
  • Employee Recognition Programs
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • Overtime, Differential & Bonus Pay
Salary Range: $140,000 - $145,000

jobs.description:
Opportunity is not evenly distributed. Shopify puts independence within reach for anyone with a dream to start a business. We propel entrepreneurs and enterprises to scale the heights of their potential. Since 2006, we’ve grown to 10,000 employees and generated over $496 billion in sales for millions of merchants in 175 countries.
This is life-defining work that directly impacts people’s lives as much as it transforms your own. This is putting the power of the few in the hands of the many, is a future with more voices rather than fewer, and is creating more choices instead of an elite option.

About You

Moving at our pace brings a lot of change, complexity, and ambiguity—and a little bit of chaos. Shopifolk thrive on that and are comfortable being uncomfortable. That means Shopify is not the right place for everyone.
Before you apply, consider if you can:
  • Care deeply about what you do and about making commerce better for everyone
  • Excel by seeking professional and personal hypergrowth
  • Keep up with an unrelenting pace (the week, not the quarter)
  • Be resilient and resourceful in face of ambiguity and thrive on (rather than endure) change
  • Bring critical thought and opinion
  • Embrace differences and disagreement to get shit done and move forward
  • Work digital-first for your daily work

About the role

Data is a crucial part of Shopify’s mission to make commerce better for everyone. We organize and interpret petabytes of data to provide solutions for our merchants and stakeholders across the organization.
As a Data Engineer at Shopify, your primary responsibility will be to contribute to Shopify’s Data Warehouse. Your work will unlock powerful insights to guide the development and improvement of Shopify’s products.
As an embedded Data Engineer, you will work directly building foundations for products that transform merchants' lives. You'll collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of professionals that can include Product Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Business Analysts, and Product Management. The data you shape will be used to power product analysis, dashboards, and reports. You will also contribute by performing product analysis and creating dashboards and reports yourself from time to time. Get excited about flexing these analysis and reporting muscles, while also evangelizing the values and excellence in the Data Engineering craft to your multidisciplinary peers in a fast moving environment with competing priorities.
Our product is designed to empower entrepreneurs. Consequently, the work you do will not only create value for our users but also contribute to global entrepreneurship. To thrive here, you need to be dedicated to your craft and committed to constant development. You should be an independent thinker who can solve complex problems and handle a bit of chaos without breaking a sweat.
Example day to day responsibilities include:
  • Working with business partners to understand business and product objectives and identify the data needed to support them
  • Designing, building, implementing, and documenting data models
  • Writing data transformations using dbt or Spark
  • Shipping data pipelines including real-time streaming and batch processing
  • Optimizing data transformation pipelines to increase freshness or reduce computational time/cost
  • Working with engineers to understand and influence how data is produced
  • Collaborating with other data engineers on tooling for automated tasks around consuming, validating raw/modeled data, updating modeled data
  • Subscribing to and implementing architecture and standards following the Data Engineer craft at Shopify
  • Collaborating with sister disciplines (Engineering, Data Science) to establish best practices and evangelize the values and priorities of the Data Engineering craft
  • Partnering closely with product, engineering and other business leaders to influence product and program decisions with data
  • Building production-quality dashboards and scalable data products

Qualifications

  • Commercial experience in Data Engineering, and/or Analytics Engineering, ​​​​​​building scalable data warehouses
  • Dimensional Modeling (Star Schema, Kimball, Inmon)
  • Advanced SQL skills (ease with window functions, defining UDFs)
  • Exposure to Data Engineering tooling: ingesting, testing transformations, lineage, orchestration, publishing data, metric layers
  • Hands-on experience implementing real-time and batch data pipelines with tight SLOs and complex transformation requirements
  • Fantastic collaboration and communication skills, demonstrated by successful large-scale projects spanning multiple teams
  • Technical thought leader, comfortable navigating ambiguity and mentoring various level of team members
  • Aptitude for product analysis, dashboarding, and reporting

jobs.excerpt: Pediatric Hematology/Oncology PhysicianRole type: Contractor Location: Remote, United States only Commitment: Part-time, project-based Compensation: $160–$180 USD per hour About the rolemicro1 is looking for experienced Pediatric Hematology/Oncology Physicians to support a customer project focused on improving AI-generated clinical documentation.
jobs.description:
Pediatric Hematology/Oncology Physician

Role type: Contractor

Location: Remote, United States only

Commitment: Part-time, project-based

Compensation: $160–$180 USD per hour

About the role

micro1 is looking for experienced Pediatric Hematology/Oncology Physicians to support a customer project focused on improving AI-generated clinical documentation.

In this role, you'll use your clinical expertise to evaluate AI-generated transcripts and medical notes from outpatient pediatric hematology/oncology encounters. Your feedback will help improve the accuracy, completeness, and clinical relevance of AI-assisted documentation.

What you'll do

  1. Review AI-generated transcripts of outpatient pediatric hematology/oncology visits for clinical accuracy, completeness, and clarity.
  2. Evaluate clinical documentation, including History of Present Illness (HPI), interval histories, and Assessment and Plans (A&Ps).
  3. Identify inaccuracies or missing details related to chemotherapy regimens, treatment toxicities, supportive care, and laboratory findings.
  4. Assess pediatric-specific considerations, including weight- and BSA-based dosing, developmental milestones, and age-appropriate communication.
  5. Review how documentation captures caregiver involvement, shared decision-making, and psychosocial considerations.
  6. Provide clear, actionable feedback to improve AI-generated clinical notes and EHR documentation.

Required qualifications

  1. MD, DO, or equivalent medical degree, with board certification or eligibility in Pediatric Hematology/Oncology.
  2. At least 2 years of recent outpatient pediatric hematology/oncology experience following fellowship.
  3. Strong experience managing chemotherapy, longitudinal patient care, and treatment-related complications.
  4. Proven ability to independently document HPIs, interval histories, and Assessment and Plans.
  5. Solid understanding of pediatric chemotherapy protocols, transfusion practices, supportive care, and age-specific laboratory interpretation.
  6. Strong written communication skills and attention to clinical detail.
  7. Based in the United States.

Preferred qualifications

  1. Experience treating both malignant and non-malignant pediatric hematologic conditions, such as sickle cell disease, hemophilia, and ITP.

About the assignment

We are looking for a Cloud Network Architect – Azure to design, implement and optimize scalable, secure hybrid and multi‑cloud network architectures. The role focuses on Azure networking expertise, network automation (IaC) and DevOps practices to modernize network infrastructure and enable cloud migrations. The architect will lead network transformation initiatives and collaborate with cross‑functional teams to deliver robust, high‑performance networking solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and design scalable, secure, highly available Azure network solutions including topology diagrams, IP schemes and security policies.

  • Design hybrid connectivity between on‑premises data centers and Azure using ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway and Virtual WAN.

  • Develop network architecture standards, patterns and best practices for cloud and hybrid environments.

  • Design multi‑region and multi‑cloud network architectures for global connectivity and disaster recovery.

  • On-Premises Network Integration:

  • Design and implement connectivity between on‑premises networks and Azure cloud infrastructure.

  • Configure and maintain BGP peering between on‑premises routers and Azure Route Server/ExpressRoute.

  • Integrate on‑premises network security policies with cloud security controls and migrate services to cloud‑native equivalents.

  • Network Automation & DevOps:

  • Develop Infrastructure as Code templates (Terraform, ARM, Bicep) for network provisioning and build CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.

  • Automate network configuration, monitoring and troubleshooting using PowerShell, Azure CLI, Python and Ansible.

  • Implement GitOps practices, create self‑service network provisioning portals/APIs, and develop automated testing and remediation frameworks.

  • Security & Compliance:

  • Design and implement network security architectures including segmentation, micro‑segmentation and Zero Trust principles.

  • Configure Azure Firewall, NSGs, ASGs and route tables for defense‑in‑depth and implement encryption for transit and remote access solutions.

  • Perform network security assessments and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and security standards.

  • Monitoring & Operations:

  • Implement comprehensive network monitoring using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and Network Watcher with flow logging and alerting.

  • Develop runbooks, automated remediation workflows, capacity planning and maintain CMDB and network documentation.

  • Collaboration & Leadership:

  • Lead architecture reviews, provide technical guidance, mentor junior engineers and collaborate with cloud, security and application teams.

  • Interface with vendors and service providers and present architecture proposals to stakeholders.

  • Strategic Initiatives:

  • Drive network modernization and cloud migration initiatives, evaluate emerging technologies and develop network automation roadmaps.

Requirements

Mandatory

  • Azure Virtual Network (VNet) design and implementation
  • Azure ExpressRoute configuration and optimization
  • Azure VPN Gateway and Site-to-Site/Point-to-Point VPN
  • Azure Load Balancer (ALB/NLB) and Application Gateway
  • Azure Traffic Manager and Front Door
  • Azure Firewall and Network Virtual Appliances (NVAs)
  • Azure Private Link and Private Endpoint
  • Azure Virtual WAN and SD-WAN integration
  • Azure Network Watcher and monitoring
  • Azure DDoS Protection and network security
  • Hub-and-spoke network topology design
  • Azure Route Server and BGP configuration
  • Enterprise routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP)
  • Switching technologies (VLAN, VXLAN, STP, HSRP/VRRP)
  • MPLS and WAN technologies
  • Software-Defined Networking (SDN) and SD-WAN

Chief Financial Officer (CFO) & Business Advisor | Fractional or Outsourced CFO Experience | 100% Remote | W-2

Description:

Company: How To MANAGE a Small Law Firm (HTM)
Employment: Full-Time | W-2 Employee with Benefits | No outside work or consulting
Compensation: $110,000 Guaranteed Base + Per-Client Incremental Compensation | Targeted Total Compensation: $160,000 – $182,000
Location: Remote within AZ, CO, FL, GA, ID, IL, LA, MD, MI, MO, NC, NE, NJ, NY, OH, OR, PA, TN, TX, VA, WA, WV.

YOU’RE THE OUTSIDE CFO OWNERS TRUST WITH THEIR NUMBERS

An owner tells you, “We’re busy, but there’s no cash.” You find out why: the pricing, the unbilled hours, the slow collections, the hire that never paid for itself. Then you explain it in plain English and help them fix it.

You’ve done this for owners who weren’t your employer: as a fractional, outsourced, or virtual CFO, a consultant, or a trusted advisor. You love the moment it clicks for them.

If that sounds like you, keep reading.

THE ROLE

HTM helps solo and small law firm owners build more profitable businesses. As our Chief Financial Officer & Business Advisor, you’ll be the financial leader and trusted advisor to about 30 law firm owners. Law firms are professional services businesses, where the people are the production engine. You’ll advise on pricing, margins, cash flow, hiring, and growth, building the models, forecasts, and KPI dashboards yourself. We provide the portfolio of potential clients and the systems. No cold calling or prospecting.

THIS MIGHT BE YOU IF

  • You have 8+ years of finance leadership, and you have served multiple outside business owners or clients as a fractional, outsourced, or virtual CFO, consultant, or advisor.
  • You have been the person owners rely on for pricing, profitability, and cash flow decisions.
  • You build the models, forecasts, and cash flow plans yourself, and you turn them into practical advice.
  • You think in utilization, realization, capacity, and revenue per head, from consulting, engineering, accounting, architecture, IT services, or similar firms. (A huge plus.)
  • You have improved profitability, pricing, or margins for a client, and can show the numbers.
  • You are Profit First certified, or you think like it. (A strong plus.)

Leading finance inside a company is valuable experience, but on its own it isn’t enough for this role. Legal experience is not required. We’ll teach you the law-firm specifics.

WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

It is a full-time W-2 position with no outside work or consulting. It is not a CFO seat inside a single company or family group, and it is not a controller, bookkeeping, treasury, SEC reporting, capital raising, M&A, or nonprofit finance role. If your background is only real estate, construction, or manufacturing, expect a learning curve.

WHY HTM

  • $110,000 guaranteed base salary, plus incremental compensation for each client you serve, up to 30 clients. Targeted total compensation is $160,000 to $182,000.
  • Full-time W-2 with benefits: medical, dental, and vision (75% paid by HTM), 401(k) match, unlimited PTO, and more
  • 100% remote, with travel to U.S. events a couple of times a year
  • Inc. 5000 every year since 2013
  • A short, hands-on working session is part of the interview process

If you read this and thought, “That’s me,” apply today.

Applicants must reside in one of the listed states and be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.

Salary: $110,000 – $182,000 / year

Job Description:

Blizzard Entertainment is looking for a Social Media Manager to temporarily support the Diablo IV Marketing team. This hands-on role will support the December 1 launch of Diablo IV Season 16 and maintain the ongoing social content cadence through January 2027, including the holiday period.


Working closely with our social agency and internal partners, this role will coordinate content production, reviews, approvals, and publishing oversight to keep day-to-day social operations running smoothly. The ideal candidate can get up to speed quickly, work independently, and maintain continuity, while also helping develop the Season 17 social agency brief using established templates

and guidance.


This role reports directly to the Director, Social & Content at Diablo.


NOTE: This is an anticipated temporary assignment through January 2027. The candidate may be based in Irvine. Remote candidates within the United States will also be considered, provided they are able to work primarily West Coast hours (9:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. PST).

This is a contingent worker position and will be staffed through Volt, a staffing and workforce management company.

Key Responsibilities


  • Maintain the Diablo social content calendar and coordinate schedules with agency partners and internal stakeholders.
  • Track deadlines, deliverables, dependencies, and approvals to keep work on schedule.
  • Support development of the Season 17 social agency brief using established templates and guidance; this responsibility does not include ownership of broader social strategy.
  • Proactively flag risks, schedule changes, and blockers, and keep stakeholders aligned on next steps.
  • Coordinate social creative assets across platforms and channels, including static, video, and motion content.
  • Track production status, asset versions, delivery dates, and publishing readiness with agency and internal partners.

  • Coordinate closely with the agency’s community manager to provide guidance, secure approvals, and ensure approved publishing plans are executed accurately. The agency will handle the majority of direct publishing and community management.

  • Coordinate with internal marketing, creative, production, community, regional, and agency partners to keep work moving.
  • Attend key planning and review meetings, communicate updates, and confirm owners and next steps.
  • Maintain continuity across social operations by routing urgent needs and keeping relevant stakeholders informed.
  • Provide occasional, scheduled operational coverage during Blizzard company closures or holiday periods, as needed, to monitor social channels, coordinate with the agency community manager, and escalate time-sensitive issues.
  • Partner with the agency and internal teams to ensure coverage plans, escalation paths, and approvals are clear in advance.

Minimum Requirements


  • 3+ years of relevant experience in social media, social operations, or content production.
  • Experience coordinating social calendars, creative production, and agency workflows.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to independently manage deadlines, dependencies, and competing priorities.
  • Familiarity with major social platforms, publishing processes, and content specifications.
  • Experience using project management and creative review or approval tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across internal and external teams.

Extra Points


  • Experience in gaming, entertainment, live-service products, or related audience-driven industries.
  • Knowledge of the Diablo franchise, its community, and its audience.
  • Experience working with third-party agencies and external partners.
  • Familiarity with Opal, Sprinklr, Airtable, Asana, or similar platforms; prior Opal experience is not required.

Your Platform


Best known for iconic video game universes including Warcraft®, Overwatch®, Diablo®, and StarCraft®, Blizzard Entertainment, Inc. (www.blizzard.com), a division of Activision Blizzard, which was acquired by Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), is a premier developer and publisher of entertainment experiences. Blizzard Entertainment has created some of the industry’s most critically acclaimed and genre-defining games over the last 30 years, with a track record that includes multiple Game of the Year awards. Blizzard Entertainment engages tens of millions of players around the world with titles available on PC via Battle.net®, Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch, iOS, and Android.

Our World


Activision Blizzard, Inc., is one of the world's largest and most successful interactive entertainment companies and is at the intersection of media, technology and entertainment. We are home to some of the most beloved entertainment franchises including Call of Duty®, World of Warcraft®, Overwatch®, Diablo®, Candy Crush™ and Bubble Witch™. Our combined entertainment network delights hundreds of millions of monthly active users in 196 countries, making us the largest gaming network on the planet!


Our ability to build immersive and innovative worlds is only enhanced by diverse teams working in an inclusive environment. We aspire to have a culture where everyone can thrive in order to connect and engage the world through epic entertainment. We provide a suite of benefits that promote physical, emotional and financial well-being for ‘Every World’ - we’ve got our employees covered!


The videogame industry and therefore our business is fast-paced and will continue to evolve. As such, the duties and responsibilities of this role may be changed as directed by the Company at any time to promote and support our business and relationships with industry partners.

Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University is seeking a collaborative and strategic Director of Web Content Strategy to lead the University’s enterprise-wide digital content strategy. This position offers the opportunity to lead a high-impact content function that directly supports student recruitment, engagement, and institutional brand strength. jobs.description:
ICF seeks a Technical Writer to support our important work in Child Care and Development Technical Assistance (CDTA) Projects. The Technical Writer will work with project teams supporting ICF’s work in the field of early childhood education in the federal, state, and private sectors. This role supports CDTA projects by developing, editing, and reviewing clear, audience‑focused written products that translate complex early childhood and Child Care and Development Fund (CCDF) topics into practical, accessible resources. The Technical Writer collaborates with subject matter experts and project teams to ensure content quality, consistency, plain language, and adherence to established editorial and quality assurance standards.


Bilingual technical writers may be asked to provide translation of project resources.


Ideal Candidate Description

The ideal candidate will have experience in the field of child development or early childhood education and care, and experience developing engaging content and resources that clarify and convey complex topics and facilitate application of the information shared. The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience working in a government context, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams or multiple projects to develop resources to meet the informational needs of specific audiences.

The ideal candidate will excel at writing and editing, as well as reviewing written materials to ensure consistent voice, format, and adherence to various protocols. Additionally, the ideal candidate will be detail-oriented, organized, adaptable, and capable of managing multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.


Job Responsibilities – Project Support and Collaboration

  • Support client priorities and project objectives by completing required and ad hoc reports as well as other relevant information gathering tasks to demonstrate project progress and accomplishments, inform client services, and identify emerging client needs.
  • Actively participate and engage in team meetings, internal workgroups, and other collaborative projects as requested. Take and record notes during meetings, including staff meetings and federal workgroup meetings.
  • Support Section 508 remediation process and ensure appropriate posting of written products and other deliverables to the website using established protocols.
  • Participate in and/or lead various workgroups as requested by the client or project leadership, and as relevant to the project’s work.
  • Support digital file management, organization, archiving, and file migration.
  • Support efforts to ensure appropriate review, approval, posting, and dissemination of resources and announcements.
  • Stay up to date on the latest research, tools, technology, and resources that could be leveraged to support project and client priorities.
  • Work collaboratively with editorial team members to establish and maintain consistent, reliable editorial standards that reflect the client's needs, objectives, and preferences.
  • Assist with updating editorial style guidance and other editorial guidance documents, including guidance related to citations, references, and other client-specific terminology.
  • Support efforts to ensure appropriate review, approval, and finalization of resources.
  • Assist in the delivery of training for project staff, partners, and client staff on effective, plain language writing techniques that are tailored to meet the specific informational needs of target audiences.

Job Responsibilities – Product Development and TA Delivery

  • Complete research and information gathering tasks to support timely, accurate responses to client and state and territory inquiries.
  • Apply client-approved templates, styles, branding, and other requirements to ensure high quality digital and written products.
  • Support data collection, reporting, and data quality assurance tasks and project evaluation efforts.
  • Prepare ad hoc reports from project databases to assist the project leadership, inform technical assistance efforts. and respond to client requests and questions.
  • Use approved AI, Smart Sheet, and Mural as tools, when appropriate, to facilitate and track task completion.
  • Develop written products and deliverables, including working with subject matter experts and other team members to clarify product audience, purpose, and scope, ensure content clarity and readability, and identify the need for additional subject matter expertise, when needed.
  • Develop or collaborate with team members to develop visual graphics and enhanced product formatting to increase readability and clarity.
  • Ensure integrity in written products by confirming that all citations are correct and copyright and permissions protocols have been followed.
  • Provide editorial expertise (such as copy editing, substantive editing, and proofreading) for the full range of project resources and deliverables, including reports, training materials, briefs, resource guides, tools, website content, announcements, etc.
  • Apply plain language principles to support specific audience comprehension when reviewing or developing content to ensure clarity and readability.
  • Stay informed about early education and child care content, client priorities and preferences, and political nuances that may affect product development.
  • Ensure quality control for written deliverables and products by consistently implementing established quality assurance protocols and procedures.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a technical writer and editor, developing resources for public dissemination in various formats.
  • 3+ years of experience supporting development of effective training and technical assistance products and resources to support effective CCDF implementation. applying high-quality writing, editing, and proofreading skills.
  • 3+ years of experience translating complex topics into content that is easy to read, understand and apply and meets the informational needs of specific audiences.
  • 2+ years of experience with web content development and web and digital resource formatting best practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing user-friendly web content.
  • Experience supplementing written content with visual graphics to strengthen user understanding,
  • Knowledge of CCDF regulations, applicable federal, state, and local laws, rules and regulations.
  • Experience working collaboratively with subject matter experts to extract relevant information to develop curated products for specific audiences.
  • Experience developing and implementing digital content strategy, including audience engagement, and communication best practices.
  • Experience developing products and public-facing resources for government or quasi-government agencies.
  • Knowledge of citation formatting (such as APA or MLA) and copyright best practices.

Professional Skills

  • Excellent verbal, interpersonal, and written communication skills.
  • Strong writing skills, with the ability to translate complex topics into simple content that is easy to read, understand, and apply.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple activities simultaneously in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, while being able to meet urgent deadlines.

  • Ability to work independently and as a dedicated team player.

  • Ability to adapt, learn, and use new technology tools and platforms and identify ways to enhance and improve efficiency and productivity.
  • Ability to handle sensitive or confidential information, and exercise good judgment, discretion, tact, and diplomacy.

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

Who The Client Is: Our client is a growing civil construction and earthworks business based in Townsville, North Queensland. With a growing team, delivering earthworks and building projects for a growing client base. The business is tendering for larger projects and is building the systems and support to scale with them.

Role Overview: Founder spends most of his day in a machine on site. This role is his right hand: you'll take the admin, bookkeeping and life admin off his plate so he can focus on the work. You'll start as a dedicated assistant, working directly with him by phone call, text and audio messages. As you learn the business, your scope will naturally grow into wider support across the business.

Key Responsibilities:

Executive and personal admin

  • Manage the founder’s inbox, flag what matters and action emails on his behalf
  • Track and file, council rates, renewals and other deadlines so nothing slips through business and personal keeping calendar tight on schedule
  • Own the founder’s calendar, bookings and appointments, both business and personal
  • Turn quick texts, calls and voice notes from the founders into completed tasks, emails and bookings
  • Make calls and send emails to suppliers, clients and service providers on the founder’s behalf
  • Tracking his movements and getting a daily journal from him to enter his cost in
  • Keep documents up to clients on time

Bookkeeping and finance

  • Maintain the books in Xero, including bank reconciliations and coding transactions
  • Prepare and send client invoices, including flat-fee charges for plant and equipment moves
  • Prepare weekly payroll information ahead of the founder’s Wednesday pay run
  • Keep supplier bills, receipts and records organised and up to date
  • Keep in contact with employees if bills have no address or purchase order and make them accountable.

Job, plant and timesheet records

  • Record plant and equipment movements between job sites as the founder’s reports them
  • Maintain the NextMinute work management system by keeping records up to date, adding uncoded items, updating rates, fuel levies, and price increases, and allocating fuel costs to the appropriate machines.
  • Log staff hours by job and site throughout the week
  • Record material deliveries (e.g. tonnes of sand or gravel) against the right job and client
  • Walk through the week's records with the founder each Wednesday to confirm everything is captured

Systems and process

  • Write SOPs for each workflow you take on, building a playbook for the business as it scales
  • Research and compare project management software for bookings, machinery and staff, run demos and present a recommendation
  • Once chosen, set up and run the software in the background so the information stays accurate
  • Support cost tracking on jobs as the business grows into larger projects
  • Excel allocation and running cost so the director can see where costs are going and where they may be bleeding money
  • Scheduling and organizing machinery maintenance and registrations

Requirements

  • 3+ years as an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant or Admin Assistant supporting a business owner
  • Bookkeeping experience, ideally with Xero (reconciliations, invoicing, bills)
  • Excellent spoken and written English, confident on the phone with Australian businesses
  • Highly organised, with strong follow-through on deadlines and payments(hyper aggressive on late payments and keeping the owner himself accountable )
  • Proactive and resourceful: you take a short instruction and run with it

Highly regarded:

  • Experience in construction, civil, earthworks, trades or plant hire
  • Familiarity with construction terms such as plant, tonnages, takeoffs and site deliveries
  • Payroll and timesheet experience, including Australian payroll basics
  • Experience with job management software such as NextMinute, ServiceM8, Buildxact, Tradify or similar
  • Experience supporting Australian clients and working to AEST

Tools You’ll Use:

Xero, email and calendar (Google Workspace or Microsoft 365), phone and SMS/WhatsApp, cloud file storage, and a project management platform once selected.

Who You Are:

Attitude comes first. You're calm, reliable and switched on, and you enjoy bringing order to a busy, fast-moving business. You're comfortable working with someone who prefers a quick call or text over a long email, and you take pride in making sure nothing gets missed. You're keen to learn the construction side and grow with the business.

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Digital Experience Engineer (Web Development) – Military OneSource to develop, maintain, modernize, and enhance secure, accessible, and responsive websites and web applications that support military members and their families.

The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience with WordPress, PHP, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, enterprise content management systems, RESTful APIs, responsive design, accessibility, UX/UI implementation, and Agile delivery. This role is suited for a practical web engineer who can translate business, content, design, and accessibility requirements into reliable digital solutions while supporting production operations in a Federal environment.DecisionPoint is seeking an experienced Digital Experience Engineer (Web Development) – Military OneSource to support the MODES III program.

This position is fully remote.

Duties & Responsibilities

WordPress & Web Development
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance responsive websites and web applications supporting Military OneSource.
  • Configure, customize, and maintain WordPress websites, themes, templates, plugins, and reusable components.
  • Develop custom website functionality using PHP, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and related web technologies.
  • Translate UX/UI designs, content requirements, and interaction specifications into responsive, accessible front-end solutions.
  • Support enterprise content management systems and database-backed web applications.
  • Troubleshoot website defects, broken functionality, display issues, integration problems, and production incidents; perform root-cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective actions.
Digital Experience & Content Management
  • Partner with UX specialists, designers, content strategists, publishers, and product owners to improve the Military OneSource digital experience.
  • Support website content structures, templates, navigation, search, publishing workflows, and content presentation.
  • Translate business and user needs into practical, maintainable digital solutions.
  • Develop reusable components that promote visual consistency, usability, accessibility, and efficient content publishing.
  • Support website modernization, redesign, migration, and platform-enhancement initiatives.
  • Use website analytics, user feedback, accessibility results, and quality findings to recommend improvements.
Accessibility & Quality Assurance
  • Develop websites and applications consistent with Section 508, WCAG, and WAI-ARIA requirements.
  • Incorporate accessibility throughout design, development, testing, remediation, and release activities.
  • Perform keyboard, screen-reader, and assistive-technology validation as appropriate.
  • Use manual and automated accessibility testing tools to identify, document, and remediate issues.
  • Participate in peer reviews, code reviews, functional testing, usability reviews, and production validation.
API, Integration & Technical Support
  • Develop and maintain integrations among websites, RESTful APIs, databases, analytics platforms, and third-party services.
  • Implement interactive and dynamic website functionality using approved technologies and development standards.
  • Support authentication, search, forms, data exchange, and other integrated website capabilities.
  • Collaborate with back-end developers, architects, cybersecurity personnel, and DevSecOps engineers to resolve technical issues.
  • Support Git-based source control, structured development workflows, build tooling, deployment processes, and configuration management.
  • Assist with website monitoring, performance optimization, reliability, and production support.
Cybersecurity & Federal Compliance
  • Apply secure web-development practices throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Support vulnerability identification, remediation, validation, and release activities.
  • Coordinate with cybersecurity personnel to support RMF, Zero Trust, NIST SP 800-53, privacy, CUI, and Authority to Operate requirements.
  • Follow applicable Federal and DoD development, security, privacy, records-management, and operational requirements.
  • Maintain technical documentation supporting application sustainment, security reviews, and knowledge transfer.
Agile Delivery & Stakeholder Collaboration
  • Participate in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, demonstrations, and retrospectives.
  • Collaborate with Government stakeholders, product owners, business analysts, content teams, UX specialists, designers, architects, testers, and operations personnel.
  • Gather and clarify requirements, identify implementation options, and provide level-of-effort estimates.
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Provide implementation documentation, status updates, issue reporting, and knowledge transfer while working independently within a multidisciplinary Agile team.
Why This Role MattersThe Digital Experience Engineer (Web Development) – Military OneSource will help modernize and sustain digital services used by military members and their families. The role combines hands-on WordPress development, front-end engineering, accessibility, UX implementation, content management, integration support, and production troubleshooting to deliver secure, reliable, and mission-focused digital experiences.

  • Must hold an active Secret clearance or higher.
Education
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Web Development, Digital Media, or a related field. Equivalent relevant education, certifications, and professional experience may be considered.
Required Experience
  • Minimum 6 years of professional website, front-end, or web-application development experience.
  • Demonstrated experience developing, maintaining, and supporting production WordPress websites.
  • Hands-on experience with PHP, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
  • Experience translating UX/UI designs and business requirements into responsive, component-based web interfaces.
  • Experience developing or customizing WordPress themes, templates, plugins, and website functionality.
  • Experience supporting enterprise content management systems and content-publishing workflows.
  • Experience integrating websites with RESTful APIs, databases, third-party systems, or dynamic data services.
  • Experience with responsive web design, cross-browser compatibility, and accessible-development practices.
  • Experience applying Section 508 and WCAG requirements.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex website issues, investigating defects, and supporting production operations.
  • Experience using Git or another source-control platform and working within Agile or Scrum teams.
  • Ability to gather requirements and clearly communicate implementation options, risks, and recommended solutions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Preferred Experience & Certifications
  • CompTIA Security+ certification.

Desired Professional Characteristics

  • Adaptability and willingness to learn new tools, standards, and technologies.

jobs.description:
Overview

At Morgan Advanced Materials, our rich history and dedication to innovation define who we are. Since our establishment in the UK in 1856, we have expanded globally, now operating across 70 sites in 18 countries. Our goal is to create a more sustainable world and enhance quality of life. We actively pursue this purpose through the development and production of advanced materials.

Within our business unit, we specialise in innovating cutting-edge carbon, graphite, and carbide products that deliver outstanding performance. We use our expertise to tackle complex challenges across many diverse industries to provide effective solutions for our valued customers.

Our products are shaping a better future; from enabling electric cars to charge faster and drive longer distances to maximising the operational efficiency of wind turbines. We are proud to help generate power for billions of people, deliver water to drought-stricken regions, improve the efficiency of industrial pumps, and protect lives both on the land and in the air.

Key Figures: Revenue £1,100.7m (2024), ~8,000 employees, manufacturing in 20+ countries, and a global customer portfolio. A UK PLC with head office located in Windsor, Berkshire UK. Listed on London Stock Exchange; Member of the FTSE 250 Index.

Responsibilities

Technical Sales Engineer

Location: Remote Domestic US Travel: Approximately 75% Salary Range: $95,000-$105,000 Morgan Advanced Materials helps customers keep critical industrial equipment running reliably. From power generation and steel production to pulp & paper and mining, their electrical carbon products and technical expertise support some of the toughest operating environments around. This role sits at the intersection of engineering and sales. You won't be selling from behind a desk. You'll spend most of your time with customers, understanding their equipment challenges, identifying opportunities to improve performance, and providing practical technical solutions that deliver real value.

The Role

As a Technical Sales Engineer, you'll manage and grow a defined territory by building strong customer relationships, uncovering new opportunities, and acting as a trusted advisor on electrical rotating equipment and carbon product applications.You'll work closely with maintenance, engineering, reliability, and operations teams, helping customers improve uptime, reduce costs, and solve equipment performance issues. If you enjoy getting out on site, speaking with customers face-to-face, and combining technical knowledge with commercial responsibility, you'll be right at home here.

What You'll Do

  • Develop new business opportunities and identify potential customers across the territory
  • Manage and grow existing customer relationships through regular site visits and technical support
  • Promote Morgan's portfolio of electrical carbon products, including carbon brushes, brush holders, slip ring assemblies, and related solutions
  • Conduct equipment inspections, collect performance data, and provide recommendations to improve reliability and operating efficiency
  • Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline through CRM activity and territory planning
  • Prepare proposals, quotations, contract discussions, and commercial recommendations
  • Deliver product presentations, technical reviews, and customer meetings
  • Support customers after installation or purchase to ensure satisfaction and long-term success
  • Monitor market activity and competitor movements, identifying opportunities to increase market share
  • Collaborate with engineering, product management, quality, customer service, and operations teams to support customer needs
  • Maintain accurate visit reports, opportunity tracking, and sales forecasts
  • Contribute ideas that improve sales processes, customer engagement, and business growth

Qualifications

About You

We're looking for someone who can comfortably move between the plant floor and the boardroom.You'll likely bring:
  • A Bachelor's degree in Engineering or another technical discipline preferred
  • 3-5 years of technical sales experience within industrial markets
  • Strong knowledge of DC motors, AC motors, generators, slip rings, commutators, brush rigging, and rotating electrical equipment
  • Experience with troubleshooting, maintenance practices, equipment reliability, and failure analysis
  • Knowledge of electrical carbon products, carbon brushes, collector systems, or related applications
  • Experience working with customers in industries such as mining, metals, steel, energy, pulp & paper, oil & gas, or similar heavy industrial environments
  • The ability to interpret technical drawings, schematics, specifications, and test reports
  • Confidence presenting solutions, discussing technical options, and negotiating commercial agreements
  • Experience using CRM platforms to manage opportunities and customer relationships
  • A proactive, self-driven approach and the ability to manage a large territory effectively
  • Strong relationship-building skills and the credibility to become a trusted technical advisor

What You'll Get

  • Opportunity to manage a well-established industrial territory with significant growth potential
  • A role that combines technical problem-solving with commercial responsibility
  • Extensive customer interaction and autonomy in how you manage your territory
  • Exposure to a broad range of industrial customers and critical equipment applications
  • The chance to work alongside engineering, product, quality, and operations specialists who understand the technical side of the business
  • Competitive compensation package, including incentive opportunities and benefits
  • Remote-based role with travel throughout the assigned territory

Interested?

If you enjoy solving industrial equipment challenges, building strong customer relationships, and turning technical expertise into commercial success, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today to learn more about the opportunity.

By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.

Want to know more? See more of what we do here.

Job Summary

Granicus is seeking a Cybersecurity Operations Engineer to operate, monitor, and continuously improve the cybersecurity controls protecting a mission-critical SaaS product.

Granicus provides purpose-built cloud technology and services that help government organizations deliver more accessible, effective, and trusted digital experiences for the communities they serve.

As a global organization, Granicus supports customers and operations across North America, the United Kingdom, Europe, Australia, and New Zealand, delivering cloud platforms that power critical digital services for government agencies and public sector organizations worldwide.

The Cybersecurity Operations Engineer will be one of two hands-on individual contributors responsible for preserving the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of a Granicus SaaS product hosted in Amazon Web Services (AWS) and subject to FedRAMP and Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) security requirements. The role will operate endpoint protection, centralized security logging and analytics, vulnerability management, and related cloud security controls; monitor the environment; triage and investigate security events; support incident response; execute operational activities for the Granicus data protection program; and contribute to other cybersecurity initiatives. The position reports to the Cybersecurity Operations Lead within the Global Cyber Defense organization led by the Senior Director, Global Cyber Defense. This role must be based in the United States and must possess or be able to obtain and maintain the personnel screening and access authorization required for CJIS-regulated environments.

Essential Function

  • Regulated SaaS Security Operations
    • Perform day-to-day security operations and security engineering for the designated SaaS product and its supporting AWS environment.
    • Execute security controls and operating procedures that preserve the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the product and its data.
    • Apply FedRAMP, NIST SP 800-53, the CJIS Security Policy, and Granicus security requirements in daily operational and technical activities.
    • Complete assigned continuous monitoring, control testing, audit evidence, corrective action, and authorization maintenance activities in partnership with Governance, Risk, and Compliance, Product, Cloud Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, and system owners.
    • Identify control gaps, configuration deviations, and emerging technical risk; resolve issues within assigned authority and promptly escalate material concerns.
  • Security Platform and Control Operations
    • Operate and maintain endpoint detection and response, centralized security logging and analytics, vulnerability scanning and management, and related cloud security capabilities supporting the product.
    • Verify that in-scope assets are inventoried and monitored, security telemetry is collected and retained, agents and sensors remain healthy, and coverage gaps are corrected.
    • Onboard and maintain security log sources, including parsing, normalization, enrichment, alert routing, retention, access, and data quality.
    • Execute vulnerability scans, validate findings, prioritize risk using exploitability and asset context, coordinate remediation, track exceptions, and verify corrective actions.
    • Build and maintain dashboards and operational reporting for asset coverage, control health, vulnerability exposure, alert trends, response performance, compliance posture, and residual risk.
    • Maintain integrations between security capabilities and cloud, engineering, service management, and collaboration systems to improve data quality, response speed, and operational consistency.
  • Monitoring, Detection, Investigation, and Incident Response
    • Monitor security alerts and telemetry, triage events, manage cases, and ensure assigned work is handled consistently and within established response expectations.
    • Investigate identity, endpoint, network, application, and cloud activity; correlate evidence to determine event scope, impact, root cause, and required action.
    • Develop, test, and tune detections, correlation logic, and investigative queries for threats relevant to the product environment while reducing false positives.
    • Perform or support incident response activities including scoping, evidence preservation, containment, eradication, recovery, root-cause analysis, and corrective action tracking.
    • Execute incident response playbooks, escalation paths, notification procedures, exercises, and post-incident reviews suitable for FedRAMP- and CJIS-regulated operations.
    • Maintain complete, accurate, and auditable investigation records, incident timelines, evidence, decisions, and required reports; participate in after-hours response when required.
  • Operational Readiness and Team Collaboration
    • Work closely with the Cybersecurity Operations Lead and the other Cybersecurity Operations Engineer to provide dependable monitoring, investigation, and incident response coverage.
    • Follow and continuously improve runbooks, operating procedures, quality standards, service metrics, shift handoffs, and escalation practices.
    • Maintain cross-training and backup capability for the team's core responsibilities, take ownership of assigned work, and support teammates during periods of elevated demand.
    • Escalate complex, high-severity, or time-sensitive issues promptly and provide clear technical context, evidence, impact analysis, and recommended actions.
    • Contribute to a culture of technical excellence, sound judgment, collaboration, accountability, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.
  • Data Protection Program Operations
    • Execute assigned operational activities for the Granicus enterprise data protection program under the direction of the Cybersecurity Operations Lead.
    • Support controls for data discovery, classification, handling, access, encryption, monitoring, retention, and secure disposal across relevant environments.
    • Monitor, triage, and investigate suspected data leakage, misuse, or policy violations in coordination with incident response, Privacy, Legal, and business processes.
    • Maintain data protection workflows, evidence, metrics, dashboards, exception records, and remediation tracking that demonstrate control coverage and effectiveness.
    • Partner with Privacy, Legal, Information Technology, Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders to implement protective controls, manage exceptions, and reduce data risk.
  • AI, Automation, and Continuous Improvement
    • Use approved AI-assisted analysis and automation throughout monitoring, investigations, vulnerability management, data protection, compliance evidence, reporting, and engineering workflows.
    • Automate repetitive activities such as alert enrichment, case creation, evidence collection, asset reconciliation, vulnerability prioritization, notification, and status reporting.
    • Validate AI-generated insights and apply human-in-the-loop safeguards so sensitive data is handled in accordance with security, privacy, customer, and regulatory requirements.
    • Use scripting, APIs, query languages, and workflow orchestration to improve the speed, consistency, scalability, and auditability of security processes.
    • Propose, test, document, and measure improvements to detections, tooling, workflows, and controls based on operational outcomes, reliability, and controlled risk.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration and Cybersecurity Projects
    • Partner with Product, Engineering, Cloud, Compliance, Privacy, and business teams supporting the designated SaaS product and data protection program.
    • Provide practical security input for architecture decisions, platform changes, releases, remediation plans, risk decisions, and customer assurance activities.
    • Communicate findings, incident status, priorities, tradeoffs, and program performance clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    • Support other cybersecurity projects and operational activities as assigned by the Cybersecurity Operations Lead or Senior Director, Global Cyber Defense.

You Will Love This Job If You Have

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of security operations and security engineering for cloud-hosted SaaS products, with practical understanding of AWS environments and the cloud shared-responsibility model.
  • Working knowledge of FedRAMP continuous monitoring, NIST SP 800-53 security controls, the CJIS Security Policy, and the operational expectations of regulated cloud environments.
  • Hands-on ability to operate endpoint detection and response, centralized logging and security analytics, vulnerability management, and cloud security monitoring capabilities.
  • Strong understanding of AWS identity, networking, compute, storage, logging, encryption, key management, and security-relevant configuration practices.
  • Ability to maintain reliable security telemetry pipelines, including log collection, parsing, normalization, enrichment, retention, access, and quality monitoring.
  • Ability to write and modify investigative queries, detections, and correlation logic and to analyze identity, endpoint, network, application, and cloud security events.
  • Practical incident response skills including scoping, evidence handling, containment, eradication, recovery, root-cause analysis, and corrective action management.
  • Knowledge of vulnerability management practices including asset discovery, scanning, validation, risk prioritization, remediation coordination, exception handling, and verification.
  • Knowledge of enterprise data protection practices including data discovery, classification, access governance, encryption, monitoring, retention, data loss prevention, and response to suspected misuse or exfiltration.
  • Experience using scripting, APIs, query languages, and workflow automation to improve security operations, evidence collection, reporting, and tool integration.
  • Ability to use AI-enabled capabilities responsibly, including human validation, prompt and data handling controls, quality measurement, explainability, and auditability.
  • Ability to maintain clear operational metrics, runbooks, case records, evidence, and technical documentation suitable for regulated and audited environments.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and decision-making skills, including the ability to remain effective during high-severity incidents.
  • Ability to translate cybersecurity and compliance requirements into practical technical actions and sustainable operating procedures.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively across Security, Product, Engineering, Cloud, Compliance, Privacy, Legal, and business teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical findings, security risk, and response actions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities independently, recognize when escalation is required, and deliver reliable outcomes in a fast-paced and evolving cybersecurity environment.

  • 3+ years of experience in cybersecurity engineering, security operations, cloud security, incident response, or related roles.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience operating security monitoring, endpoint protection, vulnerability management, and incident response capabilities in an AWS-hosted production cloud or SaaS environment.
  • Experience triaging and investigating security events and supporting incidents from initial detection through containment, recovery, and lessons learned.
  • Experience working with cloud and application logs, security analytics, detection queries, case management, and vulnerability remediation workflows.
  • Experience supporting a FedRAMP-authorized, CJIS-regulated, or similarly controlled environment is strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting operational data protection activities and applying automation or AI-assisted capabilities to security workflows is preferred.

jobs.excerpt: Join a short, paid project that tests whether AI coding agents work as well on instructions written in the target language as they do in English.
jobs.description:
Join a short, paid project that tests whether AI coding agents work as well on instructions written in the target language as they do in English. Your language skills and technical background decide where you fit. 

About the project 

Welo Data is helping evaluate how well AI coding agents perform when the instructions they receive are written in languages other than English. Agents are given a real software engineering task in a code repository, and automated tests check whether they solved it. The code, repositories and tests stay exactly as they are. Only the human-written instructions change language, so the quality of every instruction directly affects the result. 

About the roles 

There are two roles on this project. We place you in one of them based on your experience & skillsets. 

  • Translator: translate English software engineering task briefs into the target language. You keep every requirement, constraint and success condition, and you leave commands, file paths, API names, code and test conditions exactly as written in English. This role suits people with a stronger technical background, and translation experience is a plus. 

  • Reviewer: compare each translation with the English source, check that nothing is missing, added or changed in meaning, correct errors, and log each correction by error type. This role suits people with strong translation, editing or review experience and enough technical familiarity to read code context. 

Who we are looking for 

  • Native or near-native writing in the target language, and strong reading ability in English. 

  • Either professional experience in translation, editing, review or technical writing, or a software background combined with excellent writing in the target language 

  • Comfort reading technical text. Coding experience is a strong plus for the translation role and helpful for the review role. 

  • Close attention to detail. In this project, a dropped clause can make a task fail. 

Project at a glance 

  • Project duration: one week since the mid of November 

  • Languages: Dutch

  • Project time commitment: 6 hours per person 

  • Project compensation: US$80-US$92.5 per hour

  • Work location: fully remote 

How selection works (major steps) 

  1. Screening questions: about 2 minutes. They cover your language background, translation and review experience, which programming languages you know and how well, and your availability. 

  2. Language test: short exercises in the target language. 

  3. Programming skills assessment: you will be invited to another opportunity, in the programming language you know best (Rust, Go, Python, or TypeScript / JavaScript). It confirms your technical level and places you in a language track. 

  4. Financial Onboarding & Role placement: complete the financial onboarding with Welo Data. In the meanwhile, you will be informed about the decision whether you are placed in the initial translation role or the review role. 

  5. Production: once you finish all steps above, our project team will contact you for production.
