jobs.excerpt: For ambitious, culturally diverse, curious minds seeking booming careers, Job Duck unlocks and nurtures your potential.
jobs.description:
For ambitious, culturally diverse, curious minds seeking booming careers, Job Duck unlocks and nurtures your potential. We connect you with rewarding, remote job opportunities with US-based employers who recognize and appreciate your skills, allowing you to not just survive but thrive.

As a lifestyle company, we ensure that everybody working here has a fantastic time, which is why we’ve earned the Great Place to Work Certification every year since 2022!

Job Description:

Job Duck is seeking a highly organized, dependable, and detail-oriented Legal Assistant / Paralegal to provide essential administrative and legal support to attorneys handling litigation and criminal defense matters. This role is responsible for keeping cases organized and moving forward by managing court calendars, processing legal notices, coordinating discovery, and preparing routine legal documents using established templates. The ideal candidate is an independent thinker who exercises sound judgment, takes ownership of their work, and can communicate professionally and confidently with clients, court personnel, and attorneys, including in challenging situations. This position requires someone who is meticulous, trustworthy, patient, and committed to delivering excellent client service while handling confidential and privileged information with discretion.


Monthly Compensation: $ 1,527 USD

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Communicate case updates to clients and coordinate client appointments, including appointments with individuals in custody.
  • Process and follow up on tasks assigned by attorneys after each court appearance.
  • Monitor and process court notices through Missouri Case.net and CourtDrive.
  • Manage court calendars and schedule court settings, ensuring all relevant dates and deadlines are accurately recorded.
  • Request, collect, organize, and maintain discovery materials for assigned cases.
  • Draft routine legal documents, including motions, entries of appearance, and client letters, using established templates.
  • Review, organize, clear, and file case-related emails and legal documents in Clio Manage.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date electronic case files and documentation.
  • Communicate professionally with clients, court personnel, and attorneys by phone and email.
  • Handle sensitive client communications with patience, professionalism, and sound judgment.
  • Ensure all assigned administrative and legal support tasks are completed accurately and within established deadlines.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality when accessing, processing, and managing privileged legal information.

Requirements:

  • Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM CST
  • Timezone: Central Standard Time (Missouri)

  • Experience:
    ◦ Previous experience as a Legal Assistant or Paralegal.
    ◦ Litigation or criminal defense experience is preferred but not required.
    ◦ Experience working with Clio Manage is a plus.
    ◦ Familiarity with court procedures, legal documentation, and case management is beneficial.
  • Technical Requirements:
    ◦ Experience with or willingness to learn Clio Manage.
    ◦ Familiarity with Missouri Case.net and CourtDrive is preferred.

◦ Strong written English skills.

◦ Ability to communicate effectively by phone with clients and court personnel.


  • Additional Requirements:
    ◦ Willingness to sign a confidentiality agreement.
    ◦ Ability to successfully complete a criminal background check due to access to privileged and confidential legal files.
    ◦ Ability to handle sensitive information with professionalism and discretion.

  • Required Skills:
  • Highly organized and meticulous, with strong attention to detail.
  • Independent thinker with sound judgment and problem-solving abilities.
  • Trustworthy, reliable, and accountable for the quality and accuracy of their work.
  • Patient and emotionally resilient when dealing with challenging or intolerant callers.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Excellent telephone communication and client service skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Willingness to accept feedback, learn from mistakes, and continuously improve.
  • Strong follow-through and task management skills.
  • Ability to work independently while maintaining effective communication with attorneys and team members.
  • Professionalism and discretion when handling confidential and privileged information.

English, Portuguese, Spanish

jobs.excerpt: Chief Program Officer (CPO) – Insurance & Investments 1.
jobs.description:
Chief Program Officer (CPO) – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Chief Program Officer (CPO) is responsible for overseeing the organization's strategic programs, enterprise-wide initiatives, and complex, multi-project portfolios across its insurance and investment businesses.

The role ensures that major programs are strategically aligned, properly resourced, effectively governed, and successfully delivered within approved timelines and budgets. The CPO will establish program management standards, coordinate cross-functional teams, manage interdependent projects, and ensure that strategic initiatives deliver measurable business outcomes.

Working closely with the CEO, Board, and executive leadership team, the CPO will translate corporate priorities into coordinated programs that support business growth, operational excellence, digital transformation, regulatory compliance, and organizational development.

2. Key Responsibilities

Strategic Program Management

  • Develop and implement the organization's enterprise-wide program management strategy.
  • Identify, structure, prioritize, and oversee strategic programs aligned with corporate objectives.
  • Translate organizational strategies into coordinated programs with clear goals, milestones, deliverables, and expected outcomes.
  • Manage interdependencies between projects, business units, and strategic initiatives.
  • Monitor program performance and ensure alignment with organizational priorities.

Insurance & Investment Program Delivery

  • Lead strategic programs involving life insurance, general insurance, reinsurance, investment management, wealth management, and financial services.
  • Oversee programs related to insurance product development, underwriting modernization, claims transformation, policy administration, and distribution expansion.
  • Coordinate investment-related programs involving portfolio management systems, investment operations, client reporting, and service delivery, where applicable.
  • Manage initiatives involving regulatory changes, new business models, market expansion, and operational restructuring.
  • Ensure program deliverables address business requirements and relevant industry regulations.

Program Governance & Management Office

  • Establish and oversee program governance frameworks, methodologies, policies, and reporting standards.
  • Develop program charters, business cases, implementation plans, risk registers, and performance dashboards.
  • Implement structured review processes, approval mechanisms, escalation procedures, and executive reporting.
  • Ensure consistency in program management practices across subsidiaries and business units.
  • Work with the Project Management Office (PMO) to coordinate individual project delivery and maintain portfolio visibility.

Program Budget & Resource Management

  • Develop and oversee program budgets, resource plans, and financial forecasts.
  • Monitor program expenditure, financial performance, and budget variations.
  • Ensure effective allocation of people, technology, and financial resources across programs.
  • Evaluate program business cases, cost-benefit analysis, expected returns, and benefits realization.
  • Manage external consultants, contractors, technology vendors, and implementation partners.

Digital & Business Transformation Programs

  • Lead cross-functional programs involving digital transformation, automation, AI, cloud adoption, and enterprise system modernization.
  • Coordinate implementation of digital insurance platforms, customer portals, CRM systems, and investment service technologies.
  • Work with CIO, CTO, CDO, and business leaders to ensure technology programs deliver business value.
  • Oversee business process redesign, operational improvement, and organizational change initiatives.
  • Monitor adoption, implementation effectiveness, and long-term program outcomes.

Risk, Compliance & Quality Management

  • Identify, assess, and manage program-level operational, financial, regulatory, and technology risks.
  • Ensure programs comply with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.
  • Coordinate with risk, compliance, legal, and internal audit teams.
  • Establish mitigation strategies, contingency plans, and escalation mechanisms.
  • Monitor program quality and ensure deliverables meet approved standards.

Stakeholder & Executive Management

  • Collaborate with the CEO, Board, executive leadership, and business unit heads to define program priorities.
  • Coordinate communication and collaboration among project sponsors, program managers, and key stakeholders.
  • Manage relationships with regulators, external consultants, strategic partners, and implementation vendors, as appropriate.
  • Resolve conflicts involving program scope, resource allocation, timelines, and competing business priorities.
  • Present program progress, financial performance, key risks, and strategic recommendations to senior management.

Leadership & Program Management Excellence

  • Lead and develop program directors, program managers, project managers, and program delivery teams.
  • Build a high-performing program management function with clear accountability and performance standards.
  • Establish training, mentoring, and professional development initiatives.
  • Promote consistent program management methodologies and continuous improvement.
  • Introduce tools and reporting systems to improve program visibility, coordination, and delivery effectiveness.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Project Management, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • MBA or Master's degree in Program Management, Business Strategy, Finance, or a relevant discipline preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in program management, project portfolio management, enterprise transformation, or strategic initiative delivery.
  • At least 5 years in a senior leadership role overseeing large-scale, multi-project programs.
  • Experience in insurance, reinsurance, banking, investment management, asset management, wealth management, or financial services preferred.
  • Proven track record of successfully delivering complex, cross-functional programs with measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong knowledge of program governance, project management methodologies, budgeting, risk management, and resource planning.
  • Experience establishing or leading enterprise program management offices.
  • Familiarity with Agile, Waterfall, PRINCE2, PMI, and hybrid delivery methodologies.
  • Excellent leadership, strategic planning, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving capabilities.

Preferred Certifications:

  • Program Management Professional (PgMP).

- Project Management Professional (PMP).

  • Portfolio Management Professional (PfMP).

- PRINCE2 Practitioner.

- Agile or Scrum certifications.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Percentage of strategic programs delivered on time and within budget.
  • Program performance against approved strategic objectives.
  • Achievement of program milestones and deliverables.
  • Program budget variance and resource utilization.
  • Benefits realization and return on investment (ROI).
  • Effective management of project interdependencies.
  • Program risk mitigation and issue resolution effectiveness.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and executive reporting quality.
  • Compliance with program governance and reporting standards.
  • Successful delivery of digital, operational, and business transformation programs.
  • Reduction in program delays, cost overruns, and implementation risks.

jobs.excerpt: Become a part of our caring community Humana is seeking a Medicare Part D expert to join the team as a Lead Insurance Product Manager who is ready to shape PDP strategy, guide complex decisions and turn regulatory requirements into executable products.
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

Humana is seeking a Medicare Part D expert to join the team as a Lead Insurance Product Manager who is ready to shape PDP strategy, guide complex decisions and turn regulatory requirements into executable products. As Lead Insurance Product Manager for PDP Strategy & Execution, you’ll serve as the product lead for Humana’s standalone Prescription Drug Plan portfolio. You’ll connect Medicare Part D strategy to accurate, compliant and timely execution across the full product lifecycle, from early market and regulatory assessment through bid development, filing, implementation and annual readiness.

You’ll bring together Product, Pharmacy, Actuarial, Finance, Regulatory Compliance, Legal, Operations, Marketing, Sales, Digital, member communications and program delivery partners to make complex decisions, resolve competing priorities and translate approved strategy into a clear execution path. You’ll assess member, regulatory, financial and operational tradeoffs and provide recommendations that help leaders make informed decisions.

This role is designed for an advanced individual contributor who operates with significant independence, leads through expertise and influence, and raises the standard for PDP product management. You’ll guide other associates and work groups, establish methods and priorities for complex initiatives, strengthen governance and reusable tools, and build shared capability so critical knowledge and accountability extend beyond one subject matter expert.


Key Role Functions


Shape PDP Portfolio Strategy and Direction

  • Lead year-round PDP product strategy and execution, translating enterprise priorities, customer needs, market dynamics, regulatory requirements and financial considerations into actionable portfolio recommendations
  • Integrate competitive, financial, regulatory, operational and member insights to evaluate product opportunities, risks and tradeoffs
  • Analyze competitor participation, premiums, deductibles, cost sharing, formulary positioning and emerging market trends to identify implications for Humana’s PDP portfolio
  • Develop recommendations for new or enhanced benefits, product features and market approaches, including the business rationale, member impact, operational dependencies, risks and implementation path
  • Look beyond the immediate bid cycle to anticipate future portfolio needs, policy changes and market shifts and position partners for effective execution
  • Represent PDP Product Management in strategy and leadership forums, communicating the recommendation, supporting insights, tradeoffs and decisions needed

Lead PDP Bid, Benchmark and Filing Execution

  • Lead product strategy and readiness across the annual PDP bid cycle, including benefit design coordination, bid submission readiness, PBP Section Rx and HPMS activities, validation resolution and alignment across key functions
  • Coordinate benchmark, de minimis, rebate reallocation, desk review and related PDP activities, ensuring impacts, options, decisions and accountable owners are clear
  • Lead review and resolution of filing questions, validation findings, audit exhibits and other CMS submission issues, escalating material product risks at the appropriate time
  • Establish working plans, governance, decision points and controls that support accurate, timely and compliant submissions
  • Maintain clear records of assumptions, decisions, dependencies, risks, status and ownership throughout the bid cycle
  • Provide final product-level review and sign-off for designated PDP submissions and deliverables consistent with established governance

Translate Regulatory Change and Lead Feasibility

  • Interpret CMS guidance and Medicare Part D policy changes and translate them into clear product implications, requirements, decisions and downstream impacts
  • Lead feasibility assessments across product, regulatory, actuarial, financial, pharmacy, operational, technology and member-experience considerations
  • Separate immediate compliance needs from longer-term product opportunities and recommend a practical path forward when guidance or operating conditions are ambiguous
  • Lead Product participation in new Part D opportunities, including CMMI demonstrations and emerging pharmacy programs, from concept evaluation through implementation
  • Identify gaps in products, processes, controls or decision rights; use root-cause analysis to recommend sustainable solutions rather than one-time fixes

Drive Readiness, Implementation and Member Experience

  • Lead annual PDP readiness from bid approval through AEP and January 1 implementation, coordinating milestones, dependencies, issue resolution and leadership-level status reporting
  • Partner with Marketing, Sales, Digital, member-material and operational teams to ensure benefit messaging and product information are accurate, consistent and easy to understand
  • Provide PDP subject matter expertise for product data, member materials, digital tools, training, operational processes and downstream readiness
  • Partner with functional owners to confirm implemented benefits and member-facing information align with approved product decisions and CMS filings
  • Assess readiness and product risk using clear evidence, surface issues early and drive accountable owners toward resolution

Lead SPAP Strategy and Execution

  • Lead PDP Product support for State Pharmaceutical Assistance Program requests for information, evaluations, contracting support and implementations
  • Coordinate product requirements and decisions with state program contacts and internal Legal, Compliance, Pharmacy, Operations, Finance, member communications and implementation partners
  • Assess potential impacts to premiums, LIS coordination, member cost sharing, communications, systems and operational processes
  • Create clarity around scope, decision rights, dependencies and escalation paths and communicate material risks or unresolved decisions to leadership

Strengthen Governance, Quality and Product Capability

  • Establish and maintain standards, controls and reusable tools that strengthen quality, consistency and accountability across PDP strategy, filings and readiness
  • Use data, lessons learned and root-cause analysis to improve processes and reduce recurring defects, rework and unnecessary manual activity
  • Serve as the business subject matter expert for automation and product-data initiatives, translating Part D rules and user needs into practical business requirements and controls
  • Provide functional leadership, coaching and subject matter guidance to Product Managers and cross-functional partners without relying on formal authority
  • Lead associates and work groups in determining methods, analytical approaches, priorities and timelines for complex assignments
  • Build cross-training, documentation and backup coverage so critical knowledge is shared and the organization can operate with greater resilience

Influence Decisions and Lead Through Complexity

  • Facilitate decisions when member, regulatory, financial, operational and market considerations require tradeoffs
  • Exercise independent judgment on complex issues, distinguish material product risk from routine execution matters and escalate appropriately
  • Bring structure to ambiguous work by defining the problem, aligning stakeholders on the outcome and establishing a clear path to resolution
  • Communicate concise, evidence-based recommendations for working teams, senior leaders and executive audiences
  • Build trusted partnerships that allow issues to surface early and support timely, transparent decisions and collective accountability

Key Partnerships & Reporting Relationship

You’ll report to the Director, Insurance Product Management and serve as the primary CPES lead for PDP product strategy and execution. You’ll work closely with leaders and subject matter experts across Pharmacy, Part D Strategy, Actuarial, Finance, Regulatory Compliance, Legal, Operations, Marketing, Sales, Digital, Process Improvement & Program Delivery, member communications and other Product Management teams. This is an advanced individual-contributor role and does not require formal people-management authority.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 5+ years of relevant healthcare, health plan, Medicare, product management or related experience, including substantial Medicare Part D experience
  • Direct experience with standalone Prescription Drug Plans and the Medicare Part D product lifecycle
  • Experience leading Medicare Part D product strategy, bids, filings, benefit implementation or annual readiness activities
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret CMS regulatory, contractual or operational guidance and translate it into product requirements, decisions and execution plans
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex cross-functional projects, processes or work groups with minimal instruction
  • Proven ability to exercise independent judgment, analyze complex information and present clear recommendations and tradeoffs to senior leaders
  • Excellent written, verbal, facilitation and presentation skills
  • Ability to work extended hours and occasional weekends during critical CMS, bid and implementation periods

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep hands-on experience with PDP bid submission, PBP Section Rx, HPMS, audit exhibits, benchmark, de minimis, rebate reallocation or desk review activities
  • Knowledge of LIS, SPAP, formulary coordination, Part D member materials and AEP readiness
  • Experience with competitive intelligence, CMMI demonstrations or implementation of new CMS pharmacy initiatives
  • Experience developing business requirements for automation, process improvement, product data or benefit-authoring tools
  • Experience creating governance, quality controls, metrics or reusable operating mechanisms for complex product work
  • Experience coaching product professionals or leading work through indirect teams
  • Project management, Lean or related process-improvement certification

Additional Information

What Success Looks Like

  • Lead through expertise. Operate as an advanced Medicare Part D subject matter expert who independently determines methods, priorities and approaches for complex work
  • Create clarity from complexity. Translate ambiguous regulatory, financial and operational issues into clear recommendations, decisions, ownership and next steps
  • Think portfolio-first. Connect individual benefit and filing decisions to broader member value, market position, financial performance, compliance and enterprise priorities
  • Deliver with discipline. Enable accurate, timely and compliant bids, filings and readiness outcomes with risks surfaced early and decisions documented clearly
  • Influence across boundaries. Create alignment among leaders and functions with different priorities without relying on formal authority
  • Raise the standard. Build governance, controls, tools and repeatable practices that leave PDP Product Management stronger after each cycle
  • Build shared capability. Coach others, share knowledge and create durable backup coverage rather than concentrating expertise with one person
  • Focus on outcomes. Use data, sound judgment and functional expertise to move work from activity to measurable product, member and business outcomes
  • Anticipate what is next. Maintain a forward-looking view of regulatory, portfolio and operating needs while remaining accountable for near-term execution

How You’ll Lead

How you achieve results matters as much as what you deliver. You’ll bring the Humana Values and the Humana Way to life through customer-focused decisions, clarity, bold and responsible action, forward-looking planning and shared accountability.


  • Live by the Golden Rule by listening first, seeking to understand the member and partner experience, and remaining open to perspectives that challenge initial assumptions
  • Keep it simple by turning complex Part D requirements into clear insights, practical decisions and technology-enabled ways of working
  • Play to win by focusing on outcomes, taking calculated risks, making timely decisions and learning quickly when conditions change
  • Keep your eyes on the horizon by anticipating regulatory and market shifts, establishing the endpoint and dynamically adjusting the roadmap
  • Play as one team by sharing expertise and capacity, strengthening cross-functional collaboration and holding partners collectively accountable for the outcome

Role Expectations

  • Operate with significant independence within established enterprise, segment and functional strategies, policies and governance
  • Serve as a P4 Lead-level individual contributor: an advanced subject matter expert who establishes priorities and timelines, leads complex projects and processes, and provides direction to work groups
  • Exercise independent judgment on complex and diverse issues and develop creative, practical solutions using deep experience and knowledge of best practices
  • Influence functional strategy and results through recommendations, decision leadership, process improvement and cross-functional execution
  • Balance strategic thinking with hands-on ownership of critical PDP decisions and deliverables
  • Lead multiple high-priority workstreams, reprioritize quickly and remain effective during compressed CMS and bid-cycle timelines
  • Create sustainable improvements rather than relying on individual heroics or repeated escalation
  • The work follows the annual Medicare Part D and CMS regulatory cycle. Certain periods require additional flexibility, including extended hours and occasional weekend work, to meet critical regulatory and business deadlines

Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Additionally, the role involves performing account, user, and API setup for clients and helping the business identify processes and notifications that can be automated. This position ensures our managed service clients receive a reliable, hands-off compliance experience.

How our Compliance Data Specialist spends their time

  • Data transfer (60%): Move background screening results, driver records, and supporting documents from Verified First into the AccredTech platform accurately and on time, verifying data integrity at each step;
  • Document management (10%): Assign documents to the correct driver files and requirements, and flag missing, expired, incomplete, or non-compliant items for follow-up;
  • Client communication (10%): Alert and correspond with clients as needed, following each client’s specified process for notifications, escalations, and approvals;
  • Process improvement and automation (10%): Help inform the business by identifying repetitive tasks, recurring issues, and notification gaps, and partner with Product and Development to automate specific processes and notifications;
  • Account setup (10%): Perform account, user, and API setup for clients as needed, ensuring configurations match client requirements;
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What you bring

  • Ability to maintain regular and punctual attendance;
  • Ability to communicate effectively, including the ability to manage client expectations and resolve conflict professionally;
  • Ability to be held accountable to department and organizational numbers, data, and deadlines;
  • Ability to quickly pivot, be process-oriented, with high attention to detail and data accuracy;
  • Ability to manage high-volume, repetitive work while maintaining quality and consistency;
  • Demonstrate and promote non-negotiable integrity and dignity of the individual in an environment of mutual trust and respect;
  • Maintain discretion in working with sensitive and confidential information, including driver and personally identifiable information (PII);
  • Exhibit a commitment to lifelong learning, encourage others to do so, and continue to grow technically and interpersonally to perform the job at the highest levels of competency;
  • Demonstration of a servant-leadership mindset toward all, evidenced by client satisfaction;
  • Encourage a direct and positive relationship between community and company.

Preferred Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required. Associate’s or Bachelor’s Degree preferred;
  • Minimum of 1 year of experience in data entry, records management, compliance administration, or a similar detail-oriented role;
  • Knowledge of DOT/FMCSA driver qualification file (DQF) requirements (49 CFR Part 391) preferred;
  • Knowledge of the background screening industry and products preferred;
  • Intermediate level of analytical and problem-solving skills;
  • Advanced written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences;
  • Basic understanding of APIs, integrations, and user/permission setup in SaaS platforms preferred;
  • Interest in process improvement and automation; experience with workflow or automation tools a plus;
  • Minimum of 1 year of experience using Jira, Slack, Confluence, Salesforce, or similar tools;
  • Proficient with G-Suite and Microsoft Office Applications, especially spreadsheets.

What we bring:

  • Growth: Continue to learn with continuous education, career pathing, and ongoing training. You won’t stall here, growth is part of our success;

Verified First’s Talent Acquisition team is hiring on behalf of AccredTech and will be reviewing resumes. If you are among the qualified candidates, you will receive an email or a phone call to schedule an interview.

jobs.description:
Group Head of Project Management Office (PMO) – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Group Head of PMO is responsible for leading and overseeing the Group's project management function across all subsidiaries, business units, and geographical markets within the Insurance & Investments sector.

The role establishes group-wide project governance, portfolio management standards, delivery frameworks, and performance monitoring systems to ensure that strategic projects and transformation initiatives are executed effectively. The position provides centralized oversight of project priorities, budgets, resources, risks, dependencies, and expected business outcomes.

Working closely with the Group CEO, executive leadership, subsidiary CEOs, and business heads, the Group Head of PMO ensures that all major projects support the organization's strategic growth, operational efficiency, digital transformation, and long-term business objectives.

2. Key Responsibilities

Group PMO Strategy & Governance

  • Develop and implement the Group's overall Project Management Office strategy, structure, and operating framework.
  • Establish standardized project management methodologies, governance policies, procedures, and reporting requirements across all subsidiaries.
  • Define project approval processes, stage-gate reviews, escalation procedures, and accountability frameworks.
  • Ensure project portfolios are aligned with the Group's strategic objectives and business priorities.
  • Establish consistent project management standards and controls across geographical markets and business units.

Strategic Project Portfolio Management

  • Oversee the consolidated project portfolio across insurance, investment, corporate, and operational business units.
  • Evaluate, prioritize, and monitor strategic projects based on business value, financial impact, risk exposure, and resource requirements.
  • Monitor project progress, milestones, dependencies, budgets, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Identify underperforming projects and recommend corrective actions or changes in resource allocation.
  • Provide executive leadership with a consolidated view of project portfolio performance.

Insurance & Investment Project Oversight

  • Oversee group-wide projects involving insurance product development, underwriting, claims management, policy administration, and distribution expansion.
  • Monitor investment-related projects involving portfolio reporting, investment operations, wealth management platforms, and client servicing, where applicable.
  • Coordinate strategic initiatives involving regulatory compliance, business process modernization, and operational efficiency.
  • Support the implementation of new financial products, business models, and market expansion initiatives.
  • Ensure projects meet relevant insurance, investment, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.

Digital Transformation & Technology Projects

  • Provide governance and oversight for group-wide technology modernization and digital transformation initiatives.
  • Coordinate implementation of enterprise systems, CRM platforms, automation solutions, AI applications, and digital financial services.
  • Work with CIO, CTO, CDO, and business leadership to ensure successful technology project delivery.
  • Monitor system integration, implementation risks, technology budgets, and business adoption.
  • Ensure digital initiatives deliver measurable improvements in customer experience and operational performance.

Financial & Resource Management

  • Oversee consolidated project budgets, financial forecasts, and expenditure tracking across the Group.
  • Monitor project cost performance and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
  • Coordinate resource allocation across subsidiaries, departments, and strategic initiatives.
  • Evaluate project business cases, cost-benefit analysis, ROI, and expected benefits.
  • Ensure effective utilization of internal teams, external consultants, contractors, and implementation partners.

Risk, Compliance & Quality Management

  • Establish group-level project risk management and escalation frameworks.
  • Monitor operational, financial, regulatory, technology, and implementation risks across project portfolios.
  • Coordinate with group risk, compliance, legal, and internal audit functions.
  • Ensure projects comply with internal policies, governance standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Establish contingency and mitigation plans for critical projects and strategic programs.

Performance Reporting & Benefits Realization

  • Develop group-wide project dashboards, performance reports, and executive presentations.
  • Monitor project delivery against approved scope, budgets, timelines, milestones, and quality standards.
  • Track financial benefits, operational improvements, and ROI from strategic initiatives.
  • Prepare regular portfolio performance reports for the Group CEO, Board, and executive committees.
  • Recommend strategic interventions to improve project execution and delivery performance.

Stakeholder & Subsidiary Management

  • Work closely with subsidiary CEOs, managing directors, business unit heads, project sponsors, and program directors.
  • Facilitate group-level project steering committees and portfolio review meetings.
  • Coordinate project planning and delivery across subsidiaries and corporate functions.
  • Manage relationships with external consultants, technology vendors, contractors, and implementation partners.
  • Ensure consistent communication, accountability, and reporting across all Group entities.

Leadership & PMO Capability Development

  • Lead and develop the Group PMO team, including PMO directors, project managers, project analysts, and project controls specialists.
  • Establish PMO structures, responsibilities, and reporting relationships across subsidiaries.
  • Develop project management training, mentoring, and capability-building initiatives.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, transparency, collaboration, and delivery excellence.
  • Drive continuous improvement in project management maturity across the organization.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Project Management, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • MBA or Master's degree in Project Management, Business Strategy, Finance, or a relevant discipline preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in project management, program management, portfolio management, or enterprise transformation.
  • At least 5 years in a senior PMO leadership position overseeing multiple business units, subsidiaries, or large project portfolios.
  • Experience in insurance, reinsurance, banking, investment management, asset management, wealth management, or diversified financial services.
  • Proven track record of establishing or leading enterprise-level or group-level PMO functions.
  • Strong knowledge of project portfolio governance, financial management, resource planning, risk management, and strategic execution.
  • Experience managing complex, multi-country or multi-entity projects and transformation programs.
  • Knowledge of PMI, PRINCE2, Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid project management methodologies.
  • Strong leadership, executive communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and analytical capabilities.

Preferred Certifications:

- Project Management Professional (PMP).

  • Program Management Professional (PgMP).
  • Portfolio Management Professional (PfMP).

- PRINCE2 Practitioner.

- Agile or Scrum certifications.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Percentage of group-wide projects delivered on time and within approved budgets.
  • Overall project portfolio performance against Group strategic objectives.
  • Project cost variance and schedule variance.
  • Group PMO governance and reporting compliance.
  • Successful delivery of strategic insurance and investment initiatives.
  • Project risk identification, mitigation, and escalation effectiveness.
  • Resource utilization and allocation efficiency across subsidiaries.
  • Benefits realization and ROI of major strategic projects.
  • Accuracy and timeliness of consolidated project reporting.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction across Group entities.
  • Improvement in project management maturity across subsidiaries.
  • Reduction in project delays, cost overruns, and implementation risks.

Working closely with the Group CEO, executive leadership, subsidiary CEOs, and business heads, the Group Head of PMO ensures that all major projects support the organization's strategic growth, operational efficiency, digital transformation, and long-term business objectives.

2. Key Responsibilities

Group PMO Strategy & Governance

Strategic Project Portfolio Management

Insurance & Investment Project Oversight

Digital Transformation & Technology Projects

  • Provide governance and oversight for group-wide technology modernization and digital transformation initiatives.

  • Monitor system integration, implementation risks, technology budgets, and business adoption.
  • Ensure digital initiatives deliver measurable improvements in customer experience and operational performance.

Financial & Resource Management

  • Oversee consolidated project budgets, financial forecasts, and expenditure tracking across the Group.
  • Monitor project cost performance and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
  • Coordinate resource allocation across subsidiaries, departments, and strategic initiatives.
  • Evaluate project business cases, cost-benefit analysis, ROI, and expected benefits.
  • Ensure effective utilization of internal teams, external consultants, contractors, and implementation partners.

Risk, Compliance & Quality Management

  • Establish group-level project risk management and escalation frameworks.
  • Monitor operational, financial, regulatory, technology, and implementation risks across project portfolios.
  • Coordinate with group risk, compliance, legal, and internal audit functions.
  • Ensure projects comply with internal policies, governance standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Establish contingency and mitigation plans for critical projects and strategic programs.

Performance Reporting & Benefits Realization

  • Develop group-wide project dashboards, performance reports, and executive presentations.
  • Monitor project delivery against approved scope, budgets, timelines, milestones, and quality standards.
  • Track financial benefits, operational improvements, and ROI from strategic initiatives.
  • Prepare regular portfolio performance reports for the Group CEO, Board, and executive committees.
  • Recommend strategic interventions to improve project execution and delivery performance.

Stakeholder & Subsidiary Management

  • Work closely with subsidiary CEOs, managing directors, business unit heads, project sponsors, and program directors.
  • Facilitate group-level project steering committees and portfolio review meetings.
  • Coordinate project planning and delivery across subsidiaries and corporate functions.
  • Manage relationships with external consultants, technology vendors, contractors, and implementation partners.
  • Ensure consistent communication, accountability, and reporting across all Group entities.

Leadership & PMO Capability Development

  • Lead and develop the Group PMO team, including PMO directors, project managers, project analysts, and project controls specialists.
  • Establish PMO structures, responsibilities, and reporting relationships across subsidiaries.
  • Develop project management training, mentoring, and capability-building initiatives.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, transparency, collaboration, and delivery excellence.
  • Drive continuous improvement in project management maturity across the organization.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Project Management, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • MBA or Master's degree in Project Management, Business Strategy, Finance, or a relevant discipline preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in project management, program management, portfolio management, or enterprise transformation.
  • At least 5 years in a senior PMO leadership position overseeing multiple business units, subsidiaries, or large project portfolios.

  • Strong knowledge of project portfolio governance, financial management, resource planning, risk management, and strategic execution.
  • Experience managing complex, multi-country or multi-entity projects and transformation programs.
  • Knowledge of PMI, PRINCE2, Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid project management methodologies.
  • Strong leadership, executive communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and analytical capabilities.

Preferred Certifications:

Director, Automation and Enablement | United States | Remote

Pax8 is hiring a Director, Automation and Enablement in the United States to shape how automation, technology, and smarter workflows create capacity, improve productivity, and help our Americas business scale.


🚀 Build something that will change how work gets done

This is a rare opportunity to lead in genuinely greenfield space.

You’ll help decide where automation can make the biggest difference across the Americas. Rather than chasing technology for technology’s sake, you’ll start with real business problems, understand how people work today, and determine whether automation, artificial intelligence, process redesign, or another solution can make that work better.

You’ll have the autonomy to experiment, prioritize where we invest, and influence senior leaders on how Pax8 scales. And as our technology evolves, you and your team will grow alongside it, helping define what great automation and enablement look like at Pax8.


🌎 Bring your ideas to Pax8

We believe technology is most valuable when it makes work meaningfully better for people. This role sits right at that intersection, connecting technology, operations, product thinking, and the people ultimately using what we build.

Get a feel for Pax8 and our culture and explore the latest from our US Newsroom.


🛠️ What you’ll take ownership of

Shape the automation roadmap

  • Find the operational friction that is holding teams back and turn it into a clear portfolio of opportunities.
  • Prioritize based on measurable value, scalability, capacity, and business impact rather than who shouts the loudest.
  • Represent the Americas in broader conversations around automation and emerging technology, ensuring regional needs influence enterprise direction.

Lead Workflow Engineering

  • Give a growing team clear direction, priorities, and the environment to experiment and deliver.
  • Bring product discipline to the work through thoughtful backlogs, sprint planning, testing, iteration, and measurable outcomes.
  • Create repeatable ways of working that allow the function to move from individual wins to scalable delivery.

Turn ideas into better ways of working

  • Look beyond individual features to understand the complete workflow and the people behind it.
  • Explore where traditional automation, artificial intelligence, process improvement, or a combination of approaches can remove unnecessary work.
  • Deliver early, visible wins while building the framework for larger and more complex improvements.

Make adoption part of the solution

  • Ensure what we build actually gets used.
  • Work directly with business teams to understand their needs, test solutions, remove adoption barriers, and embed new capabilities into everyday work.
  • Measure utilization and value so we know whether an improvement really improved anything.

Influence across Pax8

  • Partner with senior leaders across Operations, Product, Engineering, and other functions to align priorities and manage competing demands.
  • Bring informed recommendations to senior and executive conversations and be comfortable constructively challenging an idea when there is a better path.
  • Connect regional innovation with the broader Pax8 approach to responsible, scalable automation.


💡 The impact you’ll make

The goal is bigger than simply automating tasks.

Early success will mean understanding where the greatest opportunities sit, earning the trust of key stakeholders, delivering tangible quick wins, and establishing a repeatable model that can scale.

As the function grows, the work you lead in the Americas can also help influence how automation and Workflow Engineering evolve across Pax8 globally.


🧩 You’ll be ideal for us if you

  • Bring extensive experience across product, operations, technology, automation, or workflow improvement, ideally with experience crossing more than one of those areas.
  • Have proven people leadership experience and enjoy leading small, highly capable teams where people need direction without unnecessary layers.
  • Think with a product mindset: outcomes first, clear prioritization, iterative delivery, user feedback, and measurable value.
  • Have enough technical depth to understand how solutions are built. You may have coded, automated workflows, worked closely with development teams, or built technology-enabled solutions yourself.
  • Can point to meaningful improvements you’ve led that increased efficiency, productivity, effectiveness, or organizational capacity.
  • Understand how software and product development lifecycles operate, including backlogs, sprints, testing, releases, and continuous improvement.
  • Are comfortable working with platforms such as Jira and Confluence, or comparable product and workflow management tools.
  • Understand artificial intelligence and emerging technologies without assuming artificial intelligence is automatically the answer to every problem.
  • Can move comfortably from process mapping and operational discovery to solution design, prioritization, delivery, and adoption.
  • Are confident working with senior and executive stakeholders who may have competing priorities, and can make clear, evidence-based trade-offs.
  • Care as much about whether people use and value a solution as you do about delivering it.
  • Thrive when the destination is clear but the route has not been built yet.

Experience with Lean Six Sigma, product ownership, Agile delivery, change management, Microsoft Power Platform, Copilot, or similar disciplines can be valuable, but we care most about what you have actually built, improved, and enabled.

jobs.description:
JOB OVERVIEW:

The Equipment Coordination Specialist will be responsible for managing the post-order procurement process for dental equipment and supplies and ensuring the team is tracking toward the quarterly/annual Risk and Opportunity (RO) targets. This role supports the respective district(s) by ensuring installations are coordinated internally and externally in accordance with our policies and procedures to facilitate the timely delivery and installation of dental equipment.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Manages the entire district installation process by working with the District Managers and Sales Representatives to determine appropriate installation dates and ensure all projects are current and on track with quarterly/annual RO. Leads the coordination of any installation date changes that may occur during the planning process.
  • Ensures all preparation is completed prior to the start of weekly Equipment Planning Meetings (EPMs), including scheduling customers; inputting current estimated shipping details and notes into internal software systems; daily/weekly adjustment of projected installation dates; manages the solutioning of credit issues; validates ‘Order Terms’ compliance prior to installation; and works directly with 3PL (or respective Henry Schein facilities) to ensure equipment is staged for delivery.
  • In conjunction with the District Manager, prepares for and leads all EPM for respective assigned district(s) to ensure equipment racking/anticipated arrivals and customer scheduling are transparent and seamless throughout the last-mile portion of the installation process.
  • Completes daily invoicing per order terms upon delivery/installation of equipment, including ensuring all credit and financial approvals are in place, and handles escalations as required.
  • Manages the entire equipment return process by ensuring equipment is received at the appropriate Henry Schein facility. Proactively vets the entire approval process based on the value and age of the equipment by ensuring all approval levels have been obtained. Handles escalations to ensure the return process is properly executed.
  • Processes all orders submitted by Sales as delayed deliveries and validates that delayed deliveries meet all financial documentation requirements. As delayed deliveries come due, ensures documentation is prepared and completed prior to quarter end.
  • Communicates directly with Equipment Specialists on a weekly basis to ensure alignment with order status and forecasted projections/commitments.
  • Ensures orders that were approved on an exception basis for RPOs have credit approval in place no later than 30 days before the projected installation date.
  • Collaborates daily with the respective Installation Manager to discuss the installation schedule and identify technician availability and requirements for scheduling purposes.
  • Provides financial accounting with the proper proof of delivery documents for entered equipment orders based on audit sent by the Financial Inventory Team. Verifies with Equipment Service Technicians and local management for revenue recognition.
  • Acts as back up for colleagues in other markets.
  • Other duties and special projects as assigned.

SPECIFIC KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Microsoft Office: Microsoft Word, moderate to advanced Excel knowledge and Power Point.
  • Knowledge of and the ability to learn general database applications.
  • Exceptional communication and organizational skills.
  • Ability to learn company software and systems, including project management tools
  • Understand and act on financial information that may contribute to business profitability
  • Project management skills to drive business results and an understanding of industry practices and company policies and procedures.
  • Strong decision making, analysis and problem-solving skills with ability to multi-task.

GENERAL SKILLS & COMPETENCIES:

  • Good understanding of industry practices
  • Proficient with tools, systems, and procedures
  • Basic planning/organizational skills and techniques
  • Good decision making, analysis and problem solving skills with ability to multi-task
  • Good verbal and written communication skills
  • Good presentation and public speaking skills
  • Good interpersonal skills
  • Basic conflict resolution skills
  • Developing professional credibility

MINIMUM WORK EXPERIENCE:

Typically 3 to 5 or more years of increasing responsibility in terms of any applicable professional experience.


PREFERRED EDUCATION:

jobs.excerpt: ROLE TITLECommercial Property Manager We are looking for Virtual Professionals based in the Philippines.
jobs.description:
ROLE TITLE

Commercial Property Manager

We are looking for Virtual Professionals based in the Philippines.

  • This is a fully remote Commercial Property Manager position.
  • Applications with an introduction video attached will be prioritized.
  • Due to the fully remote nature of this role, it is important that candidates are comfortable communicating on video calls.

ROLE SUMMARY

The Commercial Property Manager supports the day-to-day operations of a commercial property in Indianapolis, keeping leasing, tenant requests, maintenance, property information, and documentation moving without constant supervision.

You will manage multiple active workflows at once, including prospective tenant and application activity, lease paperwork, move-ins and move-outs, maintenance requests, vacancy updates, floor plan changes, tenant concerns, events, and property documents. The role requires consistent follow-through: identifying what needs to happen next, gathering missing information, coordinating with tenants, vendors, architects, and the property team, and tracking each item through completion.

This is an execution-heavy role for someone who can work independently, manage competing priorities, and make sound decisions about when to act, when to follow up, and when to escalate. You should not need a daily task list to stay productive or wait for someone else to tell you the next step.

If you are strongest in narrowly defined administrative tasks and require frequent direction to move work forward, this role is not a fit.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Property Marketing and Vacancy Updates

• Keep commercial vacancies current on LoopNet MLS, including unit status, availability, renovations, and other relevant property information.

• Coordinate with the current architect when floor plans need to be updated because of changes to the property or individual units.

• Maintain accurate unit information across property marketing materials and internal records so vacancy information does not become outdated.

• Eventually take ownership of updating floor plans using AutoCAD or another floor plan editing tool.

Leasing Support

• Support the screening of new rental applications by gathering, organizing, and reviewing the required information before moving the application to the next step.

• Communicate with prospective tenants and applicants throughout the leasing process and respond to questions or missing information promptly.

• Assist with preparing lease documents and associated paperwork, ensuring required information is complete and organized.

• Coordinate lease signings and follow up on outstanding documentation rather than allowing paperwork to stall.

• Coordinate move-in and move-out processes and ensure the necessary information, documents, and follow-ups are completed.

• Support lease renewal activity by tracking upcoming renewals and coordinating the required next steps.

Maintenance and Work Order Management

• When a tenant reports a maintenance issue, gather enough information to understand what is happening, determine the appropriate next step, and avoid sending incomplete information to Jennifer or a vendor.

• Coordinate with internal team and vendors when repairs or maintenance are required.

• Track open maintenance requests through completion and follow up when a vendor response, update, or repair is delayed.

• Keep work order information current so the team can see what has been reported, who is handling it, what action is pending, and whether the issue has been resolved.

• Escalate issues when the available information is insufficient, the situation requires a decision outside your authority, or progress has stalled.

Document Control

• Develop and maintain standardized formats for forms and documents used across the organization.

• Apply consistent document layouts, fonts, formatting, and other readability standards rather than creating documents with inconsistent presentation.

• Keep documents organized and accessible so the correct version can be located without unnecessary back-and-forth.

• Manage multiple documents simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and consistency.

Tenant Concierge

• Respond to tenant and guest requests involving common areas, events, Wi-Fi access, and building access.

• Determine what information or action is required for each request and coordinate with the appropriate person or vendor when the request cannot be resolved directly.

• Plan, organize, and coordinate building events, including vendor coordination and space setup.

• Ensure events and tenant activities follow applicable building rules and requirements.

Requirements

(NON-NEGOTIABLE)

• Proven work experience in property management, with the ability to handle actual property-management workflows rather than only general administrative support.

• Strong written and verbal English communication. You will communicate with tenants, applicants, vendors, architects, and internal stakeholders, so unclear or incomplete communication creates operational problems.

• Excellent proficiency in AppFolio or other property-management operational systems.

• Ability to manage multiple active property-management tasks and documents at the same time without losing track of follow-ups.

• Strong problem-solving ability. When a tenant reports an issue, you must be able to gather the relevant facts, identify the next action, and escalate appropriately instead of simply forwarding the complaint.

• Strong attention to detail, particularly when maintaining vacancy information, lease documentation, work orders, tenant records, and standardized documents.

• Ability to work independently in a remote, async environment and make routine execution decisions without requiring constant supervision.

• Ability to communicate early when an issue is blocked, information is missing, or a decision needs to be made by someone else.

• Comfort working across leasing, maintenance, tenant support, marketing, and document-management tasks rather than operating within a single narrow workflow.

TOOLS

• AppFolio

• LoopNet MLS

• Google Suite

• Slack
• Dropbox
• DocuSign
• AutoCAD or another floor plan editing software

WHAT WE ACTUALLY CARE ABOUT

• You close loops. When a tenant, applicant, vendor, or internal stakeholder needs something, you track the request through the next required action instead of assuming someone else will follow up.

• You can work from incomplete information. You know what questions to ask, what information is missing, and when an issue needs escalation.

• You protect accuracy. Vacancy information, lease documents, work orders, floor plans, and property records need to stay current because other people act on that information.

• You can switch between priorities without dropping details. Leasing activity, maintenance requests, tenant questions, and document work may be active simultaneously.

• You communicate operationally. Updates should make it clear what happened, what is pending, who owns the next action, and when follow-up is required.

• You take ownership of recurring processes. Once a workflow is understood, you should be able to execute it consistently without requiring the same instructions repeatedly.

WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

• This is not a passive administrative VA role where you wait for someone to assign every next step.

• This is not a customer-service-only position. Tenant communication must be connected to actual property-management follow-through.

• This is not a pure leasing or sales position. The role also covers maintenance coordination, document control, property marketing, and tenant/building support.

• This is not a role where maintenance complaints are simply forwarded to the property manager or vendor without gathering information and tracking the issue.

• This is not a role for someone who is uncomfortable managing several open requests and documents at the same time.

POSITION DETAILS

  • Work Arrangement: Remote
  • Work Hours: US-aligned work hours
  • Work Style: Performance-driven, async environment with an expectation of independent execution
  • Engagement Structure: Virtual/remote staffing engagement; specific engagement terms are provided during the hiring process

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

To apply, submit your resume and a short introduction explaining your commercial property-management experience.

Your application must also answer this scenario:

A tenant reports that their office has lost Wi-Fi access and says they have an important client meeting in one hour. They also mention that the building access door is intermittently failing. You have no immediate confirmation that either issue is affecting other tenants.

In 5–8 sentences, explain:

  1. What information you would gather first.
  2. Who you would contact or coordinate with.
  3. How you would prioritize the two issues.
  4. How you would track and communicate the status until resolution.

We are specifically looking for evidence of how you think through an active property-management issue, not a generic statement about being organized or proactive.

Benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Health Maintenance Organization (HMO)
  • Fully Remote Work

  • Produce recurring capacity reporting and dashboards; surface constraint and threshold-breach risks to the DC Management
  • Translate server/storage/network demand forecasts into rack-level deployment plans and site allocation recommendations
  • Partner with Deployment Engineering and DC Ops on rack elevations, placement, and burn-down of installed vs. reserved capacity
  • Maintain data accuracy in DCIM/asset systems; drive reconciliation between DCIM, AssetDB, and physical audits

jobs.description:
Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world’s leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Our broad range of services, solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Song, together with our culture of shared success and commitment to creating 360° value, enable us to help our clients reinvent and build trusted, lasting relationships. We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners and communities. Visit us at accenture.com.

Consulting professionals at Accenture belong to one of three workgroups: Management Consulting, Systems Integration Consulting or Technology Consulting. These workgroups enable us to deliver the increasingly specialized skills that clients demand while providing our people with varied career opportunities.

Our management consultants have the opportunity to work and collaborate with colleagues from across the full spectrum of consulting activity: identifying and creatively solving complex problems, designing and re-engineering critical processes, and fundamentally transforming the way a company operates. Our management consultants are more than just theorists - they turn theory into action. Acting as trusted advisors to our clients, they work directly with FORTUNE© Global 500 companies across many different industry sectors. They concentrate on getting a holistic view of a client's business and industry environment and use their expertise and critical thinking skills to design and deliver realistic, achievable business strategies and solutions that address key client priorities.

Much of the work we do is at the cutting edge of innovation and thinking. We involve our consultants in publishing and sharing this knowledge as thought leadership to benefit clients, industry and fellow colleagues.

You are:

As a Patient Access & Experience Manager in our Health Provider business, you lead and support patient access and experience transformations for complex provider organizations such as national and regional health systems, academic medical centers, IDNs, and large medical groups. You bring deep expertise in access transformation, including scheduling optimization, workflow and throughput efficiencies, digital patient experience and self-service, and contact center performance, along with working knowledge of the broader patient journey. You know how to take an engagement from assessment through implementation, and you hold yourself accountable for results.

You build relationships with operational, clinical and digital leaders across areas impacting patient access and experience, and you know how to communicate findings in a way that leads to action. You’re comfortable managing up and managing across, keeping clients aligned, teams moving, and workstreams on track. You understand that good transformation work isn’t just about recommendations; it’s about bringing people along with you.

You stay current on how AI and automation are reshaping patient access and experience, from advanced capabilities in scheduling and virtual agents to digital self-service and personalized outreach, and you help clients translate those advances into practical, scalable improvements. You also know how to develop people, and you take that part of the job seriously.

The work:

Shape and Deliver Business Transformation Projects

  • Lead end-to-end patient access and experience engagements for complex, large-scale health care providers, with deep expertise across scheduling workflow and template optimization, referral and intake management, registration, contact center operations, digital front door, and patient communications and engagement
  • Reimagine and redesign access operating models. Lead workflow redesign, policy and procedure development, organizational and workforce realignment, and the design of KPIs and performance governance frameworks tied to appointment conversion and utilization, no-show and leakage reduction, call abandonment, digital engagement, and patient satisfaction
  • Identify and prioritize client value creation opportunities based on rigorous analysis, developing business cases and value propositions, benchmarking, and a clear-eyed view of performance gaps and strategic priorities
  • Develop implementation plans and lead cross-functional teams to deliver project outcomes on schedule, within budget, and against defined performance targets. Direct business pilots and client deployment activities and ensure planned outcomes are achieved and sustained after go-live
  • Embed AI, automation, and advanced analytics into patient access and experience operations to drive measurable improvement, applying advanced capabilities to analyze capacity and demand, model scheduling scenarios, and target use cases such as virtual agents, intelligent scheduling, digital deflection and self-service, personalized outreach, and agent assistance for contact centers
  • Advise clients on digital front door strategy, consumer engagement, and omnichannel access to address provider capacity constraints and meet rising patient expectations
  • Support technology enablement across provider IT, EHRs, and patient engagement platforms (e.g., CRM, contact center, scheduling and self-service tools), advising on business requirements, system optimization, interoperability, and workflow configuration aligned to access and experience objectives
  • Design and execute the engagement’s overall communication and change management approach, tailored to the client’s organizational culture and readiness.
  • Manage engagement risk, project economics, deliverable quality, and client satisfaction throughout the engagement lifecycle

Client Relationship Development and Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key client stakeholders, typically including VP and director level leaders across access and ambulatory operations, digital / IT and consumer engagement. Engage periodically with physicians and steering committee-level stakeholders.
  • Facilitate complex meetings, executive presentations, and cross-functional workshops that build client commitment, resolve competing priorities, and move transformation forward.
  • Cultivate follow-on opportunities and develop business cases and proposals that connect Accenture’s capabilities to client priorities, while managing engagement economics including budgets, revenue forecasting, and margin performance

Practice Building

  • Contribute to practice-building activities including conference participation, thought leadership development, market offering design, and recruiting
  • Develop and share recognized expertise in specific patient access and experience domains, such as access transformation, digital engagement, or contact center modernization, contributing to internal methodology, toolkits, and knowledge assets that strengthen Accenture’s market position
  • Coach and mentor consultants and analysts, setting high standards for analytical rigor and client communication while actively supporting their professional development and career growth
  • Stay current on the regulations, consumer trends, and technology shaping patient access and experience across hospitals, health systems, medical groups, and ambulatory settings

• Travel as needed, up to 80%

Here’s What You Need

  • Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business, or a related field
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience leading patient access and experience transformation-related initiatives, across both business and technical aspects, including program planning and management, process design and optimization, experience working through organizational change, and excellent communication and presentation abilities
  • Minimum 3 years of consulting / advisory experience with healthcare provider and/or payer clients
  • Minimum 3 years experience in healthcare provider operations and customer experience capabilities – including patient access, patient experience, contact center, digital engagement, and/or CRM

Bonus points if:

  • Experience in ambulatory / clinic operations and/or physician enterprise environments, including practice operations and workflows, organizational design, and/or financial modeling
  • Working knowledge of EHR platforms and capabilities; in particular, Epic functional knowledge of patient access and engagement, self-service and outreach modules / capabilities
  • Working knowledge of contact center solutions (e.g. CCaaS, WFM, QM), CRM solutions (e.g. Salesforce, MS Dynamics), and/or patient engagement digital solutions (e.g. web / portal, AI / digital assistant)
  • Experience advising on or deploying AI, automation, and RPA in patient access / engagement context, such as contact center agent assist, conversational AI, etc.
  • MBA, MHA, or equivalent advanced degree

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.


Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.


We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer (individual contributor) to join our Voice Platform team as a hands-on senior engineer for high-performance, network-facing services that power real-time voice communications for Genesys Cloud contact centers worldwide. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced engineer who is strong in Java, AI and cloud backend development, proficient (or eager to grow) in C and systems-level software, skilled in networking and Linux, and motivated to deepen expertise in SIP/VoIP and voice-platform systems.

This is a deep technical role, not a people-management role. You will spend your time designing and building, work across cloud backend microservices, serverless components, and systems-level software, and raise the technical bar through hands-on contribution. Prior SIP/VoIP or contact-center experience is a plus, not a strict requirement. If you enjoy complex distributed systems, production ownership, and solving hard problems while continuing to learn a specialized domain, this is a high-impact opportunity.

Key Responsibilities

The primary responsibilities for this role include (but are not limited to):

  • Design, develop, and deliver scalable cloud backend and voice-platform services that support real-time communications with high reliability and operational excellence.
  • Hands-on implement backend microservices in Java and Spring Boot, along with Python-based serverless functions (AWS Lambda) for event-driven and automation workloads.
  • building AI bots, agents using latest tech stack like MCP, RAG, vector database, guardrails, langchain framework.
  • Develop and maintain systems software in C, including work with network-facing and open-source platform components (e.g. OpenSIPS/SIP routing) used in real-time communications.
  • Contribute to full-stack features, including React-based UIs and operational tooling, where needed.
  • Build and operate services on AWS, ensuring scalable, observable, and production-ready solutions.
  • Apply strong networking and Linux systems skills to develop, integrate, and troubleshoot real-time communications workloads.
  • Apply deep understanding of multithreading, concurrency, and thread-safety to design and troubleshoot high-throughput, low-latency services.
  • Build fluency in SIP/VoIP and Genesys voice-platform concepts and apply them effectively in your work.
  • Own troubleshooting of complex production issues spanning networking, systems, and service layers; drive root-cause analysis and lasting fixes using observability tooling such as SumoLogic and New Relic.
  • Drive strong system design: translate ambiguous requirements into clear architecture, make sound trade-offs, and document decisions for scalability, fault tolerance, and maintainability.
  • Collaborate with product, architecture, DevOps, QA, security, and operations to translate business and platform needs into durable technical solutions.
  • Champion engineering best practices for design, code quality, CI/CD, testing, monitoring, logging, tracing, and production operations.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on collaboration (individual contributor; no direct reports).
  • Drive continuous improvement in system performance, availability, scalability, fault tolerance, and maintainability across the voice platform.

Minimum Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience as a hands-on individual contributor, including staff/principal-level technical impact.
  • Proven ability to drive technical initiatives from architecture through production delivery.
  • Ability to provide technical guidance and influence engineering direction without formal authority.
  • Strong communication skills across engineering, product, and operations.
  • Experience supporting mission-critical, high-availability production systems.
  • Strong system design and analytical/problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to learn SIP/VoIP and real-time communications concepts quickly.
  • Ability to balance quality, performance, security, and delivery timelines.
  • AI-Assisted Engineering: Proficient with AI coding assistants and agentic dev tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Kiro, Claude, ChatGPT) across the SDLC — design exploration, code generation, test and documentation generation, large-scale refactoring, log and incident analysis. Strong judgment on when to trust, verify, or reject AI output, with attention to correctness, security, licensing, and data-privacy.
  • In depth knowledge of SIP, VoIP, RTP/SRTP.

Must Have (Core Technical Skills)

  • Languages:Java (strong), Python, C (systems/network-oriented software, or proven ability to ramp quickly).
  • Framework:Spring Boot, Spring; REST API design.
  • Experience building AI-powered features or internal tooling: integrating LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock), MCP servers/agents, RAG pipelines, embeddings, or vector databases. Experience applying AI/LLMs to observability and operations (e.g. automated log analysis, incident summarization, runbook generation). Awareness of AI safety, prompt-injection risks, and secure handling of code and data with third-party AI tools.
