jobs.description:
Senior Manager, Software Engineer

Location: US Remote


Ready to make a difference?

ICF is seeking a Senior Manager, Software Engineer to lead the engineering team responsible for Sightline ADAPT, a client-facing analytics and decision-support platform serving the utility and energy industries. This individual will directly manage a growing team of software and data engineers while owning the engineering roadmap, guiding major technical decisions, overseeing cloud and production practices, and establishing the standards required to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable products.


The successful candidate will combine strong people leadership with hands-on technical judgment, product thinking, and an AI-first mindset. They will guide Sightline ADAPT’s evolution from analytical workflows and rapidly developed prototypes into maintainable, supportable products while partnering with product and business leaders to align technical investments with user needs, client commitments, and business outcomes.

The Opportunity:

Sightline ADAPT is evolving from project-based analytical capabilities into a reusable platform that integrates customer, building, energy-usage, program, distributed-energy-resource, and grid data to support utility planning and implementation decisions. The team needs a senior software leader with demonstrated experience designing, launching, and scaling enterprise-grade analytical products.

This is not solely a hands-on development position. The successful candidate will establish the engineering practices, delivery model, technical direction, and governance needed to turn working prototypes and analytical methods into maintainable applications and shared platform capabilities.

Why you will love working here:

  • Quality of life: Flexible workplace arrangements, work-life balance
  • Investment of the community: Donation matching, volunteer opportunities
  • Investment in you: Tuition reimbursement, access to professional development resources, 401k matching, Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • And many, many more (Ask your recruiter for more details!)

What you will be doing:

People and Team Leadership

  • Directly manage an initial team of three engineers, with responsibility for performance management, coaching, career development, hiring, onboarding, and future team growth.
  • Set clear expectations, roles, decision rights, and development responsibilities while fostering a collaborative, accountable, and inclusive engineering culture.
  • Plan team capacity, assign work, remove delivery barriers, and help engineers grow their technical and leadership capabilities.
  • Provide engineering leadership across collaborating product, data science, analytics, consulting, infrastructure, security, and client-delivery teams.

Product Strategy and Delivery

  • Partner with product, consulting, and client leaders to understand user needs and translate utility use cases into prioritized product capabilities, technical requirements, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, release plans, and measurable outcomes.
  • Co-own the product and engineering roadmaps, balancing client commitments, reusable platform capabilities, technical investments, delivery risk, and available team capacity.
  • Lead delivery from discovery through production deployment and ongoing support, developing realistic estimates, staffing plans, implementation approaches, and dependency plans.
  • Identify risks and tradeoffs early, present clear recommendations, and use client feedback, adoption, operational results, and engineering insights to guide priorities and continuous improvement.

Engineering Leadership and Technical Direction

  • Establish standards for coding, testing, documentation, version control, code review, release management, and software quality.
  • Guide major technical decisions and the evolution of applications, APIs, shared services, data products, and client-specific configurations.
  • Ensure that prototypes have a defined path to production rather than becoming unsupported standalone applications.
  • Oversee the cloud, data, deployment, monitoring, and production practices needed to operate Sightline ADAPT securely and reliably in partnership with internal technology and governance teams.

AI-First Engineering and Product Innovation

  • Set an AI-first approach for software development, testing, documentation, operations, analytics, and product capabilities.
  • Help the team adopt AI-assisted engineering workflows while maintaining quality, privacy, security, intellectual-property protection, auditability, and human accountability.
  • Guide the delivery of AI-enabled features, including appropriate evaluation, monitoring, data governance, and human oversight.
  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies pragmatically and identify where they can improve the product or engineering effectiveness.

Client and Commercial Support

  • Serve as a senior technical authority in selected client meetings, demonstrations, discovery sessions, and solution reviews.
  • Translate client integration, security, data, and operational requirements into practical implementation approaches.
  • Support proposals, scopes of work, estimates, technical narratives, and delivery plans.
  • Communicate capabilities, limitations, dependencies, roadmap decisions, and delivery tradeoffs clearly to technical, client, and executive audiences.
  • Build client confidence in ICF’s ability to deliver and support enterprise-scale analytical applications.

What we need you to have (minimum qualifications):

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field.
  • 5+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including experience leading complex engineering or product initiatives.
  • Prior people management experience directly leading software or data engineers, including coaching, performance management, hiring, and team development.
  • Experience leading data-intensive, client-facing software products from development through production, scaling, and support in cloud environments.
  • Strong experience with Python, SQL, APIs, data engineering, front-end technologies, cloud services, CI/CD, and modern software development practices.
  • Experience setting technical roadmaps, leading cross-functional engineering initiatives, and applying AI-assisted development tools or AI-enabled capabilities.
  • Strong ability to communicate technical decisions, priorities, risks, and tradeoffs to technical, client, and executive audiences.

What we would like you to have:

  • Master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, information systems, or a related field.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, Databricks, Apache Spark, Docker.
  • Experience developing data-intensive SaaS platforms, analytical products, or configurable multi-client applications.
  • Experience with React, Next.js, FastAPI, .NET, or comparable modern full-stack application frameworks.
  • Experience operationalizing machine-learning, optimization, digital-twin, generative-AI, or agentic capabilities, including evaluation and monitoring.
  • Experience navigating enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, privacy, software-governance, and production-readiness reviews.
  • Experience with utility-sector data and analytical use cases, including customer, AMI, programs, DERs, forecasting, or distribution planning.
  • Familiarity with utility planning and operational technologies such as OpenDSS, CYME, Synergi, DERMS, or ADMS.
  • Experience supporting technical sales, proposals, demonstrations, client discovery, and modernization of analytical codebases or prototypes.

Working at ICF

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer. Together, our employees are empowered to share their expertise and collaborate with others to achieve personal and professional goals. For more information, please read our EEO policy.


We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.


Work Authorization and Sponsorship

All candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for new H-1B visa sponsorship by ICF. Candidates who currently hold valid work authorization may be considered for a change of employer petition, subject to company policy and applicable immigration requirements.

Reasonable Accommodations

Reasonable Accommodations are available, including, but not limited to, for disabled veterans, individuals with disabilities, and individuals with sincerely held religious beliefs, in all phases of the application and employment process. To request an accommodation, please email  and we will be happy to assist. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

Description

Channel Factory provides intelligent marketing solutions for the next generation of contextual safety, suitability, and performance for brands and agencies. Our platform helps marketers implement, automate, and scale their marketing programs across the world’s largest video library, YouTube, and emerging growth channels. We sit at the intersection of marketing and suitability and have a mission of enabling the world’s top brands to consciously connect with the right audience in the right context, maximizing suitability and contextual performance.

Channel Factory embodies a strong start-up culture that values diversity, collaboration, and results. Our bias towards execution balances critical thinking, analysis, and pragmatic problem solving. We expect a lot from one another and value our thoughtful and intellectually curious company culture. This position is a full-time role based in the United States. Remote work status is subject to change at any time.

We're looking for a detail-oriented and technically strong Media Buyer - Google Platforms to join our team. This role oversees the activation and management of YouTube advertising campaigns. You'll serve as a go-to resource for internal teams on buying best practices, platform policy, and campaign troubleshooting, all while maintaining a high standard of accuracy and responsiveness. The ideal candidate brings hands-on Google Ads experience, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to operate effectively within a fast-paced team.

Requirements

    • 3+ years of campaign management experience in Google Ads, including Google Ads Editor.
    • Experience with CM360 tracking and troubleshooting.
    • YouTube experience. Specifically, a working knowledge of different YouTube ad formats and their KPIs, including product mixes, Demand Gen, Shorts, and in-stream vs. in-feed ad types.
    • Proficiency in Google Sheets, including pivot tables, formula troubleshooting, and third-party integrations.
    • Comfortable working in a remote-ready tech stack including Slack, Salesforce, and Google Workspace.
    • Willingness to leverage AI tools that improve buying workflows, including setup, QA, bidding, and pacing.
    • Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities while consistently delivering accurate work and timely communication.
    • Ability to travel for team meetings, training, etc.
  • Bonus points for:
    • Working with conversion-based campaign goals, including online vs. offline conversion measurement, attribution and conversion reporting types, and conversion goal setup in Google Ads.
    • DV360 experience.
    • Bulk editing campaigns via spreadsheet imports and/or SDFs across Google platforms.
    • Familiarity with media deal types and their impact on pacing, including Guaranteed Outcomes, PMPs, and Auction vs. Reservation models.
    • Google Ads certifications.

Benefits

  • Work with a leading startup in a high-demand industry, and you would be working with like-minded experts aiming to transform video ad operations
  • Competitive salary
  • Comprehensive medical benefits (Medical, Vision, Dental, and Life Insurance)
  • Cell phone and Wifi Reimbursement
  • Work-life flexibility – we value your contributions above all

About Channel Factory

Founded in 2010, Channel Factory is an award-winning marketing technology company that helps top global brands and agencies maximize YouTube advertising. Recognized as a technology innovator by Cynopsis and one of the fastest-growing companies by Inc., Channel Factory has served over three hundred of the Fortune 500 in delivering scalable, brand-safe, contextually aligned YouTube advertising software and services. By tapping into the deepest proprietary data pool on the market, the company enables highly customized, contextually aware, and dynamically optimized campaigns and provides industry-leading performance for a portfolio of clients across all industries.

Channel Factory is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. Channel Factory makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time. The company also has employee resource groups focusing on encouraging inclusion and diversity in the workplace, including an LGBTQ+ committee.

About Rimini Street, Inc.

Rimini Street, Inc. (Nasdaq: RMNI), a Russell 2000® Company, is a proven, trusted global provider of end-to-end, mission-critical enterprise software support, managed services and innovative Agentic AI ERP solutions, and is the leading third-party support provider for Oracle, SAP and VMware software.

Our comprehensive portfolio of unified solutions help run, manage, support, customize, configure, connect, protect, monitor, and optimize enterprise application, database and technology software, enabling our clients to achieve better business outcomes, significantly reduce costs and reallocate resources towards strategic projects.

The Company has signed thousands of contracts with Fortune Global 100, Fortune 500, midmarket, public sector and government organizations who selected Rimini Street as their trusted, proven mission-critical enterprise software solutions provider and achieved better operational outcomes, realized billions of US dollars in savings and funded AI and other innovation investments.

We are actively seeking an experienced Sr. Director, AI Powered Service Delivery & Automation to join our team. This remote Brazil –based role reports to the GVP of Global Service Delivery Operations.

Position Summary

The Sr. Director, AI-Powered Service Delivery & Automation is responsible for defining and executing Rimini Street's AI-powered managed services strategy and leading the transformation of AMS from a labor-based support model to an intelligence-driven, automation-enabled service delivery organization. Leveraging AI, agentic workflows, AIOps, observability, and autonomous operations, this leader will design and scale capabilities that improve engineer productivity, automate service delivery activities, accelerate issue resolution, reduce cost-to-serve, and enhance client outcomes across ERP and cloud platforms.

This role is accountable for establishing and achieving measurable automation, AI adoption, productivity, service quality, and service economics targets across the AMS portfolio while driving the adoption of next-generation delivery capabilities globally.

The successful candidate will bring a proven track record of deploying AI and automation at scale within managed services environments and delivering measurable business outcomes through operational innovation. Success will be measured by increases in automated and AI-assisted resolution rates, reductions in manual engineering effort and cost-to-serve, improvements in service margins, and the establishment of scalable autonomous support capabilities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Lead AI-Powered Service Delivery Transformation

  • Define and execute the roadmap for AI-driven managed services across ERP and cloud platforms.
  • Identify and prioritize opportunities to automate diagnosis, triage, resolution, knowledge creation, documentation, and client communications.
  • Establish business cases, governance, and measurable objectives for automated resolution, ticket deflection, engineer productivity, service quality, and margin improvement.
  • Partner across Delivery, Engineering, AI, Product, and Operations teams to drive innovation and adoption.

Build AI-Enabled and Autonomous Service Operations

  • Design and deploy AI-powered assistants, copilots, agentic workflows, and enterprise knowledge capabilities that improve support effectiveness and consistency.
  • Leverage AI, large language models, automation platforms, and knowledge assets to automate support activities and enable autonomous service operations.
  • Establish standards for AI governance, operational controls, performance measurement, and responsible AI adoption.
  • Drive the transition from reactive support to predictive, proactive, and autonomous service delivery.
  • Design and deploy capabilities that increase automated and autonomous case resolution while reducing manual engineering effort.

Drive AIOps and Intelligent Operations

  • Implement AIOps, observability, monitoring, and analytics capabilities to predict, prevent, and remediate service disruptions.
  • Advance self-healing operations through automated remediation, anomaly detection, event correlation, and predictive service management.
  • Partner with ServiceNow and infrastructure teams to mature ITOM, CMDB, service mapping, discovery, and operational intelligence capabilities.

Lead AMS Delivery Transformation

  • Build and lead a global AMS Automation & AI Center of Excellence responsible for AI engineering, intelligent automation, service innovation, and next-generation delivery capabilities.
  • Transform AMS delivery from manual, case-driven execution to AI-assisted and automation-enabled workflows.

jobs.title: Group Head of Project Management Office (PMO) – Insurance & Investments
jobs.excerpt: Group Head of Project Management Office (PMO) – Insurance & Investments 1.
jobs.description:
Group Head of Project Management Office (PMO) – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Group Head of PMO is responsible for leading and overseeing the Group's project management function across all subsidiaries, business units, and geographical markets within the Insurance & Investments sector.

The role establishes group-wide project governance, portfolio management standards, delivery frameworks, and performance monitoring systems to ensure that strategic projects and transformation initiatives are executed effectively. The position provides centralized oversight of project priorities, budgets, resources, risks, dependencies, and expected business outcomes.

Working closely with the Group CEO, executive leadership, subsidiary CEOs, and business heads, the Group Head of PMO ensures that all major projects support the organization's strategic growth, operational efficiency, digital transformation, and long-term business objectives.

2. Key Responsibilities

Group PMO Strategy & Governance

  • Develop and implement the Group's overall Project Management Office strategy, structure, and operating framework.
  • Establish standardized project management methodologies, governance policies, procedures, and reporting requirements across all subsidiaries.
  • Define project approval processes, stage-gate reviews, escalation procedures, and accountability frameworks.
  • Ensure project portfolios are aligned with the Group's strategic objectives and business priorities.
  • Establish consistent project management standards and controls across geographical markets and business units.

Strategic Project Portfolio Management

  • Oversee the consolidated project portfolio across insurance, investment, corporate, and operational business units.
  • Evaluate, prioritize, and monitor strategic projects based on business value, financial impact, risk exposure, and resource requirements.
  • Monitor project progress, milestones, dependencies, budgets, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Identify underperforming projects and recommend corrective actions or changes in resource allocation.
  • Provide executive leadership with a consolidated view of project portfolio performance.

Insurance & Investment Project Oversight

  • Oversee group-wide projects involving insurance product development, underwriting, claims management, policy administration, and distribution expansion.
  • Monitor investment-related projects involving portfolio reporting, investment operations, wealth management platforms, and client servicing, where applicable.
  • Coordinate strategic initiatives involving regulatory compliance, business process modernization, and operational efficiency.
  • Support the implementation of new financial products, business models, and market expansion initiatives.
  • Ensure projects meet relevant insurance, investment, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.

Digital Transformation & Technology Projects

  • Provide governance and oversight for group-wide technology modernization and digital transformation initiatives.
  • Coordinate implementation of enterprise systems, CRM platforms, automation solutions, AI applications, and digital financial services.
  • Work with CIO, CTO, CDO, and business leadership to ensure successful technology project delivery.
  • Monitor system integration, implementation risks, technology budgets, and business adoption.
  • Ensure digital initiatives deliver measurable improvements in customer experience and operational performance.

Financial & Resource Management

  • Oversee consolidated project budgets, financial forecasts, and expenditure tracking across the Group.
  • Monitor project cost performance and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
  • Coordinate resource allocation across subsidiaries, departments, and strategic initiatives.
  • Evaluate project business cases, cost-benefit analysis, ROI, and expected benefits.
  • Ensure effective utilization of internal teams, external consultants, contractors, and implementation partners.

Risk, Compliance & Quality Management

  • Establish group-level project risk management and escalation frameworks.
  • Monitor operational, financial, regulatory, technology, and implementation risks across project portfolios.
  • Coordinate with group risk, compliance, legal, and internal audit functions.
  • Ensure projects comply with internal policies, governance standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Establish contingency and mitigation plans for critical projects and strategic programs.

Performance Reporting & Benefits Realization

  • Develop group-wide project dashboards, performance reports, and executive presentations.
  • Monitor project delivery against approved scope, budgets, timelines, milestones, and quality standards.
  • Track financial benefits, operational improvements, and ROI from strategic initiatives.
  • Prepare regular portfolio performance reports for the Group CEO, Board, and executive committees.
  • Recommend strategic interventions to improve project execution and delivery performance.

Stakeholder & Subsidiary Management

  • Work closely with subsidiary CEOs, managing directors, business unit heads, project sponsors, and program directors.
  • Facilitate group-level project steering committees and portfolio review meetings.
  • Coordinate project planning and delivery across subsidiaries and corporate functions.
  • Manage relationships with external consultants, technology vendors, contractors, and implementation partners.
  • Ensure consistent communication, accountability, and reporting across all Group entities.

Leadership & PMO Capability Development

  • Lead and develop the Group PMO team, including PMO directors, project managers, project analysts, and project controls specialists.
  • Establish PMO structures, responsibilities, and reporting relationships across subsidiaries.
  • Develop project management training, mentoring, and capability-building initiatives.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, transparency, collaboration, and delivery excellence.
  • Drive continuous improvement in project management maturity across the organization.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Project Management, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • MBA or Master's degree in Project Management, Business Strategy, Finance, or a relevant discipline preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in project management, program management, portfolio management, or enterprise transformation.
  • At least 5 years in a senior PMO leadership position overseeing multiple business units, subsidiaries, or large project portfolios.
  • Experience in insurance, reinsurance, banking, investment management, asset management, wealth management, or diversified financial services.
  • Proven track record of establishing or leading enterprise-level or group-level PMO functions.
  • Strong knowledge of project portfolio governance, financial management, resource planning, risk management, and strategic execution.
  • Experience managing complex, multi-country or multi-entity projects and transformation programs.
  • Knowledge of PMI, PRINCE2, Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid project management methodologies.
  • Strong leadership, executive communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and analytical capabilities.

Preferred Certifications:

- Project Management Professional (PMP).

  • Program Management Professional (PgMP).
  • Portfolio Management Professional (PfMP).

- PRINCE2 Practitioner.

- Agile or Scrum certifications.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Percentage of group-wide projects delivered on time and within approved budgets.
  • Overall project portfolio performance against Group strategic objectives.
  • Project cost variance and schedule variance.
  • Group PMO governance and reporting compliance.
  • Successful delivery of strategic insurance and investment initiatives.
  • Project risk identification, mitigation, and escalation effectiveness.
  • Resource utilization and allocation efficiency across subsidiaries.
  • Benefits realization and ROI of major strategic projects.
  • Accuracy and timeliness of consolidated project reporting.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction across Group entities.
  • Improvement in project management maturity across subsidiaries.
  • Reduction in project delays, cost overruns, and implementation risks.

jobs.title: Scrum Master (LATAM)
jobs.excerpt: We are seeking an experienced Scrum Master to support multiple Agile implementation teams—referred to as pods—within the Arc technology platform.
locationRestrictions: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Scrum Master to support multiple Agile implementation teams—referred to as pods—within the Arc technology platform.
The ideal candidate will facilitate Scrum practices, improve sprint execution, remove delivery impediments, and promote transparency across the pods. This role requires close collaboration with Product Owners, technical leads, Technical Project Managers, and delivery leadership.
The candidate will help teams improve their Agile maturity, maintain consistent delivery practices, and strengthen collaboration across teams. We are looking for a self-driven, proactive, and responsive professional who can take initiative, anticipate delivery challenges, communicate effectively, and work collaboratively with distributed teams.

Please submit your resume in English.

Key Responsibilities

Agile Delivery and Facilitation

  • Serve as Scrum Master for multiple software development pods, guiding teams in Scrum practices and continuous improvement.
  • Facilitate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, ensuring meetings are productive, timeboxed, and outcome-focused.
  • Lead the refinement and planning process while ensuring Product Owners retain responsibility for backlog maintenance and prioritization, and teams retain ownership of their commitments.
  • Track sprint health and delivery metrics, including velocity, commitment versus completion, and carryover, working with technical leads to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date JIRA boards to ensure transparency of work, capacity, progress, and delivery status.
  • Proactively identify potential delivery challenges, dependencies, and risks, taking initiative to address them before they impact sprint commitments.

Risk and Stakeholder Management

  • Identify, track, communicate, and help resolve pod-level risks, dependencies, and blockers.
  • Escalate cross-pod risks and delivery concerns to the appropriate Technical Project Manager.
  • Provide timely daily, weekly, and sprint-level delivery updates to Product Owners, Technical Project Managers, technology leadership, and stakeholders.
  • Assist Product Owners with the triage of User Acceptance Testing (UAT) issues, production support tickets, and software defects.
  • Facilitate effective communication between stakeholders and development teams.
  • Ensure follow-ups and action items are tracked through completion, maintaining responsiveness and accountability.
  • Prepare and present sprint status, delivery metrics, risks, and key updates to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Team Coaching and Continuous Improvement

  • Coach teams toward self-management, accountability, and cross-functional collaboration to focus on outcome results.
  • Foster a collaborative environment that encourages transparency, open communication, and continuous learning.
  • Help resolve team conflicts and remove barriers to effective collaboration.
  • Identify process improvements through retrospectives and track agreed actions through completion.
  • Support the adoption of approved AI tools that improve Agile practices, in accordance with organizational data policies.
  • Collaborate with other Scrum Masters to share best practices and promote consistency across teams.
  • Take initiative, and encourage others, to identify opportunities to improve team effectiveness, communication, and delivery processes without waiting for direction.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 5 years of experience as a Scrum Master supporting software development teams.
  • Experience supporting multiple Agile teams simultaneously.
  • Demonstrated ability to improve sprint execution and help teams deliver consistently.
  • Strong working knowledge of Scrum principles, roles, events, and artifacts.
  • Experience coaching teams toward self-management and continuous improvement.
  • Experience tracking, analyzing, and communicating sprint metrics.
  • Proficiency with JIRA, Smartsheet, or similar work management tools.
  • Familiarity with web technologies and the software development lifecycle.
  • Strong facilitation skills and the ability to keep meetings focused and productive.
  • Ability to resolve conflicts, build consensus, and influence without direct authority.
  • Ability to identify and remove blockers and determine when escalation is necessary.
  • Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to take ownership of responsibilities and independently drive activities to completion.
  • Responsive and dependable, with a strong sense of urgency in addressing team needs, stakeholder requests, and delivery issues.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to build effective working relationships with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and effectively with technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong presentation skills, including the ability to prepare and present sprint updates, delivery metrics, risks, and recommendations to leadership and stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Scrum certification, such as Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), PSM – AI Essentials, or SAFe Scrum Master.
  • Familiarity with Kanban and scaled Agile practices, such as Scrum of Scrums.
  • Familiarity with Evidence-Based Management (EBM) or other outcome-focused approaches to measuring team performance.
  • Experience using AI tools to support Agile teams, including meeting summaries, backlog refinement, or sprint analytics.
  • Experience supporting UAT and production support triage.
  • Experience working with mission-driven or nonprofit organizations.
Please list any relevant certifications in your application.

Education

Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or related field, or equivalent professional experience

All our positions are Remote and are available as Full Time Employment or B2B Contracts

AlphaGov delivers public-sector consulting for cities, counties, school systems, special districts, utilities, and related agencies. Our work spans classification and compensation, organizational and operational studies, research and program evaluation, economic and workforce analysis, surveys and community research, and applied data and infrastructure research.

Required

  • At least 5 years leading or co-leading superintendent or senior K-12 executive searches for school boards
  • A record of completed placements, with references from board chairs or district leaders
  • Experience running community engagement for a public search
  • Comfortable as a 1099 project-based consultant

Nice to have

  • Former superintendent, assistant superintendent, or school board member
  • Experience with open-meetings and public-records rules that apply to board searches
  • College president or city manager search experience

Position Description

  • Position Title: HR Administrator – Teneo (Voluntary Administration)
  • Reports To: HR Director (direct reporting line)
  • HR Advisor (day to day functional guidance)
  • Location: Offshore (remote) — Philippines
  • Working Hours: 9.00am to 5.00pm Australian Eastern Standard Time (AEST), Monday to Friday

This role follows the Australian business calendar and includes working on Philippines public holidays.


﻿Employment Type: Full time

Position Purpose

The HR Administrator provides administrative and record keeping support to the Human Resources function of The Infinity Group, working under the direct line management of the HR Director and the day to day functional guidance of the HR Advisor. This role is dedicated solely to stores administered by the Teneo Administrators, and is primarily responsible for HR record keeping, correspondence support, and assistance with the preparation and tracking of employment contracts for stores within its remit.

The role is administrative in nature and does not carry responsibility for performance management, disciplinary matters, investigations or terminations. All performance related matters must be escalated to the HR Advisor and/or HR Director immediately and are not to be handled or responded to by the HR Administrator, unless the response is administrative only i.e., lunch break hours confirmation, etc.

Key Responsibilities

HR Inbox and Query Support

  • Assist the HR Advisor in monitoring and managing the HR inbox on a daily basis for Teneo administered stores, ensuring queries are acknowledged and actioned within agreed timeframes.
  • Respond to routine, administrative HR queries from employees and store managers within Teneo administered stores in a professional, clear and accurate manner.
  • Identify and immediately escalate all performance related, disciplinary, investigation or termination related queries to the HR Advisor and/or HR Director. No response is to be provided on these matters by the HR Administrator.
  • Maintain accurate records of correspondence and queries in accordance with company record keeping requirements.

﻿Records, Contract and Document Administration

  • Prepare and populate new employment contracts and contract variations for Teneo administered stores in accordance with approved templates and instructions, for checking by the HR Advisor prior to submission for approval.
  • Maintain and update contract trackers, workbooks and personnel records relevant to Teneo administered stores, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
  • Support the tracking of contract and correspondence approval status with the Teneo Administrators, and follow up outstanding items in a timely manner under the direction of the HR Advisor.
  • Maintain accurate offboarding and personnel data in Employment Hero and ClockOn as directed.

General Administrative Support

  • Provide day to day administrative support to the HR Director, HR Advisor and broader HR team.
  • Assist with the preparation, formatting and distribution of HR correspondence and documentation as directed.
  • Maintain confidentiality of all employee and company information at all times.
  • Undertake other administrative duties as reasonably required by the HR Director or HR Advisor.

Key Selection Criteria

Essential

  • Strong administrative and organisational skills with high attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Microsoft Teams and Excel.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Availability to work 9.00am to 5.00pm Australian Eastern Standard Time, Monday to Friday, in line with the Australian business calendar, including on Philippines public holidays.
  • A strong understanding of confidentiality requirements when handling employee information.

Desirable

  • Working knowledge of the Fair Work Act 2009 (Cth), the National Employment Standards and the Pharmacy Industry Award.
  • General understanding of Australian human resources and industrial relations principles.
  • Familiarity with Employment Hero (Desired but not essential)
  • Familiarity with ClockOn (Desired but not essential)

Key Relationships

  • HR Director (direct report line and escalation point for all performance related matters).
  • HR Advisor (day to day functional guidance and task allocation).
  • Internal HR and payroll team members.
  • Store managers and store level personnel within Teneo administered stores.
  • Administrators (Teneo), for contract and correspondence approval purposes.

jobs.description:
About the company

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. This is a task-based, independent contractor opportunity, not an employment relationship. Participation is limited to this project.

Project Highlights

  • Earnings per approved task: a fixed rate for each task, set in advance
  • Fully self-scheduled: no minimum hours and no set schedule; you choose which tasks to take and when
  • Remote: open to US-licensed physicians based in eligible US states
  • No patient contact, no malpractice exposure: you review written clinical cases
  • All contributors are license-verified physicians
  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved

What this project involves

We're looking for physicians (MD/DO) with an active, unrestricted US medical license to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. Each task is a written clinical case, assessed against the project's acceptance criteria. Contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor "trap" answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales.

Each case receives three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You're improving the AI tools you'll eventually use yourself.

What we look for

This project is a good fit for US-licensed physicians looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around their other commitments. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with direct patient care experience (attending-level preferred). Practising or retired physicians welcome;
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
  • Strong written English (C1+).

This project is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join the project → Complete tasks → Get paid for approved tasks

Flexibility

You decide whether, when, and how much to contribute. There are no minimum hours, set schedules, or required availability. Task availability varies with project phases. Tasks are submitted through the platform and are approved when they meet the project’s acceptance criteria.

Earnings

Earnings are paid only for completed and approved tasks. Each task type has a fixed rate. There is no time tracking and no hour logging. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the rate. QA and adjudication tasks have a higher per-task rate.

  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved.
  • Quality incentives: additional earnings for high-quality approved tasks, on terms set out in the project guidelines.

Chief Transformation Officer (CTO) – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Chief Transformation Officer (CTO) is responsible for leading enterprise-wide transformation initiatives to improve organizational performance, operational efficiency, business agility, and long-term competitiveness across the insurance and investment businesses.

The role involves developing and executing the organization's transformation strategy, modernizing business models, optimizing operating structures, driving digital adoption, and leading strategic change programs. The CTO will work closely with the CEO, Board, and executive leadership team to translate corporate strategy into measurable transformation outcomes.

The ideal candidate will combine strategic leadership, financial and operational expertise, technology awareness, and strong change management capabilities, with a proven track record of delivering complex transformation initiatives in insurance, investment management, banking, or financial services.

2. Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Transformation Strategy

  • Develop and execute the organization's enterprise-wide transformation strategy and roadmap.
  • Identify opportunities to improve business performance, operational effectiveness, profitability, and organizational agility.
  • Align transformation priorities with corporate strategy, market conditions, and long-term business objectives.
  • Evaluate existing business models, organizational structures, and operating processes to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Establish transformation objectives, milestones, governance frameworks, and measurable success criteria.

Business Model & Operating Model Transformation

  • Lead initiatives to modernize business models, operating structures, and service delivery frameworks.
  • Drive organizational restructuring, process redesign, and business integration initiatives.
  • Improve operational efficiency across insurance underwriting, claims, policy administration, distribution, and customer service.
  • Support transformation of investment operations, portfolio reporting, client servicing, and wealth management processes, where applicable.
  • Develop scalable operating models to support business expansion, diversification, and organizational growth.

Digital & Technology Transformation

  • Lead technology-enabled business transformation initiatives in collaboration with the CIO, CTO, and CDO.
  • Drive adoption of automation, AI, advanced analytics, cloud solutions, and digital platforms.
  • Modernize legacy systems, enterprise applications, and operational infrastructure.
  • Oversee transformation programs involving InsurTech, FinTech, digital insurance, and investment platforms.
  • Ensure technology investments deliver measurable improvements in productivity, customer experience, and business performance.

Financial & Operational Performance Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve profitability, reduce operating costs, and optimize resource utilization.
  • Lead cost transformation, process efficiency, and productivity improvement programs.
  • Establish performance management frameworks and operational KPIs.
  • Evaluate transformation business cases, financial benefits, investment requirements, and expected returns.
  • Monitor cost savings, revenue improvements, and overall financial impact of transformation initiatives.

Organizational Change Management

  • Develop and implement change management strategies to support enterprise transformation.
  • Build organizational readiness and secure leadership and employee engagement.
  • Lead communication, training, and stakeholder engagement initiatives during transformation programs.
  • Address resistance to change and promote a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Support leadership development and workforce transformation initiatives.

Customer & Business Experience Transformation

  • Drive initiatives to improve customer journeys and service delivery across insurance and investment businesses.
  • Collaborate with the Chief Experience Officer and commercial leadership to improve customer satisfaction, retention, and engagement.
  • Simplify customer onboarding, claims processing, policy renewals, investment transactions, and client servicing.
  • Promote customer-centric operating models and consistent service standards.
  • Use customer insights and analytics to identify transformation priorities.

Risk, Governance & Regulatory Transformation

  • Ensure transformation initiatives align with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.
  • Work with risk, compliance, legal, and internal audit teams to strengthen organizational controls.
  • Lead initiatives to improve regulatory reporting, risk management processes, and governance frameworks.
  • Assess transformation-related operational, financial, technology, and regulatory risks.
  • Establish appropriate controls and accountability throughout transformation programs.

Strategic Projects, M&A & Business Integration

  • Oversee major strategic transformation programs, including mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures, and post-merger integration.
  • Lead integration of business processes, systems, teams, and organizational structures following acquisitions.
  • Support new market entry, geographic expansion, and business diversification initiatives.
  • Coordinate cross-functional transformation projects involving multiple subsidiaries and business units.
  • Track project outcomes and ensure delivery of expected strategic and financial benefits.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Work closely with the CEO, Board, executive team, and business unit heads to establish transformation priorities.
  • Lead transformation offices, program directors, project managers, and cross-functional teams.
  • Establish transformation governance, reporting structures, and performance accountability.
  • Manage relationships with external consultants, technology partners, and implementation specialists.
  • Present transformation progress, business impact, risks, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership and the Board.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • MBA or Master's degree in Business Strategy, Organizational Development, Finance, or Transformation Management preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in corporate strategy, business transformation, management consulting, operational excellence, or enterprise change management.
  • At least 5 years in a senior executive or leadership role overseeing large-scale transformation initiatives.
  • Significant experience in insurance, banking, investment management, asset management, wealth management, or financial services.
  • Proven track record of leading complex enterprise transformation programs with measurable financial and operational outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of insurance operations, investment services, financial products, and regulated business environments.
  • Experience in operating model redesign, organizational restructuring, digital transformation, and process optimization.
  • Strong financial acumen, strategic planning, and business performance management capabilities.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder engagement, and change management skills.

Preferred Certifications:

  • Prosci Change Management Certification.
  • Certified Business Transformation Professional (CBTP).
  • PMP or Program Management Professional (PgMP).

- Lean Six Sigma Black Belt.

- Agile or Scrum certifications.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Achievement of enterprise transformation milestones.
  • Cost savings and operational efficiency improvements.
  • Revenue growth and profitability improvements resulting from transformation.
  • Reduction in process turnaround times and operational bottlenecks.
  • Successful implementation of new operating models and business processes.

- Digital adoption and automation rates.

  • Customer satisfaction and service delivery improvements.
  • Employee engagement and organizational change adoption.
  • Successful integration of acquired businesses and strategic partnerships.
  • Realization of expected transformation benefits and ROI.
  • Regulatory compliance and risk management effectiveness.
  • Delivery of transformation initiatives within approved budgets and timelines.

    • Recommend improvements to increase reliability and operational efficiency.

    • Participate in root cause analysis and corrective action planning.
  • Documentation & Reporting

    • Generate system health, availability, and performance reports.

Job Title: Sr. Director, Digital Pricing Strategy

Job Location: Remote

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Job Description Summary

GE HealthCare is undergoing a significant customer and business model transformation, driven by the acquisition of Intelerad and the expansion of innovative software, SaaS, and cloud-based solutions. These solutions are designed to address some of the most complex challenges in the healthcare industry.

This role is a critical leadership position supporting GE HealthCare’s transition to a SaaS-first software business model. As part of a global, cross-functional environment, the Sr. Director of Digital Pricing Strategy will define and operationalize pricing and monetization strategies across newly integrated organizations. This role will play a key part in aligning commercial, finance, and product teams while driving profitable growth and long-term scalability.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Pricing Design

Develop and lead global pricing strategies for SaaS and cloud-based offerings, ensuring alignment with overall business objectives across AI, digital, and enterprise software solutions. Drive pricing transformation as core products evolve to a cloud-first model.

SaaS Monetization & Business Model Transformation

Lead the design and implementation of modern SaaS monetization strategies, including ARR growth, net revenue retention (NRR), attach rate expansion, price realization, and margin optimization. Drive the evolution from legacy licensing models to scalable subscription, consumption, and platform-based pricing models.

Post-Acquisition Integration & Change Leadership

Partner across legacy organizations to harmonize pricing strategies, tools, and operating models following the Intelerad acquisition. Lead change management efforts to ensure adoption of new pricing frameworks and foster alignment across commercial, finance, and product teams.

Market Awareness & Competitive Intelligence

Analyze market trends, competitor pricing, and customer insights to inform pricing strategy. Stay current on industry trends, regulatory environments, and best practices in SaaS and healthcare software markets.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Collaborate closely with Sales, Finance, Product Management, Legal, Professional Services, and Marketing to ensure pricing strategies align with go-to-market objectives. Engage early in product development cycles to incorporate customer value and market needs into pricing models.

Product Pricing & Enterprise Structuring

Partner with product teams to design scalable pricing structures across multi-product portfolios. Ensure pricing models support enterprise agreements spanning multiple offerings, customer segments, and healthcare modalities.

Platform & Advanced Pricing Models

Develop and implement modern SaaS pricing approaches, including platform pricing, subscription models, consumption-based pricing, and outcome-based pricing for strategic enterprise customers. Utilize advanced pricing analytics, segmentation, and elasticity modeling.

Deal Structuring & Commercial Execution

Provide hands-on leadership in structuring complex enterprise deals, including pricing, packaging, and multi-solution offerings. Translate pricing strategy into actionable sales tools, guidance, and scalable frameworks to support field execution.

Performance Forecasting & Financial Partnership

Collaborate with Finance to develop revenue forecasts, financial models, and KPI tracking frameworks for SaaS products. Ensure pricing decisions directly support margin expansion and long-term profitability.

Executive Communication & Reporting

Develop clear, data-driven pricing dashboards and insights for executive leadership. Present pricing strategies, forecasts, and performance metrics to senior stakeholders.

Change Management & Enablement

Lead organizational adoption of pricing strategies through change management, training, and communication. Equip Sales and Commercial teams with tools and frameworks to support complex SaaS transactions.

Annual Pricing Strategy

Design scalable pricing adjustments and annual increase strategies based on market data, customer value, and financial performance, ensuring measurable impact to revenue growth.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • Minimum of 10+ years of experience in pricing strategy, monetization, or related fields, preferably within SaaS or cloud-based environments
  • Proven experience building or transforming pricing models in SaaS or subscription-based businesses
  • Demonstrated success driving monetization strategy, including ARR, NRR, and margin optimization
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate market data into actionable pricing strategies
  • Extensive experience with financial modeling, forecasting, and pricing analytics tools
  • Experience structuring complex, enterprise-level deals and commercial agreements
  • Excellent cross-functional leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives in a fast-paced environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare or healthcare technology
  • Experience in late-stage SaaS, cloud-first, or private equity-backed organizations
  • Exposure to post-M&A integration and business transformation initiatives
  • Experience working with large enterprise customers and global commercial teams

Leadership Expectations & Work Environment

  • Operates as a strategic leader without direct reports initially, with potential to build a team over time
  • Thrives in a highly cross-functional, global environment
  • Demonstrates strong influence across Product, Finance, and Commercial leadership
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and building structure in a transforming organization
  • Balances strategic thinking with hands-on execution, particularly in deal structuring and pricing implementation

Why This Role

This is a unique opportunity to help define pricing and monetization strategy for GE HealthCare’s evolution into a SaaS-first enterprise. The role sits at the center of a major post-acquisition transformation and will directly impact revenue growth, margin expansion, and how digital solutions are delivered to healthcare systems globally.

We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. For U.S. based positions only, the pay range for this position is $140,000.00-$210,000.00 Annual. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the pay range and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including skills, qualifications, experience and location. In addition, this position may also be eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). GE HealthCare offers a competitive benefits package, including not but limited to medical, dental, vision, paid time off, a 401(k) plan with employee and company contribution opportunities, life, disability, and accident insurance, and tuition reimbursement.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. As Senior Occupancy Planner, you will be responsible for providing strategic occupancy planning expertise, leveraging a deep understanding of our client’s space supply and demand to develop scenario and occupancy plans for our client's portfolio in a designated region.

Fostering relationships

You'll foster critical relationships between various individuals and organizations, including:

  • Corporate Real Estate to review and resolve planning forecast requirements, concerns, and issues,
  • Business Unit leadership to collect headcount forecasts and resolve headcount forecast discrepancies between their numbers and those collected at the group level,
  • Corporate Finance group to gather top-down headcount and growth projections,

  • Move coordination and facility management teams to review and approve moves, develop migration plans, and conduct facility audits, and
  • Other members of the occupancy planning team to ensure the development of portfolio strategy plans across separate locations.

Driving optimal occupancy planning solutions

Your primary focus areas for this role will be managing the development of occupancy plans, sequencing group-level and individual moves, and resolving planning issues identified during client planning sessions. You will ensure the alignment of planning with corporate guidelines and that all scenarios maximize the use of space. You will recommend, educate, and enforce space policies/standards, procedures, and protocols, notify the client of customer-requested exceptions, and, as necessary, assist in developing site-specific Planning Strategies with Senior Leadership. You will be a Subject Matter Expert in the client's workplace program and in using data to drive solutions that increase productivity. You will be a leader in the Occupancy Planning and account team, modelling superior client relationship management and strategic thinking.

Reporting

One of your major requirements will be to get familiar with space utilization methods and the presentation of utilization data. Interacting with organizational leadership, you will identify space requirements and prepare and update project status reports on actual versus projected seat demand at the building level. In addition, you will report on current supply and capacity, forecast inventory changes as required, and work with the client to reconcile any discrepancies from top-down projections.

About the Role

We’re looking for a detail-oriented and organized Remote Bookkeeper to support the finance team with day-to-day accounting and administrative tasks for a property management portfolio.

In this role, you’ll work primarily with AppFolio and QuickBooks Online to manage accounts payable and receivable, process payments, reconcile bank and trust accounts, maintain accurate financial records, and support month-end reporting.

You’ll handle a high volume of daily transactions and work closely with the Director of Finance, while communicating with vendors, tenants, property owners, and internal team members. The ideal candidate has bookkeeping experience, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage financial tasks independently in a remote environment.

What You’ll Own

Accounts Payable

  • Review, code, and enter vendor invoices in AppFolio.
  • Create in-house maintenance invoices and bill tenants for tenant-caused repairs.
  • Follow up on past-due invoices and respond to vendor payment inquiries.
  • Maintain accurate vendor records, including W-9s, insurance documents, and payment methods.
  • Prepare 1099 forms.

Accounts Receivable & Tenant Ledgers

  • Post and reconcile rent receipts, deposits, and chargebacks.
  • Prepare move-out security deposit dispositions within required timelines.
  • Track overdue tenant payments and follow established collection policies.
  • Maintain accurate collections logs and tenant account records.

Bank & Trust Reconciliations

  • Reconcile operating, rent trust, and security deposit trust accounts daily.
  • Investigate and resolve outstanding items, non-sufficient funds (NSF) transactions, and unmatched payments.
  • Ensure financial transactions are accurately recorded and reconciled.

Month-End & Administrative Support

  • Generate month-end reports and gather supporting documentation for the Director of Finance.
  • Process owner distributions once approved.
  • Monitor the finance inbox and respond to or route inquiries from owners, tenants, and staff.
  • Keep owner, tenant, and vendor contact and payment information up to date.

Company Bookkeeping – QuickBooks Online

  • Record receipts and expenses for company entities.
  • Review and accurately categorize financial transactions.
  • Prepare weekly billable-hours reports.
  • Support commission and payroll data preparation.

Required Experience & Skills

  • At least 2 years of experience in bookkeeping or accounting support, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, and bank reconciliations.
  • Proficiency in AppFolio and QuickBooks Online.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
  • Strong data entry skills with excellent accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage a high volume of daily transactions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for working with owners, tenants, vendors, and internal teams.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment and follow established procedures.

  • Associate's or bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • Experience in property management accounting.
  • Familiarity with tenant ledgers, owner distributions, and security deposit accounting.
  • Experience maintaining vendor records and preparing 1099 forms.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You are highly organized and comfortable handling detailed, repetitive financial tasks.
  • You can manage multiple accounting priorities while maintaining accuracy.
  • You take ownership of daily responsibilities and follow established processes.
  • You proactively investigate discrepancies and follow up on unresolved transactions.
  • You communicate professionally and handle sensitive financial information with discretion.

What Success Looks Like

jobs.description:
What success looks like in this role:

U.S. Citizenship and Residency Required


Job Summary:

We are seeking a motivated Automation Engineer with 3-5 years of experience to replace repetitive manual tasks across our Steady State teams (Windows, Linux, Storage, and Backup) with reliable, reusable automation. The role focuses on automating patch management across the environment using tools such as Ansible, GitLab CI/CD, HashiCorp Vault, Terraform, and the JFrog Artifactory suite (Xray, Catalog, and Curation).


Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with Windows, Linux, storage, and backup teams to understand patch management cycles and identify opportunities to automate patching activities.
  • Analyze ServiceNow patching tickets to identify recurring manual tasks and quantify their frequency and effort across Windows, Linux, storage, and backup environments.
  • Prioritize patch management automation opportunities based on patch severity, operational risk, and impact across Windows, Linux, storage, and backup systems.
  • Develop reusable Ansible playbooks and roles to automate patch management procedures
  • Use Terraform to maintain repeatable infrastructure configurations that support patch management workflows.
  • Build and maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines to package, test, and safely deploy patch management automation to production.
  • Manage secrets, credentials, and certificates required by automated patching workflows through HashiCorp Vault.
  • Use JFrog Artifactory, including Xray, Catalog, and Curation, to manage and secure artifacts used by patch management pipelines.
  • Validate automated patching workflows against existing manual procedures before replacing manual patching activities.
  • Track and report on patch automation coverage and reductions in manual patching effort and related ticket volume across Windows, Linux, storage, and backup systems.
  • Document patch management procedures, Ansible playbooks, and pipeline configurations for Windows, Linux, storage, and backup environments.
  • Regularly review patching ticket trends to identify recurring manual work and keep the patch automation backlog current.

You will be successful in this role if you have:

  • BA/BS degree or equivalent experience and 3-5 years of experience in infrastructure operations, patch management, or related engineering roles, including patching automation.
  • Hands-on experience using Ansible, Terraform, GitLab CI/CD, and HashiCorp Vault to support production patch management workflows.

jobs.excerpt: Who You’ll Work WithAs a Layer1 software engineer, you will get to work on software that manages the physical layer, where packets meet the outside world.
jobs.description:
Who You’ll Work With

As a Layer1 software engineer, you will get to work on software that manages the physical layer, where packets meet the outside world. Stable and reliable physical connectivity is critical for any network and that is your challenge. You will get to write control software that brings to life everything from the ubiquitous 1GBASE-T connectors to 400G long reach optics that provide fiber connectivity across continents. Your software will need to work across a wide variety of forwarding engines, connectors and interface chips called gearboxes, which allow our hardware platforms to support diverse physical connectivity options within a product family. You will build instrumentation and telemetry tools that track physical link health parameters reported by the Layer1 components and enable operators to monitor and troubleshoot their links effectively. You will also work closely with our Optics teams to define standards for new media and bring them to market.

Arista Software Engineering roles demand a strong and broad software engineering background. While the primary focus area for this role is Layer1 software, the role will cover all aspects of software development spanning the addition of new features, debugging problems and fine tuning code for scalability and performance. You will own your projects from definition to deployment and customer interactions, and you will be responsible for the quality of everything you deliver.

Arista Software Engineering prides itself on a supportive and growth oriented culture. Over time, as your interests change, coupled with evolving business needs you will have the opportunity to switch from Layer1 to other areas, if you like.

What You’ll Do

  • Interface with customers, product management and hardware engineers to come up with innovative new Layer1 features.
  • Architect, design and manage the development of these features.
  • Develop and maintain features using C, C++ and Python, review and contribute to functional and design specifications. Build automated tests and test infrastructure to test the features.
  • Work with hardware and manufacturing teams to bring new Layer1 components like Phys and Transceivers to market.
  • Collaborate with hardware engineers to design optimal software control interfaces for managing Layer1 components.
  • Provide technical leadership across features, projects and tools.
  • Work with Customer Support Engineers and customers to analyze, mitigate and fix problems in customer networks.
  • Work with the System Test Engineers to analyze problems found in their tests and provide fixes for those problems.
  • Mentor new and junior engineers to bring them up to speed in Arista's software development environment.
  • BS Computer Science/Electrical Engineering/Computer Engineering + 8 years experience, or equivalent work experience
  • Expert knowledge of C or C++ and Python.
  • Knowledge of UNIX or Linux
  • Knowledge of digital communication technologies like modulation and signal encoding schemes is a plus.
  • Understanding of IP networking and/or distributed systems is a plus
  • Experience working with low level hardware components is a plus
  • Applied understanding of software engineering principles
  • Strong problem solving and software troubleshooting skills
  • Ability to design a solution and implement features independently.
  • Ability to work in small teams.

Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. What sets us apart is our relentless pursuit of innovation. We leverage the latest advancements in cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and software-defined networking to provide our clients with a competitive edge in an increasingly interconnected world. Our solutions are designed to not only meet the current demands of the digital landscape but to also anticipate and adapt to future challenges.

At Arista we value the diversity of thought and perspectives that each employee brings to the table. We believe that fostering an inclusive environment, where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome, is essential for driving creativity and innovation.

Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as Best Engineering Team, Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest standards of quality and performance in everything we do.

jobs.description:
Pelago is the leading specialty substance use care provider, built on the belief that effective treatment means matching care intensity to what each member actually needs rather than defaulting to the most expensive intervention. Our programs guide members through every stage of the substance use spectrum, from unhealthy habits to active use disorders, delivering personalized treatment for tobacco, alcohol, opioid, cannabis, and stimulant use based on individual health, habits, genetics, and goals.

With Sona, our voice-first AI Mental Health Specialist, Pelago now applies that same clinically-driven model to mental health, pairing deep clinical expertise with technology to expand access without compromising care quality. We believe technology should make clinical care more precise and more human, not replace the judgment behind it.

Pelago has scaled to helping hundreds of employers and health plans and has already helped more than 750,000 members better manage their substance use. If you're passionate about AI and making an impact on the health of others, join us and make it happen!

Overview of the Role


We are seeking a Care Specialist to join our digital clinic and help members achieve healthier, more fulfilling lives. As the first point of contact, the Care Specialist plays a vital role in creating a welcoming onboarding experience and helping members successfully begin their care journey at Pelago. This role is primarily focused on conducting intake assessments, welcome calls, and initial clinical screenings, educating members on Pelago's care model, and connecting them with the appropriate ongoing care team.

Approximately 70% of this role is dedicated to member onboarding activities, including intakes, welcome calls, and care coordination. The remaining 30% focuses on maintaining a small ongoing caseload and providing flexible clinical support through temporary member coverage, pilot initiatives, and other operational needs. The ideal candidate is clinically strong, adaptable, enjoys variety, and is passionate about improving access to high-quality substance use care.
This is a direct-service, remote clinical role based anywhere in the USA.

In this role you will…
  • Serve as the first clinical point of contact for members entering Pelago, creating a welcoming, supportive onboarding experience.
  • Conduct initial screenings and intake assessments to evaluate behavioral health history, substance use, symptoms, and member goals.
  • Understand all Pelago care pathways, effectively communicate treatment options to members, and guide them toward the most appropriate level of care.
  • Facilitate warm transitions by connecting members with their assigned counselor or coach and sharing relevant clinical information to support continuity of care.
  • Conduct welcome calls and other early member touchpoints to build rapport, answer questions, increase engagement, and ensure a smooth transition into ongoing care.
  • Maintain a small ongoing caseload by providing individual counseling, monitoring progress toward behavior change goals, and supporting members as needed.
  • Provide temporary member coverage during clinician leave, staffing transitions, or other operational needs.
  • Support special projects, pilot programs, and new clinical workflows as needed.
  • Document member interactions thoroughly and contribute to ongoing quality improvement efforts.
  • Utilize evidence-based approaches including CBT, Motivational Interviewing (MI), mindfulness-based interventions, harm reduction techniques, and relapse prevention.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (including Product, Clinical, and Operations) to optimize the member experience and inform service improvements.
  • Maintain active licensure(s)/certification(s) in good standing and ensure compliance with all applicable regulations.

The background we are looking for...

  • 3+ years of clinical experience working with individuals with substance use disorders, with demonstrated expertise in CBT, MI, and relapse prevention.
  • Hold an active and unrestricted state credential (license/certification), issued via a state credentialing board. Multi-state licensure is preferred.
  • Credentialing recognized by IC&RC or NAADAC is required (e.g., AADC, CAADC, LADC, LCSW with SUD treatment scope, etc.).
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.

Additional Qualifications

  • Experience providing SBIRT care for people with SUDs.
  • Excellent attention to detail and strong documentation skills.
  • Experience in program development and quality assurance in clinical settings.
  • Strong communication and organizational skills, with a track record of managing competing priorities.
  • Technologically proficient with experience leveraging virtual tools for care delivery.
  • Bonus: Experience with research, data analysis, or program evaluation.
  • Reliable home office setup with 50–100 Mbps internet bandwidth and a confidential workspace.

The provided range reflects our US target salary range for this full-time position, which is part of our broader total compensation package, including incentive bonus program, stock options, comprehensive benefits, and incentive pay applicable to eligible roles. Individual pay within the range will vary based on a variety of factors like role-related experience and education, internal pay equity, and other relevant business factors. At Pelago, we are committed to an equitable and fair pay philosophy and review total compensation for our employees at least twice a year.
